Description: Serverless Step Functions workflow that publishes custom events to a custom EventBridge event bus, with a rule forwarding all events to CloudWatch Logs for testing and debugging.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Environment name used in resource naming.

Resources:
  LogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting CloudWatch Logs log groups.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'

  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-custom-bus'

  EventLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn: LogsKmsKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/events/${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-custom-bus'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn: LogsKmsKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/states/${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-workflow'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

  ForwardAllEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-forward-all-events'
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ''
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudWatchLogsTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt EventLogGroup.Arn

  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsPutEventsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  WorkflowStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-workflow'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "StartAt": "SendCustomEvent",
            "States": {
              "SendCustomEvent": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::events:putEvents",
                "Parameters": {
                  "Entries": [
                    {
                      "Source": "custom.workflow",
                      "DetailType": "CustomWorkflowEvent",
                      "Detail": "{\"message\":\"Hello from Step Functions\",\"environment\":\"${Environment}\"}",
                      "EventBusName": "${EventBusName}"
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
          Environment: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  CustomEventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus

  CustomEventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref WorkflowStateMachine

  EventLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group receiving forwarded events.
    Value: !Ref EventLogGroup

  ForwardAllEventsRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule forwarding all events to CloudWatch Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt ForwardAllEventsRule.Arn

  LogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the log groups.
    Value: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

Description: >
  Creates an AWS RAM resource share named MyResourceShare for internal
  (same-organization) sharing. A VPC and subnet are created in this template
  and the subnet is shared via the AWS-managed subnet permission. VPC Flow Logs
  are enabled for rejected traffic and delivered to a CMK-encrypted CloudWatch
  Logs log group. Principals (accounts/OUs) are added post-deployment.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC created for the shared subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the subnet that will be shared.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment for tagging.

  Project:
    Type: String
    Default: MyResourceShare
    Description: Project name for tagging.

Resources:
  SharedVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-shared-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

            Principal:

        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SharedVpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:

      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'

          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

        - PolicyName: SharedVpcFlowLogWritePolicy

                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups

              - Sid: UseFlowLogKmsKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SharedVpcFlowLog:

      LogDestination: !GetAtt SharedVpcFlowLogGroup.Arn

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ResourceShare:
    Type: AWS::RAM::ResourceShare
    Properties:
      Name: MyResourceShare
      AllowExternalPrincipals: false
      PermissionArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ram::aws:permission/AWSRAMDefaultPermissionSubnet'
      ResourceArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${SharedSubnet}'
      Tags:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CodePipeline custom action type for deploying to AWS OpsWorks via a backing
  Lambda function. Self-contained for a greenfield account: creates the IAM
  role, KMS key, CloudWatch log group, Lambda function, and the custom action
  type.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment tag applied to all resources.
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

Resources:
  OpsWorksDeployLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt the OpsWorks deploy Lambda CloudWatch log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-opsworks-deploy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  OpsWorksDeployLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn: OpsWorksDeployLogKey
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-opsworks-deploy'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt OpsWorksDeployLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  OpsWorksDeployRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-opsworks-deploy-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OpsWorksDeployPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - opsworks:CreateDeployment
                  - opsworks:DescribeStacks
                  - opsworks:DescribeApps
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt OpsWorksDeployLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  OpsWorksDeployFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-opsworks-deploy'
      Description: Backing Lambda handler for the Deploy to OpsWorks CodePipeline custom action.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt OpsWorksDeployRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_GROUP_NAME: !Ref OpsWorksDeployLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              print("Received event: " + json.dumps(event))

              user_params = event.get("CodePipeline.job", {}).get("data", {}) \
                  .get("actionConfiguration", {}).get("configuration", {}).get("UserParameters", "{}")
              try:
                  params = json.loads(user_params) if isinstance(user_params, str) else user_params
              except ValueError:
                  params = {}

              bucket = params.get("Deploy-Bucket")
              stack_id = params.get("OpsWorks-Stack-ID")
              app_id = params.get("OpsWorks-App-ID")

              if not (bucket and stack_id and app_id):
                  raise ValueError("Deploy-Bucket, OpsWorks-Stack-ID and OpsWorks-App-ID are required")

              client = boto3.client("opsworks")
              response = client.create_deployment(
                  StackId=stack_id,
                  AppId=app_id,
                  Command={
                      "Name": "deploy",
                      "Args": {"bucket": bucket}
                  }
              )
              print("CreateDeployment response: " + json.dumps(response, default=str))
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"deploymentId": response.get("DeploymentId")})}
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  OpsWorksDeployActionType:
    Type: AWS::CodePipeline::CustomActionType
    Properties:
      Category: Deploy
      Provider: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Version: '1'
      InputArtifactDetails:
        MaximumCount: 1
        MinimumCount: 1
      OutputArtifactDetails:
        MaximumCount: 0
        MinimumCount: 0
      ConfigurationProperties:
        - Name: Deploy-Bucket
          Description: S3 bucket containing the deployment artifact.
          Required: true
          Key: false
          Secret: false
          Type: String
        - Name: OpsWorks-Stack-ID
          Description: OpsWorks stack ID to deploy to.
          Required: true
          Key: false
          Secret: false
          Type: String
        - Name: OpsWorks-App-ID
          Description: OpsWorks application ID to deploy.
          Required: true
          Key: true
          Secret: false
          Type: String
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  CustomActionTypeProvider:
    Description: Provider name of the custom action type (equals the stack name).
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  CustomActionTypeVersion:
    Description: Version of the custom action type.

  OpsWorksDeployFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the backing Lambda function for the custom action.

Description: Lambda function that reads a database username from SSM Parameter Store, with least-privilege IAM role and SSM parameter.

Parameters:

    Type: String
    Default: alice
    Description: Database username to store in the SSM parameter.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-128 characters of letters, numbers, underscore, dot, or hyphen.

Resources:
  DbUsernameParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: dbUsername
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref DbUsername
      Description: Database username used for testing.

  DbUsernameReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

        - PolicyName: ReadDbUsernameParameter
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/dbUsername
        - PolicyName: XRayTracingWriteAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  DbUsernameReaderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: dbUsernameReader
      Description: Reads the dbUsername value from SSM Parameter Store at runtime.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt DbUsernameReaderRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          PARAMETER_NAME: !Ref DbUsernameParameter
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import logging
          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ssm = boto3.client("ssm")


          def handler(event, context):
              parameter_name = os.environ["PARAMETER_NAME"]
              response = ssm.get_parameter(Name=parameter_name, WithDecryption=False)
              username = response["Parameter"]["Value"]

                  "parameterName": parameter_name,
                  "username": username,
              }

    Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt DbUsernameReaderRole.Arn

  SsmParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter holding the database username.
    Value: !Ref DbUsernameParameter

              - kms:GenerateDataKey*

            Resource: '*'

    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup

    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroupKey.Arn

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLoggingAndTracingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy

                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "stopped",
                  "Next": "HandleStopped"
                },

                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "terminated",
                  "Next": "HandleTerminated"
                }

              "Default": "UnsupportedState"
            },
            "HandleRunning": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Placeholder for business logic when an EC2 instance transitions to running",
              "Next": "WorkflowComplete"
            },
            "HandleStopped": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Placeholder for business logic when an EC2 instance transitions to stopped",
              "Next": "WorkflowComplete"
            },
            "HandleTerminated": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Placeholder for business logic when an EC2 instance transitions to terminated",
              "Next": "WorkflowComplete"
            },
            "UnsupportedState": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Placeholder for handling unsupported EC2 instance states",
              "Next": "WorkflowComplete"
            },
            "WorkflowComplete": {
              "Type": "Succeed"
            }
          }
        }

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeStartExecutionPolicy

    Properties:

      Description: Matches EC2 instance state-change notifications for running, stopped, and terminated states.
      EventBusName: default

          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates an S3 bucket for CloudTrail logs (SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key,
  access logging enabled), a Glue database, and a Glue crawler (with a dedicated
  IAM role) to catalog CloudTrail logs under cloud-trail/AWSLogs/ so they can be
  queried with Athena.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: cloudtrail-catalog
    Description: Project name used for tagging and resource naming.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens (2-31 chars).
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment used for tagging and resource naming.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 6 * * ? *)
    Description: Schedule expression for the Glue crawler (UTC).

Resources:
  CloudTrailLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting CloudTrail logs in S3.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  CloudTrailLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-cloudtrail-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CloudTrailLogsKey

  AccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub
        - '${StackToken}-access-logs'
        - StackToken: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AccessLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDeliveryWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/cloudtrail-logs-access/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn

  CloudTrailLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub
        - '${StackToken}-cloudtrail-logs'
        - StackToken: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: cloudtrail-logs-access/
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  CloudTrailLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CloudTrailLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowGlueCrawlerListBucket
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                s3:prefix:
                  - 'cloud-trail/AWSLogs/'
                  - 'cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*'
          - Sid: AllowGlueCrawlerGetBucketLocation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
          - Sid: AllowGlueCrawlerGetObject
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*'

  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowGlueAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueCrawlerS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListBucketPrefix
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    s3:prefix:
                      - 'cloud-trail/AWSLogs/'
                      - 'cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*'
              - Sid: GetBucketLocation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadCloudTrailObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*'
              - Sid: DecryptCloudTrailObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  CloudTrailGlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub
          - '${Prefix}-${Environment}-kk-admin-db'
          - Prefix: !Ref ProjectName
            Environment: !Ref Environment
        Description: Catalogs AWS CloudTrail logs stored under cloud-trail/AWSLogs/ for Athena querying.

  CloudTrailGlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub
        - '${Prefix}-${Environment}-cloudtrail-crawler'
        - Prefix: !Ref ProjectName
          Environment: !Ref Environment

                  - ecs:ListContainerInstances

                - 'ECS_AGENT_CONFIG=/etc/ecs/ecs.config'
                - 'mkdir -p /etc/ecs'
                - 'touch "$ECS_AGENT_CONFIG"'
                - 'grep -q "^ECS_CLUSTER=" "$ECS_AGENT_CONFIG" && sed -i "s|^ECS_CLUSTER=.*|ECS_CLUSTER=$ECS_CLUSTER|" "$ECS_AGENT_CONFIG" || echo "ECS_CLUSTER=$ECS_CLUSTER" >> "$ECS_AGENT_CONFIG"'
                - 'grep -q "^ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE=" "$ECS_AGENT_CONFIG" && sed -i "s|^ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE=.*|ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE=true|" "$ECS_AGENT_CONFIG" || echo "ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE=true" >> "$ECS_AGENT_CONFIG"'
                - 'grep -q "^ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE_NETWORK_HOST=" "$ECS_AGENT_CONFIG" && sed -i "s|^ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE_NETWORK_HOST=.*|ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE_NETWORK_HOST=true|" "$ECS_AGENT_CONFIG" || echo "ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE_NETWORK_HOST=true" >> "$ECS_AGENT_CONFIG"'
                - 'if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl enable --now ecs >/dev/null 2>&1 || systemctl restart ecs || true; fi'

Description: Core event-driven architecture for the retail demo store application - custom EventBridge event bus, catch-all logging rule, event archive, schema discoverer, and SSM parameter for downstream service consumption.

Resources:
  RetailDemoStoreEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: retaildemostore-bus

  EventLogGroupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the retail demo store event log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  EventLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/events/${AWS::StackName}-retaildemostore-catchall'
      RetentionInDays: 120
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EventLogGroupKey.Arn

  EventLogGroupResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-retaildemostore-events-log-policy'
      PolicyDocument: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [
              {
                "Sid": "EventBridgeWriteToLogGroup",
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {
                  "Service": "events.amazonaws.com"
                },
                "Action": [
                  "logs:CreateLogStream",
                  "logs:PutLogEvents"
                ],
                "Resource": "${LogGroupArn}"
              }
            ]
          }
        - LogGroupArn: !GetAtt EventLogGroup.Arn

  CatchAllRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-retaildemostore-catchall'
      Description: Catch-all rule that routes all events on the retail demo bus to CloudWatch Logs. Created disabled.
      EventBusName: !Ref RetailDemoStoreEventBus
      State: DISABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ''
      Targets:
        - Id: EventLogTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt EventLogGroup.Arn

  EventArchive:
    Type: AWS::Events::Archive
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ArchiveName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-retaildemostore-archive'
      Description: Archive of all events on the retail demo store event bus.
      SourceArn: !GetAtt RetailDemoStoreEventBus.Arn
      RetentionDays: 120
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ''

  SchemaDiscoverer:

      SourceArn: !GetAtt RetailDemoStoreEventBus.Arn
      State: STARTED

    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: RetailDemoStore-eventbus
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref RetailDemoStoreEventBus
      Description: Name of the retail demo store EventBridge custom event bus for downstream services.

Outputs:

    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Provisions an IAM managed policy, IAM service user, access key, and Secrets Manager
  secret granting the Wave service programmatic access to Amazon ECR. The secret is
  encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key created in this template.
  Note: CloudFormation does not support creating IAM access keys in an "Inactive"
  state (Status Active is the only valid value). The generated access key is
  distributed solely through the Secrets Manager secret, which is the intended
  single distribution channel.

Parameters:
  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/wave-ecr-service-secret
    Description: >
      KMS key alias used to encrypt the Secrets Manager secret that stores the
      Wave ECR service account credentials. Defaults to the customer-managed key
      alias created by this template.

Resources:
  WaveEcrSecretKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the Wave ECR service account secret.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSecretsManagerUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: secretsmanager.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  WaveEcrSecretKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref KmsKeyAlias
      TargetKeyId: !Ref WaveEcrSecretKey

  WaveEcrServicePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Allows the Wave service to perform repository-level and registry-level ECR operations.
      ManagedPolicyName: wave-ecr-service-policy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EcrRepositoryLevelAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
              - ecr:UploadLayerPart
              - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
              - ecr:PutImage
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*'
          - Sid: EcrRegistryLevelAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
            Resource: '*'

  WaveEcrServiceUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: wave-ecr-service-user

  WaveEcrServiceAccessKey:

      Status: Active
      UserName: !Ref WaveEcrServiceUser

  WaveEcrServiceSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DependsOn: WaveEcrSecretKeyAlias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: nextflow/ecr_service_acct
      Description: Wave ECR service account credentials (access key ID and secret access key).
      KmsKeyId: !Ref WaveEcrSecretKey
      SecretString: !Sub

    Value: !GetAtt WaveEcrSecretKey.Arn

  SecretKmsKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting the Wave ECR service account secret.

    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient

Description: Step Functions standard workflow that writes and reads an item in a DynamoDB table.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table to create and use.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 3-255 characters of letters, numbers, underscore, hyphen, or period.

Resources:
  TableEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for DynamoDB table encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  TableEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${TableName}-dynamodb'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TableEncryptionKey

  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TableEncryptionKey.Arn

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt TableEncryptionKey.Arn

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "StartAt": "PutItem",
            "States": {
              "PutItem": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::dynamodb:putItem",
                "Parameters": {
                  "TableName": "${TableName}",
                  "Item": {
                    "id": {
                      "S.$": "$.id"
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "S.$": "States.Format('Item with id {} was inserted', $.id)"
                    }
                  }
                },
                "Next": "GetItem"
              },
              "GetItem": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::dynamodb:getItem",
                "Parameters": {
                  "TableName": "${TableName}",
                  "Key": {
                    "id": {
                      "S.$": "$.id"
                    }
                  }
                },
                "ResultSelector": {
                  "Item.$": "$.Item"
                },
                "OutputPath": "$.Item",
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - TableName: !Ref TableName

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the created Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the created DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref TableName
  TableEncryptionKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used for table encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt TableEncryptionKey.Arn

          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true

  AskAroundMeUserPoolClient:

  AskAroundMeAuthenticatedRole:

  AskAroundMeUnauthenticatedRole:

          - Effect: Allow

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Chaos engineering workflow using Step Functions to test ECS service resilience

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Environment name for tagging
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: chaos-engineering
    Description: Project name for tagging
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: SSM public parameter path resolving to the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI

Mappings:
  EcsSettings:
    Service:
      DesiredCount: 1

Resources:
  # ---------------- VPC ----------------
  ChaosVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ChaosInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ChaosVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref ChaosInternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: ChaosVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref ChaosInternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------- NAT Gateway ----------------
  NatGatewayEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: ChaosVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-nat'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------- VPC Flow Logs (S3 destination) ----------------
  FlowLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flowlogs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  FlowLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FlowLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsAclCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsPutObject
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${FlowLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${FlowLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ChaosVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref ChaosVpc
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: s3
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsBucket.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flowlog'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------- Security Group ----------------
  ChaosSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for chaos engineering resources
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS within VPC
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTP within VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------- EC2 Instance ----------------
  ChaosInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ChaosInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ChaosInstanceRole

  ChaosInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ChaosSecurityGroup
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref ChaosInstanceProfile
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
        HttpTokens: required
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------- ECS ----------------
  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-cluster'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ecs-task-exec-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  EcsTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${ProjectName}-task'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: app
          Image: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:latest
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-task'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: PrivateRoute
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      ServiceName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-service'
      TaskDefinition: !Ref EcsTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !FindInMap [EcsSettings, Service, DesiredCount]
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ChaosSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-service'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------- KMS ----------------
  ChaosTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting the chaos alert SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-topic-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------- SNS ----------------
  ChaosAlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-alerts'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt ChaosTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-alerts'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ChaosAlertTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref ChaosAlertTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowHealthCheckLambdaPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref ChaosAlertTopic

  # ---------------- Shared Lambda Execution Role ----------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ChaosLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TerminateInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
              - Sid: DescribeEcs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                  - ecs:DescribeClusters
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EcsCluster}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:service/${EcsCluster}/*'
              - Sid: PublishAlerts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource:
                  - !Ref ChaosAlertTopic
              - Sid: UseTopicKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ChaosTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lambda-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------- Lambda: Terminate Instance ----------------
  TerminateInstanceLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-terminate-instance'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              instance_id = event.get('instanceId')
              if not instance_id:
                  raise ValueError('instanceId is required')
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              response = ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              terminated = [
                  t['InstanceId'] for t in response.get('TerminatingInstances', [])
              ]
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'instanceId': instance_id,
                  'terminated': terminated
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-terminate-instance'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------- Lambda: Health Check ----------------
  HealthCheckLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-health-check'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref ChaosAlertTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              cluster = event.get('clusterName')
              service = event.get('serviceName')
              topic_arn = event.get('topicArn') or os.environ.get('SNS_TOPIC_ARN')
              if not cluster or not service:
                  raise ValueError('clusterName and serviceName are required')

              ecs = boto3.client('ecs')
              response = ecs.describe_services(cluster=cluster, services=[service])
              services = response.get('services', [])
              if not services:
                  raise ValueError('Service not found: %s' % service)

              svc = services[0]
              running = svc.get('runningCount', 0)
              desired = svc.get('desiredCount', 0)
              healthy = running >= desired and desired > 0

              result = {
                  'clusterName': cluster,
                  'serviceName': service,
                  'runningCount': running,
                  'desiredCount': desired,
                  'healthy': healthy
              }

              if not healthy:
                  sns = boto3.client('sns')
                  message = (
                      'ECS service %s in cluster %s is UNHEALTHY. '
                      'runningCount=%d desiredCount=%d'
                      % (service, cluster, running, desired)
                  )
                  sns.publish(
                      TopicArn=topic_arn,
                      Subject='ECS Service Unhealthy Alert',
                      Message=message
                  )
                  result['alertPublished'] = True
              else:
                  result['alertPublished'] = False

              return result
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-health-check'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------- Step Functions ----------------
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates an AWS DevOps Agent Space with dedicated IAM roles for the agent
  service and the operator application. The roles trust
  aidevops.amazonaws.com with aws:SourceAccount and aws:SourceArn conditions
  to prevent confused-deputy access. The current account is associated as the
  primary monitoring account.

Parameters:
  AgentSpaceName:
    Type: String
    Default: devops-agent-space
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: Name of the DevOps Agent Space.
  Application:
    Type: String
    Default: devops-agent
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: Application tag value applied to all resources.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - staging
      - development
      - test
    Description: Environment tag value applied to all resources.

Resources:

  DevOpsAgentSpace:
    Type: AWS::DevOpsAgent::AgentSpace
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref AgentSpaceName
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AgentServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-agent-service-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by the AWS DevOps Agent service.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDevOpsAgentService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentSpace.Arn
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowCreateServiceLinkedRoles
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateDevOpsAgentServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: aidevops.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  OperatorAppRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-operator-app-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by the DevOps Agent operator application.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDevOpsAgentService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentSpace.Arn
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  AgentSpaceId:
    Description: ID of the DevOps Agent Space.
    Value: !Ref DevOpsAgentSpace
  AgentSpaceArn:
    Description: ARN of the DevOps Agent Space.
    Value: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentSpace.Arn
  AgentSpaceName:
    Description: Name of the DevOps Agent Space.
    Value: !Ref AgentSpaceName
  OperatorUrl:
    Description: URL of the DevOps Agent operator console for this agent space.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/aidevops/home?region=${AWS::Region}#/agent-spaces/${DevOpsAgentSpace}'
  AgentServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the DevOps Agent service.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentServiceRole.Arn
  OperatorAppRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the operator application.
    Value: !GetAtt OperatorAppRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Demo stack creating SSM parameters, a Secrets Manager secret with a generated password, and a Lambda function that lists them.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment tag applied to resources.
    Default: demo
    AllowedValues:
      - demo
      - dev
      - test
      - prod

Resources:
  DemoKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the ParameterStoreDemo stack.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/ParameterStoreDemo'
          - Sid: AllowSecretsManager
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: secretsmanager.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DemoKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-demo'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DemoKmsKey

  DemoStringParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/demo/string-param'
      Type: String
      Value: 'This is a plain String parameter created by the ParameterStoreDemo stack.'
      Description: Demo String parameter namespaced under the stack path.
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  DemoSecureStringParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/demo/secure-param'
      Type: String
      Value: 'This is a second parameter created by the ParameterStoreDemo stack.'
      Description: Demo parameter namespaced under the stack path.
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  DemoSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/demo/credentials'
      Description: Demo secret with a dynamically generated password.
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt DemoKmsKey.Arn
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username": "demo-user"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/ParameterStoreDemo
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt DemoKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ParameterStoreDemo-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ParameterStoreAndSecretsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SsmParameterAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}/*'
              - Sid: SecretsManagerAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource:
                  - !Ref DemoSecret
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LambdaLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: XRayWriteAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ParameterStoreDemoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ParameterStoreDemo
      Description: Lists SSM parameters under the stack path and secrets matching the stack prefix.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STACK_NAME: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
          PARAMETER_PATH: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/'
          SECRET_ARN: !Ref DemoSecret
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
          secretsmanager = boto3.client('secretsmanager')


          def handler(event, context):
              stack_name = os.environ['STACK_NAME']
              parameter_path = os.environ.get('PARAMETER_PATH', '/{}/'.format(stack_name))
              secret_arn = os.environ.get('SECRET_ARN')

              print('Stack name: {}'.format(stack_name))
              print('Parameter path: {}'.format(parameter_path))

              parameters = []
              paginator = ssm.get_paginator('get_parameters_by_path')
              for page in paginator.paginate(Path=parameter_path, Recursive=True, WithDecryption=False):
                  for parameter in page.get('Parameters', []):
                      parameters.append({
                          'Name': parameter.get('Name'),
                          'Type': parameter.get('Type'),
                          'Version': parameter.get('Version'),
                          'LastModifiedDate': str(parameter.get('LastModifiedDate')),
                      })
              print('Parameters under {}: {}'.format(parameter_path, json.dumps(parameters, default=str)))

              secrets = []
              filters = [{'Key': 'name', 'Values': [stack_name]}]
              paginator = secretsmanager.get_paginator('list_secrets')
              for page in paginator.paginate(Filters=filters):
                  for secret in page.get('SecretList', []):
                      secrets.append({
                          'Name': secret.get('Name'),
                          'ARN': secret.get('ARN'),
                          'Description': secret.get('Description'),
                          'LastChangedDate': str(secret.get('LastChangedDate')),
                      })
              print('Secrets matching prefix {}: {}'.format(stack_name, json.dumps(secrets, default=str)))

              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'stackName': stack_name,
                  'parameterPath': parameter_path,
                  'secretArn': secret_arn,
                  'parameters': parameters,
                  'secrets': secrets,
              }

Outputs:
  StringParameterName:
    Description: Name of the demo String parameter.
    Value: !Ref DemoStringParameter

  SecureStringParameterName:
    Description: Name of the second demo parameter.
    Value: !Ref DemoSecureStringParameter

  SecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the generated Secrets Manager secret.
    Value: !Ref DemoSecret

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !GetAtt DemoKmsKey.Arn

  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the demo Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref ParameterStoreDemoFunction

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the demo Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt ParameterStoreDemoFunction.Arn

  LambdaExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

  LambdaLogGroupName:
