AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lambda function that logs the current UTC time every 5 minutes via an EventBridge rate rule, with scoped IAM logging permissions, an explicit CMK-encrypted log group, and active X-Ray tracing.

Parameters:
  FunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: log-current-time
    Description: Name of the Lambda function.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag value applied to all resources.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

Resources:
  LogGroupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt the Lambda function CloudWatch log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${FunctionName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${FunctionName}'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogGroupKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt FunctionLogGroup.Arn
        - PolicyName: LambdaXRayTracingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LogCurrentTimeFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: FunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref FunctionName
      Description: Logs the current UTC time to CloudWatch Logs.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt FunctionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def handler(event, context):
              now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
              logger.info("Current UTC time: %s", now)
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": {
                      "message": "Logged current UTC time",
                      "utc_time": now
                  }
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FunctionName}-every-5-minutes'
      Description: Triggers the Lambda function every 5 minutes.
      ScheduleExpression: rate(5 minutes)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: LogCurrentTimeTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt LogCurrentTimeFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ScheduleRuleInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LogCurrentTimeFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt ScheduleRule.Arn

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref LogCurrentTimeFunction
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt LogCurrentTimeFunction.Arn
  EventRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule that triggers the function.
    Value: !GetAtt ScheduleRule.Arn
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group for the Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref FunctionLogGroup
  LogGroupKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the CMK used to encrypt the Lambda function log group.
    Value: !GetAtt LogGroupKmsKey.Arn

  database and caching processes across Windows and Linux EC2 instances. The

  LinuxProcessKeywords:

    Description: Comma-separated list of Windows process keywords to detect.

      Name: Custom-Inventory-Processes-Document
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '2.2'
        description: Collect running database and caching processes into SSM custom inventory.
        parameters:
          LinuxProcessKeywords:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated Linux process keywords.
            default: "CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
          WindowsProcessKeywords:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated Windows process keywords.
            default: "sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: CollectLinuxProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - '#!/bin/bash'
                - 'set -e'
                - 'TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600")'
                - 'INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)'
                - 'if [ -z "$INSTANCE_ID" ]; then INSTANCE_ID=$(cat /var/lib/amazon/ssm/registration 2>/dev/null | grep -o ''"ManagedInstanceID"[^,]*'' | cut -d''"'' -f4); fi'
                - 'INV_DIR="/var/lib/amazon/ssm/${INSTANCE_ID}/inventory/custom/Processes"'
                - 'mkdir -p "$INV_DIR"'
                - 'OUT_FILE="${INV_DIR}/${INSTANCE_ID}.json"'
                - 'IFS='','' read -ra KEYWORDS <<< "{{ LinuxProcessKeywords }}"'
                - 'ENTRIES=""'
                - 'for KW in "${KEYWORDS[@]}"; do'
                - '  KW_TRIMMED=$(echo "$KW" | sed -e ''s/^[[:space:]]*//'' -e ''s/[[:space:]]*$//'')'
                - '  if [ -z "$KW_TRIMMED" ]; then continue; fi'
                - '  PIDS=$(pgrep -f "$KW_TRIMMED" 2>/dev/null || true)'
                - '  if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then'
                - '    for PID in $PIDS; do'
                - '      PNAME=$(ps -p "$PID" -o comm= 2>/dev/null | tr -d ''[:space:]'')'
                - '      if [ -z "$PNAME" ]; then PNAME="$KW_TRIMMED"; fi'
                - '      ENTRY=$(printf ''{"Name":"%s","Keyword":"%s","Pid":"%s","Status":"Running"}'' "$PNAME" "$KW_TRIMMED" "$PID")'
                - '      if [ -z "$ENTRIES" ]; then ENTRIES="$ENTRY"; else ENTRIES="${ENTRIES},${ENTRY}"; fi'
                - '    done'
                - '  fi'
                - 'done'
                - 'printf ''{"SchemaVersion":"1.0","TypeName":"Custom:Processes","Content":[%s]}'' "$ENTRIES" > "$OUT_FILE"'
                - 'echo "Wrote inventory to $OUT_FILE"'
          - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
            name: CollectWindowsProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Windows
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - '$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"'
                - 'try {'
                - '  $token = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds"="21600"}'
                - '  $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id" -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token"=$token}'
                - '} catch {'
                - '  $instanceId = $env:COMPUTERNAME'
                - '}'
                - '$invDir = "C:\ProgramData\Amazon\SSM\InstanceData\$instanceId\inventory\custom\Processes"'
                - 'New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $invDir | Out-Null'
                - '$outFile = Join-Path $invDir "$instanceId.json"'
                - '$keywords = "{{ WindowsProcessKeywords }}" -split ","'
                - '$entries = @()'
                - 'foreach ($kw in $keywords) {'
                - '  $k = $kw.Trim()'
                - '  if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($k)) { continue }'
                - '  $procs = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Process -Filter "Name LIKE ''%$k%''" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue'
                - '  if (-not $procs) { $procs = Get-Process -Name "*$k*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }'
                - '  foreach ($p in $procs) {'
                - '    $pname = $p.Name'
                - '    $pidVal = $p.ProcessId'
                - '    $entries += [ordered]@{ Name = "$pname"; Keyword = "$k"; Pid = "$pidVal"; Status = "Running" }'
                - '  }'
                - '}'
                - '$content = [ordered]@{ SchemaVersion = "1.0"; TypeName = "Custom:Processes"; Content = @($entries) }'
                - '$content | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress | Set-Content -Path $outFile -Encoding UTF8'
                - 'Write-Output "Wrote inventory to $outFile"'

  CustomInventoryProcessesAssociation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Association
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref CustomInventoryProcessesDocument
      AssociationName: Custom-Inventory-Processes
      Targets:
        - Key: InstanceIds
          Values:
            - '*'
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      AutomationTargetParameterName: InstanceIds
      Parameters:
        LinuxProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref LinuxProcessKeywords
        WindowsProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref WindowsProcessKeywords
      ApplyOnlyAtCronInterval: false

Outputs:
  DocumentName:
    Description: Name of the custom SSM Command document.
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryProcessesDocument
  AssociationName:
    Description: Name of the SSM association that runs the custom inventory document.
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryProcessesAssociation

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Private S3 buckets for a data processing pipeline (source, target, and optional EMR log bucket) with KMS encryption, versioning, access logging, public access blocking, TLS-only bucket policies, lifecycle rules, and cross-stack exports.

Parameters:
  CreateEmrLogBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether to create the optional EMR log bucket.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
  StorageClass:
    Type: String
    Description: Storage class to transition objects to after 90 days.
    AllowedValues:
      - STANDARD_IA
      - GLACIER
    Default: STANDARD_IA

Conditions:
  CreateEmrLogBucketCondition: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateEmrLogBucket
    - 'true'

Resources:
  PipelineDataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting pipeline S3 buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  PipelineDataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-data'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref PipelineDataKey

  AccessLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerPreferred
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${AccessLogBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyNonTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${AccessLogBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${AccessLogBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineDataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: source/
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: TransitionAndExpire
            Status: Disabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: !Ref StorageClass
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  TargetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineDataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: target/
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: TransitionAndExpire
            Status: Disabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: !Ref StorageClass
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  EmrLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: CreateEmrLogBucketCondition
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineDataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: emr-log/
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: TransitionAndExpire
            Status: Enabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: !Ref StorageClass
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  SourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref SourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${SourceBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${SourceBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  TargetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TargetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${TargetBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${TargetBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  EmrLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: CreateEmrLogBucketCondition
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref EmrLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${EmrLogBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${EmrLogBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

Outputs:
  SourceBucketName:
    Description: Name of the pipeline source bucket.
    Value: !Ref SourceBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SourceBucketName'

  TargetBucketName:
    Description: Name of the pipeline target bucket.
    Value: !Ref TargetBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TargetBucketName'

  EmrLogBucketName:
    Description: Name of the EMR log bucket.
    Condition: CreateEmrLogBucketCondition
    Value: !Ref EmrLogBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EmrLogBucketName'

  EmrLogBucketRegionalDomainName:
    Description: Regional domain name (DNS name) of the EMR log bucket.
    Condition: CreateEmrLogBucketCondition
    Value: !GetAtt EmrLogBucket.RegionalDomainName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EmrLogBucketRegionalDomainName'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained stack that automatically enforces IMDSv2 on EC2 instances when
  they enter the running state. An EventBridge rule triggers the AWS-managed
  AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata Systems Manager Automation document, which
  disables IMDSv1 (sets HttpTokens to required) and applies a configurable HTTP
  PUT response hop limit. All IAM roles and resources are created within this
  stack; no pre-existing infrastructure is referenced.

Parameters:
  HttpPutResponseHopLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 64
    Description: >-
      The HTTP PUT response hop limit applied to instance metadata options by
      the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata automation. Valid range is 1-64.

Resources:
  EventBridgeAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by EventBridge to start the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata
        SSM Automation execution.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartConfigureEC2MetadataAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartConfigureEC2MetadataAutomation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:*'

  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSSMAutomationAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata SSM Automation
        document to describe instances and modify their metadata options.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConfigureEC2MetadataPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'

  EnforceImdsv2OnStartRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: enforce-imdsv2-on-instance-running
      Description: >-
        Triggers the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata automation whenever an EC2
        instance enters the running state, disabling IMDSv1.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
      Targets:
        - Id: ConfigureEC2MetadataAutomationTarget
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeAutomationRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              instance: $.detail.instance-id
            InputTemplate: !Sub |
              {
                "InstanceId": ["<instance>"],
                "AutomationAssumeRole": ["${AutomationExecutionRole.Arn}"],
                "HttpPutResponseHopLimit": ["${HttpPutResponseHopLimit}"]
              }

Outputs:
  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule that triggers the IMDSv2 enforcement automation.
    Value: !GetAtt EnforceImdsv2OnStartRule.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EventBridgeRuleArn'

  EventBridgeAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by EventBridge to start the automation.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeAutomationRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EventBridgeAutomationRoleArn'

  AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the SSM Automation document during execution.
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AutomationExecutionRoleArn'

    Type: String

    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,32}$'
    Description: Environment name used for tagging and naming resources.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom EventBridge event bus (target for the AppSync data source)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'appsync-notes-bus-${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::StackName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key for CloudWatch Logs encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt the AppSync CloudWatch Log Group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppSyncLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/appsync-notes-logs-${EnvironmentName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AppSyncLogsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Group for AppSync execution/request logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/appsync/apis/notes-api-${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AppSyncLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by AppSync to write events to the custom bus
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncEventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: Allows AppSync to put events onto the custom EventBridge bus
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncEventBridgePutEvents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt EventBus.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AppSync GraphQL API (IAM auth only, X-Ray, CloudWatch logging)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'notes-api-${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::StackName}'
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLogsRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL
        ExcludeVerboseContent: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role for AppSync to write to CloudWatch Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: Allows AppSync to write execution logs to CloudWatch Logs
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AppSyncLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AppSyncLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GraphQL schema
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Note {
          NoteId: ID!
          title: String!
          content: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getNote(NoteId: ID!): Note
        }

        type Mutation {
          saveNote(title: String!, content: String!): Note
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge data source
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: EventBridgeDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_EVENTBRIDGE
      Description: Puts Note events onto the custom EventBridge bus
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncEventBridgeRole.Arn
      EventBridgeConfig:
        EventBusArn: !GetAtt EventBus.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resolver: saveNote mutation -> PutEvents on the custom bus
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SaveNoteResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: saveNote
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt EventBridgeDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($noteId = $util.autoId())
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutEvents",
          "events": [
            {
              "source": "com.example.notes",
              "detail-type": "NoteSaved",
              "detail": {
                "NoteId": "$noteId",
                "title": "$ctx.args.title",
                "content": "$ctx.args.content"
              },
              "resources": []
            }
          ]
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        #set($noteId = $util.autoId())
        {
          "NoteId": "$noteId",
          "title": "$ctx.args.title",
          "content": "$ctx.args.content"
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resolver: getNote query
  # NOTE: EventBridge is a write-only (PutEvents) target. A true read path
  # cannot be satisfied by EventBridge. This resolver issues a lookup event
  # onto the same bus and returns the requested NoteId with empty fields,
  # documenting the limitation. A persistent store (e.g. DynamoDB) would be
  # required for real reads.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetNoteResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getNote
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt EventBridgeDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutEvents",
          "events": [
            {
              "source": "com.example.notes",
              "detail-type": "NoteLookupRequested",
              "detail": {
                "NoteId": "$ctx.args.NoteId"
              },
              "resources": []
            }
          ]
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        {
          "NoteId": "$ctx.args.NoteId",
          "title": "",
          "content": ""
        }

    Description: AppSync GraphQL API ID
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId

    Description: AppSync GraphQL API URL
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl

  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API ARN
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Scheduled Lambda function to clean up expired items from the "throttle"
  DynamoDB table. The Lambda function's CloudWatch Logs log group is created
  implicitly by the Lambda service (AWS-managed encryption key).

Parameters:
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: 'rate(1 hour)'
    Description: >-
      EventBridge schedule expression for the cleanup function. Pass an empty
      string to disable the scheduled trigger (the Lambda function is still created).

Conditions:
  ScheduleEnabled: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref ScheduleExpression
      - ''

Resources:
  ThrottleTableKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for encrypting the throttle DynamoDB table.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              Bool:
                kms:GrantIsForAWSResource: 'true'

  ThrottleTableKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-throttle-table'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ThrottleTableKey

  ThrottleTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: pk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: expiresAt
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: pk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: expiresAt
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt ThrottleTableKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  CleanupFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ThrottleTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ThrottleTable.Arn}/index/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${DynamoDBCleanupFunction}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  DynamoDBCleanupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt CleanupFunctionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ThrottleTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import time
          import boto3

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["TABLE_NAME"]
          BATCH_SIZE = 25
          MAX_ITEMS = 5000

          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)


          def _delete_batch(keys):
              with table.batch_writer(overwrite_by_pkeys=["pk", "expiresAt"]) as batch:
                  for key in keys:
                      batch.delete_item(Key=key)


          def handler(event, context):
              now = int(time.time())
              deleted = 0
              scanned = 0
              start_key = None

              while True:
                  scan_kwargs = {
                      "ProjectionExpression": "pk, expiresAt",
                      "FilterExpression": "expiresAt < :now",
                      "ExpressionAttributeValues": {":now": now},
                  }
                  if start_key:
                      scan_kwargs["ExclusiveStartKey"] = start_key

                  response = table.scan(**scan_kwargs)
                  items = response.get("Items", [])
                  scanned += response.get("ScannedCount", 0)

                  for i in range(0, len(items), BATCH_SIZE):
                      chunk = items[i:i + BATCH_SIZE]
                      keys = [{"pk": it["pk"], "expiresAt": it["expiresAt"]} for it in chunk]
                      _delete_batch(keys)
                      deleted += len(keys)

                  start_key = response.get("LastEvaluatedKey")
                  if not start_key or deleted >= MAX_ITEMS:
                      break

              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "deleted": deleted,
                  "scanned": scanned,
              }

  CleanupScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: ScheduleEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DynamoDBCleanupSchedule'
      Description: Hourly trigger for the DynamoDB cleanup function.
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: DynamoDBCleanupFunctionTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupFunction.Arn

  CleanupSchedulePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: ScheduleEnabled
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt CleanupScheduleRule.Arn

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB cleanup Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBCleanupFunction

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB cleanup Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupFunction.Arn

  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table being cleaned up.
    Value: !Ref ThrottleTable

  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group implicitly created for the cleanup function.
    Value: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${DynamoDBCleanupFunction}'

  ThrottleTableKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt ThrottleTableKey.Arn

Description: ECS Fargate task definition with supporting IAM roles and CloudWatch log group

Parameters:

    Type: String
    Default: book-app
    Description: Name of the ECR repository used for the task definition family, container name, and log stream prefix

  LogGroupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting the ECS CloudWatch log group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/ecs/${EcrRepoName}

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EcrRepoName}
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogGroupKey.Arn

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TaskRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: root
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - ssm:StartSession
                  - ssm:CreateSession
                  - ssm:ResumeSession
                  - ssm:TerminateSession
                Resource: '*'

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TaskExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Ref EcrRepoName
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE

        - Name: !Ref EcrRepoName

          Privileged: false

            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp

            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref EcrRepoName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Wind Farm demo - creates an IoT SiteWise Turbine Asset Model and a Wind Farm
  Asset Model with a hierarchy linking the two, plus 5-minute tumbling-window
  metrics and an overdrive-state transform.

Resources:
  TurbineAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: WindTurbineAssetModel
      AssetModelDescription: Represents an individual wind turbine with measurements, transforms and 5-minute metrics.
      AssetModelProperties:
        - Name: TurbineId
          LogicalId: turbineid_prop
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute: {}
        - Name: RatedCapacity
          LogicalId: ratedcapacity_prop
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute: {}
        - Name: Location
          LogicalId: location_prop
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute: {}
        - Name: WindSpeed
          LogicalId: windspeed_prop
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - Name: Torque
          LogicalId: torque_prop
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: Nm
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - Name: PowerOutput
          LogicalId: power_prop
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - Name: RotorSpeed
          LogicalId: rotorspeed_prop
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: rpm
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - Name: OverdriveState
          LogicalId: overdrive_prop
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Transform
            Transform:
              Expression: if(gt(torque, 3), 1, 0)
              Variables:
                - Name: torque
                  Value:
                    PropertyPath:
                      - Name: Torque
        - Name: AverageWindSpeed
          LogicalId: avgwind_prop
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: avg(wind_speed)
              Variables:
                - Name: wind_speed
                  Value:
                    PropertyPath:
                      - Name: WindSpeed
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - Name: OverdriveStateTime
          LogicalId: overdrivetime_prop
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: seconds
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: statetime(overdrive_state)
              Variables:
                - Name: overdrive_state
                  Value:
                    PropertyPath:
                      - Name: OverdriveState
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - Name: AveragePower
          LogicalId: avgpower_prop
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: avg(power_output)
              Variables:
                - Name: power_output
                  Value:
                    PropertyPath:
                      - Name: PowerOutput
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: WindFarmDemo
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Demo

  WindFarmAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: WindFarmAssetModel
      AssetModelDescription: Represents a wind farm that rolls up totals from its child turbines over a 5-minute tumbling window.
      AssetModelProperties:
        - Name: FarmId
          LogicalId: farmid_prop
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute: {}
        - Name: TotalCapacity
          LogicalId: totalcapacity_prop
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute: {}
        - Name: TotalPower
          LogicalId: totalpower_prop
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: sum(turbine_power)
              Variables:
                - Name: turbine_power
                  Value:
                    PropertyPath:
                      - Name: Turbine
                      - Name: AveragePower
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - Name: AverageWindSpeedAcrossTurbines
          LogicalId: avgwindfarm_prop
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: avg(turbine_wind_speed)
              Variables:
                - Name: turbine_wind_speed
                  Value:
                    PropertyPath:
                      - Name: Turbine
                      - Name: AverageWindSpeed
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
      AssetModelHierarchies:
        - Name: Turbine
          LogicalId: turbine_hierarchy
          ChildAssetModelId: !Ref TurbineAssetModel
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: WindFarmDemo
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Demo

Outputs:
  TurbineAssetModelId:
    Description: Identifier of the Turbine Asset Model.
    Value: !Ref TurbineAssetModel

  WindFarmAssetModelId:
    Description: Identifier of the Wind Farm Asset Model.
    Value: !Ref WindFarmAssetModel

  TurbineHierarchyId:
    Description: Identifier of the hierarchy association between the Wind Farm Asset Model and the Turbine Asset Model.
    Value: !GetAtt WindFarmAssetModel.AssetModelHierarchies.0.Id

  Two Cognito identity pools for testing with unauthenticated identities enabled.
  One pool is used for Lambda-based access and the other for Step Functions
  workflow-based access, each with a supporting IAM role attached as the
  unauthenticated role.

  LambdaIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: LambdaTestIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: false
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: cognito-test

  StepFunctionsIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: StepFunctionsTestIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: false
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: cognito-test

  LambdaCognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: LambdaCognitoUnauthRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CognitoUnauthenticatedAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref LambdaIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaInvokeAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowLambdaInvoke

                  - lambda:InvokeFunction

Description: >-
  PCI compliance remediation prerequisites: IAM role assumed by SSM Automation,
  EC2, and EventBridge, plus custom SSM Automation documents used by AWS Config
  Conformance Pack remediations (restrict default SG, delete unused SG, release
  unassociated EIPs, update ASG health check).

Parameters:
  SecurityGroupIdParameterName:
    Type: String
    Default: SecurityGroupId
    Description: >-
      Name of the runtime parameter used by the security-group automation
      documents to receive the target security group ID.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

  AllocationIdParameterName:
    Type: String
    Default: AllocationId

    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

  AutoScalingGroupNameParameterName:
    Type: String
    Default: AutoScalingGroupName

    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$'

    MaxLength: 64

Resources:
  PciAutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      RoleName: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by SSM Automation, EC2, and EventBridge to perform PCI

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmAutomationAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow

                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

            Principal:

                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: pci-automation-remediation-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ElasticIpReleasePermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Mirrors three CodeCommit repositories (card-service, rule-service, ecs-pipeline)
  from the current deployment region to a target replica region using CodeBuild,
  triggered automatically by EventBridge on pushes to the 'mainline' branch.

Parameters:
  TargetReplicaRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-\d{1}$'
    Description: The target region to which the repositories are mirrored.
  SourceRepositoryOne:
    Type: String
    Default: card-service
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$'
    Description: Name of the first source CodeCommit repository.
  SourceRepositoryTwo:
    Type: String
    Default: rule-service
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$'
    Description: Name of the second source CodeCommit repository.
  SourceRepositoryThree:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-pipeline
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$'
    Description: Name of the third source CodeCommit repository.
  SourceBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: mainline
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$'
    Description: The branch that triggers mirroring.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention for the CodeBuild project.

Resources:
  MirrorDataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for repository mirror artifacts and CodeBuild logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  MirrorDataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/repository-mirror
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MirrorDataKey

  AccessLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MirrorDataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: artifact-access-logs/
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  CodeBuildLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt MirrorDataKey.Arn
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  CodeBuildRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: codecommit-mirror-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadSourceRepositories
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                  - codecommit:GetRepository
                  - codecommit:GetBranch
                  - codecommit:ListBranches
                  - codecommit:GetCommit
                  - codecommit:ListRepositories
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepositoryOne}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepositoryTwo}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepositoryThree}'
              - Sid: WriteReplicaRepositories
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPush
                  - codecommit:CreateBranch
                  - codecommit:PutFile
                  - codecommit:GetRepository
                  - codecommit:GetBranch
                  - codecommit:ListBranches
                  - codecommit:GetCommit
                  - codecommit:ListRepositories
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepositoryOne}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepositoryTwo}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepositoryThree}'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CodeBuildLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CodeBuildLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: ArtifactBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: AccessLogBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AccessLogBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: KmsUsageForArtifactsAndLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MirrorDataKey.Arn

  CodeBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: repository-mirror-project
      Description: Mirrors CodeCommit repositories to a target replica region.
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildRole.Arn
      Artifacts:
        Type: NO_ARTIFACTS
      Cache:
        Type: S3
        Location: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/standard:7.0
        PrivilegedMode: false
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: SOURCE_REGION
            Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          - Name: TARGET_REGION
            Value: !Ref TargetReplicaRegion
          - Name: SOURCE_BRANCH
            Value: !Ref SourceBranch
          - Name: REPO_ONE
            Value: !Ref SourceRepositoryOne
          - Name: REPO_TWO
            Value: !Ref SourceRepositoryTwo
          - Name: REPO_THREE
            Value: !Ref SourceRepositoryThree
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          phases:
            pre_build:
              commands:
                - echo "Installing git-remote-codecommit"
                - pip install --upgrade pip
                - pip install git-remote-codecommit
                - git config --global credential.helper '!aws codecommit credential-helper $@'
                - git config --global credential.UseHttpPath true
                - echo "Source region: $SOURCE_REGION Target region: $TARGET_REGION Branch: $SOURCE_BRANCH"
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  set -e
                  for REPO in "$REPO_ONE" "$REPO_TWO" "$REPO_THREE"; do
                    echo "Mirroring repository: $REPO"
                    WORKDIR="/tmp/mirror-$REPO"
                    rm -rf "$WORKDIR"
                    git clone --mirror "codecommit::$SOURCE_REGION://$REPO" "$WORKDIR"
                    cd "$WORKDIR"
                    git push --mirror "codecommit::$TARGET_REGION://$REPO"
                    cd /
                    rm -rf "$WORKDIR"
                    echo "Completed mirroring of $REPO"
                  done
      LogsConfig:
        CloudWatchLogs:
          Status: ENABLED
          GroupName: !Ref CodeBuildLogGroup
        S3Logs:
          Status: DISABLED
      TimeoutInMinutes: 30
      QueuedTimeoutInMinutes: 60

  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-codebuild-mirror
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn

  MirrorRuleOne:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: mirror-card-service-mainline
      Description: Triggers repository mirroring on mainline pushes to card-service.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - !Ref SourceBranch
          repositoryName:
            - !Ref SourceRepositoryOne
      Targets:
        - Id: CodeBuildMirrorTargetOne
          Arn: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn

  MirrorRuleTwo:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: mirror-rule-service-mainline
      Description: Triggers repository mirroring on mainline pushes to rule-service.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - !Ref SourceBranch
          repositoryName:
            - !Ref SourceRepositoryTwo
      Targets:
        - Id: CodeBuildMirrorTargetTwo
          Arn: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn

  MirrorRuleThree:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: mirror-ecs-pipeline-mainline
      Description: Triggers repository mirroring on mainline pushes to ecs-pipeline.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - !Ref SourceBranch
          repositoryName:
            - !Ref SourceRepositoryThree
      Targets:
        - Id: CodeBuildMirrorTargetThree
          Arn: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn

Outputs:
  CodeBuildProjectName:
    Description: Name of the CodeBuild mirroring project.
    Value: !Ref CodeBuildProject
  CodeBuildProjectArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodeBuild mirroring project.
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
  CodeBuildRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodeBuild service role.
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildRole.Arn
  EventBridgeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge service role.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
  MirrorRuleOneName:
    Description: Name of the EventBridge rule for card-service.
    Value: !Ref MirrorRuleOne
  MirrorRuleTwoName:
    Description: Name of the EventBridge rule for rule-service.
    Value: !Ref MirrorRuleTwo
  MirrorRuleThreeName:
    Description: Name of the EventBridge rule for ecs-pipeline.
    Value: !Ref MirrorRuleThree
  CodeBuildLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Log Group for CodeBuild.
    Value: !Ref CodeBuildLogGroup
  ArtifactBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 artifact/cache bucket.
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
  AccessLogBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 server access log destination bucket.
    Value: !Ref AccessLogBucket
  AccessLogBucketPolicyId:
    Description: ID of the bucket policy granting S3 server access log delivery.
    Value: !Ref AccessLogBucketPolicy
  MirrorDataKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key used for artifacts and logs.
    Value: !GetAtt MirrorDataKey.Arn
  MirrorDataKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias name of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !Ref MirrorDataKeyAlias
  TargetReplicaRegionOutput:
    Description: The target replica region.
    Value: !Ref TargetReplicaRegion

Description: Secure S3 bucket infrastructure with encryption, versioning, public access block, TLS-only policy, access logging, and same-region replication.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: testanu
    Description: Application name used to derive all bucket names.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]$'

Resources:
  ReplicationKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for S3 primary and replica bucket encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
            Resource: '*'

  PrimaryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ReplicationKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref LogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: !Sub '${AppName}-primary-logs/'
      ReplicationConfiguration:
        Role: !GetAtt ReplicationRole.Arn
        Rules:
          - Id: !Sub '${AppName}-replication-rule'
            Priority: 1
            Status: Enabled
            DeleteMarkerReplication:
              Status: Disabled
            Filter:
              Prefix: ''
            Destination:
              Bucket: !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
              StorageClass: STANDARD

  LogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AppName}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  ReplicaBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ReplicationKmsKey.Arn

      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

        DestinationBucketName: !Ref LogBucket

      Bucket: !Ref PrimaryBucket
      PolicyDocument:

            Effect: Deny

            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PrimaryBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${PrimaryBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:

  ReplicaBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ReplicaBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  LogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${LogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LoggingDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource:

              - !Sub '${LogBucket.Arn}/${AppName}-replica-logs/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'true'

  ReplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AppName}-s3-replication-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SourceBucketPermissions

                Action:
                  - 's3:GetReplicationConfiguration'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
              - Sid: SourceObjectPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersion'

                  - 's3:GetObjectVersionTagging'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*'
              - Sid: DestinationBucketPermissions

                Action:
                  - 's3:ReplicateObject'
                  - 's3:ReplicateDelete'
                  - 's3:ReplicateTags'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*'
              - Sid: KmsPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                Resource:

Description: >-
  Route53 hosted zone and DNS records for the Ear Hustle production environment.
  NOTE: The ACM certificate for feeds.<domain> must be created in a follow-up
  stack AFTER this hosted zone is delegated at the registrar (name servers set).

  DomainValidationOptions with HostedZoneId so ACM can auto-create the DNS

    Type: String
    Default: earhustlesq.com

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

        - Name: !Ref DomainName

          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - '"v=spf1 include:cmail1.com ~all"'
        - Name: !Sub 'cm.${DomainName}'
          Type: MX
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - '10 mail.cmail1.com.'
        - Name: !Sub 'google._domainkey.${DomainName}'

        - Name: !Sub 'zendesk-verification.${DomainName}'
