AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Automation infrastructure for Aurora Global Database failover. Provisions an
  SSM automation role, a Lambda execution role, an SSM Automation document that
  determines the active region via Route 53 ARC, performs the Aurora global
  cluster failover, and flips ARC routing controls while updating a Secrets
  Manager secret with the new writer endpoint, plus a TriggerFailover Lambda
  function that starts the automation execution on demand. A customer-managed
  KMS key encrypts the log group and the secret.

Parameters:
  PrimaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-\d{1}$'
    Description: The primary AWS region of the Aurora Global Database.
  SecondaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-\d{1}$'
    Description: The secondary AWS region of the Aurora Global Database.

Resources:

  AuroraFailoverCmk:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for Aurora failover log group and secret.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/TriggerFailover'
          - Sid: AllowSecretsManager
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: secretsmanager.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'

  AuroraFailoverCmkAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/aurora-failover-cmk
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuroraFailoverCmk

  AuroraFailoverSSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: AuroraFailoverSSMAutomationRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AuroraFailoverSSMAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RDSGlobalClusterAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:DescribeDBClusters
                  - rds:DescribeGlobalClusters
                  - rds:FailoverGlobalCluster
                  - rds:SwitchoverGlobalCluster
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:rds:*:${AWS::AccountId}:global-cluster:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:rds:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster:*'
              - Sid: RDSDescribeAll
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:DescribeDBClusters
                  - rds:DescribeGlobalClusters
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Route53ARCAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:GetRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:UpdateRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:ListRoutingControls
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeCluster
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeControlPanel
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeRoutingControl
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeSafetyRule
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListClusters
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListControlPanels
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListRoutingControls
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListSafetyRules
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SecretsManagerAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Ref AuroraWriterEndpointSecret
              - Sid: KmsAccessForSecret
                Effect: Allow

                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt

    Properties:
      RoleName: TriggerFailoverLambdaRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:

          PolicyDocument:

            Statement:
              - Sid: StartAutomationExecution
                Effect: Allow

                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution

                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument'

        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludePunctuation: true

  AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Determines the active region via Route 53 ARC, performs an Aurora
          Global Database failover, then flips ARC routing controls and updates
          the Secrets Manager secret with the new writer endpoint.
        assumeRole: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/AuroraFailoverSSMAutomationRole'
        parameters:
          PrimaryRegion:
            type: String
            default: us-east-1
            description: The primary AWS region of the Aurora Global Database.
          SecondaryRegion:
            type: String
            default: us-west-2
            description: The secondary AWS region of the Aurora Global Database.
        mainSteps:
          - name: DetermineActiveRegion
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Determine the active region by reading ARC routing control state.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: determine_active_region
              InputPayload:
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def determine_active_region(events, context):
                    primary = events['PrimaryRegion']
                    secondary = events['SecondaryRegion']
                    client = boto3.client('route53-recovery-cluster')
                    active_region = primary
                    try:
                        controls = client.list_routing_controls(
                            MaxResults=100
                        )
                        for control in controls.get('RoutingControls', []):
                            state = client.get_routing_control_state(
                                RoutingControlArn=control['RoutingControlArn']
                            )
                            if state.get('RoutingControlState') == 'On':
                                active_region = primary
                                break
                    except Exception:
                        active_region = primary
                    return {
                        'ActiveRegion': active_region,
                        'PrimaryRegion': primary,
                        'SecondaryRegion': secondary
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.ActiveRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: PrimaryRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.PrimaryRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: SecondaryRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.SecondaryRegion
                Type: String

          - name: PerformGlobalClusterFailover
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Perform the Aurora global cluster failover to the target region.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: perform_failover
              InputPayload:
                ActiveRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.ActiveRegion }}'
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.SecondaryRegion }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def perform_failover(events, context):
                    active = events['ActiveRegion']
                    primary = events['PrimaryRegion']
                    secondary = events['SecondaryRegion']
                    target = secondary if active == primary else primary
                    client = boto3.client('rds')
                    clusters = client.describe_global_clusters()
                    global_clusters = clusters.get('GlobalClusters', [])
                    if not global_clusters:
                        raise Exception('No Aurora global clusters found')
                    global_cluster_id = global_clusters[0]['GlobalClusterIdentifier']
                    client.failover_global_cluster(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id,
                        TargetDbClusterIdentifier=target
                    )
                    return {
                        'GlobalClusterIdentifier': global_cluster_id,
                        'TargetRegion': target
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: GlobalClusterIdentifier
                Selector: $.Payload.GlobalClusterIdentifier
                Type: String
              - Name: TargetRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.TargetRegion
                Type: String

          - name: FlipRoutingControlsAndUpdateSecret
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: >-
              Flip ARC routing control states and update the Secrets Manager
              secret with the new writer endpoint.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: flip_and_update
              InputPayload:
                TargetRegion: '{{ PerformGlobalClusterFailover.TargetRegion }}'
                GlobalClusterIdentifier: '{{ PerformGlobalClusterFailover.GlobalClusterIdentifier }}'
                SecretArn: !Ref AuroraWriterEndpointSecret
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import json

                def flip_and_update(events, context):
                    target_region = events['TargetRegion']
                    global_cluster_id = events['GlobalClusterIdentifier']
                    secret_arn = events['SecretArn']

                    arc = boto3.client('route53-recovery-cluster')
                    controls = arc.list_routing_controls(MaxResults=100)
                    for control in controls.get('RoutingControls', []):
                        arn = control['RoutingControlArn']
                        state = arc.get_routing_control_state(
                            RoutingControlArn=arn
                        )
                        current = state.get('RoutingControlState')
                        new_state = 'Off' if current == 'On' else 'On'
                        arc.update_routing_control_state(
                            RoutingControlArn=arn,
                            RoutingControlState=new_state
                        )

                    rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name=target_region)
                    clusters = rds.describe_db_clusters()
                    writer_endpoint = None
                    for cluster in clusters.get('DBClusters', []):
                        if cluster.get('GlobalWriteForwardingStatus') in (None, 'disabled'):
                            writer_endpoint = cluster.get('Endpoint')
                            if writer_endpoint:
                                break
                    if not writer_endpoint:
                        raise Exception('Unable to determine new writer endpoint')

                    secrets = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
                    secrets.put_secret_value(
                        SecretId=secret_arn,
                        SecretString=json.dumps({
                            'endpoint': writer_endpoint,
                            'port': '3306'
                        })
                    )
                    return {
                        'WriterEndpoint': writer_endpoint,
                        'TargetRegion': target_region,
                        'GlobalClusterIdentifier': global_cluster_id
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: WriterEndpoint
                Selector: $.Payload.WriterEndpoint
                Type: String
              - Name: TargetRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.TargetRegion
                Type: String

  TriggerFailover:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: TriggerFailoverLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: TriggerFailover
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt TriggerFailoverLambdaRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DOCUMENT_NAME: !Ref AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
          SECRET_ARN: !Ref AuroraWriterEndpointSecret
          PRIMARY_REGION: !Ref PrimaryRegion
          SECONDARY_REGION: !Ref SecondaryRegion
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              document_name = os.environ['DOCUMENT_NAME']
              primary_region = os.environ.get('PRIMARY_REGION', 'us-east-1')
              secondary_region = os.environ.get('SECONDARY_REGION', 'us-west-2')

              ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
              response = ssm.start_automation_execution(
                  DocumentName=document_name,
                  Parameters={
                      'PrimaryRegion': [primary_region],
                      'SecondaryRegion': [secondary_region]
                  }
              )
              return {
                  'AutomationExecutionId': response['AutomationExecutionId'],
                  'DocumentName': document_name
              }

Outputs:
  SSMDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation document.
    Value: !Ref AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
  TriggerFailoverFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the TriggerFailover Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt TriggerFailover.Arn
  AutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SSM automation execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt AuroraFailoverSSMAutomationRole.Arn
  LambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt TriggerFailoverLambdaRole.Arn
  WriterEndpointSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the writer endpoint.
    Value: !Ref AuroraWriterEndpointSecret
  CmkArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key.
    Value: !GetAtt AuroraFailoverCmk.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Multi-tenant QuickSight dashboard application on AWS App Runner with ECR repository, build role, and task role. Two-phase deploy - Phase 1 deploy with DeployService=false to create the repository, push an image tagged with ImageTag, then Phase 2 update the stack with DeployService=true to create the App Runner service.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: quicksight-multitenant-app
    Description: Name of the application used for resource tagging.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment tag.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
  ImageTag:
    Type: String
    Default: v1
    Description: Container image tag to deploy from the ECR repository. The default v1 is a placeholder used only when DeployService=false. When DeployService=true, override this with the tag of an image you have already pushed to the repository. Repository tags are immutable, so each deploy must use a unique tag.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$'
  DeployService:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Set to true only after an image tagged with ImageTag has been pushed to the ECR repository. When false, the App Runner service is not created.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

Conditions:
  ShouldDeployService: !Equals [!Ref DeployService, 'true']

Resources:
  AppKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for ECR repository and Secrets Manager secret encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEcrServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecr.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:RetireGrant
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowSecretsManagerServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: secretsmanager.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'secretsmanager.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-kms'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AppKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-kms'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AppKmsKey

  AppRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KmsKey: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-ecr'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  BuildRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-apprunner-build-role'
      Description: App Runner build role granting ECR image pull access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAppRunnerBuildAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: build.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcrPullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrAuthorizationToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrRepositoryAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                Resource: !GetAtt AppRepository.Arn
              - Sid: EcrRepositoryDecrypt
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-apprunner-build-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-apprunner-task-role'
      Description: App Runner instance role granting Directory Service and QuickSight access for tenant provisioning.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAppRunnerTasksAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DirectoryServiceAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DirectoryServiceActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ds:DescribeDirectories
                  - ds:CreateMicrosoftAD
                  - ds:AuthorizeApplication
                  - ds:UnauthorizeApplication
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: QuickSightAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightTenantProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:CreateNamespace
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSet
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSource
                  - quicksight:RegisterUser
                  - quicksight:DescribeNamespace
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:CreateGroup
                  - quicksight:CreateGroupMembership
                  - quicksight:DescribeGroup
                  - quicksight:ListUsers
                  - quicksight:ListNamespaces
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-apprunner-task-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AppSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-secret'
      Description: Placeholder secret for QuickSight integration credentials.
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"admin"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludePunctuation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-app-secret'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AppRunnerService:
    Type: AWS::AppRunner::Service
    Condition: ShouldDeployService
    Metadata:
      Comment: Created only when DeployService=true. An image tagged with the ImageTag parameter value must already exist in AppRepository. The container must listen on port 8080 and serve HTTP 200 on /status.
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service'
      SourceConfiguration:
        AutoDeploymentsEnabled: true
        AuthenticationConfiguration:
          AccessRoleArn: !GetAtt BuildRole.Arn
        ImageRepository:
          ImageIdentifier: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${AppRepository}:${ImageTag}'
          ImageRepositoryType: ECR
          ImageConfiguration:
            Port: '8080'
            RuntimeEnvironmentVariables:
              - Name: ALLOW_IP_RANGE
                Value: 0.0.0.0/0
              - Name: AWS_REGION
                Value: !Ref AWS::Region
              - Name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
                Value: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              - Name: ADMIN_EMAIL
                Value: admin@example.com
              - Name: ADMIN_USER_NAME
                Value: admin
              - Name: QS_TEMPLATE_ID
                Value: tenant-dashboard-template
              - Name: QS_DATASET_ID
                Value: tenant-dataset

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CIS AWS Foundations aligned VPC Flow Logs enablement solution using AWS Systems Manager
  Automation. Creates a CMK-encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group, a flow logs delivery IAM
  role, an automation execution IAM role, a direct-enable automation document, and a
  Change Manager gated automation document.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name used for tagging resources in this stack.
    Default: production
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'

Resources:

  FlowLogsLogGroupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch Logs log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}-cis'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CIS-VPC-FlowLogs

  FlowLogsLogGroupKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroupKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}-cis'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroupKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CIS-VPC-FlowLogs

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-delivery-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by VPC Flow Logs to deliver logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogsLogGroup}'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroupKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-automation-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by SSM Automation to enable VPC Flow Logs and manage Change Manager requests.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EC2FlowLogsManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: KmsForLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroupKey.Arn
              - Sid: PassFlowLogsRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
              - Sid: ChangeManagerPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartChangeRequestExecution
                  - ssm:CreateOpsItem
                  - ssm:DescribeOpsItems
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:GetDocument
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DirectEnableFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-EnableVpcFlowLogsDirect'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture on a specified VPC,
          delivering to the CloudWatch Logs log group created by this stack.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC on which to enable flow logs.
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: The CloudWatch Logs log group name to deliver flow logs to.
            default: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
          DeliverLogsPermissionArn:
            type: String
            description: The IAM role ARN used by VPC Flow Logs to deliver logs.
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Invoke EC2 CreateFlowLogs to enable REJECT flow logging on the VPC.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
                DeliverLogsPermissionArn: '{{ DeliverLogsPermissionArn }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def handler(event, context):
                    vpc_id = event['VpcId']
                    log_group_name = event['LogGroupName']
                    role_arn = event['DeliverLogsPermissionArn']

                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    existing = ec2.describe_flow_logs(
                        Filters=[
                            {'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},
                            {'Name': 'log-destination-type', 'Values': ['cloud-watch-logs']},
                        ]
                    ).get('FlowLogs', [])

                    for fl in existing:
                        if fl.get('TrafficType') == 'REJECT' and fl.get('FlowLogStatus') == 'ACTIVE':
                            return {
                                'VpcId': vpc_id,
                                'FlowLogId': fl.get('FlowLogId'),
                                'Status': 'AlreadyEnabled',
                            }

                    response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                        ResourceType='VPC',
                        TrafficType='REJECT',
                        LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                        LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=role_arn,
                    )

                    unsuccessful = response.get('Unsuccessful', [])
                    if unsuccessful:
                        raise Exception('CreateFlowLogs failed: {}'.format(unsuccessful))

                    flow_log_ids = response.get('FlowLogIds', [])
                    return {
                        'VpcId': vpc_id,
                        'FlowLogIds': flow_log_ids,
                        'Status': 'Created',
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: VpcId
                Selector: $.Payload.VpcId
                Type: String
              - Name: FlowLogIds
                Selector: $.Payload.FlowLogIds
                Type: StringList
              - Name: Status
                Selector: $.Payload.Status
                Type: String
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ChangeManagerFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn:
      - DirectEnableFlowLogsDocument
      - AutomationExecutionRole
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-EnableVpcFlowLogsViaChangeManager'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Routes VPC Flow Logs enablement through AWS Systems Manager Change Manager
          as a formal change request, then executes the direct-enable automation document.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC on which to enable flow logs.
          ChangeRequestTitle:
            type: String
            description: Title for the Change Manager change request.
            default: Enable VPC Flow Logs (REJECT) per CIS AWS Foundations
          ChangeRequestDescription:
            type: String
            description: Description for the Change Manager change request.
            default: Enables VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture on the target VPC.
        mainSteps:
          - name: StartChangeRequestExecution

Resources:
  LambdaLogGroupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt the Lambda CloudWatch log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'

      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          route53 = boto3.client('route53')


          def send_response(event, context, status, data=None, physical_resource_id=None, reason=None):
              log_stream = getattr(context, 'log_stream_name', None) or physical_resource_id or 'custom-resource'
              body = {
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': reason or 'See CloudWatch Log Stream: {}'.format(log_stream),
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or log_stream,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': data or {},
              }
              payload = json.dumps(body).encode('utf-8')
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event['ResponseURL'],
                  data=payload,
                  method='PUT',
                  headers={'Content-Type': '', 'Content-Length': str(len(payload))},
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                  logger.info('Response status: %s', resp.status)


          def build_data(delegation_set):
              nameservers = delegation_set.get('NameServers', [])
              data = {'DelegationSetId': delegation_set.get('Id', '')}
              for idx in range(4):
                  ns = nameservers[idx] if idx < len(nameservers) else ''
                  data['NameServer{}'.format(idx + 1)] = ns
                  data['IPv4Address{}'.format(idx + 1)] = ''
                  data['IPv6Address{}'.format(idx + 1)] = ''
              return data


          def find_delegation_set_by_caller_reference(caller_reference):
              paginator = route53.get_paginator('list_reusable_delegation_sets')
              for page in paginator.paginate():
                  for delegation_set in page.get('DelegationSets', []):
                      if delegation_set.get('CallerReference') == caller_reference:
                          return delegation_set
              return None


          def create_or_adopt_delegation_set(caller_reference):
              try:
                  response = route53.create_reusable_delegation_set(
                      CallerReference=caller_reference
                  )
                  return response['DelegationSet']
              except ClientError as exc:
                  code = exc.response.get('Error', {}).get('Code', '')
                  if code != 'DelegationSetAlreadyCreated':
                      raise
                  logger.info('Delegation set already exists for caller reference %s, adopting', caller_reference)
                  existing = find_delegation_set_by_caller_reference(caller_reference)
                  if existing is None:
                      raise
                  return existing


          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info('Received event: %s', json.dumps(event))
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              properties = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              caller_reference = properties.get('CallerReference', 'reusable-delegation-set')
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')

              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      delegation_set = create_or_adopt_delegation_set(caller_reference)
                      data = build_data(delegation_set)
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', data, delegation_set['Id'])
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      if physical_id:
                          try:
                              response = route53.get_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_id)
                              delegation_set = response['DelegationSet']
                              data = build_data(delegation_set)
                              send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', data, physical_id)
                              return
                          except route53.exceptions.NoSuchDelegationSet:
                              logger.info('Delegation set %s not found, recreating', physical_id)
                      delegation_set = create_or_adopt_delegation_set(caller_reference)
                      data = build_data(delegation_set)
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', data, delegation_set['Id'])
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if physical_id:
                          try:
                              route53.delete_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_id)
                          except route53.exceptions.NoSuchDelegationSet:
                              logger.info('Delegation set %s already deleted', physical_id)
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_id)
                  else:
                      send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', reason='Unsupported request type: {}'.format(request_type), physical_resource_id=physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                  logger.exception('Failed to process request')
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', reason=str(exc), physical_resource_id=physical_id)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless WebSocket API (API Gateway v2) that asynchronously invokes a Step Functions state machine on the default route, waits 5 seconds, and posts a response back to the connected WebSocket client via the API Gateway Management API.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: Name of the API Gateway WebSocket stage (also used in the callback URL).
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag applied to all resources.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS CMK for CloudWatch Logs encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LogGroupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for WebSocket API access log group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs log group for API Gateway access logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}-websocket-access'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogGroupKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # WebSocket API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by API Gateway to call Step Functions StartExecution
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Integration: AWS integration to Step Functions StartExecution
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole.Arn
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json: !Sub
          - |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineArn}",
              "input": "{\"message\": $util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$')), \"connectionId\": \"$context.connectionId\"}"
            }
          - StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine
      TimeoutInMillis: 29000

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Default route bound to the Step Functions integration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${StepFunctionsIntegration}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Stage (auto-deploy so the default route is live immediately)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt WebSocketAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","connectionId":"$context.connectionId","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status","integrationErrorMessage":"$context.integrationErrorMessage","errorMessage":"$context.error.message"}'
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role for the state machine (PostToConnection via execute-api)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageConnectionsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/POST/@connections/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Standard Step Functions state machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "StartAt": "WaitFiveSeconds",
            "States": {
              "WaitFiveSeconds": {
                "Type": "Wait",
                "Seconds": 5,
                "Next": "PostToConnection"
              },
              "PostToConnection": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::apigateway:invoke",
                "Parameters": {
                  "ApiEndpoint": "${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com",
                  "Method": "POST",
                  "Stage": "${StageName}",
                  "Path.$": "States.Format('/@connections/{}', $.connectionId)",
                  "RequestBody": {
                    "message.$": "$.message",
                    "connectionId.$": "$.connectionId"

    Default: CostManagement
    Description: Value for the Application tag.

  EnvironmentTag:
    Type: String
    Default: Production
    AllowedValues:
      - Production
      - Staging
      - Development
    Description: Value for the Environment tag.

Conditions:
  UseSms: !Equals [!Ref NotificationMethod, SMS]
  UseEmail: !Equals [!Ref NotificationMethod, EMAIL]

              - kms:DescribeKey

            Condition:

                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationTag
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BillingTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/billing-topic-key

          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag

  for the ontology lookup service. Creates a user pool with software-token MFA,

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless content moderation API using Amazon Rekognition. Creates a REST API (ContentModeration) with a prod stage and a Python 3.14 Lambda (invokeContentModeration) that validates an image URL, fetches the image, and returns Rekognition DetectModerationLabels results.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS CMK for CloudWatch log group encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt CloudWatch log groups for the content moderation workload.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: invokeContentModeration-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: invokeContentModeration-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/invokeContentModeration:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda log group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/invokeContentModeration
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ContentModerationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 512
      Timeout: 30
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import socket
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error
          from urllib.parse import urlparse

          import boto3

          MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024
          ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = ('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png')
          FETCH_TIMEOUT = 10
          MIN_CONFIDENCE = 60

          CORS_HEADERS = {
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,POST',
          }


          def _response(status_code, body):
              headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
              headers.update(CORS_HEADERS)
              return {
                  'statusCode': status_code,
                  'headers': headers,
                  'body': json.dumps(body),
              }


          def _error(status_code, message):
              return _response(status_code, {'error': message})


          def _parse_body(event):
              body = event.get('body')
              if body is None:
                  return None
              if isinstance(body, dict):
                  return body
              if isinstance(body, (bytes, bytearray)):
                  body = body.decode('utf-8')
              if isinstance(body, str):
                  try:
                      return json.loads(body)
                  except (ValueError, TypeError):
                      return None
              return None


          def _validate_extension(url):
              path = urlparse(url).path.lower()
              return path.endswith(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS)


          def _fetch_image(url):
              request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'ContentModeration/1.0'})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=FETCH_TIMEOUT) as response:
                  content_length = response.headers.get('Content-Length')
                  if content_length is not None:
                      try:
                          if int(content_length) > MAX_BYTES:
                              return None, _error(413, 'Image exceeds the 5MB size limit.')
                      except (ValueError, TypeError):
                          pass
                  data = response.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)
              if len(data) > MAX_BYTES:
                  return None, _error(413, 'Image exceeds the 5MB size limit.')
              return data, None


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  payload = _parse_body(event)
                  if not isinstance(payload, dict):
                      return _error(400, 'Request body must be a JSON object containing a "url" field.')

                  url = payload.get('url')
                  if not url or not isinstance(url, str):
                      return _error(400, 'Missing required "url" field in request body.')

                  if not _validate_extension(url):
                      return _error(415, 'Unsupported image format. Supported formats are jpg, jpeg, and png.')

                  try:
                      image_bytes, fetch_error = _fetch_image(url)
                  except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
                      if exc.code == 404:
                          return _error(404, 'Image not found at the provided URL.')
                      return _error(502, 'Failed to fetch image: upstream returned HTTP {0}.'.format(exc.code))
                  except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
                      reason = getattr(exc, 'reason', exc)
                      if isinstance(reason, socket.timeout):
                          return _error(504, 'Timed out while fetching the image.')
                      return _error(502, 'Failed to fetch image: {0}.'.format(reason))
                  except socket.timeout:
                      return _error(504, 'Timed out while fetching the image.')

                  if fetch_error is not None:
                      return fetch_error

                  if not image_bytes:
                      return _error(400, 'The fetched image is empty.')

                  client = boto3.client('rekognition')
                  result = client.detect_moderation_labels(
                      Image={'Bytes': image_bytes},
                      MinConfidence=MIN_CONFIDENCE,
                  )

                  labels = []
                  for label in result.get('ModerationLabels', []):
                      item = {
                          'Name': label.get('Name'),
                          'Confidence': label.get('Confidence'),
                      }
                      if label.get('ParentName'):
                          item['ParentName'] = label.get('ParentName')
                      labels.append(item)

                  return _response(200, {
                      'ModerationLabels': labels,
                      'Count': len(labels),
                  })
              except Exception:
                  return _error(500, 'Internal server error while processing the image.')

  # Lambda permission for API Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ContentModerationFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ContentModerationFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ContentModerationApi}/*/POST/moderate'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ContentModerationApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:

  ContentModerationResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi

  ContentModerationMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ContentModerationResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    DependsOn:

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ContentModerationDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:

    Properties:

      Description: Deployment for the ContentModeration API.

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

        Statement:

  ApiGatewayAccount:

      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

  ContentModerationStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ContentModerationDeployment
      StageName: prod
      Description: Production stage for the ContentModeration API.
      TracingEnabled: true

        Format: >-

      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 100
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 200
          LoggingLevel: ERROR
          MetricsEnabled: true
          CachingEnabled: true
          CacheDataEncrypted: true

    Description: ID of the API key required to invoke the content moderation endpoint.
    Value: !Ref ContentModerationApiKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: StudyBuddy Cognito user pool with Lambda triggers, SPA app client, Hosted UI domain, and Google identity provider backed by Secrets Manager.

Parameters:
  FrontendDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: localhost:3000
    Description: Frontend domain (host[:port]) used to build OAuth callback and logout URLs.

Resources:
  StudyBuddyUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: StudyBuddyUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Your StudyBuddy verification code is {####}.'
      EmailVerificationSubject: StudyBuddy verification code
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn

  PostAuthenticationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess

  PostConfirmationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess

  PreSignUpFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess

  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: StudyBuddyPostAuthentication
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              return event

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: StudyBuddyPostConfirmation
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              return event

  PreSignUpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: StudyBuddyPreSignUp
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              return event

  PostAuthenticationFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  PostConfirmationFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  PreSignUpFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  GoogleOAuthSecretKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key protecting the StudyBuddy Google OAuth secret.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSecretsManagerUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: secretsmanager.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'secretsmanager.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  GoogleOAuthSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: StudyBuddyGoogleOAuth
      Description: Google OAuth client credentials for StudyBuddy Cognito identity provider.
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt GoogleOAuthSecretKey.Arn
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"client_id":"REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"}'
        GenerateStringKey: client_secret
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludePunctuation: true

  GoogleIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      ProviderName: Google
      ProviderType: Google
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${GoogleOAuthSecret}:SecretString:client_id}}'
        client_secret: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${GoogleOAuthSecret}:SecretString:client_secret}}'
        authorize_scopes: profile email openid

  StudyBuddyUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: GoogleIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ClientName: StudyBuddyFrontend
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${FrontendDomainName}/callback'
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${FrontendDomainName}/logout'
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  StudyBuddyUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      Domain: !Sub 'studybuddy-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: StudyBuddy Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: StudyBuddy Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: StudyBuddy frontend app client ID.
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPoolClient
  HostedUIDomain:
    Description: Cognito Hosted UI domain prefix.
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPoolDomain
  GoogleOAuthSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding Google OAuth credentials.
    Value: !Ref GoogleOAuthSecret
  GoogleOAuthSecretKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key protecting the Google OAuth secret.
    Value: !GetAtt GoogleOAuthSecretKey.Arn

Description: >

  (10.50.0.0/16) and a Fog layer (10.60.0.0/16). Each VPC has one subnet in the
  first available AZ, one route table, an S3 gateway endpoint, and a KMS

    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  FogVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.60.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the Fog VPC.

  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt VPC flow log groups.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              - 'kms:CreateGrant'
              - 'kms:RetireGrant'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FlowLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKey

  UsersFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn: FlowLogsKey
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}-users'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-users-flowlogs'
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Users
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FogFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn: FlowLogsKey
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}-fog'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fog-flowlogs'
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Fog
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFlowLogsDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt UsersFlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${UsersFlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
                  - !GetAtt FogFlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FogFlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  UsersFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref UsersVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt UsersFlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-users-flowlog'
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Users
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FogFlowLog:

        - Key: Layer
          Value: Fog
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
