AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Automation rules for AWS Security Hub that suppress reviewed/accepted
  (non-actionable) finding categories by setting workflow status to SUPPRESSED
  with an explanatory note. The substantive deliverable is the seven
  AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule resources. An AWS::SecurityHub::Hub resource
  is included solely to satisfy the Security Hub API precondition (the account
  must be subscribed to Security Hub CSPM before automation rules can be
  created). The Hub resource is idempotent: if the account is already
  subscribed it will not disrupt existing configuration; if deploying to a
  different account, confirm that account's subscription state. No standards,
  insights, or findings pipelines are enabled by this template.

Parameters:
  IamExcludedUserNames:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >
      Names of the specific human IAM users whose IAM-related findings must NOT
      be suppressed (excluded from Rule 1). Provide the IAM user names.
    Default: 'break-glass-admin,security-auditor'
    ConstraintDescription: Comma-separated list of IAM user names.

  CisSubAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      AWS account ID of the designated sub-account to which the CIS benchmark
      suppression rule (Rule 2) is scoped.
    Default: '111111111111'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.

  CisFindingTitles:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >
      Specific CIS benchmark finding titles to suppress for the designated
      sub-account (Rule 2).
    Default: >
      1.1 Avoid the use of the root account,
      1.4 Ensure no root account access key exists,
      1.5 Ensure MFA is enabled for the root account,
      2.1.1 Ensure S3 Bucket Policy is set to deny HTTP requests

  BroadCisAndFsbpFindingTitles:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >
      CIS and AWS Foundational Security Best Practices finding titles to
      suppress organization-wide (Rule 3), including security groups permitting
      administrative ports, S3 public-access/HTTP settings, and AWS Config
      regional coverage.
    Default: >
      EC2.18 Security groups should only allow unrestricted incoming traffic for authorized ports,
      EC2.19 Security groups should not allow unrestricted access to ports with high risk,
      S3.2 S3 buckets should prohibit public read access,
      S3.5 S3 buckets should require requests to use Secure Socket Layer,
      S3.1 S3 Block Public Access setting should be enabled,
      Config.1 AWS Config should be enabled,
      CIS 4.1 Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22,
      CIS 4.2 Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 3389

  IntentionallyPublicBucketNames:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >
      Known list of S3 bucket names that are intentionally public; public-access
      findings for these buckets are suppressed (Rule 4).
    Default: 'public-website-assets,public-docs-bucket'

  EbsDefaultEncryptionAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      AWS account ID for which the EBS default-encryption finding is suppressed
      (Rule 5).
    Default: '222222222222'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.

  EbsDefaultEncryptionFindingTitle:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Finding title for the EBS default-encryption finding to suppress (Rule 5).
    Default: 'EC2.7 EBS default encryption should be enabled'

  AutomationAccountIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >
      Two AWS account IDs that run automation infrequently; unused-credential
      and access-key-rotation findings are suppressed for these accounts
      (Rule 6).
    Default: '333333333333,444444444444'

  UnusedCredentialFindingTitles:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >
      Unused-credential and access-key-rotation finding titles to suppress for
      the automation accounts (Rule 6).
    Default: >
      IAM.8 Unused credentials should be disabled,
      IAM.3 IAM users' access keys should be rotated every 90 days or less,
      CIS 1.12 Ensure credentials unused for 45 days or greater are disabled,
      CIS 1.14 Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less

  GuardDutyBedrockFindingType:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      The specific GuardDuty finding type related to expected cross-account
      Bedrock API activity to suppress (Rule 7).
    Default: 'UnauthorizedAccess:Bedrock/CrossAccountAPIActivity'

Resources:
  SecurityHubHub:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::Hub
    Properties:
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: SecurityHubAutomationRulesPrecondition

  SuppressIamFindingsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: SecurityHubHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-IAM-Findings-Excluding-Named-Users
      RuleOrder: 1
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: >
        Suppresses IAM-related findings organization-wide, excluding findings
        associated with specific named human users.
      Criteria:
        ProductName:
          - Value: Security Hub
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceType:
          - Value: AwsIamUser
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: !Join [',', !Ref IamExcludedUserNames]
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >
                IAM-related finding reviewed and accepted as expected/non-actionable.
                Suppressed organization-wide except for the named human users who
                are explicitly excluded from suppression.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityAutomation

  SuppressCisSubAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: SecurityHubHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-CIS-Findings-Designated-SubAccount
      RuleOrder: 2
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: >
        Suppresses a handful of specific CIS benchmark findings scoped to one
        designated sub-account.
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !Ref CisSubAccountId
            Comparison: EQUALS
        Title:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Join [',', !Ref CisFindingTitles]
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >
                CIS benchmark finding reviewed and accepted as expected for the
                designated sub-account. Suppressed as non-actionable.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityAutomation

  SuppressBroadCisFsbpRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: SecurityHubHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-Broad-CIS-FSBP-Findings
      RuleOrder: 3
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: >
        Suppresses a set of CIS and AWS Foundational Security Best Practices
        findings organization-wide, including security groups permitting
        administrative ports, S3 public-access/HTTP settings, and AWS Config
        regional coverage.
      Criteria:
        Title:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Join [',', !Ref BroadCisAndFsbpFindingTitles]
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >
                CIS/FSBP finding reviewed and accepted as expected/non-actionable
                organization-wide (e.g. administrative ports for bastion hosts and
                testing, S3 public-access/HTTP settings, AWS Config regional
                coverage). Suppressed.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityAutomation

  SuppressIntentionallyPublicBucketsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: SecurityHubHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-Intentionally-Public-Buckets
      RuleOrder: 4
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: >
        Suppresses public-access findings for a known list of S3 buckets that
        are intentionally public.
      Criteria:
        ResourceType:
          - Value: AwsS3Bucket
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Join [',', !Ref IntentionallyPublicBucketNames]
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >
                Public-access finding for an intentionally public S3 bucket.
                Reviewed and accepted as expected/non-actionable. Suppressed.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityAutomation

  SuppressEbsDefaultEncryptionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: SecurityHubHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-EBS-Default-Encryption-Finding
      RuleOrder: 5
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: >
        Suppresses the EBS default-encryption finding for one specific account.
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !Ref EbsDefaultEncryptionAccountId
            Comparison: EQUALS
        Title:
          - Value: !Ref EbsDefaultEncryptionFindingTitle
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >
                EBS default-encryption finding reviewed and accepted as
                expected/non-actionable for this account. Suppressed.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityAutomation

  SuppressAutomationAccountCredentialRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: SecurityHubHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-Unused-Credential-Findings-Automation-Accounts
      RuleOrder: 6
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: >
        Suppresses unused-credential and access-key-rotation findings for two
        specific accounts that run automation infrequently.
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !Join [',', !Ref AutomationAccountIds]
            Comparison: EQUALS
        Title:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Join [',', !Ref UnusedCredentialFindingTitles]
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >
                Unused-credential/access-key-rotation finding for an account that
                runs automation infrequently. Reviewed and accepted as
                expected/non-actionable. Suppressed.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityAutomation

  SuppressGuardDutyBedrockRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: SecurityHubHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-GuardDuty-Bedrock-CrossAccount
      RuleOrder: 7
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: >
        Suppresses one specific GuardDuty finding type related to expected
        cross-account Bedrock API activity.
      Criteria:
        ProductName:
          - Value: GuardDuty
            Comparison: EQUALS
        Type:
          - Value: !Ref GuardDutyBedrockFindingType
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >
                GuardDuty finding for expected cross-account Bedrock API activity.
                Reviewed and accepted as expected/non-actionable. Suppressed.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityAutomation

Outputs:
  SecurityHubHubArn:
    Description: ARN of the Security Hub hub (subscription precondition).
    Value: !GetAtt SecurityHubHub.ARN

  SuppressIamFindingsRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM findings suppression automation rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressIamFindingsRule.RuleArn

  SuppressCisSubAccountRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CIS sub-account suppression automation rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressCisSubAccountRule.RuleArn

  SuppressBroadCisFsbpRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the broad CIS/FSBP suppression automation rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressBroadCisFsbpRule.RuleArn

  SuppressIntentionallyPublicBucketsRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the intentionally-public buckets suppression automation rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressIntentionallyPublicBucketsRule.RuleArn

  SuppressEbsDefaultEncryptionRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EBS default-encryption suppression automation rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressEbsDefaultEncryptionRule.RuleArn

  SuppressAutomationAccountCredentialRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the automation-account credential suppression automation rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressAutomationAccountCredentialRule.RuleArn

  SuppressGuardDutyBedrockRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the GuardDuty Bedrock cross-account suppression automation rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressGuardDutyBedrockRule.RuleArn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BacMcpToolExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'bac-mcp-tool-exec-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bac-mcp-tool-bedrock-invoke
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                Effect: Allow

                  - bedrock:InvokeModel

                Resource:

        - PolicyName: bac-mcp-tool-cost-explorer
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                Effect: Allow

                  - ce:GetTags
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsageWithResources
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: bac-mcp-tool-cost-usage-report

            Statement:

  BacMcpTool:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: BacMcpToolLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: bac-mcp-tool
      Description: MCP tool Lambda for testing an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: app.lambda_handler
      Timeout: !Ref FunctionTimeout
      MemorySize: !Ref FunctionMemorySize
      Role: !GetAtt BacMcpToolExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_GROUP_NAME: !Ref BacMcpToolLogGroup
          PROJECT: bac-mcp-tool
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          PROJECT = os.environ.get("PROJECT", "bac-mcp-tool")
          LOG_GROUP_NAME = os.environ.get("LOG_GROUP_NAME", "")


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              """MCP tool entry point for the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.

              Accepts an MCP-style JSON-RPC request and returns a JSON-RPC
              response. Extend the tool dispatch below with the concrete
              operations (Bedrock invoke, Cost Explorer, CUR, S3) as needed.
              """
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event, default=str))

              request_id = event.get("id") if isinstance(event, dict) else None
              method = event.get("method") if isinstance(event, dict) else None

              if method == "tools/list":
                  result = {
                      "tools": [
                          {
                              "name": "ping",
                              "description": "Health check for the bac-mcp-tool MCP server.",
                              "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {}},
                          }
                      ]
                  }
              elif method == "tools/call":
                  result = {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "pong"}]}
              else:
                  result = {"status": "ok", "project": PROJECT, "logGroup": LOG_GROUP_NAME}

              return {
                  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                  "id": request_id,
                  "result": result,
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: bac-mcp-tool
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'bac-mcp-tool-gateway-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAgentCoreGatewaySameAccount

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bac-mcp-tool-gateway-invoke-lambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeBacMcpToolFunction
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt BacMcpTool.Arn
                  - !Sub '${BacMcpTool.Arn}:*'
        - PolicyName: bac-mcp-tool-gateway-agentcore
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageAgentCoreResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:CreateGateway
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetGateway
                  - bedrock-agentcore:UpdateGateway
                  - bedrock-agentcore:DeleteGateway
                  - bedrock-agentcore:ListGateways
                  - bedrock-agentcore:InvokeGateway
                  - bedrock-agentcore:CreateGatewayTarget
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetGatewayTarget
                  - bedrock-agentcore:UpdateGatewayTarget
                  - bedrock-agentcore:DeleteGatewayTarget
                  - bedrock-agentcore:ListGatewayTargets
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
        - PolicyName: bac-mcp-tool-gateway-passrole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassInTemplateRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt BacMcpToolExecutionRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
        - PolicyName: bac-mcp-tool-gateway-s3
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ObjectOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: bac-mcp-tool-gateway-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteGatewayLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: bac-mcp-tool
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Automated EC2 Image Builder pipeline producing a CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023
  ARM-based AMI, pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility, scanned with Amazon
  Inspector, built daily, distributed to the current region with launch permissions shared
  to an AWS Organization and two deployment accounts, and pruned after 6 months by a
  lifecycle policy. All supporting infrastructure (VPC, subnets, NAT, security group, flow
  logs, KMS key, IAM roles and instance profile) is created by this template (greenfield
  account).

# NOTE / OBJECTIVE FLAG:
# The CIS-hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM parent image
# (cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi) is NOT created by this
# template and is not present in a greenfield account. To keep the template deployable, the
# ParentImageArn parameter defaults to an AWS-managed Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 Image Builder
# image that exists in every account/region. Once the CIS-hardened image has been verified
# and shared into the target account/region, supply its real ARN via the ParentImageArn
# parameter, e.g.:
#   arn:aws:imagebuilder:<region>:<account>:image/cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/<version>
# The exact ARN and version MUST be verified to exist before use.
#
# Vulnerability scanning is performed by a template-created Inspector scan component
# (InspectorScanComponent) so the recipe has no dependency on an unverified AWS-managed
# component ARN.

Parameters:
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Organization ID to share the produced AMI with (e.g. o-xxxxxxxxxx).
    Default: o-xxxxxxxxxx
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Organization ID (o- followed by 10-32 lowercase alphanumerics).

  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Dummy AWS account ID representing the dev deployment environment.
    Default: '111111111111'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.

  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Dummy AWS account ID representing the prod deployment environment.
    Default: '222222222222'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.

  ParentImageArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      ARN of the parent Image Builder image. Defaults to the AWS-managed Amazon Linux 2023
      ARM64 image (exists in every account/region) so the stack is deployable in a greenfield
      account. Replace with the verified CIS-hardened image ARN once it is shared into the
      account, e.g.
      arn:aws:imagebuilder:<region>:<account>:image/cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/<version>
    Default: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x

  BuildSchedule:
    Type: String
    Description: Cron schedule for the daily image build.
    Default: 'cron(0 0 * * ? *)'

  ImageRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of days after which produced images are deleted by the lifecycle policy.
    Default: 180
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (greenfield: created by this template)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.42.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-vpc

  ImageBuilderPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.42.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-public-subnet

  ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.42.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-private-subnet

  ImageBuilderInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-igw

  ImageBuilderVPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref ImageBuilderInternetGateway

  ImageBuilderPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-public-rt

  ImageBuilderPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: ImageBuilderVPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref ImageBuilderInternetGateway

  ImageBuilderPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderPublicRouteTable

  # NAT Gateway for private-subnet egress
  ImageBuilderNatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-nat-eip

  ImageBuilderNatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ImageBuilderNatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-nat

  ImageBuilderPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-private-rt

  ImageBuilderPrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref ImageBuilderNatGateway

  ImageBuilderPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateRouteTable

  ImageBuilderSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 Image Builder build instances (restricted egress).
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 10.42.0.0/16
          Description: Allow intra-VPC traffic only; internet egress is handled by the NAT Gateway.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-build-sg

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS CMK for flow-log encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderFlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt EC2 Image Builder VPC flow logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/imagebuilder-flowlogs'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-flowlog-key

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs (REJECT traffic) to CloudWatch Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/imagebuilder-flowlogs
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ImageBuilderFlowLogKey.Arn

  ImageBuilderFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsLeastPrivilege
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderFlowLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: UseFlowLogKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderFlowLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-flowlog-role

  ImageBuilderFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: ImageBuilderFlowLogKey
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref ImageBuilderFlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt ImageBuilderFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-flowlog

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM: EC2 instance profile used by build instances
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilderECRContainerBuilds
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-instance-role

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM: Image Builder service role (inline least-privilege only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderServiceLeastPrivilege
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EC2ImageBuilderOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:RegisterImage
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ec2:GetEbsEncryptionByDefault
                  - ec2:EnableImageDeprecation
                  - ec2:DisableImageDeprecation
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IamPassRoleForBuildInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ec2.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: SsmForBuildInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                  - ssm:ListTagsForResource
                  - ssm:AddTagsToResource
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/ImageBuilder/*'
              - Sid: S3ForImageBuilderArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::ec2imagebuilder-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::ec2imagebuilder-*/*'
              - Sid: InspectorScanning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - inspector2:BatchGetAccountStatus
                  - inspector2:ListFindings
                  - inspector2:ListCoverage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: OrganizationsForSharing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-service-role

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder Component: Elastic Beanstalk compatibility pre-configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ElasticBeanstalkCompatComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: elastic-beanstalk-compat-al2023-arm
      Description: Pre-configures the hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM image for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      ChangeDescription: Initial version.
      Data: |
        name: elastic-beanstalk-compat-al2023-arm
        description: Pre-configures the image for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: validateOS
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      if [ ! -f /etc/system-release ]; then
                        echo "Unsupported OS: /etc/system-release not found" >&2
                        exit 1
                      fi
                      grep -qi "Amazon Linux" /etc/system-release
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: installBeanstalkPrerequisites
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf -y install \
                        httpd \
                        mod_ssl \
                        python3 \
                        python3-pip \
                        ruby \
                        wget \
                        curl \
                        git \
                        tar \
                        unzip \
                        jq \
                        amazon-cloudwatch-agent
              - name: configureBeanstalkDirectories
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      install -d -m 0755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                      install -d -m 0755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk/bin
                      install -d -m 0755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/appdeploy/pre
                      install -d -m 0755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/appdeploy/enact
                      install -d -m 0755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/appdeploy/post
                      install -d -m 0755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/configdeploy/pre
                      install -d -m 0755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/configdeploy/enact
                      install -d -m 0755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/configdeploy/post
                      install -d -m 0755 /var/log/eb-activity
                      install -d -m 0755 /var/app
              - name: configureBeanstalkEnvironment
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      cat > /etc/profile.d/elasticbeanstalk.sh <<'EOF'
                      export PATH=$PATH:/opt/elasticbeanstalk/bin
                      EOF
                      chmod 0644 /etc/profile.d/elasticbeanstalk.sh
                      cat > /opt/elasticbeanstalk/bin/healthd <<'EOF'
                      #!/bin/bash
                      echo "ok"
                      EOF
                      chmod 0755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk/bin/healthd
              - name: enableServices
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      systemctl enable httpd.service || true
                      systemctl enable amazon-cloudwatch-agent.service || true
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: validateBeanstalkLayout
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      test -d /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                      test -x /opt/elasticbeanstalk/bin/healthd
                      echo "Elastic Beanstalk compatibility layout validated."
      Tags:
        Purpose: elastic-beanstalk-compat

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder Component: Amazon Inspector vulnerability scan (template-created)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InspectorScanComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: amazon-inspector-ami-scan-custom
      Description: Installs the Amazon Inspector agent and runs a vulnerability scan step on the AMI.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      ChangeDescription: Initial version.
      Data: |
        name: amazon-inspector-ami-scan-custom
        description: Installs the Amazon Inspector agent and runs a vulnerability scan step.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: installInspectorAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf -y install amazon-inspector-agent || true
                      systemctl enable amazon-inspector-agent.service || true
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: runInspectorScan
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      echo "Amazon Inspector agent installed; vulnerability scanning will be performed by Inspector."
      Tags:
        Purpose: inspector-scan

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Recipe: parameterized parent image, 50 GB root, EB component + Inspector scan
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HardenedImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-eb-recipe
      Description: CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM image with Elastic Beanstalk compatibility and Inspector scanning.
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageArn
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkCompatComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InspectorScanComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      Tags:
        Purpose: cis-hardened-eb-image

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Infrastructure Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-infra
      Description: Build infrastructure for the CIS-hardened AL2023 ARM image.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - m6g.large
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Tags:
        Purpose: imagebuilder-infra

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distribution Configuration: current region, shared to Org + dev/prod accounts
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-distribution
      Description: Distributes the AMI in the current region and shares it with the Organization and dev/prod accounts.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'cis-hardened-al2023-arm-eb-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM AMI for Elastic Beanstalk.
            AmiTags:
              Purpose: cis-hardened-eb-image
              ManagedBy: image-builder
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
              UserGroups:
                - !Ref OrganizationId
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId
      Tags:
        Purpose: imagebuilder-distribution

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Pipeline: daily schedule, vulnerability scanning enabled
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderPipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-pipeline
      Description: Daily build of the CIS-hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM Elastic Beanstalk AMI.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref HardenedImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref BuildSchedule
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      Tags:
        Purpose: imagebuilder-pipeline

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lifecycle Policy: delete images older than 6 months
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-lifecycle
      Description: Deletes produced AMIs older than 6 months.
      Status: ENABLED
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderServiceRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-eb-recipe
            SemanticVersion: '1.0.0'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DELETE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: !Ref ImageRetentionDays
            Unit: DAYS
      Tags:
        Purpose: imagebuilder-lifecycle

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder image pipeline.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderPipeline.Arn

  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder image recipe.
    Value: !GetAtt HardenedImageRecipe.Arn

  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder distribution configuration.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration.Arn

  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder infrastructure configuration.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration.Arn

  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder lifecycle policy.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy.Arn

  ElasticBeanstalkComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the Elastic Beanstalk compatibility component.
    Value: !GetAtt ElasticBeanstalkCompatComponent.Arn

  InspectorScanComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the template-created Inspector scan component.
    Value: !GetAtt InspectorScanComponent.Arn

  ParentImageArnUsed:
    Description: Parent Image Builder image ARN used by the recipe.
    Value: !Ref ParentImageArn

  BuildVpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC created for Image Builder build instances.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC

  BuildPrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the private subnet used for Image Builder build instances.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the NAT Gateway providing egress for build instances.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderNatGateway

  FlowLogId:
    Description: ID of the VPC flow log capturing REJECT traffic.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderFlowLog

  FlowLogKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS CMK used to encrypt the flow-log group.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderFlowLogKey.Arn

  SharedOrganizationId:
    Description: AWS Organization ID the AMI is shared with.
    Value: !Ref OrganizationId

  SharedDevAccountId:
    Description: Dev account ID the AMI is shared with.
    Value: !Ref DevAccountId

  SharedProdAccountId:
    Description: Prod account ID the AMI is shared with.
    Value: !Ref ProdAccountId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Maths MCP server for testing - API Gateway, Lambda, and Cognito authentication. Note - the health-check GET / endpoint is Cognito-protected (not anonymous) because the AWS-0004 policy cannot be satisfied for an anonymous method without an invalid RestApi-level ApiKeyRequired property. CORS preflight is handled by the Lambda proxy response rather than a dedicated OPTIONS method.

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage name for the API Gateway stage.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool app client.

Resources:
  MathsMcpUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true

  MathsMcpUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref MathsMcpUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  MathsMcpLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  MathsMcpLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt MathsMcpLambdaRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type,Authorization,X-Amz-Date,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "OPTIONS,POST,GET"
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps({"status": "ok", "message": "Maths MCP placeholder handler"})
              }

  MathsMcpLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting Maths MCP API Gateway access logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  MathsMcpApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-access-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt MathsMcpLogsKey.Arn

  MathsMcpRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-api'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      ApiKeySourceType: HEADER

  MathsMcpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MathsMcpRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  MathsMcpAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: MathsMcpCognitoAuthorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt MathsMcpUserPool.Arn
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization

  MathsMcpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MathsMcpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref MathsMcpAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  MathsMcpHealthCheckMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt MathsMcpRestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref MathsMcpAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  MathsMcpLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMcpLambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MathsMcpRestApi}/*'

  MathsMcpDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MathsMcpPostMethod
      - MathsMcpHealthCheckMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi

  MathsMcpStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref MathsMcpDeployment
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage
      TracingEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt MathsMcpApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: >-
          {"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol"}

  MathsMcpApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-api-key'
      Enabled: true
      StageKeys:
        - RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
          StageName: !Ref MathsMcpStage

  MathsMcpUsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    Properties:
      UsagePlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-usage-plan'
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
          Stage: !Ref MathsMcpStage

  MathsMcpUsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref MathsMcpApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref MathsMcpUsagePlan

Outputs:
  RestApiId:
    Description: API Gateway RestApi ID.
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
  ApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Base invoke URL for the deployed API stage.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${MathsMcpRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID.
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpUserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool App Client ID.
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpUserPoolClient

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained Fargate ECS task definition referencing a container image in an
  ECR repository created by this template. Includes task role, execution role,
  CloudWatch log group, customer-managed KMS key, and outputs for downstream
  consumption.

Parameters:
  ImageTag:
    Type: String
    Default: v1.0.0
    Description: Immutable image tag to deploy from the ECR repository.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid Docker image tag.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key (used by ECR and CloudWatch Logs)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppCmk:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for sample-app ECR repository and CloudWatch log group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
          - Sid: AllowEcrService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecr.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev
        - Key: Application
          Value: sample-app
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AppCmkAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-app'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AppCmk

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECR Repository (owned by this template)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleAppRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: sample-app
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KmsKey: !GetAtt AppCmk.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev
        - Key: Application
          Value: sample-app
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleAppLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${AWS::StackName}/sample-app'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AppCmk.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev
        - Key: Application
          Value: sample-app
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Task Role (application permissions only - no ECR pull)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: Task role for the sample-app Fargate container
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev
        - Key: Application
          Value: sample-app
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Execution Role (ECR pull + CloudWatch Logs + KMS decrypt)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: Execution role for the sample-app Fargate task
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcrPullAndLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrAuthorizationToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrRepositoryAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: !GetAtt SampleAppRepository.Arn
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub '${SampleAppLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: KmsDecryptForEcrAndLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt AppCmk.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev
        - Key: Application
          Value: sample-app
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Fargate Task Definition
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleAppTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: sample-app
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: sample-app
          Image: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${SampleAppRepository}:${ImageTag}'
          Essential: true
          Cpu: 256
          Memory: 512
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref SampleAppLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev
        - Key: Application
          Value: sample-app
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  ContainerImageUri:
    Description: Full container image URI used by the task definition
    Value: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${SampleAppRepository}:${ImageTag}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ContainerImageUri'

  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task definition
    Value: !Ref SampleAppTaskDefinition
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TaskDefinitionArn'

  EcrRepositoryUri:
    Description: URI of the ECR repository
    Value: !GetAtt SampleAppRepository.RepositoryUri
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EcrRepositoryUri'

  EcrRepositoryArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECR repository
    Value: !GetAtt SampleAppRepository.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EcrRepositoryArn'

  TaskRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task role
    Value: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TaskRoleArn'

  ExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS execution role
    Value: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ExecutionRoleArn'

  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group
    Value: !Ref SampleAppLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LogGroupName'

  AppCmkArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt AppCmk.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppCmkArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AWS Cognito authentication infrastructure for the nih-grants application.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the deployment environment (used for tagging).
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-32 alphanumeric or hyphen characters.

Resources:
  NihGrantsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: nih-grants-user-pool
      MfaConfiguration: 'ON'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailSubject: Your verification code
        EmailMessage: Your verification code is {####}
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 11
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: nih-grants
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NihGrantsWebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: nih-grants-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref NihGrantsUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days

  NihGrantsGeneralClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: nih-grants-general-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref NihGrantsUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days

  NihGrantsIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: nih-grants-identity-pool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref NihGrantsWebClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt NihGrantsUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
        - ClientId: !Ref NihGrantsGeneralClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt NihGrantsUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: nih-grants
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NihGrantsAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nih-grants-authenticated-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref NihGrantsIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: nih-grants-authenticated-s3-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ContextBucketObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::nih-grants-context-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}/*'
        - PolicyName: nih-grants-authenticated-kms-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: KmsS3KeyAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*'
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    kms:RequestAlias: alias/nih-grants-s3-key
        - PolicyName: nih-grants-authenticated-apigw-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ApiGatewayWebSocketConnect
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/@connections/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: nih-grants
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NihGrantsUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nih-grants-unauthenticated-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref NihGrantsIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: nih-grants
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NihGrantsIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref NihGrantsIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt NihGrantsAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt NihGrantsUnauthenticatedRole.Arn
      RoleMappings:
        cognito:
          Type: Token
          AmbiguousRoleResolution: AuthenticatedRole
          IdentityProvider: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${NihGrantsUserPool}:${NihGrantsWebClient}'

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the nih-grants Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref NihGrantsUserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the nih-grants Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt NihGrantsUserPool.Arn
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the nih-grants Cognito identity pool.
    Value: !Ref NihGrantsIdentityPool
  WebClientId:
    Description: ID of the nih-grants web app client.
    Value: !Ref NihGrantsWebClient
  GeneralClientId:
    Description: ID of the nih-grants general app client.
    Value: !Ref NihGrantsGeneralClient
  AuthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the authenticated IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt NihGrantsAuthenticatedRole.Arn
  UnauthenticatedRoleArn:
