AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Route 53 public hosted zone for the domain with the full set of DNS record
  sets required to run external services (Squarespace website, G Suite mail,
  ZenDesk helpdesk, Google Workspace DKIM, Campaign Monitor email marketing)
  plus an internal office printer record. All records live under the single
  hosted zone created by this stack.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: podcastgarage.org
    Description: Apex domain name for the public hosted zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\.\-]*[a-zA-Z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid DNS domain name.

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: 'google-site-verification=REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION_TOKEN'
    Description: >
      Google site verification token value (public DNS value, not a secret).
      Replace the placeholder default with the token provided by Google.

  SpfPolicy:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all'
    Description: SPF policy string for the apex TXT record.

  DmarcRuaAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: dmarc-reports@podcastgarage.org
    Description: >
      Mailbox that receives DMARC aggregate reports (deployment-specific;
      replace with the real reporting address).

  DmarcPolicy:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@podcastgarage.org'
    Description: >
      Full DMARC TXT record value. Update the rua address to match
      DmarcRuaAddress if you change it.

  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: 'zendesk-verification=REPLACE_WITH_ZENDESK_VERIFICATION_TOKEN'
    Description: >
      ZenDesk domain verification token (public DNS value, not a secret).
      Replace the placeholder default with the token provided by ZenDesk.

  ZendeskValidationTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REPLACE_WITH_ZENDESK_VALIDATION_TARGET.zendesk.com'
    Description: >
      ZenDesk-provided CNAME target for domain validation. Replace the
      placeholder default with the value provided by ZenDesk.

  ZendeskDkimSelector1Target:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REPLACE_WITH_ZENDESK_DKIM_SELECTOR1_TARGET.zendesk.com'
    Description: >
      ZenDesk DKIM selector 1 CNAME target. Replace the placeholder default
      with the value provided by ZenDesk.

  ZendeskDkimSelector2Target:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REPLACE_WITH_ZENDESK_DKIM_SELECTOR2_TARGET.zendesk.com'
    Description: >
      ZenDesk DKIM selector 2 CNAME target. Replace the placeholder default
      with the value provided by ZenDesk.

  GoogleDkimPublicKey:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_DKIM_PUBLIC_KEY'
    Description: >
      Google Workspace DKIM signing public key (public DNS value, not a
      secret). Replace the placeholder default with the key generated in the
      Google Admin console.

  CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKey:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=REPLACE_WITH_CAMPAIGN_MONITOR_DKIM_PUBLIC_KEY'
    Description: >
      Campaign Monitor DKIM public key (public DNS value, not a secret).
      Replace the placeholder default with the key provided by Campaign
      Monitor.

  CampaignMonitorSpfInclude:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=spf1 include:cmail1.com ~all'
    Description: SPF policy for the dedicated Campaign Monitor subdomain.

  PrinterIpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 192.168.1.50
    Description: >
      Private RFC1918 IPv4 address of the internal office printer. This
      record is intentionally published in the public zone per the request.

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'Public hosted zone for ${DomainName} managed by CloudFormation'
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: podcastgarage
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Apex TXT: SPF policy + Google site verification token + ZenDesk verification token
  # Route 53 allows exactly one TXT record set per name; all values are separate
  # quoted ResourceRecords entries within this single record set.
  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${SpfPolicy}"'
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'
        - !Sub '"${ZendeskVerificationToken}"'

  # Apex A: Squarespace website hosting IPv4 addresses
  ApexARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: A
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 198.185.159.144
        - 198.185.159.145
        - 198.49.23.144
        - 198.49.23.145

  # www CNAME: Squarespace CNAME target
  WwwCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - ext-cust.squarespace.com

  # Apex MX: G Suite mail delivery
  ApexMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'

  # _dmarc TXT: DMARC policy for G Suite reporting
  DmarcTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${DmarcPolicy}"'

  # Internal office printer A record (intentionally in the public zone)
  PrinterARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'printer.${DomainName}'
      Type: A
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PrinterIpAddress

  # ZenDesk domain validation CNAME
  ZendeskValidationCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk-verification.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskValidationTarget

  # ZenDesk DKIM selector 1 CNAME
  ZendeskDkimSelector1CnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskDkimSelector1Target

  # ZenDesk DKIM selector 2 CNAME
  ZendeskDkimSelector2CnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk2._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskDkimSelector2Target

  # Google Workspace DKIM signing key
  GoogleDkimTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'google._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleDkimPublicKey}"'

  # Campaign Monitor DKIM record
  CampaignMonitorDkimTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cm._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKey}"'

  # Dedicated SPF-aligned subdomain for Campaign Monitor: TXT
  CampaignMonitorSubdomainTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'email.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${CampaignMonitorSpfInclude}"'

  # Dedicated SPF-aligned subdomain for Campaign Monitor: MX (bounce/return-path)
  CampaignMonitorSubdomainMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'email.${DomainName}'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '10 mail.cmail1.com'

Outputs:
  HostedZoneId:
    Description: ID of the created Route 53 public hosted zone.
    Value: !Ref HostedZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HostedZoneId'

  HostedZoneName:
    Description: Domain name of the created Route 53 public hosted zone.
    Value: !Ref DomainName

  NameServers:
    Description: >
      Name servers for the hosted zone. Configure these as the delegation
      (NS) records at your domain registrar.
    Value: !Join [',', !GetAtt HostedZone.NameServers]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM roles and managed policies for an e-commerce serverless architecture (SQS, DynamoDB Streams, SNS, API Gateway), parameterized by environment, with a customer-managed KMS key for encryption at rest.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name used to suffix all resource names.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the queue, table and topic
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcommerceDataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for e-commerce serverless data (${Environment})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  EcommerceDataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/ecommerce-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EcommerceDataKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SQS Queue (owned by this template, encrypted with CMK)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  POCQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub 'POC-Queue-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt EcommerceDataKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB Table with Streams enabled, encrypted with CMK
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcommerceOrdersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'ecommerce-orders-${Environment}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: orderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: orderId
          KeyType: HASH
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt EcommerceDataKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS Topic (encrypted with CMK)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  POCTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub 'POC-Topic-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt EcommerceDataKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Role 1: SQS-consumer Lambda
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcommerceSqsConsumerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'EcommerceSqsConsumerRole-${Environment}'
      Description: Role for Lambda that consumes SQS messages and writes to DynamoDB.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub 'EcommerceSqsConsumerInlinePolicy-${Environment}'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SqsConsumePermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                Resource: !GetAtt POCQueue.Arn
              - Sid: DynamoDbWritePermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt EcommerceOrdersTable.Arn
              - Sid: KmsUsageForQueueAndTable
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt EcommerceDataKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Role 2: DynamoDB-Streams-consumer Lambda
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcommerceStreamConsumerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'EcommerceStreamConsumerRole-${Environment}'
      Description: Role for Lambda that consumes DynamoDB Streams and publishes to SNS.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub 'EcommerceStreamConsumerInlinePolicy-${Environment}'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDbStreamReadPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeStream
                  - dynamodb:GetRecords
                  - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
                  - dynamodb:ListStreams

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC with public and private subnets, NAT gateway for outbound connectivity from private resources.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.32.0/21
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    Description: Environment name used for tagging.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Alphanumeric characters and hyphens only.
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: nat-test
    Description: Prefix used for naming and tagging resources.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Alphanumeric characters and hyphens only.

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcFlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt VPC flow log data in CloudWatch Logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcFlowLogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref VpcFlowLogKey

  VpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn:
      - VpcFlowLogKey
      - VpcFlowLogKeyAlias
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-log-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcFlowLogPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-log-policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref VpcFlowLogRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
              - !Sub '${VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: VpcFlowLogPolicy
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-private-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: PublicDefaultRoute
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIp.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-nat-gw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the private subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  NatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway
  NatElasticIpAddress:
    Description: Public IP address of the NAT gateway Elastic IP.
    Value: !Ref NatElasticIp
  VpcFlowLogId:
    Description: ID of the VPC flow log.
    Value: !Ref VpcFlowLog
  VpcFlowLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group receiving VPC flow logs.
    Value: !Ref VpcFlowLogGroup
  VpcFlowLogKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS CMK used to encrypt VPC flow logs.
    Value: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogKey.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Amazon Athena named queries for analyzing AppStream 2.0 usage data in the
  "appstream-usage" database. Provides pre-built queries for current vs.
  previous month comparisons of average session length per stack, daily
  session counts, all session details, streaming hours per user, and unique
  users per application. Includes an Athena workgroup with an enforced S3
  results location, a customer-managed KMS key for results encryption, and
  access logging for the results bucket.

Resources:

  AthenaResultsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting Athena query results.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  AthenaResultsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/appstream-usage-athena-results
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AthenaResultsKey

  AthenaResultsLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireAccessLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
            NoncurrentVersionExpirationInDays: 30

  AthenaResultsLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AthenaResultsLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3LoggingDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${AthenaResultsLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt AthenaResultsBucket.Arn
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AthenaResultsLogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AthenaResultsLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AthenaResultsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AthenaResultsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AthenaResultsLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: results-access-logs/
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireAthenaResults
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
            NoncurrentVersionExpirationInDays: 30

  AthenaResultsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AthenaResultsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAthenaServiceAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: athena.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
              - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AthenaResultsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AthenaResultsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AthenaResultsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AthenaResultsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AppStreamUsageWorkGroup:
    Type: AWS::Athena::WorkGroup
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-usage-workgroup
      Description: Workgroup for AppStream 2.0 usage analytics queries.
      State: ENABLED
      WorkGroupConfiguration:
        EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration: true
        PublishCloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        RequesterPaysEnabled: false
        ResultConfiguration:
          OutputLocation: !Sub 's3://${AthenaResultsBucket}/results/'
          EncryptionConfiguration:
            EncryptionOption: SSE_KMS
            KmsKey: !GetAtt AthenaResultsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AppStreamUsageAnalytics

  AvgSessionLengthPerStackQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-avg-session-length-per-stack
      Database: appstream-usage
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkGroup
      Description: >
        Average session length per AppStream 2.0 stack comparing the current
        month against the previous month, for monthly reporting of session
        duration metrics.
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          stack_name,
          AVG(CASE
                WHEN date_trunc('month', session_start_time) = date_trunc('month', current_date)
                THEN date_diff('second', session_start_time, session_end_time) / 60.0
              END) AS avg_session_minutes_current_month,
          AVG(CASE
                WHEN date_trunc('month', session_start_time) = date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month)
                THEN date_diff('second', session_start_time, session_end_time) / 60.0
              END) AS avg_session_minutes_previous_month,
          COUNT(CASE
                  WHEN date_trunc('month', session_start_time) = date_trunc('month', current_date)
                  THEN 1
                END) AS sessions_current_month,
          COUNT(CASE
                  WHEN date_trunc('month', session_start_time) = date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month)
                  THEN 1
                END) AS sessions_previous_month
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE session_end_time IS NOT NULL
          AND session_start_time >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month)
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY stack_name

  DailySessionCountsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-daily-session-counts
      Database: appstream-usage
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkGroup
      Description: >
        Daily count of AppStream 2.0 sessions for the current and previous
        month, grouped by day, to support monthly reporting and trend analysis.
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          date_trunc('day', session_start_time) AS session_day,
          COUNT(*) AS session_count,
          COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE session_start_time >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month)
        GROUP BY date_trunc('day', session_start_time)
        ORDER BY session_day

  AllSessionDetailsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-all-session-details
      Database: appstream-usage
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkGroup
      Description: >
        Detailed listing of all AppStream 2.0 sessions for the current and
        previous month, including user, stack, fleet, application, and timing
        information for ad-hoc analysis and monthly reporting.
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          session_id,
          user_id,
          stack_name,
          fleet_name,
          application_name,
          instance_type,
          session_start_time,
          session_end_time,
          date_diff('second', session_start_time, session_end_time) / 3600.0 AS session_hours
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE session_start_time >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month)
        ORDER BY session_start_time DESC

  StreamingHoursPerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-streaming-hours-per-user
      Database: appstream-usage
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkGroup
      Description: >
        Total streaming hours per user for the current and previous month,
        aggregated by user, to support monthly usage and billing analysis.
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          user_id,
          SUM(CASE
                WHEN date_trunc('month', session_start_time) = date_trunc('month', current_date)
                THEN date_diff('second', session_start_time, session_end_time) / 3600.0
                ELSE 0
              END) AS streaming_hours_current_month,
          SUM(CASE
                WHEN date_trunc('month', session_start_time) = date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month)
                THEN date_diff('second', session_start_time, session_end_time) / 3600.0
                ELSE 0
              END) AS streaming_hours_previous_month
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE session_end_time IS NOT NULL
          AND session_start_time >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month)
        GROUP BY user_id
        ORDER BY streaming_hours_current_month DESC

  UniqueUsersPerApplicationQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-unique-users-per-application
      Database: appstream-usage
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkGroup
      Description: >
        Count of unique users per application for the current and previous
        month, aggregated by application, to support monthly adoption and
        usage reporting.
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          application_name,
          COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                  WHEN date_trunc('month', session_start_time) = date_trunc('month', current_date)
                  THEN user_id
                END) AS unique_users_current_month,
          COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                  WHEN date_trunc('month', session_start_time) = date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month)
                  THEN user_id
                END) AS unique_users_previous_month
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE session_start_time >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained three-tier VPC network foundation with public, private application, and private database subnets across three availability zones, a single NAT gateway, and dedicated route tables.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-vpc

  VpcFlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting three-tier VPC flow log group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  VpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: three-tier-vpc-flow-logs
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogKey.Arn

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: three-tier-vpc-flow-logs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref VpcFlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-vpc-flow-log

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-nat-eip

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-nat-gateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-public-subnet-1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-public-subnet-2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-public-subnet-3
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PrivateAppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-private-app-subnet-1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateApp

  PrivateAppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-private-app-subnet-2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateApp

  PrivateAppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.5.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-private-app-subnet-3
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateApp

  PrivateDBSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.6.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-private-db-subnet-1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateDB

  PrivateDBSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.7.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-private-db-subnet-2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateDB

  PrivateDBSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.8.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-private-db-subnet-3
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateDB

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-public-rt
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateAppRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-private-app-rt
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateApp

  PrivateAppDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateDBRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-private-db-rt
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateDB

  PrivateDBDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDBRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateDBSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDBSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDBRouteTable

  PrivateDBSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDBSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDBRouteTable

  PrivateDBSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDBSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDBRouteTable

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: ID of the three-tier VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 3
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  PrivateAppSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private application subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet1

  PrivateAppSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private application subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet2

  PrivateAppSubnet3Id:
    Description: ID of private application subnet 3
    Value: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet3

  PrivateDBSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private database subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateDBSubnet1

  PrivateDBSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private database subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateDBSubnet2

  PrivateDBSubnet3Id:
    Description: ID of private database subnet 3
    Value: !Ref PrivateDBSubnet3

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway
    Value: !Ref NatGateway

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the public route table
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateAppRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the private application route table
    Value: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateDBRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the private database route table
    Value: !Ref PrivateDBRouteTable

  VpcFlowLogId:
    Description: ID of the VPC flow log
    Value: !Ref VpcFlowLog

  VpcFlowLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the VPC flow log CloudWatch log group
    Value: !Ref VpcFlowLogGroup

  VpcFlowLogKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the CMK used to encrypt the VPC flow log group
    Value: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  QuickSight administrative monitoring and data pipeline environment with Glue ETL jobs,
  CloudWatch metric streams, and Firehose delivery to an S3 data lake. NOTE: The Glue ETL
  script objects (s3://<ScriptBucketName>-<AccountId>/scripts/*.py) must be uploaded as an
  operational step after stack creation, since CloudFormation has no native inline-object-upload primitive.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    Description: Base name for the S3 bucket that will store the Glue ETL scripts. The account ID is appended to guarantee global uniqueness.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Customer Managed Key
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DataLakeKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for QuickSight admin suite data lake buckets
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  DataLakeKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/quicksight-admin-suite-${AWS::Region}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataLakeKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Buckets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-logs-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  AdminSuiteLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${AdminSuiteLogBucket.Arn}/access-logs/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AdminSuiteLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: access-logs/
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  AdminSuiteBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowFirehoseDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
            Action:
              - 's3:PutObject'
              - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
              - 's3:ListBucket'
              - 's3:AbortMultipartUpload'
              - 's3:ListBucketMultipartUploads'
              - 's3:ListMultipartUploadParts'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/cloudwatch/*'

  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ScriptBucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AdminSuiteLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: access-logs/
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  ScriptBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScriptBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowGlueScriptAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
            Action:
              - 's3:GetObject'
              - 's3:PutObject'
              - 's3:ListBucket'
              - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Consolidated IAM Role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConsolidatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'quicksight-admin-suite-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConsolidatedAdminPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3Access
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:AbortMultipartUpload'
                  - 's3:ListBucketMultipartUploads'
                  - 's3:ListMultipartUploadParts'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: KMSAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
              - Sid: GlueAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'glue:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: QuickSightAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'quicksight:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IAMAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:GetRole'
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                  - 'iam:ListRoles'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudwatch:PutMetricData'
                  - 'cloudwatch:PutMetricStream'
                  - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricData'
                  - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics'
                  - 'cloudwatch:ListMetrics'
                  - 'cloudwatch:ListMetricStreams'
                  - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricStream'
                  - 'cloudwatch:DeleteMetricStream'
                  - 'cloudwatch:StartMetricStreams'
                  - 'cloudwatch:StopMetricStreams'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: FirehoseAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'firehose:*'
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue Jobs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-assets-access
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      Timeout: 360
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  GlueJobDatasetMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-dataset-metadata
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/dataset_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-folder-assets
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-q-metadata
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/q_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-datasource-properties
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/datasource_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue Triggers (staggered daily sequence starting 02:00 UTC)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-assets-access-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 2 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess

  TriggerDatasetMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-dataset-metadata-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(15 2 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasetMetadata

  TriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-folder-assets-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(30 2 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets

  TriggerQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-q-metadata-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(45 2 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata

  TriggerDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-datasource-properties-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Kinesis Firehose Delivery Streams
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FirehoseIngestion:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-metrics-ingestion
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
        Prefix: cloudwatch/ingestion/
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED

  FirehoseDashboard:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-metrics-dashboard
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
        Prefix: cloudwatch/dashboard/
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED

  FirehoseSpice:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-metrics-spice
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
        Prefix: cloudwatch/spice/
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED

  FirehoseQIndex:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-metrics-q-index
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
        Prefix: cloudwatch/q-index/
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED

  FirehoseQActions:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-metrics-q-actions
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
        Prefix: cloudwatch/q-actions/
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Metric Streams
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MetricStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-ingestion-metrics
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseIngestion.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionSuccessCount
            - IngestionFailureCount
            - IngestionErrorCount
            - DatasetRowsIngested
            - DatasetSizeBytes

  MetricStreamDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-dashboard-metrics
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseDashboard.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - DashboardViewCount
            - DashboardViewLoadTime
            - VisualLoadTime
            - VisualLoadErrorCount

  MetricStreamSpice:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-spice-metrics
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseSpice.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - SPICECapacityUsage
            - SPICECapacityAllocated
            - SPICECapacityConsumed

  MetricStreamQIndex:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-q-index-metrics
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseQIndex.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - QIndexDocumentCount
            - QIndexTextSizeBytes

  MetricStreamQActions:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-q-actions-metrics
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseQActions.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - QActionInvocationCount
            - QActionErrorCount

Outputs:
  AdminSuiteBucketName:
    Description: Name of the admin suite data lake bucket.
    Value: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
  ScriptBucketNameOut:
    Description: Actual name of the Glue scripts bucket (base name plus account ID).
    Value: !Ref ScriptBucket
  LogBucketName:
    Description: Name of the access log bucket.
    Value: !Ref AdminSuiteLogBucket
  DataLakeKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
  ConsolidatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the consolidated IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Puppet Quick Start VPC infrastructure with public subnet, internet gateway, route table, VPC flow logs, and private Route53 hosted zone with A records.

Parameters:
  VPCCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/19
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PuppetIP:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.10
    Description: IP address for puppet.example.com.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.

  LinuxAgentIP:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.11
    Description: IP address for linuxagent.example.com.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.

  WindowsAgentIP:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.12
    Description: IP address for windowsagent.example.com.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VPCCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet Quick Start VPC
        - Key: Environment
          Value: PuppetQuickStart

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet Quick Start Public Subnet
        - Key: Environment
          Value: PuppetQuickStart

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet Quick Start Internet Gateway
        - Key: Environment
          Value: PuppetQuickStart

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet Quick Start Public Route Table
        - Key: Environment
          Value: PuppetQuickStart

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  VPCFlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting Puppet Quick Start VPC flow logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet Quick Start VPC Flow Log Key
        - Key: Environment
          Value: PuppetQuickStart

  VPCFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn: VPCFlowLogKey
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt VPCFlowLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet Quick Start VPC Flow Log Group
        - Key: Environment
          Value: PuppetQuickStart

  VPCFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsWritePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt VPCFlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet Quick Start VPC Flow Log Role
        - Key: Environment
          Value: PuppetQuickStart

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: VPCFlowLogRole
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref VPCFlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VPCFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet Quick Start VPC Flow Log
        - Key: Environment
          Value: PuppetQuickStart

  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: example.com
      VPCs:
        - VPCId: !Ref VPC
          VPCRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet Quick Start Hosted Zone
        - Key: Environment
          Value: PuppetQuickStart

  PuppetRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: puppet.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PuppetIP

  LinuxAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: linuxagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LinuxAgentIP

  WindowsAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: windowsagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WindowsAgentIP

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: ID of the Puppet Quick Start VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPCId'

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the Puppet Quick Start public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetId'

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the Puppet Quick Start internet gateway.
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InternetGatewayId'

  HostedZoneId:
    Description: ID of the Puppet Quick Start private hosted zone.
    Value: !Ref HostedZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HostedZoneId'
