      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  VpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/vpc/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}/flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints allowing HTTPS from within the VPC.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow HTTPS from within VPC CIDR.
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow HTTPS egress within VPC CIDR.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  StsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  EcsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecs'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  EcsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks allowing intra-VPC communication.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow container port from within VPC CIDR.
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow container port egress within VPC CIDR.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow HTTPS egress within VPC CIDR.
        - IpProtocol: udp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow DNS egress within VPC CIDR.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-ecs-sg'
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If
        - HasCustomTaskRole
        - !Ref TaskRoleArn
        - !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !If
            - HasCustomImage
            - !Ref ContainerImage
            - !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${EcrRepository}:latest'
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ServiceDiscoveryNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.local'
      Vpc: !Ref Vpc
      Description: Private DNS namespace for the environment.
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ServiceDiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      NamespaceId: !Ref ServiceDiscoveryNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - PrivateDefaultRoute
      - EcrApiEndpoint
      - EcrDkrEndpoint
      - LogsEndpoint
      - StsEndpoint
      - EcsEndpoint
      - S3GatewayEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
        MaximumPercent: 200
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref EcsSecurityGroup
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${EcsCluster}/${EcsService.Name}'
      RoleARN: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForApplicationAutoScaling_ECSService'

  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-down'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-up'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 15
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 25
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 25
            ScalingAdjustment: 4

  ScaleDownAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low'
      AlarmDescription: Scale down when average CPU is at or below 20 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt EcsService.Name
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 20
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy

  ScaleUpAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: Scale up in graduated steps when average CPU is at or above 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt EcsService.Name
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 70
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy

Outputs:
  EcsClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster.
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster
  EcsServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsService.Name
  EcrRepositoryUri:
    Description: URI of the private ECR repository for the container image.
    Value: !GetAtt EcrRepository.RepositoryUri
  ServiceDiscoveryNamespaceName:
    Description: Name of the Cloud Map private DNS namespace.
    Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.local'
  ServiceDiscoveryNamespaceId:
    Description: ID of the Cloud Map private DNS namespace.
    Value: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryNamespace.Id
  ServiceDiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service.
    Value: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AWS network backbone for hybrid interconnect demonstrations with an OCI primary region, including VPC, IGW, private subnet, route table, transit gateway with VPC attachment, restricted security group, optional OCI VPN, and encrypted VPC flow logs.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet.
  InternalCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    Description: Internal CIDR range allowed to access HTTPS inbound.
  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR range for HTTPS outbound and TGW route.
  OciVpnGatewayIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 203.0.113.1
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI VPN gateway.
  CreateVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the Customer Gateway and VPN connection to OCI.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,32}$'
    Description: Environment name used for tagging.

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateVpn: !Equals [!Ref CreateVpn, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: oci-hybrid-backbone

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: oci-hybrid-backbone

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: oci-hybrid-backbone

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: oci-hybrid-backbone

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: oci-hybrid-backbone

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-vpc-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: oci-hybrid-backbone

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group allowing HTTPS inbound from internal CIDR and HTTPS outbound to OCI backbone CIDR.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from internal CIDR range.
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS outbound to OCI backbone CIDR range.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: oci-hybrid-backbone

  CustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: ShouldCreateVpn
    Properties:
      BgpAsn: 65000
      IpAddress: !Ref OciVpnGatewayIp
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cgw-oci'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: oci-hybrid-backbone

  VpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: ShouldCreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpn-oci'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: oci-hybrid-backbone

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: oci-hybrid-backbone

  TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment

  TransitGatewayRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment

  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for VPC flow logs encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  FlowLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: oci-hybrid-backbone

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: FlowLogsRole
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlog'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: oci-hybrid-backbone

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
  SubnetId:
    Description: ID of the created private subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the created security group.
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the created transit gateway.
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  VpnConnectionId:
    Condition: ShouldCreateVpn
    Description: ID of the created VPN connection to OCI.
    Value: !Ref VpnConnection
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group receiving VPC flow logs.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline (S3, KMS, IAM, Glue jobs, scheduled triggers, Glue catalog for CloudTrail logs).

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: quicksight-admin
    Description: Environment name used for tagging and naming.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,32}$'

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key for the pipeline bucket (SSE-KMS)
  # Key policy grants the account root; the Glue role grants itself KMS access
  # via its own inline policy to avoid a circular dependency.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PipelineBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for the QuickSight admin pipeline bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  PipelineBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-pipeline-bucket'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref PipelineBucketKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 access-log destination bucket (SSE-S3, not KMS)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-access-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AccessLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: S3ServerAccessLogsPolicy
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/pipeline-access-logs/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt PipelineBucket.Arn
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 bucket holding Glue scripts and pipeline data (SSE-KMS + access logging)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PipelineBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-pipeline-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: pipeline-access-logs/
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PipelineBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PipelineBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PipelineBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${PipelineBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumable by Glue
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GluePipelineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-glue-pipeline-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AssumeServiceRoles
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'sts:AssumeRole'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/GlueServiceRole*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormationServiceRole*'
        - PolicyName: IamFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:*'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: QuickSightAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'quicksight:*'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: GlueAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'glue:*'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: S3BucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PipelineBucket.Arn
                  - !GetAtt AccessLogsBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:AbortMultipartUpload'
                  - 's3:ListMultipartUploadParts'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${PipelineBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: KmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PipelineBucketKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudwatch:*'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:*'
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue catalog database + table for CloudTrail logs
  # NOTE: The CloudTrail log table is created here so downstream consumers can
  # reference it. The table uses the standard CloudTrail SerDe with a
  # representative column set. Column definitions may need adjustment to match
  # the exact CloudTrail log schema in use; this is flagged as an objective
  # rather than inventing unsupported properties.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailLogDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}_cloudtrail'
        Description: Glue catalog database for CloudTrail logs.

  CloudTrailLogTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref CloudTrailLogDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: cloudtrail_logs
        Description: CloudTrail log table.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: cloudtrail
          typeOfData: file
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/cloudtrail/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/CloudTrail/'
          InputFormat: com.amazon.emr.cloudtrail.CloudTrailInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: com.amazon.emr.hive.serde.CloudTrailSerde
            Parameters:
              serialization.format: '1'
          Columns:
            - Name: eventversion
              Type: string
            - Name: useridentity
              Type: string
            - Name: eventtime
              Type: string
            - Name: eventsource
              Type: string
            - Name: eventname
              Type: string
            - Name: awsregion
              Type: string
            - Name: sourceipaddress
              Type: string
            - Name: useragent
              Type: string
            - Name: requestparameters
              Type: string
            - Name: responseelements
              Type: string
            - Name: requestid
              Type: string
            - Name: eventid
              Type: string
            - Name: eventtype
              Type: string
            - Name: recipientaccountid
              Type: string

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue jobs (3x PythonShell 3.9 / Glue 3.0, 2x glueetl 5.0 / G.1X)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GroupMembershipJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-group-membership'
      Role: !GetAtt GluePipelineRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxRetries: 1
      Timeout: 60
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/scripts/group_membership.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/tmp/group-membership/'
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ObjectAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-object-access'
      Role: !GetAtt GluePipelineRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxRetries: 1
      Timeout: 60
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Complete EC2 Image Builder pipeline for building and managing custom AMIs with a custom Chef recipe component, daily schedule, tests, distribution, and lifecycle policy.

Parameters:
  PipelineName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-ami-pipeline
    Description: Name of the Image Builder image pipeline.
  ComponentName:
    Type: String
    Default: chef-recipe-component
    Description: Name of the custom Chef recipe component.
  WorkflowComponentName:
    Type: String
    Default: ssm-agent-metadata-component
    Description: Name of the custom build workflow component.
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Target region to share the resulting AMI with.
  AmiRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of days after which AMIs are deprecated by the lifecycle policy.
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.medium
    Description: EC2 instance type used by Image Builder build instances.
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 8
    Description: Root volume size in GB for the image recipe.
  ChefRecipeS3Key:
    Type: String
    Default: chef/recipe.tar.gz
    Description: S3 object key of the Chef recipe archive.

Resources:
  SnsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the Image Builder notification SNS topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'

  S3KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the Chef recipe and access log S3 buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'

  ChefRecipeLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt S3KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  ChefRecipeLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ChefRecipeLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ChefRecipeLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt ChefRecipeBucket.Arn
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ChefRecipeLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ChefRecipeLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ChefRecipeBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt S3KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref ChefRecipeLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: access-logs/

  ChefRecipeBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ChefRecipeBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ChefRecipeBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  NotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: Image Builder Pipeline Notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SnsKmsKey

  ImageBuilderInfrastructureRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilderECRContainerBuilds
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ChefRecipeBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ChefRecipeBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt S3KmsKey.Arn

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureRole

  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/EC2ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderServiceAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: '*'

  ChefRecipeComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentName
      Description: Downloads and executes a Chef recipe archive from S3.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2
      Data: !Sub
        - |
          name: ChefRecipeComponent
          description: Downloads and executes a Chef recipe archive from S3.
          schemaVersion: 1.0
          phases:
            - name: build
              steps:
                - name: DownloadChefRecipe
                  action: S3Download
                  inputs:
                    - source: s3://${BucketName}/${ChefKey}
                      destination: /tmp/chef-recipe.tar.gz
                - name: ExtractChefRecipe
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - mkdir -p /tmp/chef-recipe
                      - tar -xzf /tmp/chef-recipe.tar.gz -C /tmp/chef-recipe
                - name: ExecuteChefRecipe
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - cd /tmp/chef-recipe
                      - if command -v chef-client >/dev/null 2>&1; then chef-client --local-mode --chef-license accept-silent; else echo "chef-client not installed"; fi
        - BucketName: !Ref ChefRecipeBucket
          ChefKey: !Ref ChefRecipeS3Key

  SsmAgentMetadataComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref WorkflowComponentName
      Description: Updates the SSM agent and collects instance metadata before AMI creation.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2
      Data: |
        name: SsmAgentMetadataComponent
        description: Updates the SSM agent and collects instance metadata before AMI creation.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSsmAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - if command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent; else echo "yum not available"; fi
              - name: CollectMetadata
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /var/log/imagebuilder-metadata
                    - uname -a > /var/log/imagebuilder-metadata/system-info.txt
                    - cat /etc/os-release >> /var/log/imagebuilder-metadata/system-info.txt
                    - date >> /var/log/imagebuilder-metadata/system-info.txt

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-recipe'
      Description: Image recipe using latest Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI with Chef component.
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id}}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SsmAgentMetadataComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ChefRecipeComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-infra'
      Description: Infrastructure configuration for the custom AMI pipeline.
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      SnsTopicArn: !Ref NotificationTopic

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-distribution'
      Description: Distribution configuration sharing the AMI with the current account in the target region.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref TargetRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            AmiTags:
              Pipeline: !Ref PipelineName
              ManagedBy: ImageBuilder

  # NOTE: ImageScanningConfiguration is intentionally omitted from the ImagePipeline below.
  # Enabling image scanning on an AMI pipeline requires Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning to be
  # enabled at the account/region level, which is an out-of-band prerequisite that cannot be
  # provisioned by this greenfield stack. Once Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning is enabled in the
  # target region, the following block can be re-added to the ImagePipeline properties:
  #   ImageScanningConfiguration:
  #     ImageScanningEnabled: true
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref PipelineName
      Description: Daily pipeline for building and managing custom AMIs.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 2 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE

  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-lifecycle'
      Description: Deprecates AMIs older than the retention period based on tag selection.
      Status: ENABLED
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderServiceRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-recipe'
            SemanticVersion: '1.0.0'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
            IncludeResources:
              Amis: true
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: !Ref AmiRetentionDays
            Unit: DAYS
          ExclusionRules:
            TagMap:
              Pipeline: !Ref PipelineName

Outputs:
  PipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder image pipeline.
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePipeline.Arn
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder image recipe.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
  ChefRecipeComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom Chef recipe component.
    Value: !GetAtt ChefRecipeComponent.Arn
  SsmAgentMetadataComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom SSM agent metadata component.
    Value: !GetAtt SsmAgentMetadataComponent.Arn
  ChefRecipeBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket hosting the Chef recipe artifact.
    Value: !Ref ChefRecipeBucket
  ChefRecipeLogBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket receiving access logs.
    Value: !Ref ChefRecipeLogBucket
  SnsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the SNS notification topic.
    Value: !GetAtt SnsKmsKey.Arn
  S3KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the S3 buckets.
    Value: !GetAtt S3KmsKey.Arn
  InfrastructureRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder infrastructure IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInfrastructureRole.Arn
  ServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder service IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderServiceRole.Arn
  NotificationTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS notification topic.
    Value: !Ref NotificationTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Provisions a VPC with networking, five EC2 instances, encrypted EBS volumes
  attached to the first three instances, and a comprehensive set of CloudWatch
  alarms (CPU utilization, status check failed, and EBS reachability) wired to
  an encrypted SNS topic. Includes a customer-managed KMS key, IMDSv2-enforced
  instances, encrypted root volumes, restricted security group rules, and VPC
  flow logs.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name used in tags and alarm names.

  Project:
    Type: String
    Default: ec2-monitoring
    Description: Project name used in tags and alarm names.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first subnet.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second subnet.

  AdminCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block permitted for administrative SSH access (must be within the VPC CIDR by default).

  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    Description: EC2 instance type for the five instances.

  LatestAmazonLinuxAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: Public SSM parameter path resolving to the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI.

  AlarmActionEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email address to subscribe to the SNS alarm topic (leave blank to skip).

Conditions:
  HasAlarmEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmActionEmail, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key for EBS, SNS, and CloudWatch Logs encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for EBS volumes, SNS topic, and VPC flow log encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEc2ServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${Project}-${Environment}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AppKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${Project}-${Environment}-app-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AppKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-igw'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-subnet-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-subnet-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-public-rt'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${Project}-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VpcFlowLogPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-vpc-flow-log-policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref VpcFlowLogRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: VpcFlowLogPolicy
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref VpcFlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

          ToPort: 22

        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to VPC endpoints within the VPC
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: DNS over TCP within the VPC
        - IpProtocol: udp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: DNS over UDP within the VPC

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-instance-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy

Description: DynamoDB test table with customer-managed KMS encryption, point-in-time recovery, and comprehensive CloudWatch alarms.

    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for DynamoDB table encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow

            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt

              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
