AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Content-level PII classification scanner for files exposed through an S3 Access Point.
  Uses Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities to identify sensitive data, stores classification
  reports in a DynamoDB table (PITR + CMK encryption), and optionally publishes findings to SNS.
  By default the scanner Lambda runs OUTSIDE any VPC. If the target S3 Access Point is
  VPC-origin, supply VpcId, SubnetIds, SecurityGroupId and RouteTableIds so the Lambda is
  deployed inside that same VPC. When a VPC is supplied, the template can optionally create
  the S3 (Gateway), Comprehend, DynamoDB and SNS (Interface) VPC endpoints; set
  CreateEndpoints=false if the target VPC already has ANY of those four endpoints, since a
  duplicate Interface endpoint or a second S3 Gateway endpoint bound to the same route tables
  will fail and roll back the whole stack.

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      Optional. VPC ID to deploy the scanner Lambda into. Leave EMPTY (default) to run the
      Lambda outside any VPC (only works if the scanned S3 Access Point is internet-origin).
      If the access point network origin is VPC-scoped, supply this plus SubnetIds,
      SecurityGroupId and RouteTableIds.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional. Comma-separated subnet IDs (in the supplied VPC) for the Lambda. Required when VpcId is set.
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional. Security group ID for the Lambda (in the supplied VPC). Required when VpcId is set.
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional. Comma-separated route table IDs for the S3 Gateway endpoint. Required when VpcId is set and CreateEndpoints is true.
  CreateEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >
      When a VPC is supplied, create the S3 (Gateway), Comprehend, DynamoDB and SNS (Interface)
      VPC endpoints. Set to 'false' if the target VPC ALREADY has ANY of those four endpoints,
      to avoid duplicate-endpoint failures that roll back the stack.
  MemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Memory (MB) for the scanner Lambda.
  Timeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 3
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Timeout (seconds) for the scanner Lambda.
  ComprehendLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: en
    AllowedValues:
      - en
      - es
      - fr
      - de
      - it
      - pt
    Description: Default Comprehend language code used when detecting PII entities.
  MaxFilesToScan:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000
    Description: Maximum number of files to scan per invocation (cost and runtime control).
  ChunkSizeBytes:
    Type: Number
    Default: 4096
    MinValue: 256
    MaxValue: 102400
    Description: Byte size of each chunk read from large files before calling Comprehend.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention (days) for the scanner Lambda log group.
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional. Email address to subscribe to the SNS findings topic. Leave empty to skip the subscription.

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  CreateVpcEndpoints: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateEndpoints, 'true']
  HasNotificationEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key used for S3, SNS, Logs and DynamoDB encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for PII scanner data at rest (S3, SNS, Logs, DynamoDB)
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3Use
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  DataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 access-log destination bucket (SSE-S3 only; access-log delivery does not
  # support SSE-KMS on the destination bucket)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  AccessLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: S3ServerAccessLogsPolicy
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/access-logs/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt ContentBucket.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scanned content source bucket + Access Point
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ContentBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: access-logs/
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  AccessPoint:
    Type: AWS::S3::AccessPoint
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ContentBucket
      Name: !Sub 'pii-scanner-ap-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'

  ContentBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ContentBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccessPointObjectRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ContentBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:DataAccessPointArn: !GetAtt AccessPoint.Arn
          - Sid: AllowBucketLevelRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource: !GetAtt ContentBucket.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Classification report table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ReportId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ScanTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ReportId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: ScanTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS findings topic
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Topic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: PII Classification Findings
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn

  TopicEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasNotificationEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref Topic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScannerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role for the scanner Lambda
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScannerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiiScannerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3AccessPointRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ContentBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ContentBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !GetAtt AccessPoint.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AccessPoint.Arn}/object/*'
              - Sid: ComprehendDetect
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                  - comprehend:DetectDominantLanguage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBReports
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt ReportTable.Arn
              - Sid: SnsPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref Topic
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt ScannerLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: KmsUse
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: VpcNetworkInterfaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scanner Lambda
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref MemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref Timeout
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !GetAtt AccessPoint.Arn
          ACCESS_POINT_NAME: !Ref AccessPoint
          BUCKET_NAME: !Ref ContentBucket
          REPORT_TABLE: !Ref ReportTable
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref Topic
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES: !Ref MaxFilesToScan
          CHUNK_SIZE: !Ref ChunkSizeBytes
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroupIds:
            - !Ref SecurityGroupId
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import time
          import uuid
          import boto3
          from botocore.config import Config

          s3 = boto3.client('s3', config=Config(retries={'max_attempts': 5, 'mode': 'standard'}))
          comprehend = boto3.client('comprehend')
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          sns = boto3.client('sns')

          ACCESS_POINT_ARN = os.environ['ACCESS_POINT_ARN']
          ACCESS_POINT_NAME = os.environ['ACCESS_POINT_NAME']
          BUCKET_NAME = os.environ['BUCKET_NAME']
          REPORT_TABLE = os.environ['REPORT_TABLE']
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ.get('SNS_TOPIC_ARN', '')
          LANGUAGE_CODE = os.environ.get('LANGUAGE_CODE', 'en')
          MAX_FILES = int(os.environ.get('MAX_FILES', '500'))
          CHUNK_SIZE = int(os.environ.get('CHUNK_SIZE', '4096'))

          table = dynamodb.Table(REPORT_TABLE)


          def list_objects(prefix=''):
              """Paginate through objects exposed via the S3 Access Point."""
              keys = []
              token = None
              while True:
                  kwargs = {
                      'Bucket': ACCESS_POINT_NAME,
                      'MaxKeys': 1000,
                  }
                  if prefix:
                      kwargs['Prefix'] = prefix
                  if token:
                      kwargs['ContinuationToken'] = token
                  resp = s3.list_objects_v2(**kwargs)
                  for obj in resp.get('Contents', []):
                      keys.append({'Key': obj['Key'], 'Size': obj.get('Size', 0)})
                      if len(keys) >= MAX_FILES:
                          return keys
                  if resp.get('IsTruncated'):
                      token = resp.get('NextContinuationToken')
                  else:
                      break
              return keys


          def read_chunks(key, size):
              """Read a file in bounded byte ranges to handle large files."""
              if size == 0:
                  return
              start = 0
              while start < size:
                  end = min(start + CHUNK_SIZE - 1, size - 1)
                  resp = s3.get_object(
                      Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_NAME,
                      Key=key,
                      Range='bytes=%d-%d' % (start, end),
                  )
                  data = resp['Body'].read()
                  if data:
                      yield data
                  start = end + 1


          def detect_pii(text):
              if not text.strip():
                  return []
              try:
                  resp = comprehend.detect_pii_entities(Text=text, LanguageCode=LANGUAGE_CODE)
                  return resp.get('Entities', [])
              except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                  print('Comprehend error: %s' % exc)
                  return []


          def scan_object(key, size):
              findings = []
              for chunk in read_chunks(key, size):
                  try:
                      text = chunk.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                  except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                      continue
                  for entity in detect_pii(text):
                      findings.append({
                          'Type': entity.get('Type'),
                          'Score': str(entity.get('Score')),
                          'BeginOffset': entity.get('BeginOffset'),
                          'EndOffset': entity.get('EndOffset'),
                      })
              return findings


          def handler(event, context):
              prefix = event.get('prefix', '')
              report_id = event.get('reportId') or str(uuid.uuid4())
              scan_ts = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime())

              objects = list_objects(prefix)
              results = []
              total_findings = 0
              for obj in objects:
                  findings = scan_object(obj['Key'], obj['Size'])
                  total_findings += len(findings)
                  results.append({
                      'Key': obj['Key'],
                      'Size': obj['Size'],
                      'FindingCount': len(findings),
                      'Findings': findings[:100],
                  })

              record = {
                  'ReportId': report_id,
                  'ScanTimestamp': scan_ts,
                  'AccessPointArn': ACCESS_POINT_ARN,
                  'LanguageCode': LANGUAGE_CODE,
                  'FilesScanned': len(objects),
                  'TotalFindings': total_findings,
                  'Results': results,
              }
              table.put_item(Item=record)

              if SNS_TOPIC_ARN and total_findings > 0:
                  sns.publish(
                      TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN,
                      Subject='PII scan findings: %d' % total_findings,
                      Message=json.dumps({
                          'ReportId': report_id,
                          'ScanTimestamp': scan_ts,
                          'FilesScanned': len(objects),
                          'TotalFindings': total_findings,
                      }),
                  )

              return {
                  'ReportId': report_id,
                  'ScanTimestamp': scan_ts,
                  'FilesScanned': len(objects),
                  'TotalFindings': total_findings,
              }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC endpoints (only when a VPC is supplied AND CreateEndpoints is true)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from the scanner Lambda to VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref SecurityGroupId
          Description: HTTPS from scanner Lambda security group

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  ComprehendEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend'
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  DynamoDBEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  SnsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns'
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  ScannerFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the PII scanner Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt ScannerFunction.Arn

  ReportTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB classification report table
    Value: !Ref ReportTable

  AccessPointArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 Access Point being scanned
    Value: !GetAtt AccessPoint.Arn

  SnsTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS findings topic
    Value: !Ref Topic

  ExampleInvocation:
    Description: Example AWS CLI command to invoke the scanner
    Value: !Sub |
      aws lambda invoke --function-name ${ScannerFunction} --payload '{"prefix":"","reportId":"example-report"}' --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out response.json

Description: Glue databases and tables for property graph (LPG) and RDF air-routes data.

Parameters:
  GraphDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database
    Description: Name of the Glue database for LPG (property graph) tables.
  GraphRdfDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database-rdf
    Description: Name of the Glue database for RDF tables.

  GraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref GraphDatabaseName
        Description: Glue database for property graph (LPG) air-routes tables.

  GraphRdfDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref GraphRdfDatabaseName

  AirportTable:

    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        Description: Airport vertices for the air-routes property graph.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          graph.label: vertex
          gremlin.query: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').outE('route').limit(10).inV().values('code')"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: description
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: tz
              Type: string
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe

              field.delim: ","

          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SortColumns: []

        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          graph.label: vertex
          gremlin.query: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').outE('route').limit(10).inV().values('code')"

          Columns:
            - Name: code

            - Name: description
              Type: string
            - Name: continent
              Type: string
            - Name: population
              Type: int
            - Name: area
              Type: double
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat

            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Compressed: false
          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SortColumns: []
          StoredAsSubDirectories: false

    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: continent
        Description: Continent vertices for the air-routes property graph.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          graph.label: vertex
          gremlin.query: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').outE('route').limit(10).inV().values('code')"

          Columns:
            - Name: code

            - Name: description
              Type: string
            - Name: countries

            - Name: area
              Type: double
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Compressed: false
          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SortColumns: []
          StoredAsSubDirectories: false

    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route

        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          graph.label: edge
          gremlin.query: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').outE('route').limit(10).inV().values('code')"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:

          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:

          Compressed: false
          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SortColumns: []
          StoredAsSubDirectories: false

    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: customairport

        Parameters:

        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:

            - Name: type

            - Name: lat

            - Name: lon

            - Name: elev

            - Name: runways

            - Name: city

            - Name: country

          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Compressed: false
          NumberOfBuckets: -1
          SortColumns: []
          StoredAsSubDirectories: false

  AirportRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphRdfDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf
        Description: RDF airport class table for the air-routes ontology.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          rdf-type: "true"

        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  PiBot Cognito authentication setups. Creates two independent Cognito
  configurations: (1) main web application with user pool, client, identity
  pool (unauthenticated access allowed), and IAM roles for authenticated and
  unauthenticated users granting IoT, Kinesis Video, Rekognition, and
  Cognito/mobile analytics permissions; (2) IoT trusted-user provisioning with
  user pool, client, identity pool (authenticated only), and an IAM role
  granting IoT provisioning permissions.

Parameters:
  Project:
    Type: String
    Default: PiBot
    Description: Project name used for naming and tagging resources.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used for naming and tagging resources.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main Web Application - Cognito User Pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${Project}-Web-UserPool-${Environment}'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref Project
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  WebUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${Project}-Web-Client-${Environment}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref WebUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  WebIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${Project}_Web_IdentityPool_${Environment}'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref WebUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt WebUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main Web Application - IAM Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Project}-Web-AuthenticatedRole-${Environment}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref WebIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotWebAuthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IoTOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: KinesisVideoStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RekognitionLabelDetection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CognitoAndMobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  WebUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Project}-Web-UnauthenticatedRole-${Environment}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref WebIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotWebUnauthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IoTOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: KinesisVideoStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RekognitionLabelDetection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CognitoAndMobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  WebIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref WebIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt WebAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt WebUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IoT Trusted-User Provisioning - Cognito User Pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${Project}-Provisioning-UserPool-${Environment}'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref Project
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  ProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${Project}-Provisioning-Client-${Environment}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  ProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${Project}_Provisioning_IdentityPool_${Environment}'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt ProvisioningUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IoT Trusted-User Provisioning - IAM Role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ProvisioningAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Project}-Provisioning-AuthenticatedRole-${Environment}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotProvisioningAuthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IoTTrustedUserProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:CreateKeysAndCertificate
                  - iot:CreateCertificateFromCsr
                  - iot:AttachPolicy
                  - iot:AttachThingPrincipal
                  - iot:RegisterThing
                  - iot:DescribeCertificate
                  - iot:DescribeThing
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt ProvisioningAuthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  WebIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity Pool ID for the main web application.
    Value: !Ref WebIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-WebIdentityPoolId'

  WebUserPoolId:
    Description: User Pool ID for the main web application.
    Value: !Ref WebUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-WebUserPoolId'

  WebUserPoolClientId:
    Description: User Pool Client ID for the main web application.
    Value: !Ref WebUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-WebUserPoolClientId'

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity Pool ID for IoT trusted-user provisioning.
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-ProvisioningIdentityPoolId'

  ProvisioningUserPoolId:
    Description: User Pool ID for IoT trusted-user provisioning.

    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-ProvisioningUserPoolId'

  ProvisioningUserPoolClientId:
    Description: User Pool Client ID for IoT trusted-user provisioning.
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Project}-${Environment}-ProvisioningUserPoolClientId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Public Route 53 hosted zone for radiotopia.fm with a comprehensive set of
  production DNS record sets (SPF, DMARC, MX, apex A, www CNAME, CloudFront
  alias A/AAAA pairs, ACM validation records, and third-party mail/marketing
  verification and DKIM records). All CloudFront distributions, the WAF, and
  the access-log bucket are created in this template so no external
  infrastructure is referenced.

Parameters:
  WebsiteHostingIPv4One:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.51.100.10
    Description: First static IPv4 address of the third-party website hosting service.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
  WebsiteHostingIPv4Two:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.51.100.11
    Description: Second static IPv4 address of the third-party website hosting service.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
  WebsiteHostingCanonicalHost:
    Type: String
    Default: ext-cust.squarespace.com
    Description: >
      Canonical hostname of the third-party website hosting service (no trailing
      dot). Used directly as the CloudFront origin domain name; a trailing dot is
      appended where Route 53 requires a fully qualified value.
  EventSubdomainIPv4:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.51.100.20
    Description: IPv4 address for the special event subdomain.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
  FeedProxyHost:
    Type: String
    Default: feeds.megaphone.fm.
    Description: Hostname of the podcast feed-proxy service.
  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=placeholderGoogleTokenValue
    Description: Google site-verification token value.
  SecondOwnershipVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: ms=placeholderMicrosoftTokenValue
    Description: Second domain-ownership verification token value.
  GoogleDkimPublicKey:
    Type: String
    Default: MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAtPlaceholderPublicKeyValue
    Description: Google Workspace DKIM RSA public key (p= value).
  MailChimpVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholderMailChimpVerificationToken
    Description: MailChimp domain verification TXT token.
  SquarespaceVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholderSquarespaceVerificationToken
    Description: Squarespace site-verification TXT token.
  CampaignMonitorVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholderCampaignMonitorVerificationToken
    Description: Campaign Monitor verification TXT token.
  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholderZendeskVerificationToken
    Description: Zendesk domain verification TXT token.
  AcmValidationTokenMedia:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholderacmvalidationtokenmedia
    Description: ACM DNS validation token for the media subdomain certificate.
  AcmValidationTokenTower:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholderacmvalidationtokentower
    Description: ACM DNS validation token for the tower subdomain certificate.
  AcmValidationTokenV1:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholderacmvalidationtokenv1
    Description: ACM DNS validation token for the v1 subdomain certificate.
  AcmValidationTokenPlus:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholderacmvalidationtokenplus
    Description: ACM DNS validation token for the plus subdomain certificate.

Resources:
  RadiotopiaHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Public hosted zone for radiotopia.fm production DNS.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront access-log bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudFrontLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'radiotopia-fm-cloudfront-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AccessControl: LogDeliveryWrite
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:

      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: ObjectWriter
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions

            NoncurrentVersionExpirationInDays: 30
          - Id: ExpireLogObjects
            Status: Enabled

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # WAFv2 WebACL for CloudFront (scope CLOUDFRONT)

    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia-fm-cloudfront-waf

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  integration supporting an AI agent for protein variant effect prediction.
  Provisions an IAM role for bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com, stores its ARN in SSM,
  creates an AgentCore Gateway with a custom JWT authorizer, and a gateway target
  exposing an MCP inline tool schema with invoke_endpoint and get_results operations.
  The backend Lambda function and Cognito user pool / app client are created in
  this template so the stack is fully self-contained in a greenfield account.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,38}[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: >
      Lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens only; must start and end
      with an alphanumeric character; 1-40 characters.
    Description: Project name used for naming and tagging resources.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: MCP gateway for protein variant effect prediction
    Description: Description for the AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      Optional gateway name. If left blank, a name is auto-generated from
      ProjectName as '<ProjectName>-gateway'.

Conditions:
  CreateGatewayName: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref GatewayName
      - ''

Resources:
  BackendLambdaRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BackendLambda:
    Type: 'AWS::Lambda::Function'
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-variant-effect-predictor'
      Description: Backend handler for protein variant effect prediction jobs.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt BackendLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import uuid

          def handler(event, context):
              tool = event.get("tool") or event.get("name") or ""
              args = event.get("arguments") or event.get("input") or {}
              if tool == "invoke_endpoint":
                  job_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                  return {
                      "job_id": job_id,
                      "status": "SUBMITTED",
                      "sequence": args.get("sequence"),
                      "variant": args.get("variant"),
                  }
              if tool == "get_results":
                  return {
                      "job_id": args.get("job_id"),
                      "status": "COMPLETED",
                      "score": 0.0,
                  }
              return {"status": "UNKNOWN_TOOL", "tool": tool}
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  UserPool:
    Type: 'AWS::Cognito::UserPool'
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-pool'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: production
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: 'AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient'
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  GatewayRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeBackendLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
                Resource: !GetAtt BackendLambda.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: 'AWS::SSM::Parameter'
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the AgentCore Gateway.
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: production
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # NOTE: The exact property schema for AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway and
  # AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget (authorizer configuration and inline
  # tool schema shape) is subject to change. The properties below reflect the
  # documented shape at time of authoring. Unverified sub-properties have been
  # omitted rather than invented.
  Gateway:
    Type: 'AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway'
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - CreateGatewayName
        - !Ref GatewayName
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      RoleArn: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      ProtocolType: MCP
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
          AllowedAudience:
            - !Ref UserPoolClient
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: production
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  GatewayTarget:
    Type: 'AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget'
    Properties:
      GatewayIdentifier: !Ref Gateway
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lambda-target'
      Description: MCP target exposing protein variant effect prediction operations.
      CredentialProviderConfigurations:
        - CredentialProviderType: GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt BackendLambda.Arn
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload:
                - Name: invoke_endpoint
                  Description: >
                    Submit a protein sequence and variant for variant effect
                    prediction. Returns a job identifier for polling.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      sequence:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Amino acid sequence of the protein.
                      variant:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Variant identifier (e.g. A123V).
                    Required:
                      - sequence
                      - variant
                - Name: get_results
                  Description: >
                    Retrieve the status and results of a previously submitted
                    prediction job.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      job_id:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Identifier of the prediction job.
                    Required:
                      - job_id

Outputs:
  GatewayId:
    Description: Identifier of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !Ref Gateway

  GatewayArn:
    Description: ARN of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayArn

  GatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn

  GatewayRoleArnSsmParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name storing the gateway IAM role ARN.
    Value: !Ref GatewayRoleArnParameter

  GatewayName:
    Description: Resolved name of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !If
      - CreateGatewayName
      - !Ref GatewayName
      - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'

  BackendLambdaArn:
    Description: ARN of the backend Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt BackendLambda.Arn

  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool used by the JWT authorizer.
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Client ID used as the JWT audience for the gateway authorizer.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Private VPC infrastructure with ALB and Lambda subnets, optional NAT egress, KMS-encrypted artifact bucket, S3 gateway endpoint, VPC flow logs, and S3 access logging.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  AlbSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first ALB private subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  AlbSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second ALB private subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  LambdaSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the Lambda private subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  NatSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public NAT Gateway subnet (used only when NAT egress is enabled).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  EnableNatEgress:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Enable NAT Gateway internet egress for OAuth and external identity provider flows.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for tagging.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

Conditions:
  NatEgressEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatEgress, 'true']

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: alb

  AlbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: alb

  LambdaSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: lambda

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  AlbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  LambdaSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref LambdaSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: NatEgressEnabled
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: NatEgressEnabled
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: NatEgressEnabled
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref NatSubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: NatEgressEnabled
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: NatEgressEnabled
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: NatEgressEnabled
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref NatSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: NatEgressEnabled
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: NatEgressEnabled
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIp.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref NatSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateNatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: NatEgressEnabled
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowArtifactBucketAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'

  AlbSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the Application Load Balancer.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTP from within the VPC.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS from within the VPC.
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS egress to targets within the VPC.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Lambda functions with no inbound rules.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS egress for OAuth and external identity provider flows.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ArtifactKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting the artifact storage bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-artifact-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ArtifactKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-artifact-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ArtifactKey

  LogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting CloudWatch Logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-logs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DependsOn: LogsKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-logs-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogsKey

  AccessLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-access-log-bucket'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: artifact-bucket/
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-artifact-bucket'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
