AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Step Functions two-step Pass workflow with two separate API Gateway REST APIs (GET and POST) each with its own IAM role, deployed to a stage with access logging, X-Ray tracing, API key enforcement, CMK-encrypted logs, and response caching.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: API Gateway stage name for both REST APIs.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
  ApiNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: sfn-pass
    Description: Prefix used for naming both REST APIs and related resources.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

Resources:
  ApiLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt API Gateway access logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/${ApiNamePrefix}-access-logs'

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${ApiNamePrefix}-access-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ApiLogsKey.Arn

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${ApiNamePrefix}-state-machine'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "Simple two-step Pass workflow",
          "StartAt": "FirstPass",
          "States": {
            "FirstPass": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Next": "SecondPass"
            },
            "SecondPass": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  GetApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  PostApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  GetRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ApiNamePrefix}-get-api'
      Description: REST API exposing a GET endpoint that starts the state machine.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  GetResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt GetRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: start

  GetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref GetResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiGatewayRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}",
              "input": "{\"source\":\"GET\"}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'

  GetDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      Description: Deployment for the GET API.

  GetStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref GetDeployment
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      Description: Stage for the GET API.
      TracingEnabled: true
      CacheClusterEnabled: true
      CacheClusterSize: '0.5'
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status"}'
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: false
          MetricsEnabled: true
          CachingEnabled: true
          CacheTtlInSeconds: 300
          CacheDataEncrypted: true

  GetApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    DependsOn:
      - GetStage
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ApiNamePrefix}-get-api-key'
      Enabled: true
      StageKeys:
        - RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
          StageName: !Ref StageName

  GetUsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    DependsOn:
      - GetStage
    Properties:
      UsagePlanName: !Sub '${ApiNamePrefix}-get-usage-plan'
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
          Stage: !Ref StageName

  GetUsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    DependsOn:
      - GetUsagePlan
      - GetApiKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref GetApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref GetUsagePlan

  PostRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ApiNamePrefix}-post-api'
      Description: REST API exposing a POST endpoint that starts the state machine.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  PostResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt PostRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: start

  PostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref PostResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiGatewayRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}",
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'

  PostDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      Description: Deployment for the POST API.

  PostStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref PostDeployment
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      Description: Stage for the POST API.
      TracingEnabled: true
      CacheClusterEnabled: true
      CacheClusterSize: '0.5'
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status"}'
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: false
          MetricsEnabled: true
          CachingEnabled: true
          CacheTtlInSeconds: 300
          CacheDataEncrypted: true

  PostApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    DependsOn:
      - PostStage
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ApiNamePrefix}-post-api-key'
      Enabled: true
      StageKeys:
        - RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
          StageName: !Ref StageName

  PostUsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    DependsOn:
      - PostStage
    Properties:
      UsagePlanName: !Sub '${ApiNamePrefix}-post-usage-plan'
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
          Stage: !Ref StageName

  PostUsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    DependsOn:
      - PostUsagePlan
      - PostApiKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref PostApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref PostUsagePlan

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

  StateMachineExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the state machine execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn

  GetApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL for the GET API stage.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${GetRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${StageName}/start'

  PostApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL for the POST API stage.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${PostRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${StageName}/start'

  GetApiGatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the GET API integration.
    Value: !GetAtt GetApiGatewayRole.Arn

  PostApiGatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the POST API integration.
    Value: !GetAtt PostApiGatewayRole.Arn

  GetApiKeyId:
    Description: ID of the API key for the GET API.
    Value: !Ref GetApiKey

  PostApiKeyId:
    Description: ID of the API key for the POST API.
    Value: !Ref PostApiKey

  ApiAccessLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Log Group used for API access logs.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn

  ApiLogsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS CMK used to encrypt API access logs.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiLogsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Hospitality Insights foundation stack - IAM roles for Lambda microservices and Bedrock AgentCore runtime, plus Secrets Manager secrets for naming prefix and ScrapingBee API key.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Project name used as a prefix for all resource names and ARN patterns.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.

Resources:
  SecretsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for encrypting ${ProjectName} ${Environment} Secrets Manager secrets.'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ScraperLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: scraper-least-privilege
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBScraperAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: SQSScraperAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: S3ScraperAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: SecretsScraperAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AnalysisLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: analysis-least-privilege
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBAnalysisAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: ComprehendAnalysisAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:DetectEntities
                  - comprehend:DetectKeyPhrases
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectSentiment
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: BedrockAnalysisAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*'
              - Sid: S3AnalysisAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: SecretsAnalysisAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlertsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: alerts-least-privilege
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SNSAlertsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: SQSAlertsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBAlertsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: SecretsAlertsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ApiLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-api-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: api-least-privilege
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBApiAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: SQSApiAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: S3ApiAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: StepFunctionsApiAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: SecretsApiAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AdminLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-admin-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: admin-scoped-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: SQSAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:*
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: SNSAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:*
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: StepFunctionsAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:*
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: S3AdminBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: S3AdminObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObjectAttributes
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: SecretsAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ArchivalLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-archival-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: archival-least-privilege
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBArchivalAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: S3ArchivalAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: SQSArchivalAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: SecretsArchivalAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  BedrockAgentCoreRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-bedrock-agentcore-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - bedrock.amazonaws.com
                - bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bedrock-agentcore-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                  - bedrock:Converse
                  - bedrock:ConverseStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*'
              - Sid: BedrockAgentSessionManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:CreateAgentSession
                  - bedrock:GetAgentSession
                  - bedrock:ListAgentSessions
                  - bedrock:DeleteAgentSession
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBAgentCoreAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: S3AgentCoreAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: SecretsAgentCoreAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  SecretsPrefixSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/${Environment}/prefix'
      Description: !Sub 'Establishes the naming prefix ${ProjectName}/${Environment}/ for all Hospitality Insights secrets. Contains no sensitive value.'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt SecretsKmsKey.Arn
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"prefix":"placeholder"}'
        GenerateStringKey: prefix
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ScrapingBeeApiKeySecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/${Environment}/scrapingbee-api-key'
      Description: Placeholder secret for the ScrapingBee API key. Replace the generated value with the real API key after deployment.
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt SecretsKmsKey.Arn
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"apiKey":"placeholder"}'
        GenerateStringKey: apiKey
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludePunctuation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  ScraperRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Scraper Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt ScraperLambdaRole.Arn
  AnalysisRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Analysis Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt AnalysisLambdaRole.Arn
  AlertsRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Alerts Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt AlertsLambdaRole.Arn
  ApiRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiLambdaRole.Arn
  AdminRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Admin Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt AdminLambdaRole.Arn
  ArchivalRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Archival Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt ArchivalLambdaRole.Arn
  BedrockAgentCoreRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Bedrock AgentCore runtime role.
    Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentCoreRole.Arn
  SecretsPrefixSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret that establishes the naming prefix.
    Value: !Ref SecretsPrefixSecret
  ScrapingBeeSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the ScrapingBee API key.
    Value: !Ref ScrapingBeeApiKeySecret
  SecretsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the Secrets Manager secrets.
    Value: !GetAtt SecretsKmsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Audit events SQS queue with KMS encryption, optional DLQ, and CloudWatch alarms with SNS notifications.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev
  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Email address to receive alarm notifications. Leave empty to skip subscription.
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  IsNotDev: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref Environment
      - dev
  HasAlertEmail: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref AlertEmail
      - ''

Mappings:
  EnvConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      MaxReceiveCount: 3
      OldestMessageThreshold: 3600
      DlqVisibleThreshold: 1
    staging:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
      MaxReceiveCount: 5
      OldestMessageThreshold: 1800
      DlqVisibleThreshold: 1
    prod:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 120
      MaxReceiveCount: 5
      OldestMessageThreshold: 900
      DlqVisibleThreshold: 1

Resources:
  AuditEventsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for audit events SQS queues
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: AuditEvents

  AuditEventsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/audit-events-${Environment}-${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey

  AuditEventsDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNotDev
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: AuditEvents

  AuditEventsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNotDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, MaxReceiveCount]
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: AuditEvents

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: AuditEvents

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlertEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail

  OldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'audit-events-oldest-message-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when the oldest message age in the audit events queue exceeds threshold.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, OldestMessageThreshold]
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: AuditEvents

  DlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'audit-events-dlq-visible-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when messages appear in the audit events dead letter queue.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, DlqVisibleThreshold]
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: AuditEvents

Outputs:
  AuditEventsQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the primary audit events queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn
  AuditEventsQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the primary audit events queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsQueue
  AuditEventsDlqArn:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: ARN of the audit events dead letter queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.Arn
  AuditEventsDlqUrl:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: URL of the audit events dead letter queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsDlq
  AuditEventsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS CMK used for audit events encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for alarm notifications.
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito user pool for researchapp / AgentCore with web and machine clients, groups, resource server, hosted domain, customer-group Lambda, and SSM configuration.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine app client.
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the web app client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'researchapp-agentcore-${UserPoolName}'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 1
      Description: Administrator group with higher precedence.

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GroupName: customer
      Precedence: 10
      Description: Customer group.

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: researchapp-agentcore
      Name: researchapp-agentcore
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to researchapp AgentCore resources.

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - researchapp-agentcore/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  MachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - researchapp-agentcore/read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub 'researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'

  ConfigKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key used to encrypt the researchapp AgentCore machine client secret and Lambda log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  ConfigKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/researchapp-agentcore-config
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ConfigKmsKey

  MachineClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_secret
      Description: Encrypted machine-to-machine app client secret for researchapp AgentCore.
      KmsKeyId: !Ref ConfigKmsKey
      SecretString: !GetAtt MachineClient.ClientSecret

  CustomerGroupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: customer-group-lambda-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  CustomerGroupLambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/researchapp-agentcore-add-customer-group
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ConfigKmsKey.Arn

  CustomerGroupLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: researchapp-agentcore-add-customer-group
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CustomerGroupLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
          CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME: customer
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import logging
          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = os.environ.get('USER_POOL_ID')
              group_name = os.environ.get('CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME', 'customer')
              username = event.get('userName') or event.get('username')
              if not username:
                  logger.error('No username provided in event: %s', event)
                  raise ValueError('userName is required')
              client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  GroupName=group_name
              )
              logger.info('Added user %s to group %s', username, group_name)
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'ok'}

  SsmUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user_pool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool

  SsmWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebClient

  SsmMachineClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineClient

  SsmMachineClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_secret
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineClient.ClientSecret

  SsmOAuthScopes:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/oauth_scopes
      Type: String
      Value: researchapp-agentcore/read openid email profile

  SsmDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  SsmTokenUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/token_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  SsmAuthorizeUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/authorize_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'

  SsmCognitoDomain:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  WebClientId:
    Description: Web app client ID.
    Value: !Ref WebClient
  MachineClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine app client ID.
    Value: !Ref MachineClient
  CognitoDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted domain URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  SsmParameterPathPrefix:
    Description: SSM parameter path prefix for integration configuration.
    Value: /app/researchapp/agentcore/

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained GraphQL API for cryptocurrency ticker data using AWS AppSync, DynamoDB, and the CoinGecko HTTP API.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key for DynamoDB and CloudWatch Logs encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppDataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for CryptoTickerAPI data and logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/appsync/apis/CryptoTickerAPI'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Group for AppSync logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/appsync/apis/CryptoTickerAPI
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AppDataKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role for AppSync to write logs to CloudWatch
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AppSyncLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AppSyncLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AppDataKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AppDataKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role for AppSync to access DynamoDB
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${APIDataTable.Arn}/index/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AppDataKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AppSync GraphQL API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      XrayEnabled: false
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ERROR
        ExcludeVerboseContent: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GraphQL Schema
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CryptoTickerAPISchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          priceUsd: Float
          timestamp: String
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type PriceHistoryItem {
          ticker: String!
          priceUsd: Float
          timestamp: String
          sk: String
        }

        type PriceHistoryEdge {
          cursor: String!
          node: PriceHistoryItem
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceHistoryItem]
          nextToken: String
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(ticker: String!): TickerInfo
          priceHistory(ticker: String!, limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Data Sources
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoDataSource
      Type: HTTP
      Description: HTTP data source for the CoinGecko public API
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com

  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      Description: DynamoDB data source for APIDataTable
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        UseCallerCredentials: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Function: FetchTickerPriceFunction (HTTP -> CoinGecko)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FetchTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: FetchTickerPriceFunction
      Description: Fetch the current USD price for a ticker from CoinGecko
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/api/v3/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "query": {
              "ids": "$ctx.args.ticker",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            },
            "headers": {
              "Accept": "application/json"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        #if($ctx.result.statusCode < 200 || $ctx.result.statusCode >= 300)
          $util.error("CoinGecko request failed with status $ctx.result.statusCode", "CoinGeckoError")
        #end
        #set($body = $util.parseJson($ctx.result.body))
        #set($ticker = $ctx.args.ticker)
        #set($price = $body.get($ticker).get("usd"))
        #if($util.isNull($price))
          $util.error("No price found for ticker $ticker", "TickerNotFound")
        #end
        $util.toJson({
          "ticker": $ticker,
          "priceUsd": $price,
          "timestamp": "$util.time.nowISO8601()"
        })

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Function: StorePriceRecordFunction (DynamoDB PutItem)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StorePriceRecordFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: StorePriceRecordFunction
      Description: Store a historical price record in APIDataTable
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.ticker),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.timestamp)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.ticker),
            "priceUsd": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.priceUsd),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.timestamp)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        $util.toJson($ctx.prev.result)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resolver: Query.ticker (PIPELINE)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - CryptoTickerAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt StorePriceRecordFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": {
            "ticker": $util.toJson($ctx.args.ticker)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resolver: Query.priceHistory (DynamoDB Query)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PriceHistoryQueryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - CryptoTickerAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: priceHistory
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($limit = 25)
        #if($ctx.args.limit)
          #set($limit = $ctx.args.limit)
        #end
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :ticker",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.ticker)
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $limit,
          #if($ctx.args.nextToken)
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($ctx.args.nextToken),
          #end
          "select": "ALL_ATTRIBUTES"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        #set($items = [])
        #foreach($item in $ctx.result.items)
          $util.qr($items.add({
            "ticker": $item.get("ticker"),
            "priceUsd": $item.get("priceUsd"),
            "timestamp": $item.get("timestamp"),
            "sk": $item.get("sk")
          }))
        #end
        $util.toJson({
          "items": $items,
          "nextToken": $ctx.result.nextToken
        })

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resolver: TickerInfo.priceHistory (DynamoDB Query)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PriceHistoryFieldResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - CryptoTickerAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($limit = 25)
        #if($ctx.args.limit)
          #set($limit = $ctx.args.limit)
        #end
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :ticker",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.source.ticker)
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $limit,
          #if($ctx.args.nextToken)
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($ctx.args.nextToken),
          #end
          "select": "ALL_ATTRIBUTES"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        #set($items = [])
        #foreach($item in $ctx.result.items)
          $util.qr($items.add({
            "ticker": $item.get("ticker"),
            "priceUsd": $item.get("priceUsd"),
            "timestamp": $item.get("timestamp"),
            "sk": $item.get("sk")
          }))
        #end
        $util.toJson({
          "items": $items,
          "nextToken": $ctx.result.nextToken
        })

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Key (created after schema)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CryptoTickerAPIKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn:
      - CryptoTickerAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Description: Default API key for CryptoTickerAPI

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: The ID of the CryptoTickerAPI GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId

  GraphQLUrl:
    Description: The GraphQL endpoint URL of the CryptoTickerAPI
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.GraphQLUrl

  ApiKeyId:
    Description: The ID of the default API key
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPIKey.ApiKeyId

  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: The name of the APIDataTable DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref APIDataTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: MediaPackage live channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints, optional live-to-VOD and VOD workflows.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: mediapackage
    Description: Logical name prefix for resource naming.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for tagging.
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Segment duration in seconds for the HLS endpoint.
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 86400
    Description: Startover window in seconds for the origin endpoints.
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: Manifest name for the origin endpoints.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 60
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Output type controlling which origin endpoints are created.
  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Existing S3 bucket name for live-to-VOD storage. Leave empty to disable live-to-VOD.
  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Existing S3 bucket name for VOD source content. Leave empty to disable VOD workflows.
  CustomTags:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Comma-separated key=value pairs for custom tagging (e.g. "team=media,cost=123").

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  CreateHlsEndpoint: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateDashEndpoint: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]

Resources:
  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-channel'
      Description: !Sub 'MediaPackage live channel for ${Environment}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-channel'
        - Key: CustomTags
          Value: !Ref CustomTags

  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-hls'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub 'HLS origin endpoint for ${Environment}'
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        PlaylistType: EVENT
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-hls'
        - Key: CustomTags
          Value: !Ref CustomTags

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-dash'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub 'DASH origin endpoint for ${Environment}'
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-dash'
        - Key: CustomTags
          Value: !Ref CustomTags

  MediaPackageRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: !Sub 'IAM role for MediaPackage to access S3 buckets in ${Environment}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-role'
        - Key: CustomTags
          Value: !Ref CustomTags

  ArchiveBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-archive-s3-access'
      Roles:
        - !Ref MediaPackageRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ArchiveBucketAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:

      Description: Extensive permissions for managing VPCs, subnets, security groups, load balancers, Auto Scaling groups, launch templates, EKS access entries, and IAM service-linked roles for the CAPA controllers.

              - ec2:TerminateInstances
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck

              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EksClusterAndNodegroupManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:CreateNodegroup

  # Nodes Role + Instance Profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: DynamoDB table for a new application with configurable keys, billing mode, PITR, customer-managed KMS encryption, and optional CloudWatch alarms publishing to an encrypted SNS topic.

Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    Description: Name of the partition (hash) key attribute.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    Description: Attribute type of the partition key.
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: sortKey
    Description: Name of the optional sort (range) key attribute. Leave empty to omit the sort key.
    MinLength: 0
    MaxLength: 255
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    Description: Attribute type of the sort key (used only when SortKeyName is non-empty).
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    Description: Billing mode for the table.
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Provisioned read capacity units (used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Provisioned write capacity units (used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).
  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery for the table.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  EnableAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Enable CloudWatch alarms for throttling and errors.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  AlarmNotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Email address subscribed to the SNS topic for alarm notifications (required when EnableAlarms is true).
  ThrottleAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 0
    Description: Threshold for the throttling alarm (sum of throttled requests per period).
  ErrorAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 0
    Description: Threshold for the error alarm (sum of user errors per period).
  AlarmEvaluationPeriods:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of periods to evaluate before alarming.
  AlarmPeriodSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 60
    Description: Period in seconds over which the metric is evaluated.

Conditions:
  HasSortKey: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref SortKeyName
      - ''
  UseProvisionedBilling: !Equals
    - !Ref BillingMode
    - PROVISIONED
  AlarmsEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableAlarms
    - 'true'

Resources:
  AppEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for DynamoDB table and SNS topic encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  AppEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-app-encryption'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AppEncryptionKey

  ApplicationTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - UseProvisionedBilling
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AppEncryptionKey.Arn

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      DisplayName: DynamoDB Application Table Alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AppEncryptionKey.Arn

  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmNotificationEmail

  ThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB table throttled requests exceeded threshold.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref ApplicationTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: !Ref AlarmPeriodSeconds
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB table user errors exceeded threshold.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref ApplicationTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: !Ref AlarmPeriodSeconds
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref ErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref ApplicationTable
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationTable.Arn
  EncryptionKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used for encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt AppEncryptionKey.Arn
  AlarmTopicArn:
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic used for alarm notifications.
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic
