AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipeline building custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs (x86_64 and arm64) with Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and SSM sudo access.

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    Description: Version string for the Image Builder recipes and images.
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a semantic version like 1.0.0
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024
    Description: Root volume size in GB for the built AMIs.
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-xxxxxxxxxx'
    Description: AWS Organization ID to share the built AMIs with.
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Organization ID (o-xxxxxxxxxx)

Resources:
  BuildVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-vpc'

  BuildInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-igw'

  BuildVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref BuildInternetGateway

  BuildPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-public-subnet'

  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-private-subnet'

  BuildPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-public-rt'

  BuildPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref BuildInternetGateway

  BuildPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildPublicRouteTable

  BuildNatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  BuildNatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt BuildNatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-nat'

  BuildPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-private-rt'

  BuildPrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref BuildNatGateway

  BuildSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildPrivateRouteTable

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Egress-only security group for Image Builder build instances.
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow outbound traffic within the VPC (NAT egress path).
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-sg'

  ImageBuilderKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for Image Builder logging bucket and SNS topic encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowS3Use
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowFlowLogsDeliveryUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'delivery.logs.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  ImageBuilderKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ImageBuilderKey

  AccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  AccessLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt LoggingBucket.Arn
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'

  LoggingBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  LoggingBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LoggingBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LoggingBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${LoggingBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${LoggingBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  BuildVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: s3
      LogDestination: !GetAtt AccessLogsBucket.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-vpc-flowlog'

  NotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: ImageBuilderBuildNotifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKey.Arn

  NotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref NotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilderECRContainerBuilds'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderLoggingAndNotificationAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3LoggingAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LoggingBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LoggingBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: SnsPublishAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'sns:Publish'
                Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
              - Sid: KmsAccessForLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKey.Arn

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  InstallComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-install-software'
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and enables SSM user sudo access.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Data: |
        name: InstallSoftware
        description: Install Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and enable SSM sudo access.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: installDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf update -y
                    - dnf install -y docker python3 python3-pip jq
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
                    - usermod -aG docker ec2-user || true
              - name: installDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
                    - COMPOSE_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/docker/compose/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name)
                    - curl -sSL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/${COMPOSE_VERSION}/docker-compose-linux-$(uname -m)" -o /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - chmod +x /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - ln -sf /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
                    - docker compose version
              - name: installPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
                    - python3 -m pip install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: enableSsmSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - id ssm-user || useradd -m ssm-user
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users

  TestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-test-software'
      Description: Verifies Docker Compose and Python imports.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Data: |
        name: TestSoftware
        description: Verify Docker Compose and Python imports.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: testDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - docker compose version
              - name: testPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp; print('imports ok')"

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra'
      Description: Shared infrastructure configuration for AL2023 AMI builds.

      InstanceTypes:

        - t3.large
        - m6g.medium
        - m6g.large

        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup

    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-recipe-x86'
      Description: AL2023 x86_64 recipe with Docker, Docker Compose, and Python packages.
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Architecture: x86_64

    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe

      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Architecture: arm64

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution'
      Description: Public AMI distribution with organization sharing.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: Custom AL2023 AMI built by Image Builder.
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Image

      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Architecture: x86_64

    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Image

      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref RecipeArm64

      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration

      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Architecture: arm64

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo - Cognito User Pool with seeded test users

Resources:
  AgentOpsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false

  AgentOpsWebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
      Precedence: 10

  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
      Precedence: 20

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
      Precedence: 1

  SeederFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoSeederPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                  - cognito-idp:ListUsers
                Resource: !GetAtt AgentOpsUserPool.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'

  SeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: agentops-cognito-seeder
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt SeederFunctionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import boto3

          DEMO_PASSWORD = "Demo1234!"

          USERS = [
              {"email": "alice@demo.local", "group": "team-alpha", "role": "member"},
              {"email": "bob@demo.local", "group": "team-alpha", "role": "member"},
              {"email": "charlie@demo.local", "group": "team-alpha", "role": "team_admin"},
              {"email": "dave@demo.local", "group": "team-beta", "role": "member"},
              {"email": "eve@demo.local", "group": "team-beta", "role": "team_admin"},
              {"email": "admin@demo.local", "group": "admin", "role": "admin"},
          ]

          def send_response(event, context, status, reason, physical_id, data=None):
              body = json.dumps({
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason,
                  "PhysicalResourceId": physical_id,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "Data": data or {},
              }).encode("utf-8")
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=body,
                  method="PUT",
                  headers={"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(body))},
              )
              urllib.request.urlopen(req)

          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId", "agentops-cognito-seeder")
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", "Delete not required", physical_id)
                      return

                  user_pool_id = event["ResourceProperties"]["UserPoolId"]
                  client = boto3.client("cognito-idp")

                  for user in USERS:
                      email = user["email"]
                      try:
                          client.admin_get_user(UserPoolId=user_pool_id, Username=email)
                      except client.exceptions.UserNotFoundException:
                          client.admin_create_user(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              UserAttributes=[
                                  {"Name": "email", "Value": email},
                                  {"Name": "email_verified", "Value": "true"},
                                  {"Name": "custom:role", "Value": user["role"]},
                              ],
                              MessageAction="SUPPRESS",
                          )
                      client.admin_set_user_password(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=email,
                          Password=DEMO_PASSWORD,
                          Permanent=True,
                      )
                      client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=email,
                          GroupName=user["group"],
                      )

                  send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", "Users seeded", physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  send_response(event, context, "FAILED", str(exc), physical_id)

  SeederFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref SeederFunction
      Principal: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/${AWS::StackName}/*'

  SeedUsersCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn:
      - TeamAlphaGroup
      - TeamBetaGroup
      - AdminGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt AgentOpsUserPool.Arn

  AppClientId:
    Description: Cognito App Client ID
    Value: !Ref AgentOpsWebClient

  Region:
    Description: AWS Region
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  SeederFunctionArn:
    Description: Seeder Lambda Function ARN
    Value: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  AWS Client VPN usage reporting stack. Creates a CloudWatch dashboard with
  Logs Insights widgets (tables) for total usage per endpoint, usage per
  authentication type (AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, Mixed Auth), distinct users, and
  connection durations. The Client VPN connection log group is externally
  managed and referenced only by name via a parameter.
  NOTE: AWS::CloudWatchLogs::QueryDefinition is not a valid CloudFormation
  resource type, so the Logs Insights queries are surfaced as documented query
  strings embedded in the dashboard widgets (and exposed as outputs) instead of
  as standalone saved-query resources.

Parameters:
  QueryFolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    Description: >
      Logical folder path used to organize/name the Logs Insights queries
      surfaced by this stack (embedded in the dashboard and outputs).
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >
      Must contain only alphanumeric characters, forward slashes,
      underscores, or hyphens.
  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    Description: >
      Name of the existing (externally managed) CloudWatch Logs log group that
      holds AWS Client VPN connection logs. This stack does not create it.
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CloudWatch Logs log group name.

Resources:
  ClientVpnUsageDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}-client-vpn-usage'
      DashboardBody: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "widgets": [
              {
                "type": "text",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 0,
                "width": 24,
                "height": 2,
                "properties": {
                  "markdown": "# AWS Client VPN Usage Reporting\nQuery folder: **${QueryFolderPath}** | Log group: **${ClientVpnLogGroupName}**\nAuthentication methods covered: AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, Mixed Auth."
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 2,
                "width": 24,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Total Usage per Endpoint",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "view": "table",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, @message | filter ispresent(endpoint) or ispresent(connection_id) | stats count(*) as connection_events by endpoint, connection_id | sort connection_events desc"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 8,
                "width": 24,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Usage per Authentication Type (AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, Mixed Auth)",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "view": "table",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, @message | parse @message /(?<auth_method>AD|SAML|MutualAuth|Mutual Auth|MixedAuth|Mixed Auth|certificate|federated)/ | filter ispresent(auth_method) | stats count(*) as event_count by auth_method | sort event_count desc"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 14,
                "width": 24,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Distinct Users",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "view": "table",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, @message | parse @message /(?<username>[A-Za-z0-9._%+\\-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.\\-]+)/ | filter ispresent(username) | stats count_distinct(username) as distinct_users by username | sort distinct_users desc"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 20,
                "width": 24,
                "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Connection Durations",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "view": "table",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, @message | parse @message /(?<event_type>CONNECT|DISCONNECT)/ | filter ispresent(event_type) | stats avg(duration) as avg_duration_seconds, max(duration) as max_duration_seconds, min(duration) as min_duration_seconds, count(*) as sessions by connection_id | sort avg_duration_seconds desc"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        - QueryFolderPath: !Ref QueryFolderPath
          ClientVpnLogGroupName: !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName

Outputs:
  DashboardName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch dashboard created for Client VPN usage reporting.
    Value: !Ref ClientVpnUsageDashboard
  DashboardUrl:
    Description: Console URL of the Client VPN usage reporting dashboard.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${AWS::Region}#dashboards:name=${ClientVpnUsageDashboard}'
  QueryFolderPath:
    Description: Resolved query folder path used to organize the Logs Insights queries.
    Value: !Ref QueryFolderPath
  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Description: Resolved name of the externally managed Client VPN log group referenced by the queries.
    Value: !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
  QueryEndpointUsage:
    Description: Logs Insights query for total usage per endpoint.
    Value: !Sub "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, @message | filter ispresent(endpoint) or ispresent(connection_id) | stats count(*) as connection_events by endpoint, connection_id | sort connection_events desc"
  QueryAuthTypeUsage:
    Description: Logs Insights query for usage per authentication type.
    Value: !Sub "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, @message | parse @message /(?<auth_method>AD|SAML|MutualAuth|Mutual Auth|MixedAuth|Mixed Auth|certificate|federated)/ | filter ispresent(auth_method) | stats count(*) as event_count by auth_method | sort event_count desc"
  QueryDistinctUsers:
    Description: Logs Insights query for distinct users.
    Value: !Sub "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, @message | parse @message /(?<username>[A-Za-z0-9._%+\\-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.\\-]+)/ | filter ispresent(username) | stats count_distinct(username) as distinct_users by username | sort distinct_users desc"
  QueryConnectionDurations:
    Description: Logs Insights query for connection durations.
    Value: !Sub "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, @message | parse @message /(?<event_type>CONNECT|DISCONNECT)/ | filter ispresent(event_type) | stats avg(duration) as avg_duration_seconds, max(duration) as max_duration_seconds, min(duration) as min_duration_seconds, count(*) as sessions by connection_id | sort avg_duration_seconds desc"

Description: AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication system - Cognito User Pool with PLUS tier, advanced security, SPA/admin/M2M clients, groups, resource server, and domain.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev

Resources:
  HotelUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool'
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailMessage: 'Your AnyCompany Hotel verification code is {####}.'
        EmailSubject: 'AnyCompany Hotel - Verify your email'
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Schema:
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      UserPoolTags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Application: AnyCompanyHotel

  SpaAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  AdminAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  HotelResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api'
      Name: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-resource-server'
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel resources
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel resources
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AnyCompany Hotel resources

  M2MAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: HotelResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${HotelResourceServer}/read'
        - !Sub '${HotelResourceServer}/write'
        - !Sub '${HotelResourceServer}/admin'
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel administrators with full access
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel property managers
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel regional managers
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel revenue managers
      Precedence: 4
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: FrontDesk
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel front desk staff
      Precedence: 5
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel housekeeping staff
      Precedence: 6
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool

  HotelUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref HotelUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool-id'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt HotelUserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool-arn'

  SpaClientId:
    Description: Public SPA app client ID
    Value: !Ref SpaAppClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa-client-id'

  AdminClientId:
    Description: Admin app client ID
    Value: !Ref AdminAppClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin-client-id'

  M2MClientId:
    Description: M2M app client ID
    Value: !Ref M2MAppClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m-client-id'

  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Description: Resource server identifier
    Value: !Ref HotelResourceServer
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-resource-server-identifier'

  UserPoolDomainUrl:
    Description: Full Cognito hosted domain URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${HotelUserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-domain-url'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Hospitality Insights - Cognito User Pool (prod) with post-authentication Lambda trigger, groups, optional SSO and custom domain.

Parameters:
  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional federated identity provider name (e.g. a SAML/OIDC provider name).
      Leave empty to disable SSO integration.
  SSOLoginURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional login URL for the SSO provider. Leave empty to disable SSO integration.
  CustomDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be empty or a valid Cognito domain prefix (lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens,
      1-63 chars, not starting/ending with a hyphen).
    Description: >-
      Optional custom domain prefix for the hosted UI. Leave empty to omit the custom domain.

Conditions:
  EnableSSO: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref SSOProviderName
      - ''
  EnableCustomDomain: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref CustomDomainPrefix
      - ''

Resources:
  HospitalityInsightsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: hospitality-insights-prod-user-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: HospitalityInsights
        Environment: prod

  HospitalityInsightsUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: hospitality-insights-prod-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 24
      IdTokenValidity: 24
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - EnableSSO
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SSOProviderName
        - - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs:
        - !If
          - EnableSSO
          - !Ref SSOLoginURL
          - https://localhost/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - !If
          - EnableSSO
          - !Ref SSOLoginURL
          - https://localhost/logout
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile

  PostAuthenticationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cognito-admin-update-user-attributes
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'
        - PolicyName: lambda-basic-execution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:xray:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: hospitality-insights-prod-post-authentication
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import datetime
          import logging

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')


          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event.get('userPoolId')
              user_name = event.get('userName')
              if not user_pool_id or not user_name:
                  logger.error('Missing userPoolId or userName in event: %s', event)
                  return event

              last_login = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

              try:
                  client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=user_name,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {'Name': 'custom:last_login', 'Value': last_login}
                      ],
                  )

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API for managing client connections and session state with DynamoDB TTL, Lambda handlers, and IAM permissions.

Resources:
  SessionTableKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for DynamoDB session table encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  LogGroupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for CloudWatch Logs encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'

  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ConnectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ConnectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ExpiresAt
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SessionTableKey.Arn

  WebSocketApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogGroupKey.Arn

  ConnectFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SessionTableConnectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  DisconnectFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SessionTableDisconnectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  DefaultFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageConnectionsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${WebSocketApiStage}/POST/@connections/*

  ConnectFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ConnectFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import time
          import json
          import boto3

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              expires_at = int(time.time()) + 3600
              table.put_item(
                  Item={
                      'ConnectionId': connection_id,
                      'ExpiresAt': expires_at
                  }
              )
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'connected'})}

  DisconnectFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt DisconnectFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              table.delete_item(Key={'ConnectionId': connection_id})
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'disconnected'})}

  DefaultFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt DefaultFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ENDPOINT_URL: !Sub https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${WebSocketApiStage}
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          ENDPOINT_URL = os.environ['ENDPOINT_URL']
          apigw = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=ENDPOINT_URL)

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              body = event.get('body', '')
              apigw.post_to_connection(
                  ConnectionId=connection_id,
                  Data=body.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(body, str) else body
              )
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'echoed'})}

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: SessionWebSocketApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ConnectFunction.Arn}/invocations
      IntegrationMethod: POST

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DisconnectFunction.Arn}/invocations
      IntegrationMethod: POST

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DefaultFunction.Arn}/invocations
      IntegrationMethod: POST

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${ConnectIntegration}

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DefaultIntegration}

  WebSocketApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: api
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt WebSocketApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol","connectionId":"$context.connectionId","errorMessage":"$context.error.messageString"}'

  ConnectFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ConnectFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*

  DisconnectFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref DisconnectFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*

  DefaultFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref DefaultFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*

Outputs:
  WebSocketApiEndpoint:
    Description: WebSocket API endpoint URL (wss)
    Value: !Sub wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${WebSocketApiStage}

  SessionTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB session tracking table
    Value: !Ref SessionTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Test VPC with a single public subnet, internet gateway, public route table, and network ACL allowing all TCP/UDP traffic.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: Range18
    AllowedValues:
      - Range18
      - Range19
      - Range20
      - Range21
      - Range22
      - Range23
    Description: Select the VPC CIDR range token. Range18 selects 172.18.0.0/16, Range19 selects 172.19.0.0/16, Range20 selects 172.20.0.0/16, Range21 selects 172.21.0.0/16, Range22 selects 172.22.0.0/16, and Range23 selects 172.23.0.0/16. The public subnet is carved out as the corresponding /22 block.

Mappings:
  VpcCidrMap:
    Range18:
      Cidr: 172.18.0.0/16
    Range19:
      Cidr: 172.19.0.0/16
    Range20:
      Cidr: 172.20.0.0/16
    Range21:
      Cidr: 172.21.0.0/16
    Range22:
      Cidr: 172.22.0.0/16
    Range23:
      Cidr: 172.23.0.0/16
  SubnetCidrMap:
    Range18:
      SubnetCidr: 172.18.0.0/22
    Range19:
      SubnetCidr: 172.19.0.0/22
    Range20:
      SubnetCidr: 172.20.0.0/22
    Range21:
      SubnetCidr: 172.21.0.0/22
    Range22:
      SubnetCidr: 172.22.0.0/22
    Range23:
      SubnetCidr: 172.23.0.0/22

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap
        - VpcCidrMap
        - !Ref VpcCidr
        - Cidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: test-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: test-vpc

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap
        - SubnetCidrMap
        - !Ref VpcCidr
        - SubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: test-vpc-public-subnet
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: test-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: test-vpc-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: test-vpc

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: test-vpc-public-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Project
          Value: test-vpc

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:

                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) experiment template for multi-service chaos engineering (subnet network disruption, DynamoDB global table replication pause) with IAM role, KMS-encrypted CloudWatch log group.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: The target region used to identify cross-region replication targets for DynamoDB.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-[0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name (e.g. us-west-2).

  ExperimentDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: PT20M
    Description: ISO-8601 duration for the disruption and pause-replication actions (default 20 minutes).
    AllowedPattern: '^PT[0-9]+[MH]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an ISO-8601 duration such as PT20M or PT1H.

Resources:
  FisRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: IAM role assumed by AWS FIS to run chaos experiments.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FisChaosExperimentPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TransitGatewayAndRouteTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:ReplaceRoute
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transit-gateway/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:route-table/*'
              - Sid: SubnetAndNetworkAclAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
                  - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclEntry
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-acl/*'
              - Sid: S3ReplicationAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBGlobalTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:global-table/*'
              - Sid: TagBasedTargetSelection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'

  FisLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key used to encrypt the FIS experiment CloudWatch log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  FisLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/fis-experiment-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FisLogsKey

  FisLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/fis/experiment-template-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FisLogsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 30

  FisExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: Multi-service chaos experiment disrupting subnet network connectivity and pausing DynamoDB global table replication.
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      Tags:
        ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        Environment: chaos-engineering
      Targets:
        Subnets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        DynamoDBGlobalTables:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:global-table
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
      Actions:
        DisruptNetworkConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity
          Description: Disrupt subnet network connectivity for tagged subnets.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ExperimentDuration
            scope: all
          Targets:
            Subnets: Subnets
        PauseDynamoDBReplication:
          ActionId: aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication
          Description: Pause DynamoDB global table replication to the target region.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ExperimentDuration
          Targets:
            Tables: DynamoDBGlobalTables
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 1
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FisLogGroup.Arn

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: The ID of the FIS experiment template.
    Value: !Ref FisExperimentTemplate

  FisRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM role used by FIS.
    Value: !GetAtt FisRole.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: The ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the FIS log group.
    Value: !GetAtt FisLogsKey.Arn

  LogGroupName:
    Description: The name of the CloudWatch log group used for FIS experiment logging.
    Value: !Ref FisLogGroup

  TargetRegion:
    Description: The target region used to identify cross-region replication targets for DynamoDB.
    Value: !Ref TargetRegion

      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGateway1Eip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway2Eip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1Eip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2Eip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC flow logs encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  FlowLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: FlowLogsRole
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
