final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline with custom component, recipe, infrastructure,
  distribution, pipeline, lifecycle policy, and IAM roles. NOTE: AMI image
  scanning (ImageScanningEnabled) is set to false because it requires
  account-level Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning to be enabled out-of-band.
  To enable scanning, activate Inspector EC2 scanning in the account, then
  set ImageScanningEnabled back to true.

Resources:
  # -------------------------
  # Networking
  # -------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-imagebuilder-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-imagebuilder-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public subnet hosting the NAT Gateway
  NatSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-imagebuilder-nat-subnet

  # Private subnet used by Image Builder build instances
  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-imagebuilder-private-subnet

  NatRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-imagebuilder-nat-rt

  NatDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref NatRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref NatSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref NatRouteTable

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref NatSubnet

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-imagebuilder-private-rt

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS within VPC
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTP within VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-imagebuilder-sg

  # -------------------------
  # KMS Key for Flow Logs
  # -------------------------
  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting VPC flow logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  FlowLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/sample-imagebuilder-flowlogs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKey

  # -------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # -------------------------
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: sample-imagebuilder-vpc-flow-logs
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sample-imagebuilder-flowlogs-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsWritePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn

  # -------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # -------------------------
  BuildInfrastructureRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sample-imagebuilder-infrastructure-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: sample-imagebuilder-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInfrastructureRole

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sample-imagebuilder-lifecycle-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  # -------------------------
  # Custom Component
  # -------------------------
  SampleComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Installs and runs Chef Client on Linux using a WebDownload action.
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Data: |
        name: sample-component
        description: Installs and runs Chef Client on Linux using a WebDownload action.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefClient
                action: WebDownload
                inputs:
                  - source: https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh
                    destination: /tmp/install.sh
              - name: InstallChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chmod +x /tmp/install.sh
                    - /tmp/install.sh -P chef-client
              - name: RunChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chef-client --version

  # -------------------------
  # Image Recipe
  # -------------------------
  SampleRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Combines custom component with chrony test component.
      ParentImage: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/x.x.x
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:component/update-linux/x.x.x
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SampleComponent
        - ComponentArn: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:component/chrony-time-configuration-test/x.x.x
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  # -------------------------
  # Infrastructure Configuration
  # -------------------------
  SampleInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-infrastructure-configuration
      Description: Infrastructure configuration for sample pipeline.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref InstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  # -------------------------
  # Distribution Configuration
  # -------------------------
  SampleDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution-configuration
      Description: Distributes AMI to us-east-1.
      Distributions:
        - Region: us-east-1
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: sample-ami-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref AWS::AccountId

  # -------------------------
  # Image Pipeline
  # -------------------------
  SampleImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: sample-image-pipeline
      Description: Daily image pipeline at 9 AM UTC.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref SampleRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleDistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: false
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: cron(0 9 * * ? *)
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      Status: ENABLED

  # -------------------------
  # Lifecycle Policy
  # -------------------------
  SampleLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: sample-lifecycle-policy
      Description: Deprecates AMIs older than 6 months for Environment=Dev.
      Status: ENABLED
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: sample-recipe
            SemanticVersion: 1.0.0
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
            IncludeResources:
              Amis: true
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS
          ExclusionRules:
            TagMap:
              Environment: Dev

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the image pipeline
    Value: !GetAtt SampleImagePipeline.Arn

  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe
    Value: !GetAtt SampleRecipe.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito authentication layer for a Lex chatbot web UI with authenticated and unauthenticated access, IAM roles for Lex V1 or Lex V2, and optional live chat API invoke permission.

Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: identity pool
    Description: Name of the Cognito identity pool.
  LexV1BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: OrderFlowers
    Description: Name of the Lex V1 bot. A non-empty value selects the Lex V1 policy branch.
  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ID of the Lex V2 bot. A non-empty value selects the Lex V2 policy branch.
  LexV2BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Alias ID of the Lex V2 bot.
  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: When true, deny unauthenticated Lex and API actions.
  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: When true, add an execute-api invoke permission for the livechat endpoint.

Conditions:
  UseLexV1: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref LexV1BotName
      - ''
  UseLexV2: !And
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Ref LexV2BotId
        - ''
    - !Equals
      - !Ref LexV1BotName
      - ''
  ForceLogin: !Equals
    - !Ref ForceCognitoLogin
    - 'true'
  EnableLiveChat: !Equals
    - !Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat
    - 'true'

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
          ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient

  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PollySynthesizeSpeech
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - polly:SynthesizeSpeech
                Resource: '*'

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated

  LexV1Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UseLexV1
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LexV1Access
      Roles:
        - !Ref AuthenticatedRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:PostText
              - lex:PostContent
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}'

  LexV2Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UseLexV2
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LexV2Access
      Roles:
        - !Ref AuthenticatedRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:RecognizeText
              - lex:RecognizeUtterance
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV2BotId}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias:${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}'

  LiveChatPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: EnableLiveChat
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LiveChatInvoke
      Roles:
        - !Ref AuthenticatedRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - execute-api:Invoke
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/*/livechat'

  DenyLexAndApiPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: ForceLogin
    Properties:
      PolicyName: DenyLexAndApiWhenForced
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnauthenticatedRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - lex:PostText
              - lex:PostContent
              - lex:RecognizeText
              - lex:RecognizeUtterance
              - execute-api:Invoke
            Resource: '*'

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: Cognito identity pool ID.
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IdentityPoolId'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito user pool client ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId'

  NOTE: CloudFront distributions, ACM certificates, and external verification
  tokens are OUT OF SCOPE for this template and must be supplied as Parameters

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Customer support authentication infrastructure using Amazon Cognito:
  user pool (email sign-in, auto-verified), admin/customer groups,
  web (authorization code) and machine-to-machine (client credentials)
  app clients, resource server with custom "read" scope, hosted UI domain,
  PostConfirmation Lambda that adds new users to the "customer" group,
  and SSM parameters under /app/customersupport/agentcore/.

Parameters:
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Globally unique prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain
      (lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only).
    Default: customersupport-auth
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 63
    ConstraintDescription: >
      Must be 1-63 characters, lowercase alphanumeric or hyphens,
      and must not begin or end with a hyphen.

  WebCallbackUrls:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Allowed callback URLs for the web application client.
    Default: 'https://localhost:3000/callback'

  WebLogoutUrls:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Allowed logout URLs for the web application client.
    Default: 'https://localhost:3000/logout'

  PasswordMinimumLength:
    Type: Number
    Description: Minimum password length for the user pool.
    Default: 12
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 99

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: customersupport-user-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: !Ref PasswordMinimumLength
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User Groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrator group with higher precedence.
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Customer group with lower precedence.
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resource Server with custom "read" scope
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: customersupport-api
      Name: Customer Support API
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to customer support resources

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web application client (authorization code grant)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ClientName: customersupport-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub '${ResourceServer}/read'
      CallbackURLs: !Ref WebCallbackUrls
      LogoutURLs: !Ref WebLogoutUrls
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Machine-to-machine client (client credentials grant)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ClientName: customersupport-m2m-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${ResourceServer}/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted UI domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PostConfirmation Lambda: add new sign-ups to "customer" group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PostConfirmationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostConfirmationLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: customersupport-post-confirmation
      Description: Adds newly confirmed users to the customer group.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunctionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
          CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME: !Ref CustomerGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import logging
          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = os.environ['USER_POOL_ID']
              group_name = os.environ['CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME']
              username = event.get('userName')
              if not username:
                  logger.error('No userName found in event: %s', event)
                  return event
              try:
                  client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      GroupName=group_name,
                  )
                  logger.info('Added user %s to group %s', username, group_name)
              except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                  logger.error(
                      'Failed to add user %s to group %s: %s',
                      username, group_name, exc,
                  )
                  raise
              return event

  PostConfirmationPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref PostConfirmationFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameters under /app/customersupport/agentcore/
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/web-client-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Description: Cognito web application client ID.

  MachineClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/m2m-client-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineClient
      Description: Cognito machine-to-machine client ID.

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito user pool ID.

  OAuthScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/oauth-scope
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${ResourceServer}/read'
      Description: Custom OAuth read scope identifier.

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/discovery-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OIDC discovery URL for the user pool.

  TokenEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/token-endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: OAuth token endpoint for the hosted UI domain.

  AuthorizeEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/authorize-endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Description: OAuth authorize endpoint for the hosted UI domain.

  DomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito hosted UI domain.

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  WebClientId:
    Description: Web application client ID.
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient

  MachineClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine client ID.
    Value: !Ref MachineClient

  OAuthScope:
    Description: Custom OAuth read scope.
    Value: !Sub '${ResourceServer}/read'

  HostedUiDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI domain.
    Value: !Sub '${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OIDC discovery URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC spanning two Availability Zones with public/private subnets, Internet Gateway, and per-AZ NAT Gateways.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - staging
      - development
    Description: Environment name used for tagging resources.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.10.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-primary-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcFlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt VPC flow log data in CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-vpc-flow-log-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcFlowLogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${Environment}-vpc-flow-log'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref VpcFlowLogKey

  VpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-vpc-flow-log-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-vpc-flow-log-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref VpcFlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.10.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.10.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.10.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.10.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-nat-gateway-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # All DNS records in a single atomic RecordSetGroup
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AllDnsRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      RecordSets:
        # Apex Google Workspace records
        - Name: prxu.org
          Type: TXT
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'
        - Name: prxu.org
          Type: MX
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - '1 smtp.google.com.'
        # CDN A/AAAA alias records
        - Name: dovetail-cdn.prxu.org
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt DovetailCdnDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: dovetail-cdn.prxu.org
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt DovetailCdnDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: dovetail-cdn-staging.prxu.org
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt DovetailCdnStagingDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: dovetail-cdn-staging.prxu.org
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt DovetailCdnStagingDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: f.prxu.org
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt FeederCdnDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: f.prxu.org
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt FeederCdnDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: f-staging.prxu.org
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt FeederStagingCdnDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: f-staging.prxu.org
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt FeederStagingCdnDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: f.development.prxu.org
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt FeederDevelopmentCdnDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: f.development.prxu.org
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt FeederDevelopmentCdnDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: a.prxu.org
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt AdFilesCdnDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: a.prxu.org
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt AdFilesCdnDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: ryan-cdn.prxu.org
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt RyanCdnDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        - Name: ryan-cdn.prxu.org
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt RyanCdnDistribution.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        # Legacy CNAME records
        - Name: legacy.dovetail-cdn.prxu.org
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '3600'
          ResourceRecords:
            - dovetail-cdn.prxu.org
        - Name: legacy.dovetail-cdn-staging.prxu.org
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '3600'
          ResourceRecords:
            - dovetail-cdn-staging.prxu.org
        # Authenticated feed proxy CNAME records

          TTL: '3600'
          ResourceRecords:

        - Name: feed-staging.prxu.org
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '3600'
          ResourceRecords:

          TTL: '30'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Simple learning VPC setup with optional internet gateway, public subnet, route table, and security group.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: SimpleApp1
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]{0,20}$'
    Description: Prefix used to name and tag all resources.
  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create an internet gateway.
  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a public subnet.
  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a route table.
  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a security group.
  AllowedHttpSourceCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    Description: CIDR range allowed to access HTTP and HTTPS.

Conditions:
  CreateIgw: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, 'true']
  CreateSubnet: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, 'true']
  CreateRouteTable: !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, 'true']
  CreateSecurityGroup: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityGroup, 'true']
  CreateRoute: !And
    - !Condition CreateIgw
    - !Condition CreateRouteTable
  CreateSubnetRouteTableAssociation: !And
    - !Condition CreateSubnet
    - !Condition CreateRouteTable

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateIgw
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-igw'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}'

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateIgw
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateSubnet
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateRouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-route-table'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}'

  InternetRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateRoute
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateSubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub '${NamePrefix} security group allowing HTTP and HTTPS'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}'

  SecurityGroupIngressHttp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: CreateSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt SecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 80
      ToPort: 80
      CidrIp: !Ref AllowedHttpSourceCidr
      Description: !Sub '${NamePrefix} allow HTTP from ${AllowedHttpSourceCidr}'

  SecurityGroupIngressHttps:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: CreateSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt SecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: !Ref AllowedHttpSourceCidr
      Description: !Sub '${NamePrefix} allow HTTPS from ${AllowedHttpSourceCidr}'

  VpcFlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${NamePrefix} CMK for VPC flow log encryption'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Landing zone hub VPC for multi-account spoke attachment with Transit Gateway, NAT gateways, VPC flow logs, and interface/gateway VPC endpoints.

Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Environment name prefix used to name and tag all resources.

Resources:
  HubVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-hub-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-hub-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-nat-gw-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-nat-gw-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  PrivateSubnet1NatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet2NatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Options:
        DnsSupport: enable
        Ipv6Support: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-tgw-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  PrivateSubnet1TgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSubnet2TgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${EnvName} VPC flow logs encryption key'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-flow-logs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn: FlowLogsKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-flow-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvName}-flow-logs-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: FlowLogsRole
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref HubVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints allowing HTTPS from within the VPC.
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow HTTPS from within the VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow all egress within the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    DependsOn:
      - HubVpc
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-vpce-ssm'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    DependsOn:
      - HubVpc
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-vpce-ec2messages'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    DependsOn:
      - HubVpc
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-vpce-ssmmessages'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    DependsOn:
      - HubVpc
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-vpce-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvName}-vpce-s3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone-hub

  SsmInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained Student Services agent infrastructure for AWS Bedrock AgentCore with per-domain Cognito user pools and least-privilege IAM execution roles.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared base IAM managed policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudentServicesBasePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: student-services-agentcore-base-policy
      Description: Base policy for Student Services AgentCore execution roles (Bedrock, Logs, Metrics, X-Ray, SSM).
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # StudentServicesAgent orchestrator execution role (IAM inbound auth, no Cognito)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # StudentServicesGateway Cognito (no execution role)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudentServicesGatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'student-services-gateway-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool

  StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: student-services-gateway
      Name: StudentServicesGateway
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: gateway.access
          ScopeDescription: Access scope for the Student Services Gateway

  StudentServicesGatewayAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: StudentServicesGatewayClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - student-services-gateway/gateway.access
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
    DependsOn: StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CourseRegistration domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CourseRegistrationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CourseRegistrationExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess'

  CourseRegistrationUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: CourseRegistrationUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false

  CourseRegistrationUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'course-registration-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool

  CourseRegistrationResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: course-registration
      Name: CourseRegistration
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: registration.access
          ScopeDescription: Access scope for Course Registration

  CourseRegistrationAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: CourseRegistrationClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - course-registration/registration.access
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
    DependsOn: CourseRegistrationResourceServer

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CourseCatalog domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CourseCatalogExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CourseCatalogExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CourseCatalogKnowledgeBaseRetrieve
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BedrockRetrieve
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:Retrieve
                Resource: '*'

  CourseCatalogUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: CourseCatalogUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false

  CourseCatalogUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'course-catalog-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool

  CourseCatalogResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: course-catalog
      Name: CourseCatalog
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: catalog.access
          ScopeDescription: Access scope for Course Catalog

  CourseCatalogAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: CourseCatalogClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - course-catalog/catalog.access
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
    DependsOn: CourseCatalogResourceServer

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CourseReview domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CourseReviewExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CourseReviewExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBReadOnlyAccess'

  CourseReviewUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: CourseReviewUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false

  CourseReviewUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain

      AllowedOAuthFlows:

      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - course-review/review.access
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
    DependsOn: CourseReviewResourceServer

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LoanApplication domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LoanApplicationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: LoanApplicationExecutionRole

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LoanApplicationSageMakerInvoke
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerInvokeEndpoint
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                Resource: '*'

  LoanApplicationUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: LoanApplicationUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false

      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:

      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - loan-application/loan.access
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
    DependsOn: LoanApplicationResourceServer
