final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CoWork (Claude Desktop) telemetry monitoring. Creates a CloudWatch Logs log group
  to receive CoWork events, metric filters that extract token usage, cache tokens,
  estimated cost and session turn counts from both CoWork event schemas
  (local agent mode and Claude Code for Desktop), and a CloudWatch dashboard
  visualizing usage, cost, per-user breakdowns and recent raw events.

Parameters:
  LogGroupNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: cowork-telemetry
    Description: Prefix used to derive the CloudWatch Logs log group name.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._/#-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 200

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period (in days) for the CoWork telemetry log group.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653

  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: CoWork-Telemetry
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch dashboard to create.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255

  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Region in which the CoWork metrics are published and displayed.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    MinLength: 9
    MaxLength: 20

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: CoWork/Telemetry
    Description: CloudWatch namespace under which CoWork metrics are emitted.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._/#:-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the CoWork telemetry log group.
  # Retained on delete/replace so telemetry data remains decryptable.
  # The key policy intentionally does NOT reference the log group ARN, which
  # would create a circular dependency with the log group's KmsKeyId.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CoWorkLogGroupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt the CoWork telemetry CloudWatch Logs log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'

  CoWorkLogGroupKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${LogGroupNamePrefix}-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CoWorkLogGroupKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Log group receiving CoWork telemetry events.
  # Encrypted with the CMK above; retained on delete/replace to protect data.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CoWorkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${LogGroupNamePrefix}-events'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CoWorkLogGroupKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Schema A: local agent mode events.
  # These filters extract metrics from the local agent mode event schema.
  # Dimension-less filters carry DefaultValue: 0 so unmatched events populate
  # zero rather than being dropped.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InputTokensFilterLocalAgent:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "usage" && $.mode = "local_agent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: '$.input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  OutputTokensFilterLocalAgent:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "usage" && $.mode = "local_agent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: '$.output_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  CacheReadTokensFilterLocalAgent:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "usage" && $.mode = "local_agent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: '$.cache_read_input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  CacheCreationTokensFilterLocalAgent:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "usage" && $.mode = "local_agent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: '$.cache_creation_input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  EstimatedCostFilterLocalAgent:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "usage" && $.mode = "local_agent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: EstimatedCost
          MetricValue: '$.estimated_cost_usd'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: None

  SessionTurnsFilterLocalAgent:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "session_turn" && $.mode = "local_agent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: SessionTurns
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Schema B: Claude Code for Desktop events.
  # These filters map the alternate schema onto the SAME metric names so the
  # dashboard aggregates across both modes. Dimension-less filters carry
  # DefaultValue: 0 so unmatched events populate zero rather than being dropped.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InputTokensFilterDesktop:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.type = "assistant" && $.source = "claude_code_desktop" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: '$.message.usage.input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  OutputTokensFilterDesktop:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.type = "assistant" && $.source = "claude_code_desktop" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: '$.message.usage.output_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  CacheReadTokensFilterDesktop:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.type = "assistant" && $.source = "claude_code_desktop" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: '$.message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  CacheCreationTokensFilterDesktop:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.type = "assistant" && $.source = "claude_code_desktop" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: '$.message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  EstimatedCostFilterDesktop:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.type = "assistant" && $.source = "claude_code_desktop" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: EstimatedCost
          MetricValue: '$.cost_usd'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: None

  SessionTurnsFilterDesktop:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.type = "result" && $.source = "claude_code_desktop" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: SessionTurns
          MetricValue: '$.num_turns'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dimensioned filters (per-user / per-model attribution).
  # NOTE: CloudWatch Logs rejects a MetricTransformation that specifies BOTH
  # Dimensions and DefaultValue ("dimensions and default value are mutually
  # exclusive properties"). Therefore these dimensioned filters intentionally
  # omit DefaultValue and emit only when a user/model value is present.
  # Zero-fill behavior for unmatched events is provided by the dimension-less
  # aggregate filters above, which carry DefaultValue: 0.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InputTokensByUserFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "usage" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: InputTokensByUser
          MetricValue: '$.input_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user'

  OutputTokensByUserFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "usage" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: OutputTokensByUser
          MetricValue: '$.output_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user'

  EstimatedCostByUserFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "usage" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: EstimatedCostByUser
          MetricValue: '$.estimated_cost_usd'
          Unit: None
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user'

  SessionTurnsByUserFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "session_turn" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: SessionTurnsByUser
          MetricValue: '1'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user'

  InputTokensByModelFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "usage" && $.model = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: InputTokensByModel
          MetricValue: '$.input_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.model'

  OutputTokensByModelFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "usage" && $.model = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: OutputTokensByModel
          MetricValue: '$.output_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.model'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch dashboard.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CoWorkDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "widgets": [
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 8, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Total Token Usage",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "stacked": false,
                  "period": 300,
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "InputTokens", { "label": "Input Tokens" } ],
                    [ ".", "OutputTokens", { "label": "Output Tokens" } ],
                    [ ".", "CacheReadTokens", { "label": "Cache Read Tokens" } ],
                    [ ".", "CacheCreationTokens", { "label": "Cache Creation Tokens" } ]

              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 8, "y": 0, "width": 8, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Total Estimated Cost (USD)",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "period": 300,
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EstimatedCost", { "label": "Estimated Cost" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 16, "y": 0, "width": 8, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Session Turn Counts",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "period": 300,
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "SessionTurns", { "label": "Session Turns" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0, "y": 6, "width": 8, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Cache Hit Tokens",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "period": 300,
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "CacheReadTokens", { "label": "Cache Read (Hits)" } ],
                    [ ".", "CacheCreationTokens", { "label": "Cache Creation" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 8, "y": 6, "width": 8, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Usage Trend Over Time",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "period": 3600,
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "InputTokens", { "label": "Input Tokens" } ],
                    [ ".", "OutputTokens", { "label": "Output Tokens" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 16, "y": 6, "width": 8, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Cost Trend Over Time",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "period": 3600,
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EstimatedCost", { "label": "Estimated Cost" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0, "y": 12, "width": 8, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Average Cost per Turn",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ { "expression": "SUM([${MetricNamespace},EstimatedCost]) / SUM([${MetricNamespace},SessionTurns])", "label": "Avg Cost per Turn", "id": "avgCostPerTurn" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 8, "y": 12, "width": 8, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Active User Count",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    [ { "expression": "COUNT([${MetricNamespace},InputTokensByUser])", "label": "Active Users", "id": "activeUsers" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 16, "y": 12, "width": 8, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Per-User Token Usage",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "period": 300,
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "InputTokensByUser", "User", "user1", { "label": "user1 Input" } ],
                    [ ".", "OutputTokensByUser", ".", ".", { "label": "user1 Output" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0, "y": 18, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Per-User Cost",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "period": 300,
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EstimatedCostByUser", "User", "user1", { "label": "user1 Cost" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12, "y": 18, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Per-User Session Activity",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "period": 300,
                  "stat": "Sum",
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "${MetricNamespace}", "SessionTurnsByUser", "User", "user1", { "label": "user1 Turns" } ]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 0, "y": 24, "width": 24, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Recent Raw CoWork Events",
                  "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                  "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, @message | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50",
                  "view": "table"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        - LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
          MetricsRegion: !Ref MetricsRegion
          MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace

  LogGroupKmsKeyArn:

    Value: !Ref MetricsRegion

  MetricNamespace:
    Description: CloudWatch namespace used for CoWork metrics.
    Value: !Ref MetricNamespace

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS CDK bootstrap environment. Creates an encrypted S3 asset
  bucket, a KMS key and alias, the standard set of CDK bootstrap IAM roles,
  and an SSM parameter tracking the bootstrap version. All resources are
  qualified so multiple bootstrap stacks can coexist in the same account and
  region. The ECR container asset repository is created by CDK on first
  deploy rather than by this template.

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    MinLength: 4
    MaxLength: 10
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]{4,10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 4-10 lowercase alphanumeric characters.
    Description: >-
      Short qualifier used to uniquely identify the bootstrap stack components
      within the same AWS account and region.

  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '21'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]+$'
    Description: >-
      The CDK bootstrap version string stored in SSM and used to identify the
      stack.

  AssetBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional custom name for the CDK file asset bucket. When empty, the name
      is auto-generated by CloudFormation.

  KmsKeyAliasName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional custom KMS alias name (without the alias/ prefix). When empty,
      defaults to cdk-<qualifier>-assets.

  ExistingKmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of an existing KMS key to use for asset bucket encryption.
      When supplied, the template does not create a new key or alias.

  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional comma-delimited list of additional AWS account IDs trusted to
      assume the deployment and lookup roles. The deploying account is always
      trusted.

  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'
    Description: >-
      Comma-delimited list of managed policy ARNs attached to the
      CloudFormation execution role.

Conditions:
  CreateNewKmsKey: !Equals [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyArn, '']
  UseCustomBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AssetBucketName, '']]
  UseCustomAliasName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyAliasName, '']]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref TrustedAccounts], '']]

Resources:
  AssetBucketLogs:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  AssetBucketLogsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AssetBucketLogs
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AssetBucketLogs}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AssetBucketLogs}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AssetBucketLogs}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AssetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - UseCustomBucketName
        - !Ref AssetBucketName
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - CreateNewKmsKey
                - !Ref AssetKmsKey
                - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyArn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AssetBucketLogs
        LogFilePrefix: 'access-logs/'

  AssetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AssetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AssetBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AssetBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AssetKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateNewKmsKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CDK bootstrap asset encryption key (${Qualifier})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEcrServiceUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecr.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  AssetKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateNewKmsKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !If
        - UseCustomAliasName
        - !Sub 'alias/${KmsKeyAliasName}'
        - !Sub 'alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-assets'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AssetKmsKey

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt DeploymentRole.Arn
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FilePublishingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AssetBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AssetBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: AssetKeyAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !If
                    - CreateNewKmsKey
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*'
                    - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyArn

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt DeploymentRole.Arn
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImagePublishingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrPublishAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*'
              - Sid: EcrAuthToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt DeploymentRole.Arn
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LookupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AssumeReadonlyAndDeployRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-readonly-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-*'

  DeploymentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeploymentPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AssumeCfnExecRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-*'
              - Sid: PassBootstrapRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CfnExecAssetAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AssetBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Elastic Beanstalk blue-green deployment template. Creates (or references) an application and blue environment, optionally creates a temporary green environment for CNAME swap, and optionally deploys a sample application bundle. Provisions the required IAM roles and VPC networking in-template for greenfield accounts.

Parameters:
  DeploymentMode:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateNewResources
    AllowedValues:
      - CreateNewResources
      - UseExisting
    Description: Create a new Elastic Beanstalk application and blue environment, or reference existing ones.

  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: bluegreen-app
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 100
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$'
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application to create or reference.

  BlueEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: bluegreen-blue
    MinLength: 4
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$'
    Description: Name of the blue Elastic Beanstalk environment to create or reference.

  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: bluegreen-green
    MinLength: 4
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$'
    Description: Name of the temporary green Elastic Beanstalk environment.

  PlatformArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:elasticbeanstalk:us-east-1::platform/Python 3.12 running on 64bit Amazon Linux 2023
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512
    Description: Elastic Beanstalk platform branch ARN (AWS-owned, region-explicit, no version suffix so EB resolves the latest version). Both environments use the same value. Override with the platform branch ARN for your target region.

  DeploySampleBundle:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create an ApplicationVersion from an S3 bundle and deploy it. When false, environments launch with the platform's built-in sample application (no S3 download required).

  SourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: elasticbeanstalk-samples
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    Description: Only used when DeploySampleBundle is 'true'. S3 bucket containing the application bundle. When the default bucket is used, the current region is appended to the bucket name. The object must be publicly readable, or upload your bundle to the stack-owned SampleBundleBucket and set this to that bucket name.

  SourceKey:
    Type: String
    Default: python-v1.zip
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 1024
    Description: Only used when DeploySampleBundle is 'true'. S3 object key of the application bundle. Must match the selected platform and be publicly readable (or uploaded to the stack-owned bucket).

  CreateGreenEnvironment:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create a temporary green environment for the CNAME swap.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC created for the Elastic Beanstalk environments.

  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet created for the Elastic Beanstalk environments.

Conditions:
  CreateNewResources: !Equals [!Ref DeploymentMode, CreateNewResources]
  CreateGreen: !Equals [!Ref CreateGreenEnvironment, 'true']
  DeployBundle: !Equals [!Ref DeploySampleBundle, 'true']
  UseDefaultBucket: !Equals [!Ref SourceBucket, elasticbeanstalk-samples]

Resources:
  Application:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Condition: CreateNewResources
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Elastic Beanstalk application for blue-green deployments.

  EBInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkMulticontainerDocker'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWorkerTier'

  EBInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EBInstanceRole

  EBServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkEnhancedHealth'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EBManagedUpdatesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticbeanstalk:CreateApplicationVersion
                  - elasticbeanstalk:UpdateEnvironment
                  - elasticbeanstalk:DescribeEvents
                  - elasticbeanstalk:DescribeEnvironments
                  - elasticbeanstalk:DescribeConfigurationSettings
                  - elasticbeanstalk:DescribeConfigurationOptions
                  - elasticbeanstalk:DescribePlatformVersion
                  - elasticbeanstalk:ListPlatformVersions
                  - elasticbeanstalk:ListAvailableSolutionStacks
                  - elasticbeanstalk:ValidateConfigurationSettings
                Resource: '*'

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-public-subnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Elastic Beanstalk environment instances.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow HTTP traffic from anywhere
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-instance-sg'

  VpcFlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the VPC flow log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  VpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogKey.Arn

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn

  SampleBundleBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: DeployBundle
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the Elastic Beanstalk sample bundle bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  SampleBundleLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: DeployBundle
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  SampleBundleLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: DeployBundle
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref SampleBundleLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${SampleBundleLogBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${SampleBundleBucket}'

  SampleBundleBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: DeployBundle
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt SampleBundleBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref SampleBundleLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: sample-bundle-access/
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  ApplicationVersion:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Condition: DeployBundle
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - CreateNewResources
        - !Ref Application
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Application bundle for blue-green deployments.
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If
          - UseDefaultBucket
          - !Sub '${SourceBucket}-${AWS::Region}'
          - !Ref SourceBucket
        S3Key: !Ref SourceKey

  BlueEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: CreateNewResources
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref Application
      EnvironmentName: !Ref BlueEnvironmentName
      PlatformArn: !Ref PlatformArn
      VersionLabel: !If
        - DeployBundle
        - !Ref ApplicationVersion
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tier:
        Name: WebServer
        Type: Standard
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EBInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: SecurityGroups
          Value: !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !GetAtt EBServiceRole.Arn
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

  GreenEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: CreateGreen
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - CreateNewResources
        - !Ref Application
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref GreenEnvironmentName
      PlatformArn: !Ref PlatformArn
      VersionLabel: !If
        - DeployBundle
        - !Ref ApplicationVersion
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tier:
        Name: WebServer
        Type: Standard
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EBInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: SecurityGroups
          Value: !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !GetAtt EBServiceRole.Arn
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

Outputs:
  ApplicationName:
    Description: Elastic Beanstalk application name.
    Value: !If
      - CreateNewResources
      - !Ref Application
      - !Ref ApplicationName

  BlueEnvironmentName:
    Description: Blue Elastic Beanstalk environment name.
    Value: !If
      - CreateNewResources
      - !Ref BlueEnvironment
      - !Ref BlueEnvironmentName

  BlueEnvironmentEndpoint:
    Description: Blue environment CNAME endpoint.
    Value: !If
      - CreateNewResources
      - !GetAtt BlueEnvironment.EndpointURL
      - 'Not created by this stack (UseExisting mode)'

  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Description: Temporary green Elastic Beanstalk environment name (when created).
    Value: !If
      - CreateGreen
      - !Ref GreenEnvironment
      - 'Green environment not requested'

  GreenEnvironmentEndpoint:
    Description: Green environment CNAME endpoint (when created).
    Value: !If
      - CreateGreen
      - !GetAtt GreenEnvironment.EndpointURL
      - 'Green environment not requested'

  ApplicationVersionLabel:
    Description: Application version label deployed to the environments.
    Value: !If
      - DeployBundle
      - !Ref ApplicationVersion
      - 'No sample bundle deployed'

  SampleBundleBucketName:
    Description: Stack-owned S3 bucket for uploading your application bundle (when DeploySampleBundle is true).
    Value: !If
      - DeployBundle
      - !Ref SampleBundleBucket
      - 'No sample bundle bucket created'

  SampleBundleBucketKeyArn:
    Description: Customer managed KMS key ARN used to encrypt the sample bundle bucket (when DeploySampleBundle is true).
    Value: !If
      - DeployBundle
      - !GetAtt SampleBundleBucketKey.Arn
      - 'No sample bundle bucket key created'

  VpcId:
    Description: VPC created for the Elastic Beanstalk environments.
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: Public subnet created for the Elastic Beanstalk environments.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

  SwapInstructions:
    Description: Use the Elastic Beanstalk SwapEnvironmentCNAMEs API to route traffic between blue and green environments.
    Value: !Sub 'aws elasticbeanstalk swap-environment-cnames --source-environment-name ${BlueEnvironmentName} --destination-environment-name ${GreenEnvironmentName}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AWS Service Catalog environment for a machine learning workshop with admin and end-user portfolios, products, launch roles, end-user roles, and switch-role outputs.

Parameters:
  RootS3URL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    Description: Root S3 URL pointing to the location of the nested CloudFormation templates.
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: user-1
    Description: Prefix used to namespace resource names.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Portfolios
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-Admin'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshop
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} ML Workshop admin portfolio for the admin team.'

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-EndUser'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshop
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} ML Workshop end-user portfolio for workshop participants.'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Launch roles (one per product)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-VpcLaunchRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateVpc
                  - ec2:DeleteVpc
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateSubnet
                  - ec2:DeleteSubnet
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateRouteTable
                  - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
                  - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
                  - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
                  - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:CreateNatGateway
                  - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
                  - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
                  - ec2:AllocateAddress
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
                  - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoints
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpoints
                  - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpointServices
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: '*'

  IamKmsS3LaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-IamKmsS3LaunchRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: IamKmsS3ProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:CreatePolicy
                  - iam:DeletePolicy
                  - iam:GetPolicy
                  - iam:GetPolicyVersion
                  - iam:CreateInstanceProfile
                  - iam:DeleteInstanceProfile
                  - iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile
                  - iam:RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile
                  - iam:GetInstanceProfile
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:CreateKey
                  - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:CreateAlias
                  - kms:DeleteAlias
                  - kms:UpdateAlias
                  - kms:ListAliases
                  - kms:EnableKeyRotation
                  - kms:PutKeyPolicy
                  - kms:GetKeyPolicy
                  - kms:TagResource
                  - kms:UntagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: '*'

  DataExchangeLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-DataExchangeLaunchRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataExchangeProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dataexchange:GetDataSet
                  - dataexchange:ListDataSets
                  - dataexchange:ListDataSetRevisions
                  - dataexchange:GetRevision
                  - dataexchange:CreateJob
                  - dataexchange:StartJob
                  - dataexchange:GetJob
                  - dataexchange:ListJobs
                  - dataexchange:SendApiAsset
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: '*'

  InfrastructureLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-InfrastructureLaunchRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InfrastructureProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: '*'

  ApplicationLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-ApplicationLaunchRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApplicationProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - lambda:CreateFunction
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionCode
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:AddPermission
                  - lambda:RemovePermission
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: '*'

  SageMakerLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-SageMakerLaunchRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:DeleteNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:DescribeNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:UpdateNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:CreateNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags
                  - sagemaker:ListTags
                  - sagemaker:CreatePresignedNotebookInstanceUrl
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: '*'

  ThirdPartyModelLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-ThirdPartyModelLaunchRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ThirdPartyModelProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags
                  - sagemaker:ListTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dataexchange:GetDataSet
                  - dataexchange:ListDataSets
                  - dataexchange:ListDataSetRevisions
                  - dataexchange:GetRevision
                  - dataexchange:CreateJob
                  - dataexchange:StartJob
                  - dataexchange:GetJob
                  - dataexchange:ListJobs
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Products
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-VPC-PrivateSubnets-Endpoints'
      Description: VPC with private subnets and VPC endpoints for the ML workshop.
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1'
          Description: VPC with private subnets and endpoints.
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  IamKmsS3Product:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-IAM-KMS-S3'
      Description: IAM roles with KMS keys and S3 buckets for the ML workshop.
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1'
          Description: IAM roles, KMS keys, and S3 buckets.
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-DataExchange'
      Description: AWS Data Exchange product for the ML workshop.
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1'
          Description: AWS Data Exchange data set provisioning.
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-Infrastructure'

      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1'
          Description: Workshop infrastructure.
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-Application'
      Description: Application product for the ML workshop.
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1'
          Description: Workshop application.
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  SageMakerNotebookProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-SageMakerNotebook'
      Description: SageMaker notebook instance product for the ML workshop.
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1'
          Description: SageMaker notebook instance.
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  ThirdPartyModelProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-ThirdPartyModel'
      Description: Third-party ML model product for the ML workshop.
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-v1'
          Description: Third-party ML model.
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Launch role constraints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VpcProduct

  IamKmsS3LaunchConstraint:

  AdminDataExchangeAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio

  AdminInfrastructureAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio

  EndUserSageMakerAssociation:

  EndUserThirdPartyModelAssociation:

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-AdminLeadEndUser'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminLeadEndUserPolicy

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

              - Effect: Allow

                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ExistingObjectTag/provisioning: 'true'

        Statement:

            Principal:

        Statement:

            Principal:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${Environment}-vpc-flow-logs-policy'

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-vpc-flow-logs-role'

      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
