AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained serverless Movies API (DynamoDB + Lambda + API Gateway)

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name used for the API Gateway stage.

Resources:
  MoviesKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for Movies API data and logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDB
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  MoviesKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/movies-api-${Environment}
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MoviesKey

  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt MoviesKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCrudPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: XRayTracingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource:
                  - '*'

  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${CreateMovieFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 1
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt MoviesKey.Arn

  ReadMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${ReadMovieFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 1
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt MoviesKey.Arn

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${UpdateMovieFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 1
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt MoviesKey.Arn

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${DeleteMovieFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 1
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt MoviesKey.Arn

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/apigateway/movies-api-${Environment}-access
      RetentionInDays: 1
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt MoviesKey.Arn

  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-create-${Environment}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  title = body.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'message': 'title is required'})
                      }
                  item = {
                      'title': title,
                      'year': body.get('year'),
                      'genre': body.get('genre')
                  }
                  table.put_item(Item=item)
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 201,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps(item)
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': str(e)})
                  }

  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-read-${Environment}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  path_params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
                  title = path_params.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'message': 'title is required'})
                      }
                  response = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
                  item = response.get('Item')
                  if not item:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 404,
                          'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie not found'})
                      }
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps(item)
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': str(e)})
                  }

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-update-${Environment}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  title = body.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'message': 'title is required'})
                      }
                  item = {
                      'title': title,
                      'year': body.get('year'),
                      'genre': body.get('genre')
                  }
                  table.put_item(Item=item)
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps(item)
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': str(e)})
                  }

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-delete-${Environment}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  title = body.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      path_params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
                      title = path_params.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'message': 'title is required'})
                      }
                  table.delete_item(Key={'title': title})
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie deleted', 'title': title})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': str(e)})
                  }

  MoviesApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub movies-api-${Environment}
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  MoviesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MoviesApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: Movies

  MovieTitleResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !Ref MoviesResource
      PathPart: '{title}'

  MoviesPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations

  MoviesPutMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: PUT
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UpdateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations

  MoviesDeleteMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DeleteMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations

  MovieTitleGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MovieTitleResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.title: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ReadMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations

  MoviesOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true

  MovieTitleOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MovieTitleResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true

  CreateMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateMovieFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/POST/Movies

  ReadMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ReadMovieFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/GET/Movies/*

  UpdateMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref UpdateMovieFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/PUT/Movies

  DeleteMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref DeleteMovieFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/DELETE/Movies

  MoviesApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MoviesPostMethod
      - MoviesPutMethod
      - MoviesDeleteMethod
      - MovieTitleGetMethod
      - MoviesOptionsMethod
      - MovieTitleOptionsMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      Description: !Sub Deployment for ${Environment}

  MoviesApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref MoviesApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref Environment
      TracingEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: >-
          {"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol","responseLength":"$context.responseLength"}

  MoviesApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub movies-api-key-${Environment}
      Enabled: true
      StageKeys:
        - RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
          StageName: !Ref MoviesApiStage

  MoviesUsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    Properties:
      UsagePlanName: !Sub movies-api-usage-plan-${Environment}
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
          Stage: !Ref MoviesApiStage

  MoviesUsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref MoviesApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref MoviesUsagePlan

Outputs:
  ApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Base invoke URL for the deployed API stage
    Value: !Sub https://${MoviesApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${Environment}

  RestApiId:
    Description: REST API ID
    Value: !Ref MoviesApi

  MoviesTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref MoviesTable

  LambdaExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: Shared Lambda execution role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

  ApiKeyId:
    Description: API key ID required to invoke the API
    Value: !Ref MoviesApiKey

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: Customer-managed KMS key ARN
    Value: !GetAtt MoviesKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Provisions a SageMaker Studio user profile for an MLOps engineer persona with a
  scoped IAM execution role. Optionally attaches to an existing SageMaker Studio
  domain, or creates a self-contained VPC, subnet, and public-internet-access
  domain when no domain ID is supplied.

Parameters:
  ExistingDomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      Optional. ID of an existing SageMaker Studio domain to attach the user
      profile to. When empty, the template creates its own VPC, subnet, and domain.

  ExistingSecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'sg-00000000000000000'
    Description: >
      Optional. Security group IDs associated with the existing domain. Required
      only when ExistingDomainId is supplied.

  ExistingSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'subnet-00000000000000000'
    Description: >
      Optional. Subnet IDs associated with the existing domain. Required only
      when ExistingDomainId is supplied.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC created when no existing domain is supplied.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the subnet created when no existing domain is supplied.

  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Studio user profile for the MLOps engineer.

Conditions:
  CreateDomain: !Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainId, '']
  UseExistingDomain: !Not [!Condition CreateDomain]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Self-contained networking (only created when no existing domain is supplied)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudioVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateDomain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-vpc'

  StudioSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-subnet'

  StudioInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-igw'

  StudioVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref StudioInternetGateway

  StudioRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-rt'

  StudioDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateDomain
    DependsOn: StudioVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref StudioInternetGateway

  StudioSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref StudioSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable

  StudioSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Studio domain
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-sg'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs (only when the template creates its own VPC)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudioFlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateDomain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt VPC flow logs for the SageMaker Studio VPC.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:RetireGrant
            Resource: '*'

  StudioVpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: CreateDomain
    DependsOn: StudioFlowLogKmsKey
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/${AWS::StackName}-studio-flowlogs'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt StudioFlowLogKmsKey.Arn

  StudioVpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt StudioVpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${StudioVpcFlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: UseFlowLogKmsKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt StudioFlowLogKmsKey.Arn

  StudioVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: CreateDomain
    DependsOn: StudioVpcFlowLogGroup
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref StudioVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt StudioVpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt StudioVpcFlowLogRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM execution role for the MLOps engineer persona
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MLOpsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-execution-role'
      Description: Execution role for the MLOps engineer SageMaker Studio user profile.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsPassRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassSageMakerExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${AWS::StackName}-mlops-execution-role'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
        - PolicyName: MLOpsPipelinesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManagePipelines
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DeletePipeline
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineParametersForExecution
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: MLOpsMonitoringPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageMonitoringSchedules
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringExecutions
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageProcessingJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: MLOpsModelRegistryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageModelsAndPackageGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: MLOpsExperimentsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ViewExperimentsTrialsLineage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
                  - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListAssociations
                  - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
                  - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
                  - sagemaker:ListContexts
                  - sagemaker:DescribeContext
                  - sagemaker:ListActions
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAction
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: MLOpsJobsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RunTrainingTransformProcessingTuningJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: MLOpsEndpointsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageEndpoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: MLOpsStudioAppsSpacesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageOwnedAppsAndSpaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/sagemaker:user-profile-owner: !Ref UserProfileName
              - Sid: DescribeDomainAndUserProfile
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
                  - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
                  - sagemaker:ListUserProfiles
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Self-contained SageMaker Studio domain (only when no existing domain)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudioDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Condition: CreateDomain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-domain'
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref StudioSubnet
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups:
          - !GetAtt StudioSecurityGroup.GroupId

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # MLOps engineer user profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If
        - CreateDomain
        - !GetAtt StudioDomain.DomainId
        - !Ref ExistingDomainId
      UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !If
          - CreateDomain
          - - !GetAtt StudioSecurityGroup.GroupId
          - !Ref ExistingSecurityGroupIds

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the created SageMaker Studio user profile.
    Value: !GetAtt UserProfile.UserProfileArn

  UserProfileName:
    Description: Name of the created SageMaker Studio user profile.
    Value: !Ref UserProfile

  ExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the MLOps engineer execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn

  DomainId:
    Description: ID of the SageMaker Studio domain the user profile is attached to.
    Value: !If
      - CreateDomain
      - !GetAtt StudioDomain.DomainId
      - !Ref ExistingDomainId

  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC (empty when an existing domain is used).
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Value: !Ref StudioVpc

  SubnetId:
    Description: ID of the created subnet (empty when an existing domain is used).
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Value: !Ref StudioSubnet

  ExistingDomainSubnetIds:
    Description: Subnet IDs supplied for the existing domain (only when an existing domain is used).
    Condition: UseExistingDomain
    Value: !Join [',', !Ref ExistingSubnetIds]

  ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds:
    Description: Security group IDs supplied for the existing domain (only when an existing domain is used).
    Condition: UseExistingDomain
    Value: !Join [',', !Ref ExistingSecurityGroupIds]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudWatch monitoring for cross-language database encryption SDK performance benchmarks (Java, .NET, Python, Go, Rust).

# Event contract: benchmark result events must be structured JSON containing at least
#   { "test_type": "memory" | "throughput" | "concurrency",
#     "language": "Java" | ".NET" | "Python" | "Go" | "Rust",
#     "memory_efficiency_ratio": <number>, "peak_memory_bytes": <number>,
#     "data_size": <number>, "p50_latency_ms": <number>,
#     "p95_latency_ms": <number>, "p99_latency_ms": <number> }
# The Language dimension value is selected from the event's "language" field
# ($.language), as CloudWatch Logs requires dimension values to be selectors.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives structured JSON benchmark result events.
    Default: /aws/benchmarks/db-encryption-sdk
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512

Resources:
  # Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the benchmark log group.
  BenchmarkLogGroupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting database encryption SDK benchmark CloudWatch Logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  # Alias for operability/discoverability of the CMK.
  BenchmarkLogGroupKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/benchmarks-db-encryption-sdk-logs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroupKey

  # Log group for benchmark results. No DeletionPolicy/UpdateReplacePolicy is set:
  # this is a monitoring log group, not a data-bearing stateful resource requiring retention.
  BenchmarkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt BenchmarkLogGroupKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Java
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  JavaMemoryEfficiencyRatioFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.test_type = "memory" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: MemoryEfficiencyRatio
          MetricNamespace: Benchmarks/DatabaseEncryptionSDK/Java
          MetricValue: $.memory_efficiency_ratio
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: $.language

  JavaPeakMemoryUsageFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.test_type = "memory" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: PeakMemoryUsage
          MetricNamespace: Benchmarks/DatabaseEncryptionSDK/Java
          MetricValue: $.peak_memory_bytes
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: $.language

  JavaThroughputP50LatencyFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.test_type = "throughput" && $.data_size = 4096 }'

        - MetricName: ThroughputP50Latency
          MetricNamespace: Benchmarks/DatabaseEncryptionSDK/Java

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL API (TodoAPIwithJs) with DynamoDB backend, JavaScript pipeline resolvers, and real-time subscriptions.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key for log group and DynamoDB encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TodoKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for TodoAPIwithJs log group and DynamoDB table encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  TodoKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-todo'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TodoKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Group for AppSync logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/appsync/apis/${AWS::StackName}-TodoAPIwithJs'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt TodoKmsKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB Table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Todos'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: owner-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TodoKmsKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Service Role for AppSync -> DynamoDB
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncDataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TodoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TodoTable.Arn}/index/owner-index'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for AppSync CloudWatch logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Data Master IAM role set - comprehensive, self-contained IAM roles covering the
  data pipeline from ingestion (DMS, EventBridge Pipes) through processing (Lambda,
  Glue, EMR Serverless, ECS Fargate) to analytics and monitoring (Lake Formation,
  Step Functions, AWS Managed Grafana). All supporting resources (S3 buckets,
  Kinesis stream, Firehose delivery stream, DynamoDB table, SQS queue, SNS topic,
  EventBridge bus, Glue catalog database) are created in this template. A KMS key
  is created in-template as a fallback when KmsKeyArn is not supplied.

Parameters:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      ARN of existing KMS key for raw data encryption. Leave empty to use the
      in-template DataMasterKey created by this stack.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:key/.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid KMS key ARN.
  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Target AWS Account ID for STS AssumeRole scoping
    Default: '000000000000'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.

Conditions:
  HasProvidedKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # In-template KMS key (fallback when KmsKeyArn is not supplied)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  DataMasterKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master encryption key for raw data, streams, queues, topics, and tables
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Supporting resources created in-template (referenced by role policies)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'dm-access-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerPreferred
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  AccessLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  RawDataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'dm-raw-data-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: access-logs/
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  CuratedDataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'dm-curated-data-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: access-logs/
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  DataLakeBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'dm-datalake-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: access-logs/
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  IngestionStream:
    Type: AWS::Kinesis::Stream
    Properties:
      Name: dm-ingestion-stream
      ShardCount: 1
      StreamEncryption:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KeyId: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  DeliveryStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: dm-delivery-stream
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt RawDataBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt FirehoseDeliveryRole.Arn
        Prefix: raw/
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  ProcessingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: dm-processing-table
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: pk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: pk
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  WorkQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: dm-work-queue
      KmsMasterKeyId: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  NotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: dm-notification-topic
      KmsMasterKeyId: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  EventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: dm-event-bus
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  GlueCatalogDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: dm_catalog
        Description: Data Master Glue catalog database

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS Kinesis role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  DmsKinesisRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-dms-kinesis-role
      Description: DMS role to write change data to Kinesis
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-dms-kinesis-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource: !GetAtt IngestionStream.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS VPC role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-dms-vpc-role
      Description: DMS VPC management role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-dms-vpc-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # EC2 describe actions do not support resource-level permissions,
              # so Resource "*" is required for this statement.
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcPeeringConnections
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpoints
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls
                  - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
                  - ec2:DescribePrefixLists
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${TargetAccountId}:role/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge Pipes role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  PipesFirehoseRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-pipes-firehose-role
      Description: EventBridge Pipes role to forward Kinesis data to Firehose
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-pipes-firehose-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                  - kinesis:ListStreams
                  - kinesis:SubscribeToShard
                Resource: !GetAtt IngestionStream.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: !GetAtt DeliveryStream.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Firehose delivery role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  FirehoseDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-firehose-delivery-role
      Description: Firehose delivery role to write raw data to S3
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-firehose-delivery-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RawDataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${RawDataBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/*:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                Resource: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda processing / controller role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ProcessingControllerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-processing-controller-role
      Description: Lambda processing controller role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-processing-controller-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                  - kinesis:ListStreams
                  - kinesis:SubscribeToShard
                Resource: !GetAtt IngestionStream.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: !GetAtt DeliveryStream.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RawDataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${RawDataBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !GetAtt CuratedDataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CuratedDataBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda worker role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  WorkerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-worker-role
      Description: Lambda worker role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-worker-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RawDataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${RawDataBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !GetAtt CuratedDataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CuratedDataBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ProcessingTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource: !GetAtt WorkQueue.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda routing role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  RoutingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-routing-role
      Description: Lambda routing role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-routing-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt EventBus.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                Resource: !GetAtt WorkQueue.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue crawler role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-glue-crawler-role
      Description: Glue crawler role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-glue-crawler-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RawDataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${RawDataBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !GetAtt CuratedDataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CuratedDataBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !GetAtt DataLakeBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${DataLakeBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue ETL job role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GlueEtlRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-glue-etl-role
      Description: Glue ETL job role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-glue-etl-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RawDataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${RawDataBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !GetAtt CuratedDataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CuratedDataBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !GetAtt DataLakeBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${DataLakeBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:Get*
                  - glue:Create*
                  - glue:Update*
                  - glue:Batch*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/dm_catalog'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/dm_catalog/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !If [HasProvidedKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt DataMasterKey.Arn]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lake Formation data lake access role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  LakeFormationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-lakeformation-role
      Description: Lake Formation data lake access role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lakeformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-lakeformation-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lakeformation:GetDataAccess
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetCatalogImportStatus
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/dm_catalog'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/dm_catalog/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DataLakeBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${DataLakeBucket.Arn}/*'
