AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Composite CloudWatch alarms for cross-region failover application health monitoring (API Gateway, Lambda, and RDS).

Parameters:
  ApiGatewayApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: Remittance
    Description: Name of the existing API Gateway API to monitor.
  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: GetRemittances
    Description: Name of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function.
  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateRemittance
    Description: Name of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function.
  RdsInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1
    Description: Identifier of the existing RDS DB instance to monitor.

Resources:
  ApiGateway4XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Remittance-API-4XX-Errors
      AlarmDescription: API Gateway 4XX errors averaging above 0 over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 0
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayApiName

  ApiGateway5XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Remittance-API-5XX-Errors
      AlarmDescription: API Gateway 5XX errors averaging above 1 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 1
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayApiName

  ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Remittance-API-Latency
      AlarmDescription: API Gateway latency at or above 10000 ms over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 10000
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayApiName

  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: GetRemittances-Errors
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances Lambda errors summed above 0 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Statistic: Sum
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 0
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: GetRemittances-Invocations
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances Lambda invocations summed above 2 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Statistic: Sum
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 2
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: GetRemittances-Duration
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances Lambda average duration at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 10000
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName

  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CreateRemittance-Errors
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance Lambda errors summed above 0 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Statistic: Sum
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 0
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CreateRemittance-Invocations
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance Lambda invocations summed above 2 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Statistic: Sum
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 2
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CreateRemittance-Duration
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance Lambda average duration at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 10000
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName

  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-CPUUtilization
      AlarmDescription: RDS CPU utilization averaging at or above 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 70
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-DatabaseConnections
      AlarmDescription: RDS database connections averaging at or above 100.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 100
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-Deadlocks
      AlarmDescription: RDS deadlocks averaging at or above 10.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 10
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-NetworkTransmitThroughput
      AlarmDescription: RDS network transmit throughput averaging at or above 10485760 bytes.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 10485760
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-NetworkReceiveThroughput
      AlarmDescription: RDS network receive throughput averaging at or above 10485760 bytes.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 10485760
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-Queries
      AlarmDescription: RDS queries averaging at or above 100.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 100
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-DiskQueueDepth
      AlarmDescription: RDS disk queue depth averaging at or above 50.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 50
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-ReadLatency
      AlarmDescription: RDS read latency averaging at or above 0.1 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 0.1
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-WriteLatency
      AlarmDescription: RDS write latency averaging at or above 0.1 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 0.1
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier

  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm aggregating API Gateway 4XX, 5XX, and latency alarms.
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - '(ALARM(${Alarm4XX}) OR ALARM(${Alarm5XX}) OR ALARM(${AlarmLatency}))'
        - Alarm4XX: !Ref ApiGateway4XXErrorAlarm
          Alarm5XX: !Ref ApiGateway5XXErrorAlarm

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm aggregating Lambda errors and duration alarms for both functions.

    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Health
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm aggregating all RDS metric alarms.
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - '(ALARM(${Cpu}) OR ALARM(${Connections}) OR ALARM(${Deadlocks}) OR ALARM(${NetTx}) OR ALARM(${NetRx}) OR ALARM(${Queries}) OR ALARM(${DiskQueue}) OR ALARM(${ReadLatency}) OR ALARM(${WriteLatency}))'

          Deadlocks: !Ref RdsDeadlocksAlarm
          NetTx: !Ref RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm
          NetRx: !Ref RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm
          Queries: !Ref RdsQueriesAlarm
          DiskQueue: !Ref RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm
          ReadLatency: !Ref RdsReadLatencyAlarm
          WriteLatency: !Ref RdsWriteLatencyAlarm

    Value: !GetAtt ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn
  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda Health composite alarm.
    Value: !Ref LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm
  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn
  RdsHealthCompositeAlarmName:

    Description: ARN of the RDS Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt RdsHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: QuickSight admin console monitoring and data extraction pipeline with Glue jobs, scheduled triggers, CloudWatch metric streams (via Lambda-backed custom resource), and Kinesis Firehose delivery to S3.

Resources:

  AdminSuiteKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for admin suite pipeline data buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAwsServicesViaService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - glue.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  AdminSuiteKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKey

  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteQuickSightPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Get*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteGluePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:GetJobs
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetTrigger
                  - glue:GetTriggers
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetCatalogImportStatus
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                  - glue:GetConnection
                  - glue:GetConnections
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteCloudWatchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:StartMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:StopMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteFirehosePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:CreateDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:DeleteDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:ListDeliveryStreams
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:UpdateDestination
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteIAMPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteKMSPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn

  AccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256

  AccessLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: script-bucket-logs/
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  ScriptBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScriptBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAdminSuiteRoleRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:GetObjectVersion
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  OutputBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: output-bucket-logs/
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  OutputBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref OutputBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAdminSuiteRoleReadWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:GetObjectVersion
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
              - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
              - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket

  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket

  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket

  GlueJobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket

  GlueJobDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket

  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      WorkerType: G.1X

                Resource: '*'

                Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn

  MetricStreamLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt MetricStreamLambdaRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import cfnresponse
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event.get('RequestType')
                  props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
                  streams = props.get('Streams', [])
                  role_arn = props.get('RoleArn')
                  client = boto3.client('cloudwatch')

                  if request_type in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      for stream in streams:
                          name = stream['Name']
                          include_filters = []
                          for f in stream.get('IncludeFilters', []):
                              include_filters.append({
                                  'Namespace': f['Namespace'],
                                  'MetricNames': f['MetricNames']
                              })
                          params = {
                              'Name': name,
                              'FirehoseArn': stream['FirehoseArn'],
                              'RoleArn': role_arn,
                              'OutputFormat': stream.get('OutputFormat', 'json'),
                              'IncludeFilters': include_filters
                          }
                          client.put_metric_stream(**params)
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'Status': 'Created'})
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      for stream in streams:
                          try:
                              client.delete_metric_stream(Name=stream['Name'])
                          except client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                              pass
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'Status': 'Deleted'})
                  else:
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

    Type: Custom::MetricStreams
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt MetricStreamLambda.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

          FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseIngestion.Arn

          AttributeType: S

          KeyType: HASH

              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com

                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem

                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments

  KittenFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: KittenCrudFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt KittenFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref KittenTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import uuid
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          CORS_HEADERS = {
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'
          }

          def _response(status, body):
              headers = dict(CORS_HEADERS)
              headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
              return {
                  'statusCode': status,
                  'headers': headers,
                  'body': json.dumps(body)
              }

          def _parse_body(event):
              body = event.get('body')
              if body is None:
                  return None
              if isinstance(body, dict):
                  return body
              try:
                  return json.loads(body)
              except (ValueError, TypeError):
                  return None

          def _validate(data):
              if not isinstance(data, dict):
                  return False
              name = data.get('name')
              color = data.get('color')
              if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
                  return False
              if not isinstance(color, str) or not color.strip():
                  return False
              return True

          def create_kitten(event):
              data = _parse_body(event)
              if not _validate(data):
                  return _response(400, {'message': 'Invalid input: name and color are required'})
              kitten_id = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('requestId') or str(uuid.uuid4())
              item = {
                  'KittenId': kitten_id,
                  'name': data['name'],
                  'color': data['color']
              }
              try:
                  table.put_item(Item=item)
              except ClientError:
                  return _response(500, {'message': 'Internal server error'})
              return _response(201, item)

          def list_kittens(event):
              try:
                  items = []
                  response = table.scan()
                  items.extend(response.get('Items', []))
                  while 'LastEvaluatedKey' in response:
                      response = table.scan(ExclusiveStartKey=response['LastEvaluatedKey'])
                      items.extend(response.get('Items', []))
              except ClientError:
                  return _response(500, {'message': 'Internal server error'})
              return _response(200, {'items': items})

          def get_kitten(kitten_id):
              try:
                  response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
              except ClientError:
                  return _response(500, {'message': 'Internal server error'})
              item = response.get('Item')
              if not item:
                  return _response(404, {'message': 'Kitten not found'})
              return _response(200, item)

          def update_kitten(event, kitten_id):
              data = _parse_body(event)
              if not _validate(data):
                  return _response(400, {'message': 'Invalid input: name and color are required'})
              try:
                  existing = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id}).get('Item')
                  if not existing:
                      return _response(404, {'message': 'Kitten not found'})
                  item = {
                      'KittenId': kitten_id,
                      'name': data['name'],
                      'color': data['color']
                  }
                  table.put_item(Item=item)
              except ClientError:
                  return _response(500, {'message': 'Internal server error'})
              return _response(200, item)

          def delete_kitten(kitten_id):
              try:
                  existing = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id}).get('Item')
                  if not existing:
                      return _response(404, {'message': 'Kitten not found'})
                  table.delete_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
              except ClientError:
                  return _response(500, {'message': 'Internal server error'})
              return _response(200, {'message': 'Kitten deleted', 'KittenId': kitten_id})

          def handler(event, context):
              method = event.get('httpMethod')
              path_params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
              kitten_id = path_params.get('id')

              if method == 'OPTIONS':
                  return _response(200, {'message': 'CORS preflight'})
              if method == 'POST' and not kitten_id:
                  return create_kitten(event)
              if method == 'GET' and not kitten_id:
                  return list_kittens(event)
              if method == 'GET' and kitten_id:
                  return get_kitten(kitten_id)
              if method == 'PUT' and kitten_id:
                  return update_kitten(event, kitten_id)
              if method == 'DELETE' and kitten_id:
                  return delete_kitten(kitten_id)
              return _response(400, {'message': 'Unsupported method or path'})

      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}/access'

  LogGroupKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-apigw-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogGroupKmsKey

  RestApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}/access'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogGroupKmsKey.Arn

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  RestApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: start

  RestApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref RestApiResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineAlias}",
              "input": "{\"source\":\"apigateway\"}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'

  RestApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - RestApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment for the start method

  RestApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - RestApiAccessLogGroup
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref RestApiDeployment
      StageName: prod
      TracingEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}/access:*'
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status","responseLength":"$context.responseLength"}'

  RestApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api-key'
      Enabled: true
      StageKeys:
        - RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
          StageName: !Ref RestApiStage

  RestApiUsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    Properties:
      UsagePlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-usage-plan'
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref RestApi
          Stage: !Ref RestApiStage
      Throttle:
        BurstLimit: 100
        RateLimit: 50
      Quota:
        Limit: 10000
        Period: DAY

  RestApiUsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref RestApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref RestApiUsagePlan

  TerminatedRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TerminatedRuleStartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  TerminatedRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-terminated'
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.states
        detail-type:
          - 'Step Functions Execution Status Change'
        detail:
          status:
            - SUCCEEDED
            - FAILED
            - TIMED_OUT
            - ABORTED
      Targets:
        - Id: StartExecutionOnTerminated
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TerminatedRuleRole.Arn
          Input: '{"source":"terminated-event"}'

  ScheduledRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ScheduledRuleStartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  ScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-scheduled'
      State: DISABLED
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      Targets:
        - Id: StartExecutionOnSchedule
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt ScheduledRuleRole.Arn
          Input: '{"source":"scheduled-event"}'

  TagRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TagRuleStartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  TagRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tag'
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.tag
      Targets:
        - Id: StartExecutionOnTag
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TagRuleRole.Arn
          Input: '{"source":"tag-event"}'

  SchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SchedulerStartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  SchedulerSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-scheduler'
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: 'OFF'
      Target:
        Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
        RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerRole.Arn
        Input: '{"source":"scheduler"}'

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  StateMachineVersionArn:
    Description: ARN of the state machine version

  StateMachineAliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the state machine alias
    Value: !Ref StateMachineAlias
  RestApiId:
    Description: ID of the API Gateway REST API

  RestApiRootResourceId:
    Description: Root resource ID of the REST API
    Value: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
  RestApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL for the start path

  RestApiKeyId:
    Description: ID of the API Gateway API key (retrieve value via GetApiKey)
    Value: !Ref RestApiKey
  RestApiUsagePlanId:
    Description: ID of the API Gateway usage plan
    Value: !Ref RestApiUsagePlan
  RestApiAccessLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway access log group

    Description: ARN of the KMS CMK used to encrypt the access log group

  TerminatedRuleArn:

    Description: ARN of the tag-event EventBridge rule
    Value: !GetAtt TagRule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions IAM identities and permission policies required by the Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) bootstrap process for an Amazon EKS cluster.

Resources:
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: capa-eks-control-plane-role
        - Key: Project
          Value: capa-eks-bootstrap

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: capa-eks-nodes-role
        - Key: Project
          Value: capa-eks-bootstrap

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: capa-eks-controllers-role
        - Key: Project
          Value: capa-eks-bootstrap

  EksControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: capa-eks-cluster-role
        - Key: Project
          Value: capa-eks-bootstrap

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  LegacyCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Permissions for the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider (EC2, Auto Scaling, ELB, KMS).
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:AttachInstances
              - autoscaling:DetachInstances
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KMSPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  NodeRegistrationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Permissions for node registration and container image pull (EC2, ECR, Secrets Manager, SSM).
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref NodesRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2DescribePermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ECRPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SecretsManagerPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: '*'

  ClusterAPIControllerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Permissions for Cluster API controllers to manage cluster infrastructure (EC2 networking, Auto Scaling, ELB, launch templates, service-linked roles).
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2NetworkingPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:DeleteLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: LaunchTemplatePermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ServiceLinkedRolePermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: '*'

  EKSClusterManagementPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Permissions for Cluster API controllers to create and manage EKS clusters, node groups, add-ons, and Fargate profiles.
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EKSPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: General purpose networking foundation with VPC, public/private subnets, NAT gateways, VPC flow logs, and S3/ECR VPC endpoints.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for tagging.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period in days for the VPC flow logs CloudWatch log group.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653

  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    Description: Type of traffic to capture in VPC flow logs.
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGateway1Eip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway2Eip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1Eip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2Eip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt the VPC flow logs CloudWatch log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
          - Sid: AllowFlowLogsDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FlowLogsRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref FlowLogsRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for interface VPC endpoints allowing outbound HTTPS within the VPC CIDR.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow outbound HTTPS within the VPC CIDR.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: The CIDR block of the VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  AvailabilityZone1:
    Description: The first availability zone used by the subnets.
    Value: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZone1'

  AvailabilityZone2:
    Description: The second availability zone used by the subnets.
    Value: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZone2'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: The ID of the first public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: The ID of the second public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: The ID of the first private subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: The ID of the second private subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

  EndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: The ID of the security group used by the interface VPC endpoints.
    Value: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EndpointSecurityGroupId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: KerberosEMRonEKS - VPC, subnets, NAT, flow logs, and interface endpoints for Microsoft AD on EKS

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPC
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.64/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.128/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.192/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-IGW
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-EIP1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-EIP2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGateway1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGateway2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicRouteTable
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRouteTable1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRouteTable2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KerberosEMRonEKS VPC flow logs encryption key
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogsKey
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogsKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/KerberosEMRonEKS-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogsRole
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCFlowLog
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: KerberosEMRonEKS interface endpoints security group - HTTPS from VPC CIDR only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/24
          Description: HTTPS from VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/24
          Description: HTTPS to VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-EndpointSecurityGroup
        - Key: Environment
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: KerberosEMRonEKS VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway 1 ID
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1

  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway 2 ID
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2

  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN for VPC flow logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch log group name for VPC flow logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup

  EndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for interface endpoints
    Value: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
