      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlog'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref VpcFlowLogKmsKey

  VpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogKmsKey.Arn

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsWritePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlog-role'

  SageMakerVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-vpc-flowlog'

  DefaultBucketKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the SageMaker default S3 bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  DefaultBucketKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-default-bucket'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DefaultBucketKmsKey

  AccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-access-logs'

  AccessLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt DefaultS3Bucket.Arn

  DefaultS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DefaultBucketKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: accesslogs/
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-default-bucket'

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Real-time monitoring group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryTokenRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Realtime-TokenRatePerUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | filter @timestamp > ago(15m)
        | stats sum(inputTokens) as inputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as outputTokens, sum(inputTokens + outputTokens) as totalTokens by userId
        | sort totalTokens desc

  QueryRequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Realtime-RequestRatePerUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId
        | filter @timestamp > ago(15m)
        | stats count(*) as requests by userId
        | sort requests desc

  QueryCurrentTpmAverage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Realtime-CurrentTpmAverage
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | filter @timestamp > ago(15m)
        | stats sum(inputTokens + outputTokens) / 15 as avgTokensPerMinute

  QueryCurrentRpmAverage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Realtime-CurrentRpmAverage
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp
        | filter @timestamp > ago(15m)
        | stats count(*) / 15 as avgRequestsPerMinute

  QueryRateLimitRisk:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Realtime-RateLimitRisk
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, statusCode, errorType
        | filter @timestamp > ago(15m)
        | filter statusCode = 429 or errorType like /(?i)rate.?limit/ or errorType like /(?i)throttl/
        | stats count(*) as rateLimitEvents by userId
        | sort rateLimitEvents desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User and session analytics group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QuerySessionLevelUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Session-SessionLevelUsage
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, sessionId, userId, inputTokens, outputTokens, costUsd
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(inputTokens) as inputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as outputTokens, sum(costUsd) as totalCost by sessionId, userId
        | sort totalCost desc

  QueryHourlyActivityTimeline:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Session-HourlyActivityTimeline
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId
        | stats count(*) as requests by bin(1h) as hour, userId
        | sort hour asc

  QueryErrorDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Session-ErrorDetection
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, sessionId, errorType, errorMessage, statusCode
        | filter ispresent(errorType) or ispresent(errorMessage) or statusCode >= 400
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 100

  QueryThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Session-ThrottlingDetection
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, sessionId, statusCode, errorType
        | filter statusCode = 429 or errorType like /(?i)throttl/ or errorType like /(?i)rate.?limit/
        | stats count(*) as throttleEvents by userId, sessionId
        | sort throttleEvents desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cost and attribution reporting group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryCostByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Cost-CostByUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, costUsd, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats sum(costUsd) as totalCost, sum(inputTokens) as inputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as outputTokens by userId
        | sort totalCost desc

  QueryCostByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Cost-CostByModel
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, model, costUsd, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats sum(costUsd) as totalCost, sum(inputTokens) as inputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as outputTokens by model
        | sort totalCost desc

  QueryCostByOrganization:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Cost-CostByOrganization
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, organizationId, costUsd, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats sum(costUsd) as totalCost, sum(inputTokens) as inputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as outputTokens by organizationId
        | sort totalCost desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Additional debugging and analysis group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryModelEfficiency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Debug-ModelEfficiency
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, model, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(inputTokens) as inputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as outputTokens by model
        | display model, requests, inputTokens, outputTokens, (inputTokens + outputTokens) / requests as tokensPerRequest, outputTokens / inputTokens as outputInputRatio
        | sort tokensPerRequest desc

  QueryCacheHitMissOverall:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Debug-CacheHitMissOverall
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens, inputTokens
        | stats sum(cacheReadInputTokens) as cacheHits, sum(cacheCreationInputTokens) as cacheMisses, sum(inputTokens) as totalInputTokens
        | display cacheHits, cacheMisses, totalInputTokens, cacheHits / (cacheHits + cacheMisses) as cacheHitRate

  QueryCacheHitMissOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Debug-CacheHitMissOverTime
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens
        | stats sum(cacheReadInputTokens) as cacheHits, sum(cacheCreationInputTokens) as cacheMisses by bin(1h) as hour
        | display hour, cacheHits, cacheMisses, cacheHits / (cacheHits + cacheMisses) as cacheHitRate
        | sort hour asc

  QueryCacheHitMissBySession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Debug-CacheHitMissBySession
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, sessionId, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens
        | stats sum(cacheReadInputTokens) as cacheHits, sum(cacheCreationInputTokens) as cacheMisses by sessionId
        | display sessionId, cacheHits, cacheMisses, cacheHits / (cacheHits + cacheMisses) as cacheHitRate
        | sort cacheHitRate desc

  QueryPeakUsageWindows:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Debug-PeakUsageWindows
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(inputTokens + outputTokens) as totalTokens by bin(1h) as hour
        | sort totalTokens desc
        | limit 24

  QuerySessionDeepDive:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Debug-SessionDeepDive
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, sessionId, userId, model, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens, costUsd, statusCode, errorType
        | filter ispresent(sessionId)
        | sort @timestamp asc
        | limit 500

  QueryFieldExplorer:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Debug-FieldExplorer
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  QueryDailyUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode-Debug-DailyUsageSummary
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, inputTokens, outputTokens, costUsd
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(inputTokens) as inputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as outputTokens, sum(costUsd) as totalCost by bin(1d) as day
        | sort day asc

    Description: Log group name that all Claude Code saved queries are scoped to.
    Value: !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryDefinitionIds:
    Description: IDs of all Claude Code CloudWatch Logs Insights saved query definitions.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB data sources, IAM auth, and CloudWatch logging.

Resources:
  AppDataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for AppSync logs and DynamoDB table encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDB
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  AppDataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/appsync-dynamodb-data-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AppDataKey

  AppSyncLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AppDataKey.Arn

  AppSyncLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncCloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AppSyncLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AppSyncLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
                  - !Sub '${Table1.Arn}/index/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AppDataKey.Arn

  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Table1
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AppDataKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  SuperCoolAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLogsRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL
        ExcludeVerboseContent: false

  SuperCoolAPISchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          description: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

        type Mutation {
          addTodo(id: ID!, description: String): Todo
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  Table1DataSourceGetAtt:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1DataSourceGetAtt
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  Table1DataSourceSub:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1DataSourceSub
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  Table1DataSourceRef:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1DataSourceRef
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SuperCoolAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt Table1DataSourceGetAtt.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "GetItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  AddTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SuperCoolAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt Table1DataSourceSub.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "description": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.description)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

Outputs:
  AppSyncApiId:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API ID
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId

  AppSyncGraphQLUrl:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API URL
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.GraphQLUrl

  AppSyncApiArn:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API ARN
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.Arn

  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref Table1

  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Description: DynamoDB table ARN
    Value: !GetAtt Table1.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions CAPA bootstrap IAM identities and permission policies for an EKS cluster with managed node groups and Fargate support.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Core CAPA bootstrap roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-control-plane-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: capa-bootstrap
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-controllers-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: capa-bootstrap
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-nodes-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: capa-bootstrap
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: capa-control-plane-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: capa-controllers-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: capa-nodes-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS service roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  EksControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-eks-control-plane-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: capa-bootstrap
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  EksFargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-eks-fargate-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: capa-bootstrap
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  EksManagedNodeGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-eks-managed-node-group-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: capa-bootstrap
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed policies
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControlPlaneLegacyCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-control-plane-legacy-cloud-provider-policy
      Description: EC2, Auto Scaling, ELB and KMS permissions for the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider.
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  NodeRegistrationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-node-registration-policy
      Description: EC2, ECR, Secrets Manager and SSM permissions for node registration and image pulls.
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref NodesRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: '*'

  ClusterApiControllersInfrastructurePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-cluster-api-controllers-infrastructure-policy
      Description: Broad EC2 networking, Auto Scaling, ELB, launch template and service-linked-role permissions for Cluster API controllers.
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: '*'

  ClusterApiControllersEksPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-cluster-api-controllers-eks-policy
      Description: EKS-specific permissions to create and manage EKS clusters, node groups, add-ons, Fargate profiles and related IAM/KMS operations.
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
              - eks:CreateAddon
              - eks:DeleteAddon
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:UpdateAddon
              - eks:CreateFargateProfile
              - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:ListFargateProfiles
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
              - eks:ListTagsForResource
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

Outputs:
  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA control plane role.
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn

  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA controllers role.
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersRole.Arn

  NodesRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA nodes role.
    Value: !GetAtt NodesRole.Arn

  EksControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS control plane service role.
    Value: !GetAtt EksControlPlaneRole.Arn

  EksFargateExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS Fargate execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt EksFargateExecutionRole.Arn

  EksManagedNodeGroupRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS managed node group role.
    Value: !GetAtt EksManagedNodeGroupRole.Arn

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the control plane instance profile.
    Value: !Ref ControlPlaneInstanceProfile

  ControllersInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the controllers instance profile.
    Value: !Ref ControllersInstanceProfile

  NodesInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the nodes instance profile.
    Value: !Ref NodesInstanceProfile

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared VPC for EMR on EKS and Celeborn shuffle service with public/private subnets, NAT, VPC endpoints, and encrypted VPC Flow Logs.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: emr-eks-celeborn
    Description: Project name used for tagging and Name tag patterns.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for tagging.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1 (AZ 1).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2 (AZ 2).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1 (AZ 1).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2 (AZ 2).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention in days for the VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch log group.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-igw'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-public-rt'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-nat-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-nat-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:

    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting VPC Flow Logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-flowlogs-key'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:

      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup

      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${ProjectName}-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Description: IAM role used by VPC Flow Logs to deliver logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-flowlogs-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-flowlogs-role'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn:
      - FlowLogsRole
      - FlowLogsLogGroup
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-vpc-flowlog'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Description: VPC with IPv4 and Amazon-provided IPv6 across three AZs, optional public subnets, and always-on private subnets.

Parameters:
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Default: main-vpc
    Description: Identifier used for naming and tagging resources.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with an alphanumeric character and contain only alphanumerics and hyphens.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  CreatePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create public subnets, an Internet Gateway, and a public route table.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-flowlog-key'
        - Key: Identifier
          Value: !Ref VpcName

    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias

      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${VpcName}-flowlog'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref VpcFlowLogKey

    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-flowlog-role'
        - Key: Identifier
          Value: !Ref VpcName

  VpcFlowLogPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy

      PolicyName: !Sub '${VpcName}-flowlog-policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref VpcFlowLogRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:

              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn

    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog

      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc

      LogGroupName: !Ref VpcFlowLogGroup

                      - Vpc

              - 64
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

        - Key: Identifier
          Value: !Ref VpcName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

    Condition: HasPublicSubnets

      VpcId: !Ref Vpc

        Fn::Select:

                      - Vpc

      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-2'
        - Key: Identifier
          Value: !Ref VpcName
        - Key: Tier

        Fn::Select:

      Ipv6CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - Fn::Select:
                  - 0
                  - Fn::GetAtt:
                      - Vpc

              - 6

      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-3'
        - Key: Identifier
          Value: !Ref VpcName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 3

              - Ref: VpcCidr

      Ipv6CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:

          - Fn::Cidr:
              - Fn::Select:
                  - 0

                      - Vpc

      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-1'
        - Key: Identifier
          Value: !Ref VpcName
        - Key: Tier

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1

              Ref: AWS::Region
      CidrBlock:

          - Fn::Cidr:
              - Ref: VpcCidr
              - 6
              - 8
      Ipv6CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 4
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - Fn::Select:
                  - 0
                  - Fn::GetAtt:
                      - Vpc
                      - Ipv6CidrBlocks
              - 6
              - 64
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-2'
        - Key: Identifier
          Value: !Ref VpcName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 5
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - Ref: VpcCidr
              - 6
              - 8
      Ipv6CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 5
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - Fn::Select:
                  - 0
                  - Fn::GetAtt:
                      - Vpc
                      - Ipv6CidrBlocks
              - 6
              - 64
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-3'
        - Key: Identifier
          Value: !Ref VpcName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-igw'
        - Key: Identifier
          Value: !Ref VpcName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Identifier
          Value: !Ref VpcName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Identifier
          Value: !Ref VpcName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc

  VpcIpv6CidrBlocks:
    Description: IPv6 CIDR blocks associated with the VPC.
    Value: !Join [',', !GetAtt Vpc.Ipv6CidrBlocks]

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Description: Comma-separated list of public subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  IAM identities and permissions required to bootstrap and operate the Cluster API
  Provider for AWS (CAPI/CAPA). Creates least-privilege roles for the Kubernetes
  control plane, Cluster API controllers, worker nodes, and the EKS control plane,
  matching instance profiles, a shared cloud-provider managed policy, a broader
  controller-level managed policy, and a bootstrapper IAM group and user.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: capa
    Description: Prefix used for naming and tagging all IAM resources created by this template.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for tagging.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key for the bootstrapper credentials secret
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BootstrapperSecretKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt the Cluster API bootstrapper credentials secret.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-bootstrapper-credentials-key'
        - Key: Project
          Value: cluster-api-provider-aws
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  BootstrapperSecretKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}-bootstrapper-credentials'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BootstrapperSecretKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed policy: AWS cloud provider integration permissions
  # Attached to the control plane role and the worker node role.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudProviderIntegrationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cloud-provider-integration'
      Description: EC2, ELB, Auto Scaling, ECR, Secrets Manager and SSM permissions required by the AWS cloud provider integration.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2FullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'ec2:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'autoscaling:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ECRFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'ecr:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SecretsManagerRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'secretsmanager:GetSecretValue'
              - 'secretsmanager:DescribeSecret'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SystemsManagerParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'ssm:GetParameter'
              - 'ssm:GetParameters'
              - 'ssm:GetParametersByPath'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SystemsManagerMessaging
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'ssm:SendCommand'
              - 'ssm:StartSession'
              - 'ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation'
              - 'ssm:ListCommands'
              - 'ssm:ListCommandInvocations'
              - 'ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel'
              - 'ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel'
              - 'ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel'
              - 'ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel'
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed policy: broader controller-level permissions
  # Attached to the controllers role, the control plane role, and the
  # bootstrapper group.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ClusterAPIControllerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cluster-api-controller'
      Description: Broader EC2 networking, load balancing, auto scaling, EKS cluster/nodegroup management and service-linked role creation permissions required by the Cluster API controllers.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2Networking
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'ec2:CreateVpc'
              - 'ec2:DeleteVpc'
              - 'ec2:DescribeVpcs'
              - 'ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute'
              - 'ec2:CreateSubnet'
              - 'ec2:DeleteSubnet'
              - 'ec2:DescribeSubnets'
              - 'ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute'
              - 'ec2:AssociateSubnetCidrBlock'
              - 'ec2:DisassociateSubnetCidrBlock'
              - 'ec2:CreateRouteTable'
              - 'ec2:DeleteRouteTable'
              - 'ec2:DescribeRouteTables'
              - 'ec2:CreateRoute'
              - 'ec2:DeleteRoute'
              - 'ec2:ReplaceRoute'
              - 'ec2:AssociateRouteTable'
              - 'ec2:DisassociateRouteTable'
              - 'ec2:CreateSecurityGroup'
              - 'ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup'
              - 'ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups'
              - 'ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress'
              - 'ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress'
              - 'ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress'
              - 'ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress'
              - 'ec2:CreateInternetGateway'
              - 'ec2:DeleteInternetGateway'
              - 'ec2:DescribeInternetGateways'
              - 'ec2:AttachInternetGateway'
              - 'ec2:DetachInternetGateway'
              - 'ec2:CreateNatGateway'
              - 'ec2:DeleteNatGateway'
              - 'ec2:DescribeNatGateways'
              - 'ec2:AllocateAddress'
              - 'ec2:ReleaseAddress'
              - 'ec2:DescribeAddresses'
              - 'ec2:CreateTags'
              - 'ec2:DeleteTags'
              - 'ec2:DescribeTags'
              - 'ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones'
              - 'ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes'
              - 'ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces'
              - 'ec2:CreateNetworkInterface'
              - 'ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface'
              - 'ec2:DescribeInstances'
              - 'ec2:RunInstances'
              - 'ec2:TerminateInstances'
              - 'ec2:DescribeImages'
              - 'ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates'
              - 'ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate'
              - 'ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate'
              - 'ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion'
              - 'ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScaling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'autoscaling:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EKSClusterAndNodegroupManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'eks:CreateCluster'
              - 'eks:DeleteCluster'
              - 'eks:DescribeCluster'
              - 'eks:ListClusters'
              - 'eks:UpdateClusterConfig'
              - 'eks:UpdateClusterVersion'
              - 'eks:CreateNodegroup'
              - 'eks:DeleteNodegroup'
              - 'eks:DescribeNodegroup'
              - 'eks:ListNodegroups'
              - 'eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig'
              - 'eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion'
              - 'eks:TagResource'
              - 'eks:UntagResource'
              - 'eks:ListTagsForResource'
              - 'eks:CreateFargateProfile'
              - 'eks:DeleteFargateProfile'
              - 'eks:DescribeFargateProfile'
              - 'eks:ListFargateProfiles'
              - 'eks:CreateAddon'
              - 'eks:DeleteAddon'
              - 'eks:DescribeAddon'
              - 'eks:ListAddons'
              - 'eks:UpdateAddon'
              - 'eks:AssociateIdentityProviderConfig'
              - 'eks:DisassociateIdentityProviderConfig'
              - 'eks:DescribeIdentityProviderConfig'
              - 'eks:ListIdentityProviderConfigs'
              - 'eks:AssociateAccessPolicy'
              - 'eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy'
              - 'eks:ListAccessEntries'
              - 'eks:ListAccessPolicies'
              - 'eks:DescribeAccessEntry'
              - 'eks:CreateAccessEntry'
              - 'eks:DeleteAccessEntry'
              - 'eks:UpdateAccessEntry'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: IAMServiceLinkedRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'iam:AWSServiceName':
                  - 'elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com'
                  - 'autoscaling.amazonaws.com'
                  - 'eks.amazonaws.com'
                  - 'spot.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: IAMPassRoleForClusterAPI
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'iam:PassRole'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'iam:PassedToService':
                  - 'ec2.amazonaws.com'
                  - 'eks.amazonaws.com'
                  - 'autoscaling.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: IAMReadForClusterAPI
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'iam:GetRole'
              - 'iam:GetInstanceProfile'
              - 'iam:ListRoles'
              - 'iam:ListInstanceProfiles'
              - 'iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies'
              - 'iam:ListRolePolicies'
              - 'iam:GetPolicy'
              - 'iam:GetPolicyVersion'
              - 'iam:ListPolicies'
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Control plane role (EC2-assumable)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-control-plane-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by Kubernetes control plane nodes managed by Cluster API Provider for AWS.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CloudProviderIntegrationPolicy
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllerPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-control-plane-role'
        - Key: Project
          Value: cluster-api-provider-aws
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-control-plane-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cluster API controllers role (EC2 and EKS Pods assumable)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-controllers-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by Cluster API Provider for AWS controllers running on EC2 or as EKS Pods.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
          - Sid: AllowEKSPodsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
              - 'sts:TagSession'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllerPolicy
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-controllers-role'
        - Key: Project
          Value: cluster-api-provider-aws
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-controllers-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Worker node role (EC2-assumable)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WorkerNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-worker-node-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by Kubernetes worker nodes managed by Cluster API Provider for AWS.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Ref CloudProviderIntegrationPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-worker-node-role'
        - Key: Project
          Value: cluster-api-provider-aws
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  WorkerNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-worker-node-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodeRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS control plane role (EKS-assumable, no instance profile)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-eks-control-plane-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by the Amazon EKS control plane service.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEKSAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
              - 'sts:TagSession'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-eks-control-plane-role'
        - Key: Project
