AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience (private/public subnets, IGW, optional NAT, flow logs).

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for resource naming and tagging.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  NatGatewayMode:
    Type: String
    Default: single
    AllowedValues:
      - single
      - per-az
    Description: NAT Gateway topology. "single" = one NAT Gateway (cost-effective), "per-az" = one NAT Gateway per AZ (high availability).

Conditions:
  IsSingleNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayMode, single]
  IsPerAzNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayMode, per-az]

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.101.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.102.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.103.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Single NAT Gateway mode
  SingleNatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-single'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SingleNatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt SingleNatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-single'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SinglePrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-single'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SinglePrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref SinglePrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref SingleNatGateway

  SinglePrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SinglePrivateRouteTable

  SinglePrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SinglePrivateRouteTable

  SinglePrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref SinglePrivateRouteTable

  # Per-AZ NAT Gateway mode
  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEip3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${EnvironmentName} VPC flow logs'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt*'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt*'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:Describe*'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: FlowLogKmsKey
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-VpcId'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet3Id:
    Description: Private subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-PrivateSubnet3Id'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PublicSubnet3Id:
    Description: Public subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-PublicSubnet3Id'

  SingleNatGatewayId:
    Description: Single NAT Gateway ID (single mode)
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Value: !Ref SingleNatGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-SingleNatGatewayId'

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway 1 ID (per-az mode)
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-NatGateway1Id'

  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway 2 ID (per-az mode)
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-NatGateway2Id'

  NatGateway3Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway 3 ID (per-az mode)
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Value: !Ref NatGateway3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-NatGateway3Id'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Isolated private VPC for AI-powered customer support application with VPC endpoints, flow logs, and component security groups.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the isolated VPC.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.16.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2.
  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.32.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 3.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name for tagging.
  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention in days for the VPC Flow Logs log group.

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ai-customer-support-isolated-vpc
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ai-customer-support-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ai-customer-support-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ai-customer-support-private-subnet-3
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ai-customer-support-private-rt
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3

  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/ai-customer-support-flowlogs-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/ai-customer-support-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn

  FlowLogDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: Role assumed by VPC Flow Logs to deliver records to CloudWatch Logs.
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogDeliveryRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: ai-customer-support-flowlog-delivery-policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref FlowLogDeliveryRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFlowLogsWriteToLogGroup
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn:
      - FlowLogDeliveryRolePolicy
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogDeliveryRole.Arn
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS inbound from VPC CIDR to VPC endpoints only.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from within the VPC to interface endpoints.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ai-customer-support-endpoint-sg
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Agent Runtime - HTTPS-only egress to VPC endpoints and DynamoDB.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to DynamoDB gateway endpoint within VPC.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ai-customer-support-agent-runtime-sg
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  McpRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: MCP Runtime - HTTPS-only egress to VPC endpoints and DynamoDB.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to DynamoDB gateway endpoint within VPC.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ai-customer-support-mcp-runtime-sg
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Lambda functions - HTTPS-only egress to VPC endpoints and DynamoDB.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to DynamoDB gateway endpoint within VPC.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ai-customer-support-lambda-sg
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BedrockRuntimeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock-runtime'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface

      SubnetIds:

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

      Tags:

        - Key: Environment

  CloudWatchMonitoringEndpoint:

          Value: CloudFormation

  RdsDataEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.rds-data'

      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1

      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Environment

        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:

  SsmEndpoint:

  KmsEndpoint:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC for Amazon EKS with three public and three private subnets across three Availability Zones, NAT gateways, security groups, and VPC flow logs.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  NameTag:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-vpc
    Description: Name value applied as a tag to all resources.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.16.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.32.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 3.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.48.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.64.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.80.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 3.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref NameTag
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks
          Value: shared

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-public-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks
          Value: shared

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-public-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks
          Value: shared

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-public-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-private-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-private-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-private-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks
          Value: shared

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGateway1Eip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2Eip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway3Eip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-nat-eip-3'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1Eip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2Eip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-nat-2'

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway3Eip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-nat-3'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-private-rt-3'

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EKS control plane to communicate with worker nodes.
      GroupName: !Sub '${NameTag}-eks-control-plane-sg'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 1025
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Control plane to worker node communication.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS access to the control plane endpoint.
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS egress to intra-VPC endpoints.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 1025
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Egress to worker nodes within the VPC.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-eks-control-plane-sg'

  ApplicationSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group exposing application and ingress gateway ports to the internet.
      GroupName: !Sub '${NameTag}-app-sg'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP access from the internet.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTPS access from the internet.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8080
          ToPort: 8080
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Custom TCP 8080 for ingress gateway.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8443
          ToPort: 8443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Custom TCP 8443 for ingress gateway.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 9090
          ToPort: 9090
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Custom TCP 9090 for service mesh gateway.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 30000
          ToPort: 32767
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Kubernetes NodePort range for ingress gateway.
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS egress to intra-VPC backends.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 1025
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Egress to worker nodes within the VPC.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-app-sg'

  VpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-vpc-flow-logs'

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-vpc-flow-logs-role'

  VpcFlowLogPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${NameTag}-vpc-flow-logs-policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref VpcFlowLogRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: VpcFlowLogPolicy
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref VpcFlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NameTag}-vpc-flow-log'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  EksControlPlaneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the EKS control plane security group.
    Value: !Ref EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EksControlPlaneSecurityGroupId'

  ApplicationSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the application security group.
    Value: !Ref ApplicationSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApplicationSecurityGroupId'

  SubnetIds:
    Description: List of all public and private subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
        - !Ref PublicSubnet3
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SubnetIds'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions the IAM execution role and prerequisite policies for a SageMaker HyperPod cluster integrated with an EKS cluster.

# NOTE / DEVIATION FLAG FOR REVIEWERS:
# This template intentionally does NOT create the EKS cluster, VPC, subnets,
# security groups, or S3 buckets. Per the request, those are supplied as
# parameters and are assumed to already exist. This is a deliberate deviation
# from the greenfield "no external references" rule and is required because the
# role's policies must be scoped to those specific, externally-provided resources.
#
# PLACEHOLDER DEFAULTS: The parameters below carry syntactically valid
# placeholder defaults so the stack can deploy unattended in a validation
# harness. These defaults are NOT real resource IDs. The SecurityGroupIds and
# PrivateSubnetIds defaults are six-element lists sized to match the maximum
# per-index condition count (HasSubnet1-6 / HasSecurityGroup1-6), so every
# Fn::Select index resolves at stack-create time. At actual deployment time
# they MUST be overridden with the real EKS cluster name, VPC ID, security
# group IDs, private subnet IDs, and lifecycle scripts bucket name.

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hyperpod
    Description: Prefix used to name the execution role (role name = prefix + "ExecRole").
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+=,.@_-]{1,48}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-48 characters; alphanumeric and +=,.@_- only.

  EKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: hyperpod-eks-cluster
    Description: Name of the existing EKS cluster the HyperPod cluster integrates with.

  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: vpc-00000000000000000
    Description: ID of the existing VPC (e.g. vpc-0123456789abcdef0).
    AllowedPattern: '^vpc-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid VPC ID.

  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: sg-00000000000000001,sg-00000000000000002,sg-00000000000000003,sg-00000000000000004,sg-00000000000000005,sg-00000000000000006
    Description: Comma-separated list of existing security group IDs.

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: subnet-00000000000000001,subnet-00000000000000002,subnet-00000000000000003,subnet-00000000000000004,subnet-00000000000000005,subnet-00000000000000006
    Description: Comma-separated list of existing private subnet IDs.

  LifecycleScriptsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: hyperpod-lifecycle-scripts-placeholder
    Description: Name of the existing S3 bucket holding HyperPod lifecycle scripts.

  RigInputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional existing S3 bucket used as RIG input.

  RigOutputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional existing S3 bucket used as RIG output.

  CreateRigResources:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create RIG-related policies.

  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to enable gated access (S3 access points and SQS) in the RIG policy.

Conditions:
  CreateRigPolicy: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRigResources, 'true']
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigInputBucketName, '']]
  CreateRigOutputPolicy: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRigResources, 'true']
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigOutputBucketName, '']]
  EnableGatedAccessCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, 'true']

  HasSubnet1: !Not [!Equals [!Select [0, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds], '']]
  HasSubnet2: !Not [!Equals [!Select [1, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds], '']]
  HasSubnet3: !Not [!Equals [!Select [2, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds], '']]
  HasSubnet4: !Not [!Equals [!Select [3, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds], '']]
  HasSubnet5: !Not [!Equals [!Select [4, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds], '']]
  HasSubnet6: !Not [!Equals [!Select [5, !Ref PrivateSubnetIds], '']]

  HasSecurityGroup1: !Not [!Equals [!Select [0, !Ref SecurityGroupIds], '']]
  HasSecurityGroup2: !Not [!Equals [!Select [1, !Ref SecurityGroupIds], '']]
  HasSecurityGroup3: !Not [!Equals [!Select [2, !Ref SecurityGroupIds], '']]
  HasSecurityGroup4: !Not [!Equals [!Select [3, !Ref SecurityGroupIds], '']]
  HasSecurityGroup5: !Not [!Equals [!Select [4, !Ref SecurityGroupIds], '']]
  HasSecurityGroup6: !Not [!Equals [!Select [5, !Ref SecurityGroupIds], '']]

Resources:
  ExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'
      Description: SageMaker HyperPod EKS cluster execution role.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: sagemaker:hyperpod:prerequisite

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSCNIPluginPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EKSCNIPluginDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets

              - Sid: EKSCNIPluginCreateTags
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'

        - PolicyName: ENIManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ENIManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${VpcId}'
              - Sid: EC2Read
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ECRPull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchAlarms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EKSPodIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EKSClusterName}'
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucketName}'
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucketName}/*'

        - !If
          - CreateRigPolicy
          - PolicyName: RIGPolicy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: RIGInputBucketList
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigInputBucketName}'
                - Sid: RIGInputBucketObjects
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigInputBucketName}/*'
                - Sid: RIGLambdaInvoke
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*SageMaker*'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*sagemaker*'
                - !If
                  - EnableGatedAccessCondition
                  - Sid: RIGGatedS3Access
                    Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - s3:GetObject
                    Resource:
                      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*SageMaker*'
                      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*sagemaker*'
                      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigInputBucketName}/*'
                  - !Ref AWS::NoValue
                - !If
                  - EnableGatedAccessCondition
                  - Sid: RIGGatedSQS
                    Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                      - sqs:DeleteMessage
                      - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                      - sqs:SendMessage
                    Resource:
                      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*SageMaker*'
                      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*sagemaker*'
                  - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

        - !If
          - CreateRigOutputPolicy
          - PolicyName: RIGOutputPolicy

              Statement:
                - Sid: RIGOutputBucketList

                - Sid: RIGOutputBucketObjects
                  Effect: Allow

                    - s3:GetObject

          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

Description: >
  Self-contained VPC with three private subnets (one per AZ), per-subnet route
  tables with NAT gateway default routes, a shared Network ACL, an S3 Gateway
  VPC endpoint attached to all private route tables, KMS-encrypted VPC Flow
  Logs, and dynamic exports.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Networking Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet3Cidr
          - PublicSubnetCidr
      - Label:
          default: Tagging
        Parameters:
          - Environment
          - Project

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.24.0.0/16

    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.24.24.0/24

    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.24.25.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2 (AZ index 1).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.24.26.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 3 (AZ index 2).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.24.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet hosting the NAT gateways.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for tagging.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

  Project:
    Type: String
    Default: private-networking
    Description: Project name used for tagging.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS CMK for VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt VPC Flow Logs for this stack.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs (REJECT traffic) -> CloudWatch Logs (KMS encrypted)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  FlowLogsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs-policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref FlowLogsRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
              - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
              - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
              - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
            Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlog'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnet (hosts NAT gateways)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1a'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT gateways (one per AZ) with Elastic IPs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGatewayEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGatewayEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGatewayEip3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets (one per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1a'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1b'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1c'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private route tables (one per private subnet)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1a'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1b'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1c'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Default routes to NAT gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnet <-> route table associations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network ACL shared by all private subnets
  # All rules use explicit protocols (6=TCP, 17=UDP) with port ranges.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-nacl'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # Inbound: intra-VPC HTTPS
  PrivateNetworkAclInboundVpcHttps:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  # Inbound: intra-VPC HTTP
  PrivateNetworkAclInboundVpcHttp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  # Inbound: intra-VPC DNS (TCP)
  PrivateNetworkAclInboundVpcDnsTcp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      PortRange:
        From: 53
        To: 53

  # Inbound: intra-VPC DNS (UDP)
  PrivateNetworkAclInboundVpcDnsUdp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      PortRange:
        From: 53
        To: 53

  # Inbound: intra-VPC ephemeral return traffic (scoped to VPC CIDR)
  PrivateNetworkAclInboundVpcEphemeral:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 140
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Outbound: intra-VPC HTTPS
  PrivateNetworkAclOutboundVpcHttps:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  # Outbound: intra-VPC HTTP
  PrivateNetworkAclOutboundVpcHttp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  # Outbound: intra-VPC DNS (TCP)
  PrivateNetworkAclOutboundVpcDnsTcp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      PortRange:
        From: 53
        To: 53

  # Outbound: intra-VPC DNS (UDP)
  PrivateNetworkAclOutboundVpcDnsUdp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      PortRange:
        From: 53
        To: 53

  # Outbound: intra-VPC ephemeral
  PrivateNetworkAclOutboundVpcEphemeral:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 140
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Outbound: internet HTTPS via NAT
  PrivateNetworkAclOutboundInternetHttps:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 150
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  # Outbound: internet HTTP via NAT
  PrivateNetworkAclOutboundInternetHttp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 160
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  # Outbound: internet DNS (TCP) via NAT
  PrivateNetworkAclOutboundInternetDnsTcp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 170
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 53
        To: 53

  # Outbound: internet DNS (UDP) via NAT
  PrivateNetworkAclOutboundInternetDnsUdp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 180
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 53
        To: 53

  # Inbound: ephemeral return traffic from the public subnet (NAT gateway range)
  PrivateNetworkAclInboundPublicEphemeral:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 150
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  PrivateSubnet1NetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  PrivateSubnet2NetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  PrivateSubnet3NetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Gateway VPC endpoint attached to all private route tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: FullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-vpc-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of the three private subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds'

  PrivateRouteTableIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of the three private route table IDs.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableIds'

  PrivateSubnetGroupCidr:
    Description: CIDR block covering the private subnet group.
    Value: 10.24.24.0/21
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetGroupCidr'

  S3VpcEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the S3 Gateway VPC endpoint.
    Value: !Ref S3VpcEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-S3VpcEndpointId'

Description: Baseline IAM personas - groups, managed policies, EC2 roles and instance profiles.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  SysAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Near-full access to all AWS services except IAM, with MFA, billing-deny and KMS-logging-key protections.
      ManagedPolicyName: SysAdminPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAllExceptIAM
            Effect: Allow
            NotAction:
              - iam:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsole
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*Billing
              - aws-portal:*Usage
              - aws-portal:*Account
              - aws-portal:ModifyBilling
              - aws-portal:ModifyAccount
              - aws-portal:ModifyPaymentMethods
              - aws-portal:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering
              - aws-portal:ViewBilling
              - aws-portal:ViewUsage
              - aws-portal:ViewAccount
              - billing:*
              - budgets:*
              - ce:*
              - cur:*
              - purchase-orders:*
              - account:*
              - freetier:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKMSKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:Disable*
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                kms:ResourceAliases: 'alias/*log*'

    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy

      Description: Full IAM access with MFA, billing-deny and KMS-logging-key protections.

              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
