final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Three-tier VPC across three Availability Zones with Internet and NAT gateways

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for tagging
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Web tier subnets (public)
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-web-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-web-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-web-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  # Application tier subnets (private)
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.10.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  # Database tier subnets (private)
  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.20.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.21.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.22.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  # Shared web route table
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-web-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  WebRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # NAT gateways and EIPs
  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEip3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Application tier route tables
  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-rt-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3

  # Database tier route tables
  DbRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-rt-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  DbRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  DbRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  DbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1

  DbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2

  DbSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3

  # VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for VPC flow log encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref FlowLogsRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn:
      - FlowLogsPolicy
      - FlowLogsRole
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref Vpc

  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: Availability Zones used by the subnets
    Value: !Join [',', [!Select [0, !GetAZs ''], !Select [1, !GetAZs ''], !Select [2, !GetAZs '']]]

  WebSubnetIds:
    Description: List of web tier subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref WebSubnet1, !Ref WebSubnet2, !Ref WebSubnet3]]

  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: List of application tier subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref AppSubnet1, !Ref AppSubnet2, !Ref AppSubnet3]]

  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: List of database tier subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref DbSubnet1, !Ref DbSubnet2, !Ref DbSubnet3]]

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared IAM roles and instance profiles required by the Amazon EKS Quick Start
  stacks. All roles and instance profiles use the eks-quickstart prefix.
  Parameter values for downstream stacks are stored under the SSM path
  /quickstart/amazon-eks.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming
        Parameters:
          - RolePrefix
    ParameterLabels:
      RolePrefix:
        default: Role name prefix

Parameters:
  RolePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-quickstart
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_-]{1,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 1-32 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters and
      +=,.@_-
    Description: >-
      Prefix applied to every IAM role and instance profile created by this
      template. Defaults to eks-quickstart.

Rules:
  RolePrefixLength:
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Not
          - !Equals
            - !Ref RolePrefix
            - ''
        AssertDescription: RolePrefix must not be empty.

Conditions:
  HasRolePrefix: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref RolePrefix
      - ''

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution roles used by the EKS Quick Start custom resources
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  CopyZipToS3Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CopyZipToS3Role'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role used to copy zip artifacts from S3 for the EKS
        Quick Start.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CopyZipToS3Policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListArtifactBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - Sid: ReadArtifactObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'

  ReadResourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ReadResourceRole'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role with read-only access across the account used to
        read resource information for the EKS Quick Start.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ReadResourcePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadOnlyDescribeAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - iam:Get*
                  - iam:List*
                  - ssm:Get*
                  - s3:Get*
                  - s3:List*
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:List*
                  - eks:Describe*
                  - eks:List*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                  - lambda:Get*
                  - lambda:List*
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'

  CreateVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CreateVpcRole'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role used to create the VPC and associated networking
        resources for the EKS Quick Start.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateVpcPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: VpcNetworkingCreateAndDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateVpc
                  - ec2:DeleteVpc
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateSubnet
                  - ec2:DeleteSubnet
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateRouteTable
                  - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
                  - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
                  - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
                  - ec2:CreateNatGateway
                  - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
                  - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
                  - ec2:AllocateAddress
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                Resource: '*'

  DeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-DeleteBucketContentsRole'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role used to delete bucket contents during EKS Quick
        Start cleanup.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeleteBucketContentsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - Sid: DeleteBucketObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'

  CleanupLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CleanupLoadBalancersRole'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role used to clean up ELB/ALB/NLB resources created by
        the EKS Quick Start.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLoadBalancersPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeAndDeleteLoadBalancers
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Delete*
                Resource: '*'

  CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRole'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role used to clean up security group dependencies
        during EKS Quick Start cleanup.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageSecurityGroupDependencies
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                Resource: '*'

  CleanupLambdaFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CleanupLambdaFunctionsRole'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role used to clean up Lambda functions created by the
        EKS Quick Start.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLambdaFunctionsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageLambdaFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:ListTags
                Resource: '*'

  ResolveCallerArnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ResolveCallerArnRole'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role used to resolve the caller ARN for the EKS Quick
        Start.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResolveCallerArnPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GetCallerIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'

  RegisterCustomResourceTypesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-RegisterCustomResourceTypesRole'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role used to register custom resource types for the
        EKS Quick Start.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RegisterCustomResourceTypesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageTypeRegistration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                Resource: '*'

  ManageNodeSecurityGroupsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ManageNodeSecurityGroupsRole'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role used to manage node security groups for the EKS
        Quick Start.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageNodeSecurityGroupsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageSecurityGroupRules
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'

  CreateFargateProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CreateFargateProfileRole'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role used to create Fargate profiles for the EKS Quick
        Start.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateFargateProfilePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageFargateProfiles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:CreateFargateProfile
                  - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
                  - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
                  - eks:ListFargateProfiles
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassFargatePodExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FargateExecutionRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: eks.amazonaws.com

  ResolveSsmParametersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ResolveSsmParametersRole'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role used to resolve SSM parameters under
        /quickstart/amazon-eks for the EKS Quick Start.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResolveSsmParametersPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadQuickStartParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/quickstart/amazon-eks'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/quickstart/amazon-eks/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS control plane and Fargate execution roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-EKSControlPlaneRole'
      Description: >-
        IAM role assumed by the Amazon EKS service to manage the cluster
        control plane.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEksAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSControlPlaneNetworkingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeNetworkingAttributes
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: '*'

  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-FargateExecutionRole'
      Description: >-
        IAM role assumed by Amazon EKS Fargate pods to pull images and write
        logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEksFargatePodsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Node instance roles and instance profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ManagedNodeInstanceRole:

    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ManagedNodeInstanceRole'
      Description: >-
        IAM role assumed by managed node group EC2 instances in the EKS Quick
        Start.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEc2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: NodeCloudFormationSignalPolicy

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lab VPC with web and application tiers across two AZs, shared route table, S3 gateway endpoint, and Kinesis interface endpoints.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: lab
    Description: Name used for tagging resources.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  WebSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for web-tier subnet 1.
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  WebSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for web-tier subnet 2.
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  AppSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for application-tier subnet 1.
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  AppSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for application-tier subnet 2.
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$

Resources:
  LabVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CMK for ${EnvironmentName} VPC flow log encryption'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowFlowLogDeliveryService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogsKmsKey

  VpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcFlowLogPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log-policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref VpcFlowLogRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
              - !Sub '${VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn:
      - VpcFlowLogPolicy
      - LogsKmsKey
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref LabVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-web-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-web-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-shared-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow inbound HTTPS from within the VPC for the web tier.
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt LabVpc.CidrBlock
          Description: HTTPS from within the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-web-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref SharedRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowReadAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: '*'

  FirehoseInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  KinesisStreamsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the lab VPC.
    Value: !Ref LabVpc
  WebSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of web-tier subnet 1.
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1
  WebSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of web-tier subnet 2.
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2
  AppSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of application-tier subnet 1.
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1
  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of application-tier subnet 2.
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2
  WebSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the web-tier security group.
    Value: !Ref WebSecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Shared per-account IAM roles supporting multiple Amazon EKS cluster deployments
  driven by CloudFormation custom resources backed by Lambda functions. Creates
  Lambda execution roles for custom-resource handlers, the EKS control-plane role,
  the Fargate pod execution role, and managed/unmanaged node instance roles with
  matching instance profiles. All names derive from a single NamePrefix parameter.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-shared
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens (2-31 chars).
    Description: Common prefix used to derive all IAM role, instance profile, and resource names.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role: S3 asset-copy handler
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3CopyLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-s3-copy-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-s3-copy-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${NamePrefix}-s3-copy*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-s3-copy-lambda-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role: read arbitrary AWS resources handler
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReadResourcesLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-read-resources-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-read-resources-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:Get*
                  - s3:List*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:Get*
                  - iam:List*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:Get*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${NamePrefix}-read-resources*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-read-resources-lambda-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role: create VPC-related IAM role handler
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CreateVpcRoleLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-create-vpc-role-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-create-vpc-role-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${NamePrefix}-create-vpc-role*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-create-vpc-role-lambda-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role: S3 bucket-contents deletion handler
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3DeleteLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-s3-delete-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-s3-delete-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${NamePrefix}-s3-delete*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-s3-delete-lambda-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role: orphaned load balancer cleanup handler
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LbCleanupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-lb-cleanup-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-lb-cleanup-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroupRules
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${NamePrefix}-lb-cleanup*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-lb-cleanup-lambda-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role: leftover Lambda function cleanup handler
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaCleanupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-lambda-cleanup-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-lambda-cleanup-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:ListTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:RemovePermission
                  - lambda:DeleteEventSourceMapping
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:${NamePrefix}-*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${NamePrefix}-lambda-cleanup*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-lambda-cleanup-lambda-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role: caller-identity lookup handler
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CallerIdentityLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-caller-identity-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-caller-identity-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${NamePrefix}-caller-identity*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-caller-identity-lambda-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role: CloudFormation resource-provider-type registration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RegisterTypeLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-register-type-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-register-type-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:CreateResource
                  - cloudformation:DeleteResource
                  - cloudformation:GetResource
                  - cloudformation:ListResources
                  - cloudformation:UpdateResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${NamePrefix}-register-type*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-register-type-lambda-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role: SSM parameter resolution handler
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SsmResolveLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ssm-resolve-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ssm-resolve-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${NamePrefix}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${NamePrefix}-ssm-resolve*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ssm-resolve-lambda-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role: create the IAM role CloudFormation assumes for VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CreateCfnVpcRoleLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-create-cfn-vpc-role-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-create-cfn-vpc-role-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${NamePrefix}-create-cfn-vpc-role*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-create-cfn-vpc-role-lambda-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS control-plane IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EksClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-eks-cluster-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSVPCResourceController'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-eks-cluster-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Fargate pod execution IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EksFargatePodExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-eks-fargate-pod-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-eks-fargate-pod-execution-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed-node EC2 instance IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-managed-node-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemClientReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-managed-node-cfn-signal-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/${NamePrefix}-*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-managed-node-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Unmanaged-node EC2 instance IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-unmanaged-node-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemClientReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-unmanaged-node-cfn-signal-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/${NamePrefix}-*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-unmanaged-node-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref NamePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-managed-node-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeRole

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-unmanaged-node-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeRole

Outputs:

  S3CopyLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 asset-copy Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt S3CopyLambdaRole.Arn

  ReadResourcesLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the read-arbitrary-resources Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt ReadResourcesLambdaRole.Arn

  CreateVpcRoleLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the create-VPC-IAM-role Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt CreateVpcRoleLambdaRole.Arn

  S3DeleteLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket-contents-deletion Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt S3DeleteLambdaRole.Arn

  LbCleanupLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the orphaned-load-balancer cleanup Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt LbCleanupLambdaRole.Arn

  LambdaCleanupLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the leftover-Lambda-function cleanup Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaCleanupLambdaRole.Arn

  CallerIdentityLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the caller-identity lookup Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt CallerIdentityLambdaRole.Arn

  RegisterTypeLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the resource-provider-type registration Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt RegisterTypeLambdaRole.Arn

  SsmResolveLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SSM parameter resolution Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt SsmResolveLambdaRole.Arn

  CreateCfnVpcRoleLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the create-CloudFormation-VPC-role Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt CreateCfnVpcRoleLambdaRole.Arn

  EksClusterRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS control-plane IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt EksClusterRole.Arn

  EksFargatePodExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Fargate pod execution IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt EksFargatePodExecutionRole.Arn

  ManagedNodeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the managed-node EC2 instance IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeRole.Arn

  UnmanagedNodeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the unmanaged-node EC2 instance IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt UnmanagedNodeRole.Arn

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the managed-node instance profile
    Value: !Ref ManagedNodeInstanceProfile

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the unmanaged-node instance profile

    Type: String
    Description: Application name.

  Env:
    Type: String
    Description: Target environment name.
    Default: dev
  Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Workload name.
    Default: workload

  BsDynamoDBTableKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:

        - AttributeName: bs

        - AttributeName: bs
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt BsDynamoDBTableKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  BsDynamoDBManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb-policy'
      Description: !Sub 'Full CRUD access to the ${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb table and its indexes.'

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DynamoDBTableCrudAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt BsDynamoDBTable.Arn
              - !Sub '${BsDynamoDBTable.Arn}/index/*'

Outputs:
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref BsDynamoDBTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${App}-${Env}-${Name}-bs-dynamodb-table-name'

  DynamoDBManagedPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM managed policy granting access to the DynamoDB table.
