AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates a dedicated IAM user and group for sending email through Amazon SES via SMTP,
  an access key for that user, a least-privilege SES send policy, a Lambda-backed custom
  resource that derives the SES SMTP password from the secret access key, and stores the
  SMTP username/password as SecureString parameters in SSM Parameter Store. The SSM
  parameters are written by the Lambda (not by CloudFormation) and therefore survive
  stack updates and deletion. Physical IAM and SSM names are suffixed with the stack
  name so multiple stacks can coexist in the same account.

Parameters:
  IAMUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IAM username (alphanumeric and +=,.@_- characters).
    Description: >
      Prefix for the IAM user created for SES SMTP access. The final IAM user, group,
      policy, and SSM parameter names are suffixed with the stack name for uniqueness.

  AccessKeyRotationVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$'
    Description: >
      Rotation version. Bump this value to force the custom resource to re-run and
      re-derive/re-store the SMTP credentials.

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 365
    Description: Retention period (in days) for the Lambda function's CloudWatch log group.

  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(|arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:key/.+)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid KMS key ARN.
    Description: >
      Optional ARN of a customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the SSM SecureString
      parameters and the Lambda log group. Leave empty to use the in-template KMS key
      for the log group and the AWS-managed alias/aws/ssm key for the parameters. When
      supplied, the key policy must allow the CloudWatch Logs service principal
      (logs.<region>.amazonaws.com) to use the key for the log group.

  ApplicationTag:
    Type: String
    Default: SES-SMTP
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: Value for the Application tag applied to all taggable resources.

  EnvironmentTag:
    Type: String
    Default: Production
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: Value for the Environment tag applied to all taggable resources.

Conditions:
  UseCustomKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM user, group (with inline SES send policy), and membership
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SesSmtpUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Sub '${IAMUsername}-${AWS::StackName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationTag
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag

  SesSmtpGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${IAMUsername}-${AWS::StackName}-SES-SMTP-Group'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${IAMUsername}-${AWS::StackName}-SES-SMTP-SendPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowSesSendEmailWithMfa
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:configuration-set/*'
                Condition:
                  Bool:
                    'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'true'
              - Sid: AllowSesSendEmailProgrammatic
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:configuration-set/*'

  SesSmtpUserToGroupAddition:
    Type: AWS::IAM::UserToGroupAddition
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Ref SesSmtpGroup
      Users:
        - !Ref SesSmtpUser

  SesSmtpAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref SesSmtpUser
      Status: Active

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # In-template KMS key used to encrypt the Lambda log group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SmtpCredentialLogGroupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for the SES SMTP credential Lambda log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationTag
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag

  SmtpCredentialLogGroupKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-ses-smtp-log-group'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SmtpCredentialLogGroupKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role and log group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SmtpCredentialLambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-ses-smtp-credential'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !If
        - UseCustomKmsKey
        - !Ref KmsKeyArn
        - !GetAtt SmtpCredentialLogGroupKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationTag
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag

  SmtpCredentialLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ses-smtp-credential-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SesSmtpCredentialLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteSmtpParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/ses-smtp/${IAMUsername}-${AWS::StackName}/*'
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt SmtpCredentialLambdaLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${SmtpCredentialLambdaLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: WriteXRayTraces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: UseLogGroupKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt SmtpCredentialLogGroupKey.Arn
              - !If
                - UseCustomKmsKey
                - Sid: UseCustomKmsKey
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - kms:Encrypt
                    - kms:GenerateDataKey
                    - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                    - kms:Decrypt
                  Resource:
                    - !Ref KmsKeyArn
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationTag
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda function implementing AWS's SES SMTP credential conversion algorithm,
  # persisting the results as SSM SecureString parameters, and responding to
  # CloudFormation via the pre-signed ResponseURL.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SmtpCredentialLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - SmtpCredentialLambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ses-smtp-credential'
      Description: Derives an SES SMTP password from an IAM secret access key and stores it in SSM.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Architectures:
        - x86_64
      Role: !GetAtt SmtpCredentialLambdaRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64
          import hashlib
          import hmac
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)


          def _sign(key, msg):
              return hmac.new(key, msg.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).digest()


          def _derive_smtp_password(secret_access_key, region):
              date = "11111111"
              service = "ses"
              terminal = "aws4_request"
              message = "SendRawEmail"
              version = b"\x04"

              signature = _sign(("AWS4" + secret_access_key).encode("utf-8"), date)
              signature = _sign(signature, region)
              signature = _sign(signature, service)
              signature = _sign(signature, terminal)
              signature = _sign(signature, message)

              return base64.b64encode(version + signature).decode("utf-8")


          def _put_secure_parameter(ssm_client, name, value, kms_key_arn):
              kwargs = {
                  "Name": name,
                  "Value": value,
                  "Type": "SecureString",
                  "Overwrite": True,
              }
              if kms_key_arn:
                  kwargs["KeyId"] = kms_key_arn
              ssm_client.put_parameter(**kwargs)


          def _send_response(event, status, data=None, physical_id=None, reason=None):
              response_url = event.get("ResponseURL")
              body = {
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": (reason or "See CloudWatch Logs for details")[:4000],
                  "PhysicalResourceId": physical_id
                  or event.get("PhysicalResourceId")
                  or "ses-smtp-credential",
                  "StackId": event.get("StackId"),
                  "RequestId": event.get("RequestId"),
                  "LogicalResourceId": event.get("LogicalResourceId"),
                  "Data": data or {},
              }
              payload = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
              logger.info("Sending response to %s with status %s", response_url, status)
              if not response_url:
                  logger.error("No ResponseURL present in event; cannot signal CloudFormation")
                  return
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  response_url,
                  data=payload,
                  method="PUT",
                  headers={"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(payload))},
              )
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as resp:
                      logger.info("CloudFormation response PUT returned HTTP %s", resp.status)
              except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                  logger.exception("Failed to PUT response to CloudFormation ResponseURL")


          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(
                  "Received event: %s",
                  json.dumps({k: v for k, v in event.items() if k != "ResourceProperties"}),
              )
              request_type = event.get("RequestType")
              properties = event.get("ResourceProperties", {}) or {}
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or "ses-smtp-credential"

              if request_type == "Delete":
                  _send_response(event, "SUCCESS", data={}, physical_id=physical_id)
                  return

              try:
                  access_key_id = properties["AccessKeyId"]
                  secret_access_key = properties["SecretAccessKey"]
                  region = properties["Region"]
                  iam_username = properties["IAMUsername"]
                  rotation_version = properties.get("RotationVersion", "1")
                  parameter_prefix = properties.get("ParameterPrefix") or "/ses-smtp/{}".format(iam_username)
                  kms_key_arn = properties.get("KmsKeyArn") or ""

                  smtp_password = _derive_smtp_password(secret_access_key, region)

                  username_param_name = "{}/username".format(parameter_prefix)
                  password_param_name = "{}/password".format(parameter_prefix)

                  ssm_client = boto3.client("ssm", region_name=region)
                  _put_secure_parameter(ssm_client, username_param_name, access_key_id, kms_key_arn)
                  _put_secure_parameter(ssm_client, password_param_name, smtp_password, kms_key_arn)

                  physical_id = "ses-smtp-credential-{}-{}".format(iam_username, rotation_version)

                  data = {
                      "SmtpUsername": access_key_id,
                      "SmtpPassword": smtp_password,
                      "SmtpUsernameParameterName": username_param_name,
                      "SmtpPasswordParameterName": password_param_name,
                  }
                  _send_response(event, "SUCCESS", data=data, physical_id=physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                  logger.exception("Failed to derive and store SMTP credentials")
                  _send_response(
                      event,
                      "FAILED",
                      physical_id=physical_id,
                      reason=str(exc),
                  )
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationTag
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom resource that derives the SMTP credentials and writes them to SSM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SmtpCredentialCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SmtpCredentialLambda.Arn
      ServiceTimeout: 300
      AccessKeyId: !Ref SesSmtpAccessKey
      SecretAccessKey: !GetAtt SesSmtpAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
      IAMUsername: !Ref IAMUsername
      Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      RotationVersion: !Ref AccessKeyRotationVersion
      ParameterPrefix: !Sub '/ses-smtp/${IAMUsername}-${AWS::StackName}'
      KmsKeyArn: !If
        - UseCustomKmsKey
        - !Ref KmsKeyArn
        - ''

    Value: !Ref SesSmtpUser

    Description: Name of the IAM group created for SES SMTP access.

  AccessKeyId:
    Description: Access key ID of the IAM user (also used as the SES SMTP username).

  SmtpUsernameParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM SecureString parameter holding the SES SMTP username.

  SmtpCredentialLambdaArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function that derives the SES SMTP credentials.
    Value: !GetAtt SmtpCredentialLambda.Arn

  LogGroupKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the in-template KMS key used to encrypt the Lambda log group.
    Value: !GetAtt SmtpCredentialLogGroupKey.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API (API Gateway v2) backed by a single Python Lambda for live grant-processing job status updates, with DynamoDB connection tracking, KMS-encrypted environment variables, and API Gateway CloudWatch logging.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Name of the API Gateway WebSocket stage to deploy.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key #3: encrypts the DynamoDB connections table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TableKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key used to encrypt the DynamoDB connections table.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  TableKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TableKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table for connection tracking and job status
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConnectionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TableKmsKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key #1: encrypts Lambda environment variables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EnvVarKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key used to encrypt the WebSocket Lambda environment variables.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  EnvVarKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-lambda-env'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EnvVarKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key #2: encrypts the API Gateway CloudWatch Logs log group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key used to encrypt API Gateway CloudWatch Logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  LogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-apigw-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogsKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs log group for API Gateway access logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}/websocket-access'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role for API Gateway account-level CloudWatch logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:GetLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:FilterLogEvents'
                Resource: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:GetLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:FilterLogEvents'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/*'

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBConnectionsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'dynamodb:GetItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:PutItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:UpdateItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:DeleteItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:Query'
                  - 'dynamodb:Scan'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ConnectionsTable.Arn}/index/*'
        - PolicyName: EnvVarKmsDecrypt
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                Resource: !GetAtt EnvVarKmsKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: TableKmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt TableKmsKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: XRayTracing
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'xray:PutTraceSegments'
                  - 'xray:PutTelemetryRecords'
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-handler'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt EnvVarKmsKey.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CONNECTIONS_TABLE: !Ref ConnectionsTable
          CONNECTIONS_TABLE_ARN: !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["CONNECTIONS_TABLE"]
          ddb = boto3.client("dynamodb")

          def handler(event, context):
              route = event.get("requestContext", {}).get("routeKey")
              connection_id = event.get("requestContext", {}).get("connectionId")

              if route == "$connect":
                  ddb.put_item(
                      TableName=TABLE_NAME,
                      Item={"connectionId": {"S": connection_id}},
                  )
                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "connected"}

              if route == "$disconnect":
                  ddb.delete_item(
                      TableName=TABLE_NAME,
                      Key={"connectionId": {"S": connection_id}},
                  )
                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "disconnected"}

              if route == "sendMessage":
                  body = event.get("body") or "{}"
                  try:
                      payload = json.loads(body)
                  except json.JSONDecodeError:
                      payload = {"message": body}
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 200,
                      "body": json.dumps(
                          {"type": "message", "connectionId": connection_id, "payload": payload}
                      ),
                  }

              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({"type": "default", "connectionId": connection_id}),
              }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # WebSocket API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Integrations (AWS_PROXY) to the Lambda function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      IntegrationMethod: POST

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      IntegrationMethod: POST

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      IntegrationMethod: POST

  SendMessageIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      IntegrationMethod: POST

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Routes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$connect'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$disconnect'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$default'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DefaultIntegration}'

  SendMessageRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: sendMessage
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${SendMessageIntegration}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda permissions for each route
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConnectPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/$connect'

  DisconnectPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/$disconnect'

  DefaultPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/$default'

  SendMessagePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/sendMessage'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Stage with auto-deploy and access logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: >-
          {"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status","connectionId":"$context.connectionId","errorMessage":"$context.error.messageString"}

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: WebSocket API connection URL (ApiEndpoint).
    Value: !GetAtt WebSocketApi.ApiEndpoint

  WssEndpoint:
    Description: Secure WSS endpoint URL for the deployed stage.
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi.ApiEndpoint}/${StageName}'

  ApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the WebSocket API.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}::/apis/${WebSocketApi}'

  ConnectionsTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB connections table.
    Value: !Ref ConnectionsTable

  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the WebSocket handler Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates standard AWS IAM Identity Center permission sets for centralized
  administrative access control (Administrator, PowerUser, OrganizationsFull,
  and ReadOnly). Permission sets are created only when an IAM Identity Center
  instance ARN is supplied via the InstanceArn parameter; with the default
  empty value the stack deploys successfully and creates only the anchor
  resource, skipping all SSO resources.

Parameters:
  InstanceArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      ARN of the IAM Identity Center instance under which to create the
      permission sets. Leave empty to deploy without creating any permission sets.

  DefaultSessionDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: 'PT12H'
    AllowedPattern: '^P(T\d+H|T\d+M|T\d+H\d+M)$'
    ConstraintDescription: >
      Must be an ISO-8601 duration such as PT12H, PT30M, or PT1H30M.
    Description: Session duration for the permission sets in ISO-8601 format.

  LogicalName:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions IAM roles and an instance profile to support a CodeDeploy and CodePipeline based release pipeline demo (EC2 instance role/profile, CodeDeploy service role, CodePipeline service role, and an S3 artifact bucket with KMS encryption and access logging).

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    Description: Name used to tag resources in this release pipeline demo.

Resources:
  PipelineArtifactBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting CodePipeline artifact bucket objects.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PipelineArtifactBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-pipeline-artifacts'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref PipelineArtifactBucketKey

  PipelineArtifactLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}-pipeline-artifact-logs'
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerPreferred
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PipelineArtifactLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PipelineArtifactLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${PipelineArtifactLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt PipelineArtifactBucket.Arn

  PipelineArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}-pipeline-artifacts'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineArtifactBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref PipelineArtifactLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: access-logs/
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ec2-instance-role'
      Description: EC2 instance role granting broad administrative access for testing/demo purposes only.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ec2-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole

  CodeDeployServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-codedeploy-service-role'
      Description: CodeDeploy service role for blue/green deployments across us-east-1 and us-west-2.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codedeploy.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ForAnyValue:StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codedeploy:us-east-1:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codedeploy:us-west-2:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeDeployEC2AndAutoScalingPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EC2DescribePermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AutoScalingLifecycleHookPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:CompleteLifecycleAction
                  - autoscaling:PutLifecycleHook
                  - autoscaling:DeleteLifecycleHook
                  - autoscaling:RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:EnterStandby
                  - autoscaling:ExitStandby
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  CodePipelineServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-codepipeline-service-role'
      Description: CodePipeline service role for artifact storage and orchestration across deployment services.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codepipeline.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodePipelineArtifactS3Permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ArtifactBucketLevel
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PipelineArtifactBucket.Arn
              - Sid: S3ArtifactObjectLevel
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${PipelineArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: ArtifactBucketKMSAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PipelineArtifactBucketKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: CodePipelineOrchestrationPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ElasticBeanstalkPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticbeanstalk:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EC2Permissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:*
                  - autoscaling:*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - logs:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudFormationPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RDSPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SQSPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ECSPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CodeDeployPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codedeploy:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LambdaPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IAMPassRolePermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt EC2InstanceRole.Arn
                  - !GetAtt CodeDeployServiceRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  EC2InstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the EC2 instance profile for pipeline demo instances.
    Value: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile

  EC2InstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 instance profile for pipeline demo instances.
    Value: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn

  EC2InstanceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 instance role.
    Value: !GetAtt EC2InstanceRole.Arn

  CodeDeployServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodeDeploy service role.
    Value: !GetAtt CodeDeployServiceRole.Arn

  CodePipelineServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodePipeline service role.
    Value: !GetAtt CodePipelineServiceRole.Arn

  PipelineArtifactBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket used for pipeline artifacts.
    Value: !Ref PipelineArtifactBucket

  PipelineArtifactBucketArn:

  PipelineArtifactBucketKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key used to encrypt pipeline artifacts.
    Value: !GetAtt PipelineArtifactBucketKey.Arn

  PipelineArtifactBucketKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the customer managed KMS key used to encrypt pipeline artifacts.
    Value: !Ref PipelineArtifactBucketKeyAlias

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless webhook handler wiring Stripe payments and Squarespace Commerce to Slack notifications via SNS.

Parameters:
  SquarespaceApiToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    MinLength: 1
    Default: REPLACE_ME_SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN
    Description: >-
      Squarespace Commerce API token used to look up orders and inventory.
      The default is a non-secret sentinel placeholder only; operators MUST
      override it at deploy time (e.g. --parameter-overrides). The Lambda
      fails fast if the sentinel is still in place.
  StripeWebhookSigningSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    MinLength: 1
    Default: REPLACE_ME_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET
    Description: >-
      Stripe webhook signing secret used to verify incoming webhook events.
      The default is a non-secret sentinel placeholder only; operators MUST
      override it at deploy time (e.g. --parameter-overrides). The Lambda
      fails fast if the sentinel is still in place.

Resources:
  WebhookKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the Stripe/Squarespace webhook handler.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSecretsManagerUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: secretsmanager.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StripeSquarespaceWebhook
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod

  WebhookKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/stripe-squarespace-webhook
      TargetKeyId: !Ref WebhookKmsKey

  SlackNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: Stripe-Squarespace Sales Notifications
      TopicName: stripe-squarespace-sales-notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt WebhookKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StripeSquarespaceWebhook
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod

  WebhookSecrets:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: stripe-squarespace-webhook-secrets
      Description: Secrets for the Stripe/Squarespace webhook handler.
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt WebhookKmsKey.Arn

      ManagedPolicyArns:

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PublishToSlackTopic
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SlackNotificationTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt WebhookKmsKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: ReadWebhookSecrets
          PolicyDocument:

                Resource: !Ref WebhookSecrets
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

                Resource: !GetAtt WebhookKmsKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: XRayTracing
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StripeSquarespaceWebhook
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod

  WebhookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: stripe-squarespace-webhook-handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt WebhookFunctionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SlackNotificationTopic
          SECRET_ARN: !Ref WebhookSecrets
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import urllib.request
          import boto3

          sns = boto3.client("sns")
          secretsmanager = boto3.client("secretsmanager")

          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ["SNS_TOPIC_ARN"]
          SECRET_ARN = os.environ["SECRET_ARN"]
          SQUARESPACE_BASE_URL = "https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce"

          SQUARESPACE_TOKEN_SENTINEL = "REPLACE_ME_SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN"
          STRIPE_SECRET_SENTINEL = "REPLACE_ME_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET"

          _cached_secrets = None


          def get_secrets():
              global _cached_secrets
              if _cached_secrets is None:
                  resp = secretsmanager.get_secret_value(SecretId=SECRET_ARN)
                  _cached_secrets = json.loads(resp["SecretString"])
              return _cached_secrets


          def validate_secrets(secrets):
              if secrets.get("squarespaceApiToken") == SQUARESPACE_TOKEN_SENTINEL:
                  raise RuntimeError(
                      "SquarespaceApiToken is still the placeholder default; "
                      "supply a real value at deploy time"
                  )
              if secrets.get("stripeWebhookSigningSecret") == STRIPE_SECRET_SENTINEL:
                  raise RuntimeError(
                      "StripeWebhookSigningSecret is still the placeholder default; "
                      "supply a real value at deploy time"
                  )


          def squarespace_get(path, token):
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  SQUARESPACE_BASE_URL + path,
                  headers={
                      "Authorization": "Bearer " + token,
                      "User-Agent": "stripe-squarespace-webhook",
                      "Accept": "application/json",
                  },
                  method="GET",
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
                  return json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))


          def find_order(event, token):
              data = event.get("data", {}).get("object", {})
              order_id = data.get("id") or data.get("metadata", {}).get("squarespaceOrderId")
              if order_id:
                  try:
                      return squarespace_get("/orders/" + str(order_id), token)
                  except Exception:
                      pass
              try:
                  listing = squarespace_get("/orders?fulfillmentStatus=PENDING", token)
                  results = listing.get("result", [])
                  if results:
                      return results[0]
              except Exception:
                  pass
              return {}


          def format_message(event, order):
              data = event.get("data", {}).get("object", {})
              amount = data.get("amount_total") or data.get("amount") or 0
              currency = (data.get("currency") or "usd").upper()
              customer = data.get("customer_details", {}).get("email") or data.get("customer") or "unknown"
              order_number = order.get("orderNumber") or data.get("id") or "unknown"
              line_items = order.get("lineItems", [])
              items = []
              for item in line_items:
                  name = item.get("productName") or item.get("sku") or "item"
                  qty = item.get("quantity", 1)
                  items.append(f"{qty}x {name}")
              items_text = ", ".join(items) if items else "n/a"
              return (
                  ":moneybag: New sale received\n"
                  f"Order: {order_number}\n"
                  f"Customer: {customer}\n"
                  f"Amount: {amount} {currency}\n"
                  f"Items: {items_text}"
              )


          def handler(event, context):
              secrets = get_secrets()
              validate_secrets(secrets)
              token = secrets["squarespaceApiToken"]
              order = find_order(event, token)
              message = format_message(event, order)
              sns.publish(
                  TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN,
                  Subject="New Stripe/Squarespace sale",
                  Message=message,
              )
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"status": "ok"}),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StripeSquarespaceWebhook
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod

      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'

        - Key: Application

  WebhookApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: stripe-squarespace-webhook-api-key

      Enabled: true

        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod

  WebhookUsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan

      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StripeSquarespaceWebhook
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod

Outputs:

    Description: Invoke URL for the POST /webhooks endpoint on the prod stage.
    Value: !Sub https://${StripeSquarespaceWebhookApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/prod/webhooks

    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key used to encrypt stack resources.
    Value: !GetAtt WebhookKmsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Supporting infrastructure for Route 53 hosted zone testing - two independent VPCs, two CloudWatch log groups, CMK encryption, and VPC flow logs.

Resources:
  LogGroupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt CloudWatch log groups for Route 53 hosted zone testing.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt Vpc1FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${Vpc1FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
                  - !GetAtt Vpc2FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${Vpc2FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  Route53HostedZoneTestVpc1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-route53-hz-test-vpc-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: svcrolegensupport
        - Key: Project
          Value: svcrolegensupport

  Route53HostedZoneTestVpc2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-route53-hz-test-vpc-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: svcrolegensupport
        - Key: Project
          Value: svcrolegensupport

  Route53HostedZoneTestLogGroup1:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/svcrolegensupport/${AWS::StackName}/route53-hostedzone-test-1'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogGroupKmsKey.Arn

  Route53HostedZoneTestLogGroup2:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/svcrolegensupport/${AWS::StackName}/route53-hostedzone-test-2'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogGroupKmsKey.Arn

  Vpc1FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/svcrolegensupport/${AWS::StackName}/vpc-flow-logs-1'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogGroupKmsKey.Arn

  Vpc2FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/svcrolegensupport/${AWS::StackName}/vpc-flow-logs-2'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogGroupKmsKey.Arn

  Vpc1FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Route53HostedZoneTestVpc1
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt Vpc1FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log-1'

  Vpc2FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Route53HostedZoneTestVpc2
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt Vpc2FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log-2'

Outputs:
  Route53HostedZoneVpc1:
    Description: Reference to the first test VPC for Route 53 hosted zone association.
    Value: !Ref Route53HostedZoneTestVpc1
    Export:
      Name: svcrolegensupport-AWS-Route53-HostedZone-VPC

  Route53HostedZoneVpc2:
    Description: Reference to the second test VPC for Route 53 hosted zone association.
    Value: !Ref Route53HostedZoneTestVpc2
    Export:
      Name: svcrolegensupport-AWS-Route53-HostedZone-VPC2

  Route53HostedZoneLogGroup1:
    Description: ARN of the first test CloudWatch log group.
    Value: !GetAtt Route53HostedZoneTestLogGroup1.Arn
    Export:
      Name: svcrolegensupport-AWS-Route53-HostedZone-LogGroup

    Description: ARN of the second test CloudWatch log group.
    Value: !GetAtt Route53HostedZoneTestLogGroup2.Arn
    Export:
      Name: svcrolegensupport-AWS-Route53-HostedZone-LogGroup2

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: On-demand DynamoDB orders table with optional DAX caching cluster and supporting VPC networking for lab testing. The orders table is encrypted at rest with the customer-managed KMS key OrdersTableKey via SSESpecification.KmsKeyId.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: saa-lab-05
    Description: Project name used as a prefix for resource names and exports.
  EnableDax:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to deploy the DAX cluster and supporting resources.
  DaxReplicationFactor:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
    Description: Number of nodes in the DAX cluster.

Conditions:
  DaxEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableDax, 'true']

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.50.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet-1'
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.50.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet-2'
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ClientSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Client security group for DAX access
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-client-sg'
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  DaxSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: DAX security group allowing access from client security group
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8111
          ToPort: 8111
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ClientSecurityGroup
          Description: DAX port access from client security group
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-sg'
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  LogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for CloudWatch Logs encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  LogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/${ProjectName}-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-flow-logs-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  OrdersTableKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for the DynamoDB orders table
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  OrdersTableKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-orders-table'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref OrdersTableKey

  OrdersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-orders'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: orderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: orderId
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KmsKeyId: !GetAtt OrdersTableKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  DaxSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DAX::SubnetGroup
    Condition: DaxEnabled
    Properties:
      SubnetGroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-subnets'
      Description: DAX subnet group for the orders cache cluster
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2

  DaxRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: DaxEnabled
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dax.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-dynamodb-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${OrdersTable.Arn}/index/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  DaxCluster:
    Type: AWS::DAX::Cluster
    Condition: DaxEnabled
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax'
      NodeType: dax.t3.small
      ReplicationFactor: !Ref DaxReplicationFactor
      IAMRoleARN: !GetAtt DaxRole.Arn
      SubnetGroupName: !Ref DaxSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DaxSecurityGroup
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB orders table
    Value: !Ref OrdersTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::Region}-orders-table-name'

  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB orders table
    Value: !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::Region}-orders-table-arn'

  DaxStatus:
    Description: Whether the DAX cluster is enabled
    Value: !If [DaxEnabled, 'enabled', 'disabled']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::Region}-dax-status'

  ClientSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the client security group
    Value: !Ref ClientSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::Region}-client-sg-id'

  DaxDiscoveryEndpoint:
    Description: DAX cluster discovery endpoint, or disabled when DAX is not enabled
    Value: !If [DaxEnabled, !GetAtt DaxCluster.ClusterDiscoveryEndpoint, 'disabled']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}-dax-discovery-endpoint'
