AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained ElastiCache for Redis (cluster mode enabled) resilience test environment with its own VPC, private subnets across two AZs, KMS-encrypted replication group, encrypted SNS topic, and an IAM role for SSM Automation signals.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet (AZ index 0).
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet (AZ index 1).
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  RedisPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6379
    Description: Port used for Redis traffic between the private subnets.
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-vpc'

  VpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-vpc-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-vpc-flow-log-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogsToLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn}:log-stream:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-vpc-flow-log-role'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-vpc-flow-log'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-private-subnet-2'

  RedisSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Permit Redis traffic between the private subnets in this stack.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref RedisPort
          ToPort: !Ref RedisPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          Description: Redis access from private subnet 1.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref RedisPort
          ToPort: !Ref RedisPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          Description: Redis access from private subnet 2.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-sg'

  RedisSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref RedisSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Ref RedisPort
      ToPort: !Ref RedisPort
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref RedisSecurityGroup
      Description: Self-referencing Redis access within the security group.

  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-subnet-group'
      Description: Private subnets across two AZs for the ElastiCache Redis resilience test environment.
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for ElastiCache at-rest and in-transit encryption, SNS topic encryption, and CloudWatch Logs encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowElastiCacheUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticache.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowSnsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  EncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  RedisReplicationGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ReplicationGroupDescription: ElastiCache Redis cluster mode enabled replication group for resilience testing.
      Engine: redis
      CacheNodeType: cache.t3.medium
      NumNodeGroups: 2
      ReplicasPerNodeGroup: 1
      ClusterMode: enabled
      MultiAZEnabled: true
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      AtRestEncryptionEnabled: true
      TransitEncryptionEnabled: true
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref ElastiCacheSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref RedisSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-replication-group'

  NotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-alarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-alarms'

  NotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref NotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  AutomationSignalRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-ssm-automation-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmAutomationAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SendAutomationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SendAutomationSignal
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-test-ssm-automation-role'

Outputs:
  ReplicationGroupConfigurationEndpoint:
    Description: Configuration endpoint address of the cluster-mode-enabled ElastiCache Redis replication group.
    Value: !GetAtt RedisReplicationGroup.ConfigurationEndPoint.Address
  NotificationTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS-encrypted SNS topic for alarm notifications.
    Value: !Ref NotificationTopic
  EncryptionKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used for encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC created for the test environment.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
  AutomationSignalRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used to send SSM Automation signals.
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationSignalRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL API for a simple songs service with IAM auth, X-Ray tracing, DynamoDB storage, and a two-step addSong pipeline resolver.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for tagging resources.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,32}$'

Resources:
  SongsTableKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the songs DynamoDB table.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SongsTableKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/songs-${EnvironmentName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SongsTableKey

  SongsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'songs-${EnvironmentName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SongsTableKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: Service role for AppSync songs API to access the songs DynamoDB table.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SongsTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt SongsTableKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SongsGraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'songs-api-${EnvironmentName}'
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SongsGraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          artist: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song]
        }

        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String!): Song
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  SongsDynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: SongsDynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref SongsTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        UseCallerCredentials: false

  NoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: NoneDataSource
      Type: NONE

  ValidateArtistFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: validateArtist
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt NoneDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": {
            "name": $util.toJson($ctx.args.name),
            "artist": $util.toJson($ctx.args.artist)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($artist = $ctx.args.artist)
        #if($util.isNullOrEmpty($artist))
          $util.error("Artist is required.", "ValidationError")
        #elseif(!$artist.matches("^[A-Za-z]+$"))
          $util.error("Artist must contain only letters.", "ValidationError")
        #end
        $util.toJson($ctx.prev.result)

  AddSongFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: addSongToDynamoDB
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsDynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($util.autoId())
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "name": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.name),
            "artist": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.artist)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  AddSongResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - SongsGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addSong
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ValidateArtistFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt AddSongFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": {}
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  GetSongsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - SongsGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getSongs
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsDynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Scan",
          "limit": 1000
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result.items)

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: The ID of the AppSync GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId

  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: The URL of the AppSync GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl

  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: The ARN of the AppSync GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.Arn

  SongsTableName:
    Description: The name of the DynamoDB songs table.
    Value: !Ref SongsTable

  SongsTableKeyArn:
    Description: The ARN of the customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the songs table.
    Value: !GetAtt SongsTableKey.Arn

  AppSyncServiceRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the AppSync service role.
    Value: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito user pool (email sign-in) with a regional REST API protected by a Cognito authorizer, backed by a single Lambda function, deployed to a prod stage.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: email-auth-user-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: email-auth-app-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lambda-basic-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  IdentityFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: cognito-identity-function
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              request_context = event.get("requestContext", {}) or {}
              authorizer = request_context.get("authorizer", {}) or {}
              claims = authorizer.get("claims", {}) or {}

              if claims:
                  identity = {
                      "authenticated": True,
                      "sub": claims.get("sub"),
                      "email": claims.get("email"),
                      "username": claims.get("cognito:username"),
                      "token_use": claims.get("token_use"),
                      "claims": claims,
                  }
              else:
                  identity = {
                      "authenticated": False,
                      "sub": None,
                      "email": None,
                      "username": None,
                      "token_use": None,
                      "claims": {},
                  }

              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(identity),
              }

  IdentityFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref IdentityFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/*

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: cognito-identity-api
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: cognito-user-pool-authorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  MeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: me

  MeMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IdentityFunction.Arn}/invocations

  OpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open

  OpenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref OpenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IdentityFunction.Arn}/invocations

  RestApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MeMethod
      - OpenMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment for prod stage

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  LogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting API Gateway access logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/cognito-identity-api-prod

  LogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cognito-identity-api-logs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogsKmsKey

  AccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn:
      - LogsKmsKey
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/apigateway/cognito-identity-api-prod
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

      TracingEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt AccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: >-

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: cognito-identity-api-key
      Enabled: true
      StageKeys:
        - RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
          StageName: !Ref ProdStage

  UsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    Properties:
      UsagePlanName: cognito-identity-usage-plan
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref RestApi
          Stage: !Ref ProdStage

  UsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref ApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref UsagePlan

    Description: API key ID for the unauthenticated /open endpoint
    Value: !Ref ApiKey

  LogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the CMK used to encrypt API Gateway access logs
    Value: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Connects this AWS account to the marbot.io monitoring and alerting service.
  Creates an EventBridge connection, API destination, keep-alive scheduled rule,
  an EventBridge invocation role, a cross-account role for marbot (gated by
  feature flags), an optional permissions boundary, and a custom resource that
  registers the account connection with marbot.

Parameters:
  MarbotEndpointId:
    Type: String
    Description: The marbot endpoint identifier used to authenticate and route requests to marbot.io. Override the placeholder default with your real endpoint ID at deploy time.
    Default: changeme
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._\-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid marbot endpoint identifier (alphanumeric, dot, dash, underscore).

  EnableAutoMonitoring:
    Type: String
    Description: Allow marbot to automatically configure CloudWatch alarms and EventBridge monitoring rules across resources.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

  EnableAccountAlias:
    Type: String
    Description: Allow marbot to enrich account IDs with friendly account aliases.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

  EnableMetricGraphs:
    Type: String
    Description: Allow marbot to embed metric graphs into CloudWatch alarm notifications.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

  EnableCodePipelineApproval:
    Type: String
    Description: Allow marbot to approve or reject CodePipeline manual approval requests.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

Conditions:
  AutoMonitoringEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAutoMonitoring, 'true']
  AccountAliasEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAccountAlias, 'true']
  MetricGraphsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableMetricGraphs, 'true']
  CodePipelineApprovalEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableCodePipelineApproval, 'true']

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge Connection (API key auth derived from the endpoint ID)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotConnection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-${AWS::StackName}-${MarbotEndpointId}'
      Description: Connection to the marbot.io monitoring and alerting service.
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: x-api-key
          ApiKeyValue: !Sub '${MarbotEndpointId}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge API Destination targeting marbot
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-${AWS::StackName}-apidesination-${MarbotEndpointId}'
      Description: API destination for the marbot.io monitoring and alerting service.
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt MarbotConnection.Arn
      HttpMethod: POST
      InvocationRateLimitPerSecond: 1
      InvocationEndpoint: !Sub 'https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoints/${MarbotEndpointId}/events'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role EventBridge assumes to invoke the API destination
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeInvocationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: Allows EventBridge to invoke the marbot API destination.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeMarbotApiDestination
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:InvokeApiDestination
                Resource: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scheduled keep-alive rule (every 30 days)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotKeepAliveRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-${AWS::StackName}-keepalive-${MarbotEndpointId}'
      Description: Posts account and stack identification details to marbot every 30 days.
      ScheduleExpression: rate(30 days)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: MarbotKeepAliveTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvocationRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub
            - '{"endpointId":"${EndpointId}","accountId":"${AccountId}","stackId":"${StackId}","stackName":"${StackName}","region":"${Region}","action":"keepalive"}'
            - EndpointId: !Ref MarbotEndpointId
              AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              StackId: !Ref 'AWS::StackId'
              StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
              Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Permissions boundary for the cross-account role (only when auto monitoring)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotRolePermissionsBoundary:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: AutoMonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'marbot-${AWS::StackName}-role-boundary-${MarbotEndpointId}'
      Description: Permissions boundary restricting the marbot cross-account role's own resource management.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowMonitoringActions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
              - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory
              - cloudwatch:PutDashboard
              - cloudwatch:GetDashboard
              - cloudwatch:ListDashboards
              - cloudwatch:DeleteDashboards
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
              - events:PutRule
              - events:DeleteRule
              - events:DescribeRule
              - events:PutTargets
              - events:RemoveTargets
              - events:ListRules
              - events:ListTargetsByRule
              - events:TagResource
              - events:UntagResource
              - iam:ListAccountAliases
              - organizations:DescribeAccount
              - codepipeline:GetPipeline
              - codepipeline:ListPipelines
              - codepipeline:PutApprovalResult
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyIamAndOrgEscalation
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - iam:CreateUser
              - iam:CreateRole
              - iam:CreatePolicy
              - iam:CreatePolicyVersion
              - iam:AttachRolePolicy
              - iam:AttachUserPolicy
              - iam:PutRolePolicy
              - iam:PutUserPolicy
              - iam:PutRolePermissionsBoundary
              - iam:PutUserPermissionsBoundary
              - iam:DeleteRolePermissionsBoundary
              - iam:DeleteUserPermissionsBoundary
              - iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
              - iam:PassRole
              - organizations:CreateAccount
              - organizations:InviteAccountToOrganization
              - organizations:RemoveAccountFromOrganization
              - organizations:LeaveOrganization
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cross-account role marbot assumes to monitor on our behalf
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotCrossAccountRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'marbot-${AWS::StackName}-monitoring-${MarbotEndpointId}'
      Description: Cross-account role assumed by marbot.io to monitor this account.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - AutoMonitoringEnabled
        - !Ref MarbotRolePermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: 'arn:aws:iam::634134578715:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: !Sub '${AWS::StackId}-${MarbotEndpointId}'
      Policies:
        - !If
          - AutoMonitoringEnabled
          - PolicyName: MarbotAutoMonitoring
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: ManageCloudWatchAlarms
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                    - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                    - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                    - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory
                    - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                    - cloudwatch:PutDashboard
                    - cloudwatch:GetDashboard
                    - cloudwatch:ListDashboards
                    - cloudwatch:DeleteDashboards
                  Resource: '*'
                - Sid: ManageEventBridgeRules
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - events:PutRule
                    - events:DeleteRule
                    - events:DescribeRule
                    - events:PutTargets
                    - events:RemoveTargets
                    - events:ListRules
                    - events:ListTargetsByRule
                    - events:TagResource
                    - events:UntagResource
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - AccountAliasEnabled
          - PolicyName: MarbotAccountAlias
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: ReadAccountAliases
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - iam:ListAccountAliases
                    - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - MetricGraphsEnabled
          - PolicyName: MarbotMetricGraphs
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: EmbedMetricGraphs
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage
                    - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                    - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - CodePipelineApprovalEnabled
          - PolicyName: MarbotCodePipelineApproval
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: ApproveCodePipelineRequests
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - codepipeline:GetPipeline
                    - codepipeline:ListPipelines
                    - codepipeline:PutApprovalResult
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role for the registration custom resource
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotRegistrationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: Execution role for the marbot registration custom resource function.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MarbotRegistrationLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda function backing the registration custom resource
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotRegistrationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'marbot-${AWS::StackName}-registration-${MarbotEndpointId}'
      Description: Registers this account connection with the marbot.io service.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Role: !GetAtt MarbotRegistrationFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.error
          import urllib.request

          def send(event, context, status, data=None, physical_id=None, reason=None):
              body = {
                  "Status": status,
                  "PhysicalResourceId": physical_id or event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
              }
              if data is not None:
                  body["Data"] = data
              if reason is not None:
                  body["Reason"] = reason
              payload = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=payload,
                  method="PUT",
                  headers={"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(payload))},
              )
              urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)

          def handler(event, context):
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              endpoint_id = props.get("EndpointId")
              account_id = props.get("AccountId")
              stack_id = props.get("StackId")
              physical_id = "marbot-registration-%s" % endpoint_id

              if not event.get("ResponseURL"):
                  raise ValueError("Missing ResponseURL; cannot signal CloudFormation")

              request_type = event.get("RequestType")
              if request_type == "Delete":
                  send(event, context, "SUCCESS", physical_id=physical_id)
                  return

              payload = json.dumps({
                  "endpointId": endpoint_id,
                  "accountId": account_id,
                  "stackId": stack_id,
                  "action": "register",
              }).encode("utf-8")
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  "https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoints/%s/register" % endpoint_id,
                  data=payload,
                  method="POST",
                  headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "x-api-key": endpoint_id},
              )
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
                      resp.read()
                  send(event, context, "SUCCESS",
                       data={"Registered": "true", "HttpStatus": "200"},
                       physical_id=physical_id)
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
                  send(event, context, "SUCCESS",
                       data={"Registered": "false", "HttpStatus": str(exc.code),
                             "Reason": "HTTP %s from marbot registration endpoint" % exc.code},
                       physical_id=physical_id)
              except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
                  send(event, context, "SUCCESS",
                       data={"Registered": "false", "HttpStatus": "unreachable",
                             "Reason": "Network error contacting marbot: %s" % exc.reason},
                       physical_id=physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                  send(event, context, "SUCCESS",
                       data={"Registered": "false", "HttpStatus": "error",
                             "Reason": "Unexpected error: %s" % exc},
                       physical_id=physical_id)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom resource that registers the account connection with marbot
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MarbotRegistration:
    Type: Custom::MarbotRegistration
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt MarbotRegistrationFunction.Arn
      EndpointId: !Ref MarbotEndpointId
      AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      StackId: !Ref 'AWS::StackId'

Outputs:
  CrossAccountRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the cross-account role marbot assumes to monitor this account.
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotCrossAccountRole.Arn

  ExternalId:
    Description: External ID required when marbot assumes the cross-account role.
    Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackId}-${MarbotEndpointId}'

  ApiDestinationArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge API destination targeting marbot.
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn

  ConnectionArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge connection to marbot.
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotConnection.Arn

  KeepAliveRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the scheduled keep-alive rule.
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotKeepAliveRule.Arn

  RegistrationId:
    Description: Physical ID of the marbot registration custom resource.
    Value: !Ref MarbotRegistration

  RegistrationStatus:
    Description: Result of the marbot registration attempt (true/false).
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotRegistration.Registered

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained backend for a simple mobile or web application. Provisions a
  DynamoDB table (numeric id partition key, provisioned 10 RCU / 10 WCU) with a
  global secondary index keyed on id (5 RCU / 10 WCU), a customer-managed KMS
  key for table encryption, point-in-time recovery, a Cognito identity pool
  allowing unauthenticated guest access, the IAM role assumed by unauthenticated
  identities, and the identity pool role attachment linking them. The
  unauthenticated role is granted least-privilege permissions for mobile
  analytics, Cognito Sync, SNS publish, and DynamoDB writes. No external
  infrastructure is referenced; all resources are defined in this template.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Name of the environment, used for tagging resources.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-32 alphanumeric or hyphen characters.

Resources:
  # Customer-managed KMS key used for DynamoDB table encryption at rest.
  AppDataTableKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for the application DynamoDB table.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Readable alias for the customer-managed key.
  AppDataTableKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-app-data-table'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AppDataTableKey

  # DynamoDB table with numeric partition key `id`, provisioned capacity,
  # a global secondary index also keyed on `id`, CMK encryption, and PITR.
  AppDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 10
        WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: id
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 5
            WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AppDataTableKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Cognito identity pool allowing unauthenticated (guest) access.
  # AllowClassicFlow enables the classic Cognito Sync / basic auth flow.
  AppIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-identity-pool'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: true

  # IAM role assumed by unauthenticated identities.
  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cognito-unauthenticated-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref AppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: UnauthenticatedGuestAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # Mobile analytics event submission.
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'
              # Cognito Sync.
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'cognito-sync:*'
                Resource: '*'
              # SNS publish. Scoped to '*' because topics are created by the
              # application at runtime; no topic is defined in this template.
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: '*'
              # DynamoDB writes scoped to the table created in this template.
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt AppDataTable.Arn
              # KMS usage required to write to the CMK-encrypted table.
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt AppDataTableKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Link the identity pool to the unauthenticated role.
  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref AppIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref AppDataTable

  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt AppDataTable.Arn

  DynamoDBTableKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used for table encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt AppDataTableKey.Arn

  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: Cognito identity pool ID for client configuration.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Data lake catalog and transform layer. Creates a Glue Data Catalog database,
  a source S3 bucket, an optional Glue crawler (schema/partition discovery,
  log-only, new folders only), and an optional Glue Spark ETL job with bookmarks
  and continuous CloudWatch logging. Both crawler and job share a single scoped
  IAM service role.

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: datalake
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Naming prefix used to build the database, crawler, and job names.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used to build resource names.

  CreateCrawler:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the Glue crawler.

  CreateJob:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the Glue Spark ETL job.

  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: 'cron(0 0 * * ? *)'
    Description: Cron schedule for the crawler (default once daily at midnight UTC).

  CrawlerTablePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Prefix applied to table names discovered by the crawler.

  SourceBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Key prefix within the source bucket for the crawler target.

  TargetBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid S3 bucket name.
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket the job writes transformed output to (optional).

  TargetBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Key prefix within the target bucket for transformed output.

  ScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: 's3://aws-glue-scripts-placeholder/etl.py'
    Description: S3 location of the Glue ETL Python script.

  WorkerType:
    Type: String
    Default: G.1X
    AllowedValues:
      - G.1X
      - G.2X
      - G.4X
      - G.8X
    Description: Glue worker type for the ETL job.

  NumberOfWorkers:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 100
    Description: Number of workers for the ETL job.

  JobTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 2880
    Description: Job timeout in minutes.

  MaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100
    Description: Maximum concurrent runs of the ETL job.

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention period in days for the job log group.

Conditions:
  CreateCrawlerCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateCrawler, 'true']
  CreateJobCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateJob, 'true']
  HasTargetBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketName, '']]

Resources:
  SourceBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CMK for ${Prefix}-${Environment} source S3 bucket encryption.'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3UseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  SourceBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${Prefix}-${Environment}-source-bucket'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SourceBucketKey

  SourceBucketLogs:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-source-logs-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  SourceBucketLogsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref SourceBucketLogs
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${SourceBucketLogs.Arn}/access-logs/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn

  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-source-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt SourceBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref SourceBucketLogs
        LogFilePrefix: 'access-logs/'
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-db'
        Description: !Sub 'Glue Data Catalog database for the ${Prefix} ${Environment} data lake.'

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-glue-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-glue-s3-access'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SourceBucketRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub '${SourceBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: SourceBucketList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn
              - Sid: SourceBucketKeyUse
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt SourceBucketKey.Arn
              - !If
                - HasTargetBucket
                - Sid: TargetBucketWrite
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:DeleteObject
                    - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${TargetBucketName}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasTargetBucket
                - Sid: TargetBucketList
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${TargetBucketName}'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-glue-logs-access'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/jobs/${Prefix}-${Environment}-*'

  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Condition: CreateCrawlerCondition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-crawler'
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      TablePrefix: !Ref CrawlerTablePrefix
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerSchedule
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: LOG
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_NEW_FOLDERS_ONLY
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Sub 's3://${SourceBucket}/${SourceBucketPrefix}'

  GlueJobLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateJobCondition
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CMK for ${Prefix}-${Environment} Glue ETL job CloudWatch logs.'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/jobs/${Prefix}-${Environment}-etl'

  GlueJobLogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateJobCondition
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${Prefix}-${Environment}-glue-job-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref GlueJobLogKey

  GlueJobLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: CreateJobCondition
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws-glue/jobs/${Prefix}-${Environment}-etl'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt GlueJobLogKey.Arn

  GlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Condition: CreateJobCondition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-etl'
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Ref ScriptLocation
      WorkerType: !Ref WorkerType
      NumberOfWorkers: !Ref NumberOfWorkers
      Timeout: !Ref JobTimeout
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: !Ref MaxConcurrentRuns
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-bookmark-option': job-bookmark-enable
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-log-filter': 'true'
        '--continuous-log-logGroup': !Ref GlueJobLogGroup
        '--source_bucket': !Ref SourceBucket
        '--source_prefix': !Ref SourceBucketPrefix
        '--target_bucket': !Ref TargetBucketName
        '--target_prefix': !Ref TargetBucketPrefix

Outputs:
  SourceBucketName:
    Description: Name of the source S3 bucket created by the template.
    Value: !Ref SourceBucket

  SourceBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the source S3 bucket created by the template.
    Value: !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn

  SourceBucketKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the CMK used to encrypt the source S3 bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt SourceBucketKey.Arn

  SourceBucketLogsName:
    Description: Name of the S3 access-log bucket for the source bucket.
    Value: !Ref SourceBucketLogs

  DatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue Data Catalog database.
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabase

  CrawlerName:
    Condition: CreateCrawlerCondition
    Description: Name of the Glue crawler.
    Value: !Ref GlueCrawler

  JobName:
    Condition: CreateJobCondition
    Description: Name of the Glue ETL job.
    Value: !Ref GlueJob

  JobLogGroupName:
    Condition: CreateJobCondition
    Description: CloudWatch log group for the Glue ETL job.
    Value: !Ref GlueJobLogGroup

  GlueJobLogKeyArn:
    Condition: CreateJobCondition
    Description: ARN of the CMK used to encrypt the Glue ETL job log group.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueJobLogKey.Arn

  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared Glue service IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn

Description: >
  ECS Fargate task definition with supporting IAM execution and task roles and a
  CloudWatch log group for container application hosting. Cluster, service, and
  networking resources are intentionally out of scope for this template.

Resources:
  # ECS task execution role: used by the ECS agent to pull images, read SSM
  # parameters, and retrieve secrets on behalf of the task.
  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMReadOnlyAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecretsManagerReadWrite

  # Standard application task role: assumed by the application containers.
  EcsTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  # Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the CloudWatch log group.
  LogGroupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt the ECS main container CloudWatch log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/ecs/test/main'

  # CloudWatch log group for the "main" container's awslogs output.
  MainContainerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/ecs/test/main
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogGroupKmsKey.Arn

  # Fargate task definition hosting the single "main" nginx container.
  TestTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: test
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: "256"
      Memory: "1024"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: main
          Image: nginx
          Essential: true
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref MainContainerLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

Outputs:
  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS Fargate task definition.
    Value: !Ref TestTaskDefinition

  ExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task execution IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn

  TaskRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS application task IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn

  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group used by the main container.
    Value: !Ref MainContainerLogGroup

  LogGroupKmsKeyArn:

      TracingConfig:

      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def _log_archive_policy():
              return {
                  "DatadogLogArchiveAndRehydratePolicy": {
                      "Type": "AWS::IAM::Policy",
                      "Properties": {

                                      ],
                                      "Resource": "*"
                                  }
                              ]
                          }
                      }
                  }
              }


          def _cloudtrail_policy():

                  "DatadogCloudTrailsPolicy": {
                      "Type": "AWS::IAM::Policy",
                      "Properties": {
                          "PolicyName": "DatadogCloudTrailsPolicy",
                          "PolicyDocument": {
                              "Version": "2012-10-17",

                                          "s3:GetObject",
                                          "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                                      ],
                                      "Resource": "*"
                                  }
                              ]
                          }
                      }
                  }
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              request_id = event.get("requestId")
              fragment = event.get("fragment", {})
              params = event.get("templateParameterValues", {}) or {}
              fragment_params = fragment.get("Parameters", {}) if isinstance(fragment, dict) else {}
              policy_type = params.get("PolicyType")
              if policy_type is None and isinstance(fragment_params, dict):
                  policy_type = fragment_params.get("PolicyType")

              try:
                  if policy_type == "LogArchive":
                      new_fragment = _log_archive_policy()
                  elif policy_type == "CloudTrail":
                      new_fragment = _cloudtrail_policy()
                  else:
                      new_fragment = fragment
                  return {
                      "requestId": request_id,
                      "status": "success",
                      "fragment": new_fragment
                  }
              except Exception as exc:
                  return {
                      "requestId": request_id,
                      "status": "failed",

                  }

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Cross-account organizational event forwarding rules. Creates five EventBridge
  rules that forward CloudWatch alarm, CloudFormation status, CloudTrail root
  activity, Slack relay payload, and EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle events to
  cross-account organizational event buses, along with the local IAM roles each
  rule target assumes.

Parameters:
  OrgCloudWatchEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the cross-account organizational CloudWatch event bus.
    Default: 'arn:aws:events:us-east-1:000000000000:event-bus/org-cloudwatch'
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:events:[a-z0-9-]+:\d{12}:event-bus/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid EventBridge event bus ARN.

  OrgCloudFormationEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the cross-account organizational CloudFormation event bus.
    Default: 'arn:aws:events:us-east-1:000000000000:event-bus/org-cloudformation'
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:events:[a-z0-9-]+:\d{12}:event-bus/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid EventBridge event bus ARN.

  OrgCloudTrailEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the cross-account organizational CloudTrail event bus.
    Default: 'arn:aws:events:us-east-1:000000000000:event-bus/org-cloudtrail'
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:events:[a-z0-9-]+:\d{12}:event-bus/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid EventBridge event bus ARN.

  OrgSlackEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the cross-account organizational Slack event bus.
    Default: 'arn:aws:events:us-east-1:000000000000:event-bus/org-slack'
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:events:[a-z0-9-]+:\d{12}:event-bus/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid EventBridge event bus ARN.

  OrgAutoScalingEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the cross-account organizational Auto Scaling event bus.
    Default: 'arn:aws:events:us-east-1:000000000000:event-bus/org-autoscaling'

  CloudTrailRootActivityRule:

  SlackMessageRelayRule:

  AutoScalingLifecycleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: org-sink-autoscaling-events

      State: ENABLED

          - EC2 Instance Refresh Lifecycle
      Targets:
        - Id: org-autoscaling-events
          Arn: !Ref OrgAutoScalingEventBusArn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt AutoScalingOrgSinkRole.Arn

Outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Customer-managed KMS key with alias, optional deletion alerts via EventBridge to a parent alert stack SNS topic.

Parameters:
  ParentAlertStack:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Name of the parent alert stack that exports a TopicArn. Leave empty to disable deletion alerts.
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL_SERVICES
    Description: Service to restrict cryptographic operations to, or ALL_SERVICES / S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS.
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL_SERVICES
      - S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS
      - connect
      - dms
      - ssm
      - ec2
      - elasticfilesystem
      - es
      - kinesis
      - kinesisvideo
      - lambda
      - lex
      - redshift
      - rds
      - secretsmanager
      - ses
      - s3
      - importexport
      - sqs
      - workmail
      - workspaces

Conditions:
  HasParentAlertStack: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ParentAlertStack, ""]]
  IsAllServices: !Equals [!Ref Service, ALL_SERVICES]
  IsS3PublicAccess: !Equals [!Ref Service, S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS]
  IsSpecificService: !And
    - !Not [!Condition IsAllServices]
    - !Not [!Condition IsS3PublicAccess]

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for AWS service data encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - !If
            - IsAllServices
            - Sid: AllowCryptographicOperationsAllServices
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
              Action:
                - kms:Encrypt
                - kms:Decrypt
                - kms:ReEncryptFrom
                - kms:ReEncryptTo
                - kms:GenerateDataKey
                - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                - kms:GenerateDataKeyPair
                - kms:GenerateDataKeyPairWithoutPlaintext
                - kms:DescribeKey
              Resource: '*'
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - IsSpecificService
            - Sid: AllowCryptographicOperationsViaService
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
              Action:
                - kms:Encrypt
                - kms:Decrypt
                - kms:ReEncryptFrom
                - kms:ReEncryptTo
                - kms:GenerateDataKey
                - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                - kms:GenerateDataKeyPair
                - kms:GenerateDataKeyPairWithoutPlaintext
                - kms:DescribeKey
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  kms:ViaService: !Sub '${Service}.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - IsS3PublicAccess
            - Sid: AllowPublicS3Decryption
              Effect: Allow
              Principal: '*'
              Action:
                - kms:Decrypt
                - kms:DescribeKey
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  KeyDeletionAlertRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasParentAlertStack
    Properties:
      Description: Alerts on KMS key deletion scheduling or disabling.
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.kms
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - kms.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - ScheduleKeyDeletion
            - DisableKey
          requestParameters:
            keyId:
              - !Ref KmsKey
      Targets:
        - Id: ParentAlertTopic
          Arn: !ImportValue
            Fn::Sub: '${ParentAlertStack}-TopicArn'

Outputs:
  KeyId:
    Description: ID of the created KMS key.
    Value: !Ref KmsKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyId'
  KeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the created KMS key.
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyArn'
  KeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias name of the created KMS key.
    Value: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyAliasName'
