AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (DLM) EBS snapshot lifecycle policy and supporting IAM role for web servers.

Parameters:
  DailySnapshotScheduledAt:
    Type: String
    Default: '17:00'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-1][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
    Description: Time of day (UTC, HH:MM) at which the daily snapshot is taken.
  SnapshotInterval:
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
    AllowedValues:
      - 2
      - 3
      - 4
      - 6
      - 8
      - 12
      - 24
    Description: Interval in hours between snapshot creations.
  SnapshotRetainRule:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of snapshots to retain.
  LogicalName:
    Type: String
    Default: WebServers
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Logical name used in the IAM role name and policy Name tag.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - test
      - development
    Description: Environment tag value used to filter target volumes.
  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: createdby
    Description: Custom tag key used to filter target volumes.
  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-cloudformation-templates
    Description: Custom tag value used to filter target volumes.

Resources:
  DataLifecycleManagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalName}-DataLifecycleManager-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dlm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataLifecycleManagerSnapshotPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshots
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource: '*'

  EbsSnapshotLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::DLM::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'EBS snapshot lifecycle policy for ${LogicalName} in ${Environment} environment'
      State: ENABLED
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt DataLifecycleManagerRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        ResourceTypes:
          - VOLUME
        TargetTags:
          - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref TagKey
            Value: !Ref TagValue
        Schedules:
          - Name: Daily Snapshots
            CopyTags: true
            CreateRule:
              Interval: !Ref SnapshotInterval
              IntervalUnit: HOURS
              Times:
                - !Ref DailySnapshotScheduledAt
            RetainRule:
              Count: !Ref SnapshotRetainRule
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'policy-${LogicalName}-${AWS::Region}'

Outputs:
  LifecyclePolicyId:
    Description: The ID of the DLM lifecycle policy.
    Value: !Ref EbsSnapshotLifecyclePolicy

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockEnforcement
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockEnforcement

  S3AccountPublicAccessBlockDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockEnforcement
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enforce S3 account-level Block Public Access for the local account.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt S3AccountPublicAccessBlockAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: IAM role ARN assumed by SSM Automation to execute the document.
        mainSteps:
          - name: PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}'
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockEnforcement
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockEnforcement

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito authentication layer for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway (OAuth2 client credentials flow).

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Project name used for the Secrets Manager secret name and SSM path prefixes.
  AllowSymbolsInPassword:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether the Cognito password policy requires symbols.

Conditions:
  UseSymbols: !Equals [!Ref AllowSymbolsInPassword, 'true']

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentcore-gateway-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: !If [UseSymbols, true, false]

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub
        - '${Region}-${StackFragment}'
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          StackFragment: !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: agentcore-gateway
      Name: agentcore-gateway
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to agentcore-gateway resources
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to agentcore-gateway resources
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to agentcore-gateway resources

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentcore-gateway-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - agentcore-gateway/read
        - agentcore-gateway/write
        - agentcore-gateway/admin
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  ClientSecretKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the Cognito client secret.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  ClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret'
      Description: Cognito client credentials for the AgentCore Gateway.
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ClientSecretKey.Arn

  CustomResourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cognito-secret-writer
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Ref ClientSecret
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ClientSecretKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'

  SecretWriterFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt CustomResourceRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CLIENT_ID: !Ref UserPoolClient
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
          SECRET_ARN: !Ref ClientSecret
          SECRET_NAME: !Sub '${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import urllib.request
          import boto3

          cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
          secretsmanager = boto3.client('secretsmanager')

          CLIENT_ID = os.environ['CLIENT_ID']
          USER_POOL_ID = os.environ['USER_POOL_ID']
          SECRET_ARN = os.environ['SECRET_ARN']
          SECRET_NAME = os.environ['SECRET_NAME']


          def send_response(event, context, status, data=None, physical_resource_id=None, reason=None):
              body = {
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': reason or 'See CloudWatch Log Stream: {}'.format(context.log_stream_name),
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': data or {}
              }
              payload = json.dumps(body).encode('utf-8')
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event['ResponseURL'],
                  data=payload,
                  method='PUT',
                  headers={'Content-Type': '', 'Content-Length': str(len(payload))}
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                  print('CFN response status: {}'.format(resp.status))


          def handler(event, context):
              physical_resource_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', SECRET_ARN)
              try:
                  request_type = event.get('RequestType')

                  if request_type == 'Delete':
                      try:
                          secretsmanager.delete_secret(
                              SecretId=SECRET_ARN,
                              ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True
                          )
                      except secretsmanager.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          pass
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_resource_id)
                      return

                  response = cognito.describe_user_pool_client(
                      UserPoolId=USER_POOL_ID,
                      ClientId=CLIENT_ID
                  )
                  client_secret = response['UserPoolClient']['ClientSecret']

                  secret_value = json.dumps({
                      'client_id': CLIENT_ID,
                      'client_secret': client_secret,
                      'user_pool_id': USER_POOL_ID
                  })

                  try:
                      secretsmanager.put_secret_value(
                          SecretId=SECRET_ARN,
                          SecretString=secret_value
                      )
                  except secretsmanager.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                      secretsmanager.create_secret(
                          Name=SECRET_NAME,
                          SecretString=secret_value
                      )

                  send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_resource_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  print('Error: {}'.format(e))
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, physical_resource_id, reason=str(e))

  SecretWriterCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SecretWriterFunction.Arn
      ServiceTimeout: 300
      ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      SecretArn: !Ref ClientSecret

  OidcDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/oidc-discovery-url
      Type: String
      Description: OIDC discovery URL consumed by the gateway stack.
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  ClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/client-id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito app client ID consumed by the gateway stack.
      Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito user pool ID consumed by the gateway stack.
      Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-arn
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito user pool ARN consumed by the gateway stack.
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  HostedDomainUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/hosted-domain-url
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito hosted domain URL consumed by the gateway stack.
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

Outputs:

    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn'

  ClientId:
    Description: Cognito app client ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClientId'

  OidcDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OIDC discovery URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-OidcDiscoveryUrl'

  HostedDomainUrl:
    Description: Cognito hosted domain URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HostedDomainUrl'

  TokenEndpointUrl:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TokenEndpointUrl'

  ScopeList:
    Description: Comma-joined list of custom scopes.
    Value: 'agentcore-gateway/read,agentcore-gateway/write,agentcore-gateway/admin'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ScopeList'

  SsmParameterPathPrefix:
    Description: SSM parameter path prefix for the gateway stack.
    Value: /protein-agent/cognito/
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SsmParameterPathPrefix'

  SecretName:
    Description: Secrets Manager secret name.
    Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SecretName'

  SecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager secret ARN.
    Value: !Ref ClientSecret
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SecretArn'

        - email

      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref TenantAppCallbackHost
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref TenantAppCallbackHost
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

  PooledTenantUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'pooledtenant-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool

  PooledTenantIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt PooledTenantUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pooled authenticated role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PooledAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: authenticated-pooled-user-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PooledTenantDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TenantPrefixedProductOrderAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/PooledProduct'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/PooledProduct/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/PooledOrder'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/PooledOrder/index/*'
                Condition:
                  ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                    dynamodb:LeadingKeys:
                      - !Sub '${!cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:tenantId}'
              - Sid: TenantAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings/index/*'
                Condition:
                  ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                    dynamodb:LeadingKeys:
                      - !Sub '${!cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:tenantId}'
              - Sid: SystemAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:userRole: SystemAdmin

  PooledIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt PooledAuthenticatedRole.Arn
      RoleMappings:
        cognito-idp:
          Type: Token
          AmbiguousRoleResolution: Deny
          IdentityProvider: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PooledTenantUserPool}:${PooledTenantUserPoolClient}'
          RulesConfiguration:
            Rules:
              - Claim: tenantId
                MatchType: Equals
                Value: tenantId
                RoleARN: !GetAtt PooledAuthenticatedRole.Arn
              - Claim: userRole
                MatchType: Equals
                Value: userRole
                RoleARN: !GetAtt PooledAuthenticatedRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Siloed tenant role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SiloedTenantRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SiloedTenantRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SiloedTenantDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SiloedProductOrderAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/PooledProduct-${!cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:tenantId}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/PooledProduct-${!cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:tenantId}/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/PooledOrder-${!cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:tenantId}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/PooledOrder-${!cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:tenantId}/index/*'
              - Sid: SiloedTenantAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings/index/*'
                Condition:
                  ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                    dynamodb:LeadingKeys:
                      - !Sub '${!cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:tenantId}'
              - Sid: SiloedSystemAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:userRole: SystemAdmin

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Operations users pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OperationUsersUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: OperationUsers-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: apiKey
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: 'Your SaaS Operations admin account'
          EmailMessage: !Sub
            - 'Your username is {username} and your temporary password is {####}. Please sign in at ${AdminAppCallbackHost}.'
            - AdminAppCallbackHost: !Ref AdminAppCallbackHost

  OperationUsersUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsOperationUsersPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref AdminAppCallbackHost
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref AdminAppCallbackHost
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
        - custom:apiKey
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

  OperationUsersUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'operationsusers-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool

  SystemAdminsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdmins
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool
      Precedence: 0

  OperationUsersIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: OperationsUser-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt OperationUsersUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  OperationUsersIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt PooledAuthenticatedRole.Arn
      RoleMappings:
        cognito-idp:
          Type: Token
          AmbiguousRoleResolution: Deny
          IdentityProvider: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${OperationUsersUserPool}:${OperationUsersUserPoolClient}'
          RulesConfiguration:
            Rules:
              - Claim: tenantId
                MatchType: Equals
                Value: tenantId
                RoleARN: !GetAtt PooledAuthenticatedRole.Arn
              - Claim: userRole
                MatchType: Equals
                Value: userRole
                RoleARN: !GetAtt PooledAuthenticatedRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # OIDC identity providers
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PooledTenantOIDCProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ProviderName: Cognito
      ProviderType: OIDC
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        'custom:tenantId': tenantId
        'custom:userRole': userRole
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref PooledTenantUserPoolClient
        authorize_scopes: openid email profile
        oidc_issuer: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PooledTenantUserPool}'
        attributes_request_method: GET

  OperationUsersOIDCProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ProviderName: Cognito
      ProviderType: OIDC
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        'custom:tenantId': tenantId
        'custom:userRole': userRole
        'custom:apiKey': apiKey
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref OperationUsersUserPoolClient
        authorize_scopes: openid email profile
        oidc_issuer: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${OperationUsersUserPool}'
        attributes_request_method: GET

Outputs:
  PooledTenantUserPoolId:
    Description: Pooled tenant user pool ID
    Value: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool
  OperationUsersUserPoolId:
    Description: Operations users user pool ID
    Value: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool
  PooledTenantIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Pooled tenant identity pool ID
    Value: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
  OperationUsersIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Operations users identity pool ID
    Value: !Ref OperationUsersIdentityPool
  PooledTenantUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Pooled tenant app client ID
    Value: !Ref PooledTenantUserPoolClient
  OperationUsersUserPoolClientId:

    Description: Siloed tenant role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt SiloedTenantRole.Arn
  OperationUsersUserPoolProviderURL:
    Description: Operations users user pool provider URL
    Value: !GetAtt OperationUsersUserPool.ProviderURL

Description: Reusable DynamoDB table stack with optional GSIs, auto scaling, PITR, SSE, streams, TTL, AWS Backup, and CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    MinLength: 1
    Description: Name of the partition key attribute. Supply your own partition key name; the default is provided only so the stack can deploy unattended.
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Type of the partition key attribute.
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional table name. Leave empty to let CloudFormation generate one.
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional sort key attribute name.
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Type of the sort key attribute.
  Attribute1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional extra attribute definition 1 name.
  Attribute1Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  Attribute2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional extra attribute definition 2 name.
  Attribute2Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  Attribute3Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional extra attribute definition 3 name.
  Attribute3Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  GSI1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional global secondary index 1 name.
  GSI1PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: GSI1 partition key attribute name.
  GSI1PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  GSI1SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional GSI1 sort key attribute name.
  GSI1SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  GSI2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional global secondary index 2 name.
  GSI2PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: GSI2 partition key attribute name.
  GSI2PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  GSI2SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional GSI2 sort key attribute name.
  GSI2SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  TimeToLiveAttribute:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional TTL attribute name.
  StreamViewType:
    Type: String
    Default: DISABLED
    AllowedValues:
      - DISABLED
      - NEW_IMAGE
      - OLD_IMAGE
      - NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  SSEEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
    Description: Backup retention in days. Set to 0 to disable backups.
  AlertNotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional existing SNS topic ARN for alarm notifications.
  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email to create an SNS topic and subscription for alerts.

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  HasAttribute1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute1Name, '']]
  HasAttribute2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute2Name, '']]
  HasAttribute3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute3Name, '']]
  HasGSI1: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1Name, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName, '']]
  HasGSI1SortKey: !And
    - !Condition HasGSI1
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1SortKeyName, '']]
  HasGSI2: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2Name, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName, '']]
  HasGSI2SortKey: !And
    - !Condition HasGSI2
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2SortKeyName, '']]
  HasTTL: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TimeToLiveAttribute, '']]
  StreamsEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, DISABLED]]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, PROVISIONED]
  IsProvisionedAndGSI1: !And
    - !Condition IsProvisioned
    - !Condition HasGSI1
  IsProvisionedAndGSI2: !And
    - !Condition IsProvisioned
    - !Condition HasGSI2
  IsPitrEnabled: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled, 'true']
  IsSSEEnabled: !Equals [!Ref SSEEnabled, 'true']
  BackupsEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, 0]]
  HasProvidedTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn, '']]
  HasAlertEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertEmail, '']]
  CreateAlertTopic: !And
    - !Not [!Condition HasProvidedTopic]
    - !Condition HasAlertEmail
  AlertsEnabled: !Or
    - !Condition HasProvidedTopic
    - !Condition CreateAlertTopic
  BackupAlarmEnabled: !And
    - !Condition AlertsEnabled
    - !Condition BackupsEnabled

Resources:
  DataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for DynamoDB table and SNS topic encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNSViaService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchViaService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub cloudwatch.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com

  DataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-data
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataKey

  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      TableName: !If
        - HasTableName
        - !Ref TableName
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasAttribute1
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute1Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasAttribute2
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute2Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasAttribute3
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute3Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI1SortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI1SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI2SortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI2SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: 1
          WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - IndexName: !Ref GSI1Name
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI1SortKey
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput: !If
              - IsProvisioned
              - ReadCapacityUnits: 1
                WriteCapacityUnits: 1
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - IndexName: !Ref GSI2Name
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI2SortKey
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput: !If
              - IsProvisioned
              - ReadCapacityUnits: 1
                WriteCapacityUnits: 1
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTTL
        - AttributeName: !Ref TimeToLiveAttribute
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - StreamsEnabled
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If
          - IsPitrEnabled
          - true
          - false
      SSESpecification: !If
        - IsSSEEnabled
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBTableScalingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt Table.Arn
                  - !Sub ${Table.Arn}/index/*

  TableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${Table}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${Table}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TableReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-table-read-scaling
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TableReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 80
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  TableWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-table-write-scaling
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TableWriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 80
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  GSI1ReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisionedAndGSI1
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${Table}/index/${GSI1Name}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GSI1WriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisionedAndGSI1
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${Table}/index/${GSI1Name}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GSI1ReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisionedAndGSI1
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-gsi1-read-scaling
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GSI1ReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 80
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  GSI1WriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisionedAndGSI1
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-gsi1-write-scaling
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GSI1WriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 80
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  GSI2ReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisionedAndGSI2
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${Table}/index/${GSI2Name}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GSI2WriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisionedAndGSI2
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${Table}/index/${GSI2Name}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GSI2ReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisionedAndGSI2
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-gsi2-read-scaling
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GSI2ReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 80
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  GSI2WriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisionedAndGSI2
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-gsi2-write-scaling
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GSI2WriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 80
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  BackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Condition: BackupsEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vault

  BackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: BackupsEnabled
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBBackupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:CreateBackup
                  - dynamodb:RestoreTableFromBackup
                  - dynamodb:ListTables
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn

  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Condition: BackupsEnabled
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-backup-plan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyBackup
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 * * ? *)
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 1440
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref BackupRetentionDays

  BackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Condition: BackupsEnabled
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-selection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - !GetAtt Table.Arn

  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: CreateAlertTopic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-alerts
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn

  AlertSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateAlertTopic
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlertTopic

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB read throttle events
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If
          - HasProvidedTopic
          - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
          - !Ref AlertTopic

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB write throttle events
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If
          - HasProvidedTopic
          - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
          - !Ref AlertTopic

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB throttled requests
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If
          - HasProvidedTopic
          - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
          - !Ref AlertTopic

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB user errors
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If
          - HasProvidedTopic
          - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
          - !Ref AlertTopic

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB system errors
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If
          - HasProvidedTopic
          - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
          - !Ref AlertTopic

  BackupVaultFailedJobsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: BackupAlarmEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: AWS Backup failed backup jobs for the table backup vault
      Namespace: AWS/Backup
      MetricName: NumberOfBackupJobsFailed
      Dimensions:
        - Name: BackupVaultName
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vault
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If
          - HasProvidedTopic
          - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
          - !Ref AlertTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: DynamoDB tables and autoscaling for AWS account-vending automation tool.

Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Stage suffix appended to every table name.

Resources:
  TablesKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for account-vending DynamoDB tables
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  TablesKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/talr-tables-${Stage}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TablesKey

  CbInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-cbInfo-${Stage}"
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TablesKey.Arn
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          KeyType: HASH

  AccountInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-accountInfo-${Stage}"
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TablesKey.Arn
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: gsiRequestId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: requestId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: KEYS_ONLY
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - IndexName: gsiAccountId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: accountId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TaskStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-taskStatus-${Stage}"
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TablesKey.Arn
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES

  NipapCfnTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-nipapCfn-${Stage}"
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TablesKey.Arn
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          KeyType: HASH

  OpsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-ops-${Stage}"
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TablesKey.Arn
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: layer
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: layer
          KeyType: HASH

  DxInterfaceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-dxInterface-${Stage}"
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TablesKey.Arn
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: vlan
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: vlan
          KeyType: RANGE

  ClaStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-claStatus-${Stage}"
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TablesKey.Arn
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH

  ConfigRulesComplianceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "talr-configRulesCompliance-${Stage}"
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TablesKey.Arn
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoscalingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AccountInfoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${AccountInfoTable.Arn}/index/gsiRequestId"
                  - !Sub "${AccountInfoTable.Arn}/index/gsiAccountId"
                  - !GetAtt TaskStatusTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*"

  AccountInfoTableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${AccountInfoTable}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoTableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${AccountInfoTable}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoGsiAccountIdReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoGsiAccountIdWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  TaskStatusTableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${TaskStatusTable}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  TaskStatusTableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${TaskStatusTable}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoTableReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AccountInfoTableReadScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoTableReadScalableTarget
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 50
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  AccountInfoTableWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AccountInfoTableWriteScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoTableWriteScalableTarget
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 50
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AccountInfoGsiRequestIdReadScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoGsiRequestIdReadScalableTarget
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 50
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  AccountInfoGsiRequestIdWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AccountInfoGsiRequestIdWriteScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoGsiRequestIdWriteScalableTarget
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits

        PredefinedMetricSpecification:

        TargetValue: 50
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  AccountInfoGsiAccountIdReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AccountInfoGsiAccountIdReadScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoGsiAccountIdReadScalableTarget
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 50
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  AccountInfoGsiAccountIdWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AccountInfoGsiAccountIdWriteScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoGsiAccountIdWriteScalableTarget
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:

        TargetValue: 50
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  TaskStatusTableReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: TaskStatusTableReadScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TaskStatusTableReadScalableTarget
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:

        TargetValue: 50
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: TaskStatusTableWriteScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TaskStatusTableWriteScalableTarget
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 50
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
