final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Secure, highly available VPC network foundation for a containerised Streamlit application, including public/private subnets across two AZs, per-AZ NAT gateways, VPC flow logs to CloudWatch, and an ECS cluster with Container Insights enabled.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet (AZ 1).
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet (AZ 2).
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet (AZ 1).
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet (AZ 2).
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment name used for tagging resources.
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,32}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-32 alphanumeric, hyphen, or underscore characters.

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatGatewayEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGatewayEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt VPC flow log data in CloudWatch Logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FlowLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn: FlowLogsKey
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Describe*
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn:
      - FlowLogsRole
      - FlowLogsKey
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-cluster'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first private subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second private subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  EcsClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster.
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the VPC flow logs CloudWatch log group.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
  FlowLogsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS CMK used to encrypt VPC flow logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions the test environment used to validate Service Catalog preventive controls (VPC, subnets, security group, KMS key, DMS/ElastiCache subnet groups, SageMaker execution role, and per-product Service Catalog launch roles).

Parameters:
  EnvironmentTag:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment tag value applied to all taggable resources.
    Default: test
    AllowedValues:
      - test
      - dev
      - staging

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: service-catalog-test-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  VpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role used by VPC Flow Logs to deliver records to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: service-catalog-test-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: service-catalog-test-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service Catalog preventive-control test resources (no ingress).
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: service-catalog-test-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for Service Catalog preventive-control test resources.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: service-catalog-test-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLaunchRolesUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt AlbLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ListenerLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt TargetGroupLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt AutoscalingLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DmsEndpointLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DmsInstanceLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DynamoDbLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EbsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EfsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElastiCacheLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElasticsearchLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt FsxLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt KinesisLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SnsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SqsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SageMakerLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt S3LaunchRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-test-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      Description: Service role required by AWS DMS before a replication subnet group can be created.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  DmsReplicationSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DMS::ReplicationSubnetGroup
    DependsOn: DmsVpcRole
    Properties:
      ReplicationSubnetGroupDescription: DMS replication subnet group for Service Catalog preventive-control tests.
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: ElastiCache subnet group for Service Catalog preventive-control tests.
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: service-catalog-test-cache-subnet-group
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  ElastiCacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Cache security group for Service Catalog preventive-control tests (no ingress rules).
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-execution-role'
      Description: Execution role for SageMaker resources created by Service Catalog products under test.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  AlbLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-launch-role'
      Description: Launch role assumed by the Service Catalog Application Load Balancer product.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AlbLaunchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  ListenerLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-listener-launch-role'
      Description: Launch role assumed by the Service Catalog Load Balancer Listener product.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ListenerLaunchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  TargetGroupLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-target-group-launch-role'
      Description: Launch role assumed by the Service Catalog Target Group product.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TargetGroupLaunchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  AutoscalingLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-autoscaling-launch-role'
      Description: Launch role assumed by the Service Catalog Auto Scaling product.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AutoscalingLaunchPolicy

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
                  - autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration
                  - autoscaling:DeleteLaunchConfiguration
                  - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
                  - autoscaling:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: service-catalog-preventive-controls

  DmsEndpointLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dms-endpoint-launch-role'
      Description: Launch role assumed by the Service Catalog DMS Endpoint product.

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

          PolicyDocument:

            Statement:

                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups

        - Key: Environment

        - Key: Purpose

  DmsInstanceLaunchRole:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless AI campaign orchestration platform - turns plain language marketing instructions into delivered multi-channel customer campaigns.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: campaign
    Description: Prefix used for naming resources.
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0
    Description: Amazon Bedrock model ID used for generative steps.
  SenderNotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: noreply@example.com
    Description: Sender notification email address.
  MessagingPhoneNumberId:
    Type: String
    Default: "+10000000000"
    Description: Messaging phone number identifier.
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Enable optional OpenSearch Serverless semantic search capability.

Conditions:
  SemanticSearchEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, "true"]

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CampaignDataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for campaign data stores.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3Use
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNSUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowOpenSearchServerlessUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aoss.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  CampaignDataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentPrefix}-campaign-data'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CampaignDataKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB Tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-customer-profiles'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn

  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain

  PredictChannelFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-predict-channel'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 120
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          CHANNEL_RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref ChannelRateLimitsTable
          MESSAGE_DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTable
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
          KMS_KEY_ARN: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              client = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime')
              model_id = os.environ['BEDROCK_MODEL_ID']
              predictions = []
              for customer in event.get('customers', []):
                  prompt = "Choose the best marketing channel (email, sms, push) for customer with preferences: " + json.dumps(customer.get('preferences', {}))
                  body = json.dumps({
                      "anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31",
                      "max_tokens": 50,
                      "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]
                  })
                  try:
                      resp = client.invoke_model(modelId=model_id, body=body)
                      result = json.loads(resp['body'].read())
                      channel = 'email'
                      content = result.get('content', [])
                      if content and isinstance(content, list):
                          text = content[0].get('text', 'email').lower()
                          for c in ['email', 'sms', 'push']:
                              if c in text:
                                  channel = c
                                  break
                  except Exception:
                      channel = 'email'
                  predictions.append({'customerId': customer.get('customerId'), 'channel': channel, 'customer': customer})
              event['predictions'] = predictions
              return event

              adapted = []

  DeliverMessagesFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-deliver-messages'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 120
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          CHANNEL_RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref ChannelRateLimitsTable
          MESSAGE_DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTable
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
          KMS_KEY_ARN: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import uuid
          import time
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
              delivery_table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['MESSAGE_DELIVERY_TABLE'])
              rate_table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['CHANNEL_RATE_LIMITS_TABLE'])
              campaign_id = event.get('campaignName', 'campaign')
              delivered = []
              for msg in event.get('adaptedMessages', []):
                  channel = msg.get('channel', 'email')
                  try:
                      rate_table.update_item(
                          Key={'channel': channel},
                          UpdateExpression='ADD sentCount :inc SET lastSent = :ts',
                          ExpressionAttributeValues={':inc': 1, ':ts': int(time.time())}
                      )
                  except Exception:
                      pass
                  message_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                  item = {
                      'messageId': message_id,
                      'campaignId': campaign_id,
                      'customerId': msg.get('customerId'),
                      'channel': channel,
                      'content': msg.get('content'),
                      'status': 'SENT',
                      'sentAt': int(time.time()),
                  }
                  try:
                      delivery_table.put_item(Item=item)
                  except Exception:
                      pass
                  delivered.append(item)
              event['deliveredMessages'] = delivered
              return event

        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MESSAGE_DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTable

          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
          KMS_KEY_ARN: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import time
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['MESSAGE_DELIVERY_TABLE'])
              body = {}
              if event.get('body'):
                  try:
                      body = json.loads(event['body'])
                  except Exception:
                      body = {}
              message_id = body.get('messageId')
              status = body.get('status', 'DELIVERED')
              if not message_id:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'messageId required'})
                  }
              try:
                  table.update_item(
                      Key={'messageId': message_id},
                      UpdateExpression='SET #s = :s, updatedAt = :ts',
                      ExpressionAttributeNames={'#s': 'status'},
                      ExpressionAttributeValues={':s': status, ':ts': int(time.time())}
                  )
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  'body': json.dumps({'messageId': message_id, 'status': status})
              }

              },
              "AdaptContent": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${AdaptContentArn}",
                "Next": "DeliverMessages"
              },
              "DeliverMessages": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${DeliverMessagesArn}",
                "Next": "RecordResults"
              },

          SafetyCheckArn: !GetAtt SafetyCheckFunction.Arn
          AdaptContentArn: !GetAtt AdaptContentFunction.Arn
          DeliverMessagesArn: !GetAtt DeliverMessagesFunction.Arn
          RecordResultsArn: !GetAtt RecordResultsFunction.Arn

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-campaign-sfn-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ParseInstructionFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt SegmentCustomersFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt PredictChannelFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt SafetyCheckFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt AdaptContentFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt DeliverMessagesFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt RecordResultsFunction.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CampaignUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-campaign-user-pool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true

  CampaignUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-campaign-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CampaignUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  CampaignUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-campaign-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CampaignUserPool

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # HTTP API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CampaignHttpApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-campaign-api'
      ProtocolType: HTTP

  CampaignAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      Name: CognitoAuthorizer
      AuthorizerType: JWT
      IdentitySource:
        - '$request.header.Authorization'
      JwtConfiguration:
        Audience:
          - !Ref CampaignUserPoolClient
        Issuer: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CampaignUserPool}'

  LauncherIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt CampaignLauncherFunction.Arn
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'

  StatusIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt CampaignStatusFunction.Arn
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'

  CallbackIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt DeliveryCallbackFunction.Arn
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'

  LauncherRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      RouteKey: 'POST /campaigns'
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CampaignAuthorizer
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${LauncherIntegration}'

  StatusRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      RouteKey: 'GET /campaigns/{id}'
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CampaignAuthorizer
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${StatusIntegration}'

  CallbackRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      RouteKey: 'POST /callbacks/delivery'
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CampaignAuthorizer
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${CallbackIntegration}'

  CampaignApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      StageName: $default
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol","responseLength":"$context.responseLength","integrationErrorMessage":"$context.integrationErrorMessage"}'

  LauncherInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref CampaignLauncherFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${CampaignHttpApi}/*'

  StatusInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref CampaignStatusFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${CampaignHttpApi}/*'

  CallbackInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref DeliveryCallbackFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${CampaignHttpApi}/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Alarm
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineFailureAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-campaign-execution-failures'
      AlarmDescription: Fires when campaign state machine executions fail.
      Namespace: AWS/States
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertsTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # OpenSearch Serverless (optional)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SemanticSearchCollection:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::Collection
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-semantic-search'
      Type: VECTORSEARCH
      Description: Vector collection for semantic campaign search.

  SemanticSearchEncryptionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-semantic-encryption'
      Type: encryption
      Policy: !Sub |
        {
          "Rules": [
            {
              "ResourceType": "collection",
              "Resource": ["collection/${SemanticSearchCollection}"]
            }
          ],
          "AWSOwnedKey": false,
          "KmsARN": "${CampaignDataKey.Arn}"
        }

  SemanticSearchNetworkPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-semantic-network'
      Type: network
      Policy: !Sub |
        [
          {
            "Rules": [
              {
                "ResourceType": "collection",
                "Resource": ["collection/${SemanticSearchCollection}"]
              }
            ],
            "AllowFromPublic": false,
            "SourceVPCEs": []
          }
        ]

  SemanticSearchAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::AccessPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-semantic-access'
      Type: data
      Policy: !Sub |
        [
          {
            "Rules": [
              {
                "ResourceType": "index",
                "Resource": ["index/${SemanticSearchCollection}/*"],
                "Permission": ["aoss:CreateIndex", "aoss:UpdateIndex", "aoss:DescribeIndex", "aoss:ReadDocument", "aoss:WriteDocument"]
              }
            ],
            "Principal": ["${LambdaExecutionRole.Arn}"]
          }
        ]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless URL shortener stack with DynamoDB, Python Lambda functions, and a regional REST API.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table storing short links.
  FunctionNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Prefix used for Lambda function and API names.
  PythonRuntime:
    Type: String
    Default: python3.14
    AllowedValues:
      - python3.14
      - python3.13
    Description: Python runtime for the Lambda functions.
  ApplicationUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com
    Description: Base application URL used to build shortened links.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment tag.
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Service name tag.
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: platform-team
    Description: Owner tag.

Resources:
  UrlShortenerKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for URL shortener DynamoDB and CloudWatch Logs encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDB
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt

              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  UrlShortenerKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${FunctionNamePrefix}-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref UrlShortenerKey

  UrlShortenerTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: shortId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: shortId
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt UrlShortenerKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  CreateFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${FunctionNamePrefix}-create"
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt UrlShortenerKey.Arn

  RetrieveFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${FunctionNamePrefix}-retrieve"
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt UrlShortenerKey.Arn

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/apigateway/${FunctionNamePrefix}-access"
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt UrlShortenerKey.Arn

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: url-shortener-lambda-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt UrlShortenerTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CreateFunctionLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${CreateFunctionLogGroup.Arn}:*"
                  - !GetAtt RetrieveFunctionLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${RetrieveFunctionLogGroup.Arn}:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  CreateFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${FunctionNamePrefix}-create"
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref UrlShortenerTable
          APPLICATION_URL: !Ref ApplicationUrl
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import random
          import string
          import boto3

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["TABLE_NAME"]
          APPLICATION_URL = os.environ["APPLICATION_URL"].rstrip("/")
          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = event.get("body")
                  if isinstance(body, str):
                      body = json.loads(body) if body else {}
                  elif body is None:
                      body = {}
                  long_url = body.get("longUrl") or body.get("url")
                  if not long_url:
                      return {
                          "statusCode": 400,
                          "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                          "body": json.dumps({"message": "longUrl is required"}),
                      }
                  length = random.randint(12, 16)
                  alphabet = string.ascii_letters + string.digits
                  short_id = "".join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(length))
                  table.put_item(Item={"shortId": short_id, "longUrl": long_url})
                  short_url = f"{APPLICATION_URL}/{short_id}"
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 201,
                      "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                      "body": json.dumps({"shortId": short_id, "shortUrl": short_url}),
                  }
              except Exception as exc:
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 500,
                      "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                      "body": json.dumps({"message": str(exc)}),
                  }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  RetrieveFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${FunctionNamePrefix}-retrieve"
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref UrlShortenerTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["TABLE_NAME"]
          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  path_params = event.get("pathParameters") or {}
                  short_id = path_params.get("shortId")
                  if not short_id:
                      return {
                          "statusCode": 400,
                          "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                          "body": json.dumps({"message": "shortId is required"}),
                      }
                  response = table.get_item(Key={"shortId": short_id})
                  item = response.get("Item")
                  if not item:
                      return {
                          "statusCode": 404,
                          "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                          "body": json.dumps({"message": "Short link not found"}),
                      }
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 302,
                      "headers": {"Location": item["longUrl"]},
                      "body": "",
                  }
              except Exception as exc:
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 500,
                      "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                      "body": json.dumps({"message": str(exc)}),
                  }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FunctionNamePrefix}-api"
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  LinksResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: links

  AdminResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: admin

  ShortIdResource:

    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: "{shortId}"

  LinksPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref LinksResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub
          - "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${FunctionArn}/invocations"
          - FunctionArn: !GetAtt CreateFunction.Arn

  AdminGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref AdminResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub
          - "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${FunctionArn}/invocations"
          - FunctionArn: !GetAtt RetrieveFunction.Arn

  ShortIdGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.shortId: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub
          - "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${FunctionArn}/invocations"
          - FunctionArn: !GetAtt RetrieveFunction.Arn

  CreateFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub

      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub

        - ApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ShortIdRetrieveFunctionPermission:

    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction

      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub

        - ApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:

    Properties:

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage

    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: test
      TracingEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol","responseLength":"$context.responseLength"}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FunctionNamePrefix}-api-key"
      Enabled: true
      StageKeys:
        - RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
          StageName: !Ref ApiStage
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ApiUsagePlan:

    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ApiUsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref ApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref ApiUsagePlan

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:

      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn
