AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless on-call incident alerting service (DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, HTTP API, SES, SSM)

Parameters:
  SenderEmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Description: Verified SES sender email address used by the notifier Lambda.
    Default: oncall@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address.
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Description: Application name used for SSM parameter path prefix.
    Default: oncall
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32

Resources:

  # ------------------------- KMS -------------------------

  AppKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for on-call service log groups and DynamoDB tables.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDB
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  AppKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-oncall'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AppKmsKey

  # ------------------------- DynamoDB Tables -------------------------

  ConfigurationTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: configurationKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: configurationKey
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  ServicesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: serviceId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: serviceId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  OnCallSchedulesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: teamId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: day
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: teamId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: day
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  IncidentsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: incidentId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: incidentId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  # ------------------------- Log Groups -------------------------

  IncidentProcessorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-incident-processor'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  NotifierLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-notifier'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}-access-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  # ------------------------- Shared Lambda Execution Role -------------------------

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ConfigurationTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ServicesTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt OnCallSchedulesTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt IncidentsTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: SESAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendTemplatedEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: LogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${IncidentProcessorLogGroup.Arn}:*'
                  - !Sub '${NotifierLogGroup.Arn}:*'
        - PolicyName: SSMAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AppName}/*'
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${AWS::StackName}-incident-workflow'
        - PolicyName: KmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: XRayAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  # ------------------------- Lambda Functions -------------------------

  IncidentProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-incident-processor'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CONFIGURATION_TABLE: !Ref ConfigurationTable
          SERVICES_TABLE: !Ref ServicesTable
          ONCALL_SCHEDULES_TABLE: !Ref OnCallSchedulesTable
          INCIDENTS_TABLE: !Ref IncidentsTable
          SENDER_EMAIL: !Ref SenderEmailAddress
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os

          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"message": "incident processor placeholder"})
              }

  NotifierFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-notifier'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SENDER_EMAIL: !Ref SenderEmailAddress
          ONCALL_SCHEDULES_TABLE: !Ref OnCallSchedulesTable
          INCIDENTS_TABLE: !Ref IncidentsTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os

          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({"message": "notifier placeholder"})
              }

  # ------------------------- Step Functions -------------------------

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt IncidentProcessorFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn
        - PolicyName: LogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  IncidentStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-incident-workflow'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "On-call incident alerting workflow",
            "StartAt": "NotifyParallel",
            "States": {
              "NotifyParallel": {
                "Type": "Parallel",
                "Branches": [
                  {
                    "StartAt": "NotifyCurrentResponder",
                    "States": {
                      "NotifyCurrentResponder": {
                        "Type": "Task",
                        "Resource": "${NotifierArn}",
                        "Retry": [
                          {
                            "ErrorEquals": [
                              "Lambda.ServiceException",
                              "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException",
                              "Lambda.SdkClientException",
                              "States.TaskFailed"
                            ],
                            "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                            "MaxAttempts": 3,
                            "BackoffRate": 2.0
                          }
                        ],
                        "Catch": [
                          {
                            "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                            "ResultPath": "$.error",
                            "Next": "NotifyCurrentResponderFailed"
                          }
                        ],
                        "End": true
                      },
                      "NotifyCurrentResponderFailed": {
                        "Type": "Fail",
                        "Error": "NotifyCurrentResponderFailed",
                        "Cause": "Failed to notify current on-call responder"
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  {
                    "StartAt": "WaitFiveMinutes",
                    "States": {
                      "WaitFiveMinutes": {
                        "Type": "Wait",
                        "Seconds": 300,
                        "Next": "NotifyEscalation"
                      },
                      "NotifyEscalation": {
                        "Type": "Task",
                        "Resource": "${NotifierArn}",
                        "Retry": [
                          {
                            "ErrorEquals": [
                              "Lambda.ServiceException",
                              "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException",
                              "Lambda.SdkClientException",
                              "States.TaskFailed"
                            ],
                            "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                            "MaxAttempts": 3,
                            "BackoffRate": 2.0
                          }
                        ],
                        "Catch": [
                          {
                            "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                            "ResultPath": "$.error",
                            "Next": "NotifyEscalationFailed"
                          }
                        ],
                        "End": true
                      },
                      "NotifyEscalationFailed": {
                        "Type": "Fail",
                        "Error": "NotifyEscalationFailed",
                        "Cause": "Failed to send escalation notification"
                      }
                    }
                  }
                ],
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - NotifierArn: !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn

  # ------------------------- HTTP API -------------------------

  HttpApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-incident-api'
      ProtocolType: HTTP

  IncidentProcessorIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IncidentProcessorFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'
      TimeoutInMillis: 29000

  GetIncidentRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: 'GET /incidents/{incidentId}'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${IncidentProcessorIntegration}'

  PutIncidentRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: 'PUT /incidents/{incidentId}'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${IncidentProcessorIntegration}'

  PostIncidentRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: 'POST /incidents/{incidentId}'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${IncidentProcessorIntegration}'

  DefaultStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      StageName: $default
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: >-
          {"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol","responseLength":"$context.responseLength","integrationErrorMessage":"$context.integrationErrorMessage"}

  ApiGatewayLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayAccessLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub '${ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn}:*'
        - PolicyName: KmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  IncidentProcessorPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref IncidentProcessorFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${HttpApi}/*/*'

  # ------------------------- SSM Parameters -------------------------

  SenderEmailParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/sender-email'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref SenderEmailAddress
      Description: Verified SES sender email address for on-call notifications.

  StateMachineArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/state-machine-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref IncidentStateMachine
      Description: ARN of the incident alerting Step Functions state machine.

  ApiEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/api-endpoint'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${HttpApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
      Description: Base endpoint URL of the incident HTTP API.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Config conformance pack for Amazon CloudWatch operational best practices, with self-contained Config recorder, delivery channel, and delivery bucket.

Parameters:
  AlarmActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Description: Require that CloudWatch alarms have alarm actions configured.
    Default: 'True'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'True'
      - 'False'
  InsufficientDataActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Description: Require that CloudWatch alarms have insufficient data actions configured.
    Default: 'True'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'True'
      - 'False'
  OkActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Description: Require that CloudWatch alarms have OK actions configured.
    Default: 'False'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'True'
      - 'False'
  MetricName:
    Type: String
    Description: Metric name that CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_RESOURCE_CHECK and CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_SETTINGS_CHECK evaluate.
    Default: CPUUtilization
    MinLength: 1
  ResourceType:
    Type: String
    Description: Resource type that CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_RESOURCE_CHECK and CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_SETTINGS_CHECK evaluate.
    Default: 'AWS::EC2::Instance'
    MinLength: 1

Conditions:
  HasAlarmActionRequired: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmActionRequired, '']]
  HasInsufficientDataActionRequired: !Not [!Equals [!Ref InsufficientDataActionRequired, '']]
  HasOkActionRequired: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OkActionRequired, '']]
  HasMetricName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref MetricName, '']]
  HasResourceType: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ResourceType, '']]

Resources:
  ConfigDeliveryBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the AWS Config delivery bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowConfigServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  ConfigDeliveryBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-config-delivery'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ConfigDeliveryBucketKey

  ConfigDeliveryLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  ConfigDeliveryLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ConfigDeliveryLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryLogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ConfigDeliveryLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${ConfigDeliveryLogsBucket.Arn}/config-delivery-access-logs/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  ConfigDeliveryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref ConfigDeliveryLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: config-delivery-access-logs/
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  ConfigDeliveryBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ConfigDeliveryBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowConfigDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/Config/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowConfigBucketAclCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:GetBucketAcl'
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  ConfigRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWS_ConfigRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConfigDeliveryBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:GetBucketAcl'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucketKey.Arn

  ConfigRecorder:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder
    Properties:
      Name: default
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ConfigRole.Arn
      RecordingGroup:
        AllSupported: true
        IncludeGlobalResourceTypes: true

  ConfigDeliveryChannel:
    Type: AWS::Config::DeliveryChannel
    Properties:
      Name: default
      S3BucketName: !Ref ConfigDeliveryBucket

  CloudWatchOperationalBestPracticesConformancePack:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConformancePack
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigDeliveryChannel
    Properties:
      ConformancePackName: CloudWatchOperationalBestPractices
      DeliveryS3Bucket: !Ref ConfigDeliveryBucket
      ConformancePackInputParameters:
        - ParameterName: AlarmActionRequired
          ParameterValue: !Ref AlarmActionRequired
        - ParameterName: InsufficientDataActionRequired
          ParameterValue: !Ref InsufficientDataActionRequired
        - ParameterName: OkActionRequired
          ParameterValue: !Ref OkActionRequired
        - ParameterName: MetricName
          ParameterValue: !Ref MetricName
        - ParameterName: ResourceType
          ParameterValue: !Ref ResourceType
      TemplateBody: !Sub
        - |
          Parameters:
            AlarmActionRequired:
              Type: String
              Default: 'True'
            InsufficientDataActionRequired:
              Type: String
              Default: 'True'
            OkActionRequired:
              Type: String
              Default: 'False'
            MetricName:
              Type: String
              Default: CPUUtilization
            ResourceType:
              Type: String
              Default: 'AWS::EC2::Instance'
          Resources:
            CloudWatchAlarmActionCheck:
              Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
              Properties:
                ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-action-check
                Source:
                  Owner: AWS
                  SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_CHECK
                Scope:
                  ComplianceResourceTypes:
                    - 'AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm'
                InputParameters:
                  alarmActionRequired: ${AlarmActionRequired}
                  insufficientDataActionRequired: ${InsufficientDataActionRequired}
                  okActionRequired: ${OkActionRequired}
            CloudWatchAlarmResourceCheck:
              Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
              Properties:
                ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-resource-check
                Source:
                  Owner: AWS
                  SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_RESOURCE_CHECK
                Scope:
                  ComplianceResourceTypes:
                    - 'AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm'
                InputParameters:
                  metricName: ${MetricName}
                  resourceType: ${ResourceType}
            CloudWatchAlarmSettingsCheck:
              Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
              Properties:
                ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-settings-check
                Source:
                  Owner: AWS
                  SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_SETTINGS_CHECK
                Scope:
                  ComplianceResourceTypes:
                    - 'AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm'
                InputParameters:
                  metricName: ${MetricName}
            CloudWatchLogGroupEncrypted:
              Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
              Properties:
                ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-log-group-encrypted
                Source:
                  Owner: AWS
                  SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP_ENCRYPTED
        - AlarmActionRequired: !If [HasAlarmActionRequired, !Ref AlarmActionRequired, 'True']
          InsufficientDataActionRequired: !If [HasInsufficientDataActionRequired, !Ref InsufficientDataActionRequired, 'True']
          OkActionRequired: !If [HasOkActionRequired, !Ref OkActionRequired, 'False']
          MetricName: !If [HasMetricName, !Ref MetricName, 'CPUUtilization']
          ResourceType: !If [HasResourceType, !Ref ResourceType, 'AWS::EC2::Instance']

Outputs:
  ConformancePackName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch operational best practices conformance pack.
    Value: !Ref CloudWatchOperationalBestPracticesConformancePack
  ConformancePackArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch operational best practices conformance pack.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:config:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:conformance-pack/${CloudWatchOperationalBestPracticesConformancePack}'
  ConfigDeliveryBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket used for AWS Config delivery.
    Value: !Ref ConfigDeliveryBucket
  ConfigDeliveryLogsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket used for Config delivery bucket access logs.
    Value: !Ref ConfigDeliveryLogsBucket
  ConfigDeliveryBucketKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key used for the Config delivery bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucketKey.Arn
  ConfigRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by AWS Config.
    Value: !GetAtt ConfigRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Encryption-at-rest foundation for the restaurant assistant application - customer managed KMS key, encrypted DynamoDB tables, and encrypted S3 buckets with access logging.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: restaurant-assistant
    Description: Project name used to derive resource names.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

Resources:
  DataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer managed key for ${ProjectName}-${Environment} data at rest
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAccountUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: AllowS3UseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*

  DataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataKey

  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-sessions
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: sessionId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: dataType
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: sessionId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: dataType
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  MarketPricesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-market-prices
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ingredient
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: marketName
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: lastUpdated
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ingredient
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: marketName
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: IngredientLastUpdatedIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: ingredient
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: lastUpdated
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  RemindersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reminders
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: reminderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: reminderId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  RateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rate-limits
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: rateLimitKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: rateLimitKey
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  AccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  AccessLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3LoggingDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AccessLogsBucket}/*
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt ImagesBucket.Arn

  ImagesBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-images-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: images/

  ImagesBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ImagesBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedObjectUploads
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ImagesBucket.Arn
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ImagesBucket}/*
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms

Outputs:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn

    Description: Friendly alias of the customer managed KMS key.

    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-kms-key-alias
  SessionsTableName:
    Description: Name of the sessions DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref SessionsTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-sessions-table-name
  MarketPricesTableName:
    Description: Name of the market prices DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref MarketPricesTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-market-prices-table-name
  RemindersTableName:
    Description: Name of the reminders DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref RemindersTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reminders-table-name
  RateLimitsTableName:

  ImagesBucketName:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared identity and state layer for a stateful agent demo on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
  (Cognito, DynamoDB, IAM, SSM). The seeded test user's password is not set by this
  template because CloudFormation has no native Cognito password property; set it
  out-of-band after deployment via: aws cognito-idp admin-set-user-password
  --user-pool-id <UserPoolId> --username <TestUserEmail> --password <password> --permanent

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: agentcore-demo
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    Description: Project name used to derive resource names and SSM parameter paths.
  TestUserEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: test@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    Description: Email address for the seeded test user (also used as the username).

Resources:
  AgentCoreDemoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  AgentCoreDemoUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-demo'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentCoreDemoUserPool

  AgentCoreDemoResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: !Sub '${ProjectName}-api'
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-api'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentCoreDemoUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: finance.read
          ScopeDescription: Read finance tracking state accumulated by the agent.
        - ScopeName: finance.write
          ScopeDescription: Write finance tracking state accumulated by the agent.
        - ScopeName: agent.invoke
          ScopeDescription: Invoke the agent runtime.

  M2MUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: AgentCoreDemoResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentCoreDemoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${AgentCoreDemoResourceServer}/finance.read'
        - !Sub '${AgentCoreDemoResourceServer}/finance.write'
        - !Sub '${AgentCoreDemoResourceServer}/agent.invoke'
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  WebUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: AgentCoreDemoResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentCoreDemoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub '${AgentCoreDemoResourceServer}/finance.read'
        - !Sub '${AgentCoreDemoResourceServer}/finance.write'
        - !Sub '${AgentCoreDemoResourceServer}/agent.invoke'
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/logout
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  SeededTestUser:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolUser
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentCoreDemoUserPool
      Username: !Ref TestUserEmail
      MessageAction: SUPPRESS
      UserAttributes:
        - Name: email
          Value: !Ref TestUserEmail
        - Name: email_verified
          Value: 'true'

  FinanceStateKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for the finance tracking DynamoDB table.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  FinanceTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-finance-state'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: pk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: pk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt FinanceStateKey.Arn

  MCPServerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-server-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-server-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBFinanceStateAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt FinanceTrackingTable.Arn
              - Sid: FinanceStateKeyUsage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FinanceStateKey.Arn
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/${ProjectName}-mcp-server:*'

  AgentRuntimeExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agent-runtime-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agent-runtime-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BedrockInvokeModel
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/*'
              - Sid: FinanceStateKeyUsage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FinanceStateKey.Arn
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/${ProjectName}-agent-runtime:*'

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/userPoolId'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref AgentCoreDemoUserPool

  UserPoolArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/userPoolArn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreDemoUserPool.Arn

  M2MClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/m2mClientId'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref M2MUserPoolClient

  WebClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/webClientId'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebUserPoolClient

  DiscoveryEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/discoveryEndpoint'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${AgentCoreDemoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  TokenEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/tokenEndpoint'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${AgentCoreDemoUserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  TableNameParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/dynamodb/tableName'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref FinanceTrackingTable

  MCPServerRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/iam/mcpServerRoleArn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MCPServerExecutionRole.Arn

  AgentRuntimeRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/iam/agentRuntimeRoleArn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt AgentRuntimeExecutionRole.Arn

  FinanceStateKeyArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/kms/financeStateKeyArn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt FinanceStateKey.Arn

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref AgentCoreDemoUserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreDemoUserPool.Arn
  M2MClientId:
    Description: Cognito machine-to-machine client ID.
    Value: !Ref M2MUserPoolClient
  WebClientId:
    Description: Cognito web client ID.
    Value: !Ref WebUserPoolClient
  HostedDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted domain prefix.
    Value: !Ref AgentCoreDemoUserPoolDomain
  FinanceTrackingTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB finance tracking table name.
    Value: !Ref FinanceTrackingTable
  MCPServerExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: IAM execution role ARN for the MCP server runtime.
    Value: !GetAtt MCPServerExecutionRole.Arn
  AgentRuntimeExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: IAM execution role ARN for the agent runtime.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentRuntimeExecutionRole.Arn
  FinanceStateKeyArn:
    Description: Customer-managed KMS key ARN for the finance tracking table.
    Value: !GetAtt FinanceStateKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Highly available two-tier VPC network with public and private subnets across two availability zones, NAT gateways per AZ, encrypted VPC flow logs, and exported network identifiers.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$'
    Description: Environment name applied as a tag.

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGateway1Eip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-1-eip'
        - Key: Environment
